title: F&B Manager – Events / Outdoor Catering
job_description:
Company Description
Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
Job Description
Position Overview
The F&B Manager – Events & Outdoor Catering is responsible for leading and managing all banquet food and beverage operations, social celebrations, weddings, corporate events, MICE functions, and outdoor catering assignments at Fairmont Mumbai and external venues.
The role focuses on delivering exceptional luxury hospitality experiences through meticulous event planning, flawless operational execution, personalized guest service, and strong commercial performance. The incumbent will work closely with the Sales & Events, Culinary, Stewarding, and other operational teams to translate client expectations into memorable experiences that reflect Fairmont’s commitment to excellence.
The position is accountable for driving revenue growth, optimizing profitability, maintaining service and food safety standards, managing operational resources, and developing a high-performing team. Particular emphasis is placed on outdoor catering logistics, client relationship management, cost control, risk mitigation, and ensuring consistent luxury service standards across all event locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Events & Banquet Operations
Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of weddings, social celebrations, corporate conferences, gala dinners, MICE functions, and other special events.
Ensure all events are executed in accordance with approved Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), client requirements, function sheets, timelines, and hotel standards.
Conduct pre-event briefings, operational readiness checks, and post-event reviews to ensure seamless delivery.
Coordinate with Sales & Events, Culinary, Stewarding, Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, and other departments to ensure operational alignment.
Maintain exceptional standards of food presentation, table setup, service etiquette, ambience, and guest engagement.
Monitor event progress and proactively resolve operational challenges while minimizing disruption to the guest experience.
Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and service resources are deployed based on event size, complexity, and service requirements.
2. Outdoor Catering Operations
Manage end-to-end outdoor catering operations at external venues, corporate premises, private residences, wedding locations, and other approved destinations.
Conduct venue inspections to assess infrastructure, kitchen facilities, utilities, accessibility, guest flow, safety requirements, and logistical feasibility.
Develop detailed event execution plans covering manpower, transportation, food dispatch, equipment, crockery, cutlery, linen, furniture, beverages, and service stations.
Coordinate with the Executive Chef and Culinary team to ensure food quality, safe transportation, temperature control, timely delivery, and appropriate presentation at external venues.
Supervise loading, dispatch, setup, service, replenishment, dismantling, and return of all hotel equipment and assets.
Establish contingency plans for adverse weather, traffic delays, power failures, equipment breakdowns, and last-minute changes in guest numbers.
Ensure that all external vendors and service partners adhere to agreed operational, hygiene, safety, and service standards.
Maintain accurate records of equipment movement, inventory, consumption, breakage, and losses for each assignment.
Ensure the outdoor catering experience reflects Fairmont's luxury positioning and service philosophy.
3. Guest Experience & Client Relationship Management
Collaborate with the Sales & Events team to understand client expectations, event objectives, budgets, themes, dietary preferences, and special requirements.
Participate in client meetings, menu tastings, venue inspections, and pre-event planning discussions.
Deliver personalized service to VIP guests, wedding families, corporate leaders, and high-profile clientele.
Ensure prompt and professional resolution of guest complaints, service concerns, and event-related issues.
Build strong relationships with corporate clients, wedding planners, event organizers, and external venue partners to encourage repeat business.
Obtain post-event feedback and implement improvements to enhance guest satisfaction and service delivery.
4. Revenue Generation & Business Development
Work with Sales & Events to identify opportunities for incremental revenue through premium menus, beverage packages, live counters, customized catering concepts, and value-added services.
Support business development initiatives to position Fairmont Mumbai as a preferred destination for luxury events and outdoor catering.
Identify opportunities across weddings, corporate gatherings, private celebrations, and premium off-site events.
Drive responsible upselling and cross-selling while maintaining guest satisfaction and brand positioning.
Monitor event revenue, average spend, contribution margins, and business performance against agreed targets.
Ensure operational feasibility and commercial viability of event commitments and customized client requests.
5. Financial Management & Cost Control
Monitor event budgets, food and beverage costs, labour expenses, equipment rentals, transportation, consumables, and outsourced services.
Work closely with Finance and Cost Control to review event costing, profitability, billing support, and financial reconciliation.
Control wastage, breakage, pilferage, unauthorized consumption, and unnecessary operational expenditure.
Ensure additional services and changes to client requirements are documented, approved, and communicated for accurate billing.
Review event profitability and recommend corrective measures to improve operating margins without compromising service quality.
Ensure efficient resource utilization and compliance with approved financial controls.
6. Food Safety, Hygiene & Risk Management
Ensure compliance with applicable food safety regulations, hotel hygiene standards, and established food handling procedures.
Monitor food storage, preparation, transportation, holding temperatures, display, replenishment, and service practices.
Ensure accurate communication and handling of allergens, dietary restrictions, and special meal requests.
Verify venue readiness, emergency access, equipment safety, fire precautions, and relevant operational permissions.
Ensure appropriate licensing, approvals, and compliance requirements are addressed for outdoor catering assignments.
Report incidents, near misses, food safety concerns, and guest injuries through established hotel procedures.
Conduct regular inspections and ensure corrective actions are implemented within the stipulated timelines.
7. People Management & Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop the Events, Banquet, and Outdoor Catering team to deliver consistent luxury service.
Prepare manpower plans and duty rosters aligned with event schedules, business volumes, and productivity requirements.
Conduct pre-shift briefings, service training, performance discussions, and on-the-job coaching.
Identify training needs in banquet service, outdoor catering logistics, guest engagement, upselling, and event execution.
Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, grooming, discipline, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate with People & Culture on recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, and colleague engagement.
Ensure fair workload distribution and adherence to hotel policies and applicable employment requirements.
Promote Fairmont's Heartist culture by encouraging respectful collaboration, colleague well-being, and service excellence.
8. Inventory & Operational Asset Management
Maintain accurate inventories of banquet equipment, crockery, cutlery, linen, furniture, portable bars, buffet equipment, and outdoor catering assets.
Ensure proper storage, cleanliness, maintenance, and availability of equipment for upcoming events.
Coordinate with Stewarding, Engineering, Purchasing, and approved vendors for repairs, servicing, rentals, and replacement requirements.
Implement standard checklists for event preparation, equipment dispatch, setup, dismantling, and reconciliation.
Monitor equipment utilization and minimize losses, breakage, and unnecessary replacement costs.
Ensure responsible waste management and sustainable operating practices, including reducing food waste and unnecessary single-use materials.
9. Reporting, Standards & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Fairmont brand standards, Accor policies, hotel SOPs, grooming guidelines, and service protocols.
Monitor guest satisfaction, event revenue, profitability, cost variances, operational productivity, and audit performance.
Prepare event performance reports, cost analyses, incident reports, inventory reconciliations, and management updates.
Conduct regular operational reviews and implement action plans to address service gaps and recurring issues.
Maintain accurate records of event requirements, client approvals, staffing deployment, equipment movement, and operational exceptions.
Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, operational efficiency, event concepts, and client experience.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of assigned event revenue and outdoor catering business targets.
Guest satisfaction, client feedback, and event experience scores.
Event profitability and adherence to food, beverage, and labour cost budgets.
Incremental revenue generation through upselling and customized offerings.
Accuracy of event costing, billing documentation, and financial reconciliation.
Compliance with food safety, hygiene, brand standards, and operational audits.
Manpower productivity, training completion, and colleague engagement.
Inventory accuracy and reduction in breakage, wastage, and equipment losses.
Client retention, repeat business, and quality of event execution.
Timely completion of reports, operational reviews, and corrective actions.
Qualifications
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Service, or a related discipline.
Approximately 5–8 years of relevant hospitality experience, including managerial or supervisory responsibility in banquet operations, events, or premium outdoor catering.
Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale weddings, corporate events, gala functions, and off-site catering assignments.
Strong understanding of banquet operations, food and beverage service, event logistics, costing, budgeting, and inventory management.
Experience managing premium clientele, event planners, corporate accounts, and external venue partners.
Knowledge of food safety, hygiene practices, risk management, and applicable hospitality regulations.
Additional Information
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Job Type: Permanent
Job Schedule: Full-Time Banquet operations Outdoor catering Event planning Luxury hospitality Team leadership Revenue management Cost control Client relationship management Food safety Logistics management Budgeting Inventory management Risk mitigation Upselling Staff training Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel or Hospitality Management. A minimum of 5–8 years of relevant experience in banquet operations, events, or premium outdoor catering is required.

title: Room Division Manager
job_description:
Company Description
Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
Job Description
POSITION PURPOSE
The Rooms Division Manager is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across the Rooms Division, ensuring seamless coordination between Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services, Concierge, Guest Relations, and other associated functions.
As a key leader within the hotel, the incumbent will champion the Fairmont philosophy of gracious, personalised and anticipatory service, ensuring that every guest experience reflects the sophistication, warmth and distinctive character of a luxury hospitality destination.
The role requires a strong balance of luxury service delivery, people leadership, operational efficiency, commercial acumen and brand compliance, with a focus on creating memorable guest experiences, developing high-performing teams and maximising departmental profitability.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Luxury Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Champion Fairmont’s luxury service philosophy, ensuring consistently personalised, intuitive and anticipatory service throughout the guest journey.
Establish a culture of genuine hospitality, attention to detail and meaningful guest engagement, ensuring that every interaction reflects the Fairmont brand promise.
Oversee guest arrival, registration, in-house experience and departure, ensuring a seamless, refined and memorable experience.
Personally engage with VIPs, luxury travellers, repeat guests, loyalty members and guests requiring special attention, ensuring their preferences are understood and thoughtfully delivered.
Drive effective guest feedback management, service recovery and complaint resolution, ensuring timely intervention and sustainable corrective action.
Monitor guest satisfaction scores, online reputation, loyalty engagement and quality audit results, translating insights into measurable service improvements.
Ensure the consistent delivery of Fairmont standards, luxury service rituals, brand service essentials and applicable quality assurance requirements.
2. Rooms Division Operations & Leadership
Provide overall operational oversight of Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Relations, Concierge, Bell Services and other assigned Rooms Division functions.
Ensure seamless coordination between Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management, Engineering, Security, Food & Beverage and other hotel departments.
Monitor room availability, occupancy, arrivals, departures, room readiness, room allocation, VIP movements and special guest requests to ensure operational preparedness.
Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, room presentation, maintenance, public-area appearance and overall product condition.
Ensure effective management of room discrepancies, out-of-order rooms, room moves, upgrades, overbooking situations and guest requests.
Conduct regular operational inspections, service observations and departmental reviews to identify opportunities for improvement.
Establish clear operating procedures, service standards, escalation protocols and accountability measures across all Rooms Division functions.
Ensure that operational decisions prioritise guest comfort, colleague safety, service quality and commercial performance.
3. Luxury Housekeeping & Product Presentation
Ensure guest rooms, suites, corridors, public areas and associated facilities consistently meet Fairmont's luxury standards.
Drive meticulous attention to detail in room presentation, amenities, linen quality, turndown service, cleanliness and the overall guest environment.
Collaborate with Engineering and other relevant departments to ensure timely resolution of maintenance concerns and preservation of the hotel product.
Monitor room inspection scores, cleaning productivity, turnaround times, guest feedback and quality audit findings.
Ensure appropriate management of lost and found items, guest belongings, room access and other housekeeping controls.
Oversee the effective use of operating supplies, linen, amenities and departmental resources without compromising the luxury guest experience.
4. Commercial Performance & Financial Management
Contribute to the hotel's rooms revenue strategy in partnership with Revenue Management, Sales and Reservations, supporting occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), RevPAR and overall profitability.
Monitor Rooms Division budgets, payroll, labour productivity, operating expenses and departmental financial performance.
Identify opportunities to optimise room inventory, upselling, room upgrades and ancillary revenue while protecting brand positioning and guest satisfaction.
Ensure effective workforce planning, roster management, productivity monitoring and deployment of colleagues in line with business volumes.
Control departmental costs, inventory, consumables and operating supplies while maintaining the standards expected of a luxury hotel.
Review financial reports, departmental performance indicators and budget variances, implementing appropriate corrective measures.
Contribute to forecasting, annual budgeting, capital expenditure planning and operational business reviews.
5. People Leadership & Talent Development
Lead, inspire and develop Rooms Division leaders and colleagues, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability and service excellence.
Demonstrate visible leadership and act as a role model for Fairmont's values, professional conduct and luxury service standards.
Ensure effective manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, succession planning and colleague engagement.
Identify high-potential talent and establish development plans, cross-training opportunities and career progression pathways.
Conduct regular performance discussions, departmental briefings, coaching sessions and leadership reviews.
Promote a respectful, inclusive and psychologically safe working environment where colleagues feel valued and empowered to deliver exceptional service.
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, the Accor Code of Ethics, applicable employment laws and workplace standards.
Collaborate with People & Culture to address employee relations matters, training requirements, engagement opportunities and performance concerns.
6. Brand Standards, Quality Assurance & Compliance
Ensure compliance with Fairmont brand standards, Accor operating procedures, quality assurance requirements and applicable luxury hospitality benchmarks.
Lead departmental readiness for internal and external quality audits, inspections and brand assessments.
Review audit findings, guest feedback trends and operational gaps, ensuring clear ownership, corrective action and timely closure.
Maintain effective controls relating to guest privacy, data protection, key management, cash handling, billing accuracy, security and incident reporting.
Ensure compliance with fire and life safety procedures, emergency response protocols, hygiene requirements and applicable statutory regulations.
Promote responsible and sustainable operating practices in line with the hotel's environmental and social commitments.
7. Interdepartmental Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Work closely with the Director of Operations, Hotel Manager and Executive Committee to achieve the hotel's strategic, operational and financial objectives.
Establish strong working relationships with Revenue Management, Sales, Reservations, Engineering, Food & Beverage, Finance, Security and People & Culture.
Partner with the Reservations and Revenue teams to optimise room allocation, inventory utilisation, upselling and guest preference management.
Coordinate with Sales and Events teams to ensure seamless execution of VIP arrivals, group movements, events and special guest requirements.
Ensure timely communication of operational priorities, guest concerns, incidents and service recovery measures to relevant stakeholders.
Represent the Rooms Division in operational meetings, business reviews, quality discussions and strategic planning sessions.
8. Innovation, Continuous Improvement & Guest Personalisation
Identify opportunities to enhance the guest journey through service innovation, digital solutions, process improvement and personalised hospitality.
Use guest profiles, preference history, feedback and operational data to anticipate needs and create tailored experiences.
Encourage teams to develop thoughtful, distinctive service touches that elevate the Fairmont experience beyond standard expectations.
Review emerging luxury hospitality trends and benchmark service practices to maintain competitiveness and relevance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction, colleague productivity, operational consistency and profitability.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated against agreed hotel and departmental targets, including:
Guest satisfaction, online reputation and loyalty engagement scores.
Fairmont brand compliance, quality assurance and LQA audit performance, as applicable.
Rooms Division operational excellence and service delivery standards.
Room readiness, housekeeping inspection scores and maintenance resolution.
Rooms revenue contribution, upselling performance and inventory optimisation.
Departmental payroll, operating expenses, productivity and budget adherence.
Guest complaint resolution, service recovery effectiveness and repeat guest satisfaction.
Colleague engagement, retention, training completion and internal talent development.
Compliance with safety, security, brand and statutory requirements.
Successful execution of departmental improvement plans and operational initiatives.
Qualifications
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.
Typically 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel operations, including substantial leadership experience within the Rooms Division of a luxury or upper-upscale hotel.
Previous experience in a Rooms Division leadership role or equivalent senior operational position is preferred.
Experience in luxury hotel environments, preferably with an internationally recognised hospitality brand.
Strong understanding of Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Relations, Concierge and overall rooms operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, forecasting, labour productivity, guest satisfaction and quality assurance.
Familiarity with hotel property management systems, guest feedback platforms, revenue systems and operational reporting tools.
Demonstrated capability in leading diverse teams, developing talent and delivering measurable operational improvements.
Additional Information
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

title: Product Lead, UI Platform
job_description:
About The Role
The UI Platform team develops a set of modular components and frameworks that are used by all Rippling products in web and mobile clients. This provides a consistent, exceptional experience to Rippling customers while allowing Rippling product teams to leverage existing components rather than building from scratch. 

Additionally, you will be responsible for the core Rippling experience; from the homepage that users see when they log in to Rippling on web & mobile to how they navigate to different parts of the product. You will ensure that Rippling users – admins, managers and employees – see value quickly from Rippling. 
What You'll Do: 
You will own a suite of Rippling platform products that meet the evolving needs of Rippling applications and the customers they serve
You will uncover product opportunities for our platform to deliver exceptional value to its applications
You’ll be eager to roll up your sleeves and dig into the technical details while obsessing over a simple, intuitive customer experience
You’ll work cross-functionally with virtually every team – across product, engineering, design, marketing, and customer-facing functions – to design an extensible system that can meet the evolving needs of Rippling product teams and our customers 
Qualifications:
8+ years of Product Management experience
Experience working on platform features that are used by other products/developers
Obsessed with providing an elegant user experience with attention to detail and bias toward simplicity
Strong ability to motivate others and drive cross-team execution
Alignment with our leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, We go and see
If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes. Product Management Platform Development UI Design Cross-functional Collaboration User Experience Technical Strategy Stakeholder Management System Design Mobile Development Web Development Product Strategy Customer Experience Candidates must have 8+ years of product management experience, specifically with platform features used by other developers. You should possess a strong focus on elegant user experience, simplicity, and the ability to drive cross-team execution.

title: Senior AI Engineer
job_description:
Job Summary:

Responsible for building high-quality, innovative and fully performing software
in compliance with coding standards and technical design. Design, modify,
develop, write and implement software programming applications. Support and/or
install software applications. Key participant in the testing process through
test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Develop software solutions by studying information needs; conferring with users;
studying systems flow, data usage and work processes; investigating problem
areas; following the software development lifecycle; Document and demonstrate
solutions; Develops flow charts, layouts and documentation Determine feasibility
by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development
and proposed solutions; Understand business needs and know how to create the
tools to manage them Prepare and install solutions by determining and designing
system specifications, standards and programming Recommend state-of-the-art
development tools, programming techniques and computing equipment; participate
in educational opportunities; read professional publications; maintain personal
networks; participate in professional organizations; remain passionate about
great technologies, especially open source Provide information by collecting,
analyzing, and summarizing development and issues while protecting IT assets by
keeping information confidential; Improve applications by conducting systems
analysis recommending changes in policies and procedures Define applications and
their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to applications, understand solution
deployment, and communicate requirements for interactions with solution context,
define Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs) Understands multiple architectures and
how to apply architecture to solutions; understands programming and testing
standards; understands industry standards for traditional and agile development
Provide oversight and foster Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility;
Adopt new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting
decentralized decision making.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Competencies: Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and
best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the
design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems,
software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
Programming Principles - Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns
to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that
are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable. Data Principles - Governs,
models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity,
quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.
Modern Development Practices - Applies modern engineering practices and
tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as
code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC.
Solution Design - Translate business requirements into integrated designs,
architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and
align with enterprise standards and subject-matter platforms. Demonstrating
Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains,
tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials
and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against
strategic needs. Strategic and Innovative Thinking - Evaluates business and
technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and
frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost-aware
innovation. Technical Passion & Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for
technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with
emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate
business performance. Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with
urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions,
guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum
and deliver consistent results. Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity
and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and
influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and
cultures bring to an organization. Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a
customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and
business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and
realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.
Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree
in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent
experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with
export controls or sanctions regulations. Experience: Experience working as a
software engineer with the following knowledge and experiences are preferred: -
Working in Agile environments; - Fundamental IT technical skill sets; - Taking a
system from coping requirements through actual launch of the system; -
Communicating with users, other technical teams and management to collect
requirements, identify tasks, provide estimates and meet production deadlines; -
Professional software engineering best practices for the full software
development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control
management, build processes, testing and operations.


QUALIFICATIONS

Role Summary: The AI Engineer will design, build, validate, and deploy
AI-enabled solutions that help Cummins teams convert complex operating, product,
engineering, and business data into practical recommendations and intelligent
workflows. This role will work closely with product owners, data scientists,
data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver reusable AI
capabilities across the Analytics and AI portfolio.

Skills

 * Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to
   design AI solutions for complex business and technical challenges.
 * Ability to bridge software engineering fundamentals with modern AI/GenAI
   technologies to deliver production-ready solutions.
 * Effective communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts,
   architecture decisions, and technical recommendations to both technical and
   non-technical stakeholders.
 * Customer-focused mindset with the ability to understand business problems and
   translate them into scalable AI applications.

 * Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and decision-making capabilities in
   fast-paced and evolving technology environments.
   
    

Technical Skills

 * AI Engineering & Generative AI
   * Strong experience building, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered
     applications and intelligent agents.
   * Expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) application development and
     Generative AI solution design.
   * Experience developing agentic AI workflows, multi-agent systems, and AI
     orchestration frameworks.
   * Knowledge of prompt engineering, agent evaluation, guardrails, grounding
     techniques, and AI application observability.
   * Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search,
     vector databases, and knowledge management architectures.
 * Open Source AI Frameworks
   * Hands-on experience with modern AI orchestration frameworks including
     LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex Hugging Face, Open-Source LLM ecosystems
   * Experience integrating both commercial and open-source foundation models.
   * Knowledge of model serving, inference optimization, and AI workflow
     orchestration patterns.
 * Software Engineering & Application Development
   * Strong proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade
     applications and APIs.
   * Experience with modern software engineering practices including
     object-oriented design, design patterns, testing, and secure coding
     principles.
   * Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven
     architectures.
   * Familiarity with front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar
     frameworks for AI application development.
   * Understanding of distributed systems and scalable application architecture.

title: Senior Associate - Tech Operations Engineering
job_description:
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the
American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with
trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We
support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data
capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is
responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and
infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality
experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for
core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security,
enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and
enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in computer science, computer science
engineering or related technical experience. 6 + years of varied experience in
software engineering. 

 * Experience with identifying application/infrastructure risks and mitigation
   strategy and the ability to work with a team to ensure risks are mitigated.

 * Experience with debugging techniques for root cause analysis of issues.

 * Experience working with monitoring tools - application performance
   monitoring, AIOps or an equivalent tool to improve overall efficiency.

 * ITIL solid understanding: Event, Incident, Release, Problem and Knowledge
   Management. 

 * Experience in one or more of the following: programming languages,
   networking, Linux/Windows, mainframe, middleware, databases, cloud.

 * Proficient verbal and written communication skills.

 * Soft skills – analytical thinking, curiosity, continuous learning and
   improvement attitude 


QUALIFICATIONS

 * Performance troubleshooting and tuning, experience implementing high
   availability solutions like Always on, Clustering, Mirroring etc.

 * DevOps knowledge for highly available IT infrastructure

 * Building live production APIs and services.

 * Experience with automation development.

 * Familiar with Agile or other rapid application development methods.

 * Hands-on expertise with application design, software development and
   automated testing.

 * Experience in technology for the banking and payments industries


At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of
innovation, shared values 
[https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/company/who-we-are/]and Leadership
Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and
colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class
customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to
uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive
support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills,
develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter,
your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of
American Express.


We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be
and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical,
financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to
thrive personally and professionally:



 * Competitive base salaries
 * Bonus incentives
 * Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability
   benefits (depending on location)
 * Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending
   on role and business need
 * Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 * Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and
   doctors (depending on location)
 * Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 * Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions
without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other
status protected by law.



Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful
completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and
regulations. Software engineering Application risk management Infrastructure risk management Debugging Root cause analysis Application performance monitoring AIOps ITIL Networking Linux Windows Middleware Database management Cloud computing Automation development Agile Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field and at least 6 years of software engineering experience. Proficiency in ITIL processes, infrastructure troubleshooting, and experience with cloud or middleware technologies is required.

title: Assistant Manager - Restaurant
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if
applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists
with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts
on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and
employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then
implements plan.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage,
culinary, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel
and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related
major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related
professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

title: Kitchen Stewarding Associate
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Operate and maintain cleaning equipment and tools, including the dish washing
machine, hand wash stations pot-scrubbing station, and trash compactor. Wash and
disinfect kitchen and store room areas, tables, tools, knives, and equipment.
Receive deliveries, store perishables properly, and rotate stock. Ensure clean
wares are stored in appropriate areas. Use detergent, rinsing, and sanitizing
chemicals in the 3-compartment sink to clean dishes. Inspect, pull, and stack
cleaned items, send soiled items back for re-scrubbing and re-washing. Rack and
spray all racked items with hot water to loosen and remove food residue. Sort,
soak, and wash/re-wash silverware. Breakdown dirty bus tubs. Empty and maintain
trashcans and dumpster area. Clean and mop all areas in assigned departments.
Dispose of glass in the proper containers. Break down cardboard boxes and place
them and other recyclables in the recycle bin.

 

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report
maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager;
complete safety training and certifications. Protect company assets. Speak with
others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive
working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure
adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull,
and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the
knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other
reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

title: Procurement Coordinator - Level III
job_description:
Job Summary:

Works independently to update procurement systems and coordinates approval and
control of procurement activities. Provides support to sourcing and finance
teams globally.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Proactively contacts suppliers to maintain pertinent data, obtain needed
documentation, and enable suppliers in procurement systems. Support
identification/resolution of supplier invoice and payment issues. Support
completion, closure, and recording activities for various contracts and other
supplier documentation. Prepare documentation for sourcing events.
Initiate/Support work delivering results in meeting cost, quality, delivery, and
inventory goals. Support supplier quality activities with supplier quality
improvement engineers, suppliers, and category teams. Liaison between
procurement teams and other functions. Participating in health safety and
environmental awareness and improvement activities and daily tasks. Perform any
other tasks assigned. Participate in Project teams, when necessary, to ensure
effective implementation of change. Communicate with the supplier and work with
supplier to manage Project deliverables within agreed timelines. Use common
process tools and business systems to provide repeatable analytics and
reporting. Ensure data integrity of all procurement information as it is created
and deliver ongoing improvement of existing data. Identify improvements for
business processes. Global focus may be required.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Competencies:
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and
cultures bring to an organization.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned
with organizational goals.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense
of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks
inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications
that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering
customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet
commitments.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty,
integrity, and authenticity.

Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of
people.

Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or
the way forward is not clear.

title: Housekeeping Executive
job_description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team,
that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Your meticulous
attention to detail and commitment to excellence will help create an
unforgettable experience for our guests. As a Housekeeping Executive, you’re not
just ensuring the cleanliness of guest rooms – you’re spreading the light and
warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for
every guest.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

 * Keep guest rooms spotless:  Clean and tidy assigned rooms, including making
   beds, cleaning bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, and performing deep cleaning
   tasks as needed
 * Replenish linens and amenities:  Replace bed linens, towels, and guest
   essentials as needed
 * Manage supplies:  Stock, maintain, and transport the housekeeping supply cart
   daily
 * Delight our guests:  Respond to guest requests promptly and courteously
 * Manage waste disposal:  Dispose of trash and recyclables in designated areas


QUALIFICATIONS

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the
qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with
Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership.
A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and
accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every
moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

 * Minimum of 1 year of experience in the Housekeeping department
 * Prior housekeeping or room attendant experience preferred, especially in
   hospitality.
 * Ability to maintain high cleanliness and presentation standards.
 * Capable of performing physically demanding tasks (e.g., lifting, bending,
   standing for long periods).
 * Courteous and professional when interacting with guests.
 * Efficient in completing tasks within set timeframes.
 * Works well with housekeeping and other hotel departments.
 * Available to work shifts, including weekends and holidays.
 * Basic proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
 * Knowledge of cleaning chemicals and safety procedures.


Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build
an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a
global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests
worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with
the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best
Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of
world-class brands [https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/],

a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re
setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports
your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and
help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog
[https://jobs.hilton.com/blogs] to see why we’re more than a great place to
stay—we’re a great place to work.  Housekeeping Cleaning Attention to detail Hospitality Customer service Time management Waste disposal Inventory management Safety procedures Teamwork Communication Candidates must have at least one year of housekeeping experience and the ability to perform physically demanding tasks. Proficiency in English and knowledge of cleaning chemicals and safety procedures are also required.

title: Events Executive
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that
guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any
deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary
supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc.
Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete
scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor
dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of
guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.

 

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling,
disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model
and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy
process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures;
report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete
safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are
clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and
protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company
standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with
disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others
using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working
relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and
respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to
quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and
implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality,
safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety
of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines
(e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time
or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects
weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and
manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and
hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move
up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees,
including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job
duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

 

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every
opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the
globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of
"Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt,
forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With
the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to
welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott
Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you
can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and
become the best version of you.

JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of
more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort
locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if
you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident,
innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake
and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience
unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie
with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training,
development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your
passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating
guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's
The JW Treatment. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with
Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose,
belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. Team leadership Staff training Inventory management Customer service Maintenance coordination Conflict resolution Safety compliance Operational efficiency Communication Problem solving Time management Attention to detail Hospitality management Scheduling Performance management Candidates must have at least 2 years of related work experience and at least 1 year of supervisory experience. A high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent is required for this position.

title: Hotel Cleanliness Expert
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest
Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with
responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole
hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be
done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and
public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert
makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

 

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to
success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures,
maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your
uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest
Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk
for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry,
push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without
assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as
requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our
guests and our business each and every time.

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


At Courtyard, we’re passionate about better serving the needs of travelers
everywhere. It’s what inspired us to create the first hotel designed
specifically for business travelers, and it’s why the Courtyard experience today
empowers our guests, no matter the purpose of their trip. We’re looking for
achievers who are passionate about providing a guest experience that goes above
and beyond, enjoy being part of a small yet ambitious team, and love learning
how to always improve – all while having fun.


In joining Courtyard, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott
International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to
an amazing global  team, and become the best version of you. Housekeeping Cleaning Customer Service Attention To Detail Physical Stamina Time Management Safety Compliance Professional Communication Candidates must be able to perform physical tasks such as lifting up to 50 pounds and standing or walking for extended periods. Professionalism in communication, appearance, and adherence to company policies is required.

title: Senior Director, Data Engineering
job_description:
Company Description
NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.
For more information, visit NIQ.com
Job Description
Summary 
We’re seeking a visionary technology leader to drive innovation and scale in our Consumer Panel Services. This role blends strategic leadership, technical excellence, and global collaboration to deliver impactful solutions that shape consumer insights across industries. 
Key Responsibilities 
Define and execute the technology strategy and roadmap for CPS initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and client needs. 
Lead the development and deployment of scalable, high-performance solutions for customer input management, including shopper data integration, panel expansion, analytics platforms, data processing, calibration, and cross-platform integration. 
Oversee cloud transformation efforts, optimizing the technology stack to deliver high-margin business outcomes. 
Manage delivery timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 
Monitor and enhance system performance for efficiency, accuracy, and security, including incident response protocols. 
Build and maintain strong partnerships with Product, Operations, Data Science, EIT, and Architecture teams, serving as a trusted technology advisor. 
Ensure robust data governance and compliance, proactively addressing security and privacy risks. 
Provide mentorship and leadership to the technology team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth. 
Qualifications
Proven experience in building and managing enterprise-grade systems with a focus on data management, processing, and analytics. 
Strong leadership and product development capabilities, with a track record of driving measurable outcomes. 
Proficiency in Big Data technologies such as Spark, Snowflake, and Databricks. 
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including Azure and AWS. 
Familiarity with third-party data providers and deep understanding of consumer-sourced data. 
Expertise in Agile methodologies, DevSecOps, and modern software development practices. 
Solid understanding of data security and compliance, with experience implementing safeguards in data-intensive environments. 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field. 
15+ years of experience in data and software engineering, architecture, and design. 
Strong background in distributed computing and cloud-native technologies. 
Experience leading SAFe Agile and DevSecOps adoption. 
Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Data Science, and Product teams. 
Proven ability to train and upskill engineering teams in emerging technologies. 
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making. 
Additional Information
Our Benefits
Flexible working environment
Volunteer time off
LinkedIn Learning
Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)
NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a
banquet or event. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and
unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in
a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a
wide range of services to make sure that guests’ experience is well taken care
of from start to finish. Whether setting tables and event materials
communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning
work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like
part of the experience.

 

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report
maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager;
complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal
appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary
information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests
according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional
language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others;
support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and

pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by

version of you. job_description:

Experience: 15+ yrs
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for a strategic and commercially driven Business Head – Commercial Interiors & Interior Architecture to lead business growth, project delivery, client relationships, and operational excellence. The role requires a strong combination of business leadership, commercial acumen, design understanding, and project management expertise within the commercial interiors industry.
The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of driving revenue, developing strategic client relationships, managing large-scale interior projects, and building high-performing teams. This position offers the opportunity to shape business strategy, strengthen market presence, and deliver high-quality commercial interior solutions aligned with client objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute business strategies to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion in commercial interiors and interior architecture.
Identify new business opportunities across corporate offices, workplaces, commercial establishments, and other relevant segments.
Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, architects, consultants, developers, and decision-makers.
Lead client acquisition, presentations, proposal development, commercial negotiations, and contract closures.
Oversee the complete project lifecycle, including client briefing, design conceptualisation, space planning, budgeting, design development, execution, and handover.
Ensure interior architecture and design solutions align with client requirements, functionality, aesthetics, technical feasibility, and brand guidelines.
Review project estimates, BOQs, tender documents, vendor quotations, budgets, and commercial proposals to maintain cost efficiency and profitability.
Monitor project schedules, resource allocation, procurement, quality, and execution standards across multiple engagements.
Collaborate with design, engineering, procurement, project management, and site execution teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
Establish and monitor business performance metrics, revenue targets, project margins, cost controls, and client satisfaction.
Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across business development, design, and project execution.
Identify operational improvements, strengthen internal processes, and implement scalable systems for business growth.
Stay informed about commercial interior design trends, workplace strategies, materials, technologies, and evolving client expectations.
Manage project risks, resolve escalations, and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, safety requirements, and applicable standards.
What Makes You a Great Fit
15+ years of professional experience in commercial interiors, interior architecture, workplace design, or related sectors, with substantial business leadership exposure.
Proven experience leading business operations, driving revenue growth, and managing large commercial interior projects.
Strong understanding of commercial interiors, interior architecture, space planning, materials, finishes, and construction methodologies.
Demonstrated expertise in business development, enterprise client acquisition, commercial negotiations, and strategic account management.
Strong financial acumen, including project costing, budgeting, BOQs, margin management, and profitability analysis.
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating design, procurement, and execution functions.
Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to balance design quality, commercial objectives, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery.
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and a results-oriented approach.
A degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Business leadership Commercial interiors Interior architecture Project management Business development Strategic planning Client relationship management Space planning Budgeting Project lifecycle management Financial acumen Team leadership Contract negotiation Workplace design Procurement Quality control Candidates must have 15+ years of professional experience in commercial interiors or interior architecture with a proven track record in business leadership. A degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or Civil Engineering is preferred, along with strong financial and strategic acumen.

title: Team Member Production (Granulation/Compression) Operator
job_description:
Company Description
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because Good Health Can’t Wait.
We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries. 
For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
Job Description
Job Summary
This role is for a Production Operator responsible for setting up, calibrating, and operating manufacturing equipment, ensuring compliance with GMP, GDP, and safety standards. The position involves preparing raw materials, conducting in-process checks, maintaining documentation, and performing cleaning and sanitization activities. You will contribute to operational excellence by supporting preventive maintenance, troubleshooting minor equipment issues, and implementing CAPA for repeat problems. The role emphasizes adherence to SOPs, personal safety practices, and continuous improvement through Kaizen, 5S, and lean initiatives. Additionally, you will engage in training programs, safety drills, and digital system usage (SOR, OEE dashboards) to strengthen operational efficiency and compliance.
Roles & Responsibilities
• You will be responsible for setting up and calibrating machinery, preparing raw materials, and ensuring readiness for production.
• You will be responsible for conducting in-process checks (weight variation, hardness, disintegration) to maintain product quality.
• You will be responsible for recording production activities, maintaining GMP documentation, and supporting internal/external audits.
• You will be responsible for cleaning and sanitizing equipment, performing CLTI activities, and verifying calibration of instruments.
• You will be responsible for troubleshooting minor equipment issues, supporting preventive maintenance, and implementing CAPA for repeat problems.
• You will be responsible for following PPE, hygiene, and safety standards, reporting incidents, and executing LOTO procedures.
• You will be responsible for participating in training sessions, safety drills, SOP updates, and engaging in Kaizen, 5S, and lean initiatives.
• You will be responsible for using computerized systems (SOR), digital dashboards (OEE, Plant Visibility, AMPLE), and supporting root cause analysis to improve efficiency.
Qualifications
Educational qualification: Diploma in Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or related field is mandatory.
Minimum work experience: 
2+ / 4+ years of experience
Skills & attributes &Critical exposures
Functional Skills 
• Batch Production
• Cleanrooms
• Equipment Maintenance
• Incident Reporting
• Quality Management
• Pharmaceutical Batch Documentation
• Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
Resident Skills
• Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPS)
• Digital Literacy
• Good Documentation Practices
• Total Productive Maintenance
• Lean Methodologies
Behavioural Skills
• Safety-first mindset with strong compliance and regulatory alignment
• Collaborative across production, quality, and cross-functional teams
• Continuous improvement orientation with problem-solving and innovation
Critical exposures
• Experience in the setup and operation of equipment used in the manufacturing of OSD products is desired.
• Experience in digital systems, material handling, inventory accuracy and adherence to safety protocol is desired.
• Exposure in troubleshooting machinery used in granulation, blending, compression, coating and packaging is preferred.
Additional Information

Benefits Offered
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

Our Work Culture
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/

A minimum of 2 to 4 years of relevant experience is required, with a preference for experience in OSD product manufacturing and digital systems.

Responsible verifying that operations are in compliance with hygiene and food
safety standards. Advises on proper food handling practices and provides food
hygiene training for all new hires and trainees. Identifies key areas of risk in
various food operations and takes preemptive remedial action. Provides technical
advice on product labeling issues for fulfilling government requriements.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the food and beverage,
culinary, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant
Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major.

 

Preferred: 

Environmental Health Degree or Culinary Degree

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Managing Hygience and Food Safety Operations

• Verifies compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA) requriements of Marriott
International throughout the operations.

• Advises and monitors food handlers on the proper good handling practices and
verifies their observance.

• Identifies key areas of risk in various food operations and takes preemptive
remedial action.

and codes of practice relating to food operations.

requirements.

health departments on food hygiene matters.

culinary leadership.

cleaning staff.

defects and non-conformities are remedied by the appropriate parties.

identifying trends and making recommendation for improvements.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.

• Liases with pest control company for any pest issues and monitors pest control
performance.

• Maintains and makes improvements to hygiene standards.

• Regularly reviews and refreshes the food safety standards of all food handlers
withing the property.

• Maintains documentation on all hygiene and food safety stadards throughout the
operation.
