title: Senior Java Engineer (Design & DSA)
job_description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Company Description
Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.
Position Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.
As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.
Job Duties and Responsibilities
Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
Java Expertise: Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework.
Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
API Design: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs for enterprise integration.
Problem Solving & Ownership: Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.
Nice to Haves
Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).
Education and Training
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Assistant Bar Manager
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if
applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists
with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts
on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and
employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then
implements plan.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage,
culinary, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel
and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related
major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related
professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team

• Handles employee questions and concerns.

• Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.

• Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

• Assists in supervising daily shift operations.

• Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of
Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.

• Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent
message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.

 

Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations

• Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.

• Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality
and service levels.

• Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.

• Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.

• Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as
necessary.

• Opens and closes restaurant shifts.

 

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service
levels.

• Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and
financial objectives are met.

• Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.

• Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as
necessary.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with
employees.

• Meets and greets guests.

 

Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Supervises on-going training initiatives.

• Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for
each position.

• Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.

 

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by
telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and
solve problems.

• Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand
times.

• Recognizes good quality products and presentations.

• Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if
applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists
with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts
on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and
employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then
implements plan.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage,
culinary, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel
and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related
major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related
professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team

• Handles employee questions and concerns.

• Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.

• Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

• Assists in supervising daily shift operations.

• Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of
Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.

• Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent
message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.

 

Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations

• Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.

• Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality
and service levels.

• Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.

• Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.

• Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as
necessary.

• Opens and closes restaurant shifts.

 

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service
levels.

• Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and
financial objectives are met.

• Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.

• Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as
necessary.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with
employees.

• Meets and greets guests.

 

Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Supervises on-going training initiatives.

• Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for
each position.

• Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.

 

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by
telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and
solve problems.

• Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand
times.

• Recognizes good quality products and presentations.

• Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing
food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix
ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards,
presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.
Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine
if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing
food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto
proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and
equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and
food.

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India’s most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
About the role
The Apprentice role at Origin is for high-potential early-career engineers who are ready to contribute immediately. This is not a passive learning role; you will be writing production code from Day 1. You will be assigned specific modules (e.g., a specific sensor driver, a safety monitor, or a diagnostic tool) and expected to deliver robust solutions under the guidance of Senior Engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Module Development:
Develop C++ drivers for auxiliary sensors and actuators within the ROS 2 framework.
Implement state machines for robot subsystems (e.g., gripper logic, battery management).
Optimize existing code for performance and readability.
System Support:
Assist in porting algorithms from Python prototypes to efficient C++ implementations.
Maintain the build system (CMake) and CI/CD pipelines for specific packages.
Perform hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and validate software releases on physical robots.
Debugging & Diagnosis:
Monitor robot telemetry during field tests and flag anomalies in sensor data.
Debug network issues and configuration mismatches in the robot's internal network.
Required Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, CS, Robotics, or equivalent).
0-2 years of experience (strong internship or project portfolio required).
Strong C++ fundamentals (pointers, memory management, OOP).
Familiarity with Linux CLI and basic shell scripting.
Understanding of basic Robotics concepts (transforms, kinematics).
Demonstrated ability to build systems (e.g., FSAE, Robocon, complex hobby projects).
Preferred Experiences
Previous exposure to ROS/ROS 2.
Experience with microcontroller interrupts and timers.
Basic PCB soldering and hardware debugging skills.
Gain experience in a dynamic startup environment at the forefront of robotics and AI innovation.
Contribute to the development of technology that will revolutionize the construction industry.
Work alongside a talented and passionate team committed to making a real-world impact.
Learn from experienced professionals and gain valuable skills in robotics software engineering.
Gain practical experience in a real-world engineering environment.

Role Summary

The Packaging Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation,
and optimization of packaging solutions to ensure product and environment
protection, cost efficiency, regulatory compliance, and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

 * Design and develop package solutions.
 * Support packaging validation through simulated and physical testing methods.
 * Collaborate with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, service,
   marketing, procurement, logistics, and suppliers.

   international / national regulations.
 * Support continuous improvement and cost‑reduction initiatives.

Required Qualifications

title: Apprentice - Embedded Hardware, Power & Safety
job_description:
About Origin
Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India’s most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
About the role
The Apprentice Engineer role is for high-potential early-career hardware engineers who want to build industrial-grade systems. You won't be confined to simulations; you will be dealing with real hardware, real power, and real testing from Day 1. Under the mentorship of Senior Engineers, you will own specific circuit modules, build test infrastructure, and learn the rigorous processes of reliable hardware design.
Key Responsibilities
Module Design & Prototyping:
Design simple, 2-to-4 layer PCBs (e.g., breakout boards, simple power regulators) using ECAD software.
Assemble prototype circuits using soldering irons, hot air rework stations, and breadboards.
Build custom wire harnesses for robot prototypes, ensuring proper crimping and routing.
Testing, Validation & HIL:
Assist in the setup and execution of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) tests, writing basic test cases to validate firmware behavior against simulated hardware.
Execute rigorous testing protocols on battery packs, inverters, and custom PCBs.
Use electronic loads to stress-test power delivery networks and document thermal performance using thermal cameras.
Assist in diagnosing electrical faults on the physical robot during field trials.
Hardware Defined Safety:
Prototype and test physical hardware safety interlocks. Wire physical E-stop buttons, limit switches, and thermal sensor fault lines into the main Power Distribution Board (PDB), ensuring that triggered error signals successfully break the power circuit without software intervention.
Required Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
0-2 years of experience (strong internship or university project portfolio demonstrating hardware creation is required).
Basic proficiency in at least one PCB design tool (KiCad, Eagle, or Altium).
Solid grasp of fundamental electronics (Ohm's law, voltage dividers, RC filters, basic transistor logic).
Exceptional hands-on skills: comfortable soldering, crimping, and using power tools.
Familiarity with the concepts of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
Demonstrated ability to build complex electromechanical systems (e.g., Solar Car, FSAE, combat robots).
Preferred Experiences
Experience with high-voltage or high-current hobby projects.
Basic Python or C skills for writing automation scripts.
For apprentice/Intern : 
This is a six-month contract-to-hire position, with potential for longer-term opportunities depending on your contributions and interests. We’re excited to work with motivated individuals who are eager to support real-world robot development and grow alongside us.
Gain experience in a dynamic startup environment at the forefront of robotics and AI innovation.
Contribute to the development of technology that will revolutionize the construction industry.
Work alongside a talented and passionate team committed to making a real-world impact.
Learn from experienced professionals and gain valuable skills in robotics software engineering.
Gain practical experience in a real-world engineering environment.
Contribute to a project with the potential to make a significant impact on the construction industry. PCB Design KiCad Eagle Altium Soldering Hardware-in-the-Loop Electronics Power Electronics Circuit Design Python C Electromechanical Systems Prototyping Testing Validation Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field with 0-2 years of experience. A strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on hardware creation and proficiency in PCB design tools is required.

title: Apprentice - Mechanical Design
job_description:
About Origin
Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labor shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India’s most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
About the role
The Mechanical Design Apprentice role is for early-career mechanical engineers who want to build real robots. You own small, clear modules of the robot. Senior Engineers mentor you. You design parts in CAD, make prototypes, assemble the hardware in the lab and test it. Your work covers three areas: the mobile manipulator (chassis, drivetrain and arm), the robotic power tools, and the enclosures and wire harnesses.
Key Responsibilities
Sub-assembly design:
Design sub-assemblies in Onshape or SolidWorks. Examples: a battery tray, a sensor shroud, a dust extraction nozzle, a motor controller bracket, a cable guide.
Make 2D manufacturing drawings for prototype vendors.
Keep the CAD vault and the Bills of Materials (BOMs) up to date.
Give mass, inertia and center-of-gravity data from CAD to the controls team for the robot URDF.
Fabrication and assembly:
Make form-and-fit prototypes on the lab 3D printers (FDM, SLA).
Assemble drivetrains, manipulator joints, chassis and power tools. Torque fasteners to specification. Press-fit bearings and set belt tension.
Build wire harnesses by hand to industrial crimp standards, with heat shrink and braided sleeve.
Make test jigs, brackets and fixtures with shop tools (drill press, bandsaw, hand tools) and 80/20 extrusions.
Write assembly procedures.
Test and validation:
Set up and run load tests, cycle tests, thermal chamber tests, drop tests and vibration tests.
Measure and log data: deflection, weight, motor temperature, enclosure temperature under compute load.
Join field tests. Watch the mechanical systems under real construction loads. Find the cause of physical failures.
Required Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics or a related field.
0–2 years of experience. A strong portfolio of physical projects is mandatory (for example FSAE, Baja, Solar Car, Robocon, combat robots or complex personal builds).
Good 3D CAD skills (Onshape or SolidWorks).
Good knowledge of statics, dynamics, kinematics, mechanics of materials and basic thermodynamics.
Good hands-on skills. You must be comfortable with hand tools, power tools and crimpers.
Preferred Experiences
Robotics projects: AMRs, robot arms, quadrupeds, humanoids, drones.
3D printer or basic CNC operation.
Basic GD&T and engineering drawing knowledge.
Basic electrical wiring: strip, solder, crimp.

Learn from experienced professionals and gain valuable skills in robotics software engineering.
Gain practical experience in a real-world engineering environment.
Contribute to a project with the potential to make a significant impact on the construction industry. Mechanical design CAD Onshape SolidWorks Prototyping Hardware assembly Drivetrain assembly Wire harness fabrication Testing and validation Statics Dynamics Kinematics Mechanics of materials Thermodynamics GD&T Electrical wiring Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics with 0-2 years of experience. A strong portfolio of physical projects and proficiency in 3D CAD software are mandatory.

title: Senior Advisor, Aravo Requirements Manager & Business Analyst
job_description:
Senior Advisor, Aravo Business Requirements Lead 

Our Dell Global Operations team operates one of the largest end-to-end supply
chains in the world. Through innovation and operational excellence, we help Dell
Technologies grow and win in the data decade – and the integrity, ingenuity, and
expertise of our team is at work every step of the way.  We deliver Dell’s
innovative technology and services portfolio with industry-leading scale and
supply chain capabilities, creating an inclusive workplace where team members
can reach their full potential.  We care about our impact on the environment,
the people, and the companies that make up our supply chain.  Furthermore, we
proactively work to mitigate risk that could affect our global supply chain and
procurement operations.  The Supply Chain Assurance organization, part of the
Global Manufacturing & Operations Technology group, helps safeguard the
integrity, security, and resilience of end-to-end supply chain operations. The
organization partners across Security, Procurement, Manufacturing Operations,
Global Audit and Transformation, Legal, Information Technology, business teams,
and the supplier ecosystem to ensure that assurance activities are risk-based,
well governed, data-driven, and continuously improving.

As a Senior Advisor, Aravo Business Requirements Lead you, will serve as a
senior individual contributor responsible for translating strategic, regulatory,
operational, and process needs into complete, configuration-ready requirements
for Dell’s enterprise Third-Party Risk Management platform. The role will
partner closely with and operate across risk-domain stakeholders, Supply Chain
Assurance, Dell IT, solution architects, configuration resources, system
integrators, and the Aravo vendor team. The successful candidate will lead
complex requirements discovery and analysis, develop high-quality user stories
and behavior-driven requirements, facilitate solution-design readiness, maintain
end-to-end traceability, and help move approved demand efficiently from business
need through design, testing, deployment, and stabilization. 

The role requires the judgment to distinguish business requirements from
technical solutions, balance competing demands, surface cross-functional
dependencies, and move approved requirements efficiently from initial business
need through design, testing, deployment, and closure.

 

You will

 * Lead and continuously improve the end-to-end Aravo requirements lifecycle,
   from demand intake and analysis through prioritization, approval, design
   readiness, testing, deployment, and closure. Serve as the central business
   requirements owner for Aravo enhancements, defects, production incidents,
   regulatory changes, and platform-maturity initiatives. Establish and govern a
   structured intake process that captures the business problem, desired
   outcome, accountable owner, affected users, criticality, regulatory driver,
   dependencies, timing, and impact of non-delivery.
 * Lead stakeholder interviews, workshops, process reviews, and cross-functional
   working sessions to define business needs and align affected
   organizations.Translate strategic, regulatory, operational, process, data,
   integration, control, and reporting needs into clear user stories, functional
   requirements, business rules, BDD scenarios, and testable acceptance
   criteria.
 * Analyze current- and future-state processes and distinguish process or
   governance gaps from configuration needs, integrations, reporting requests,
   defects, product limitations, and non-Aravo solutions. Evaluate and
   prioritize demand based on business value, regulatory obligations, control
   exposure, operational impact, urgency, cross-functional dependencies,
   delivery capacity, and alignment with the Aravo roadmap and TPRM operating
   model. Maintain the authoritative Aravo requirements register and prioritized
   backlog, ensuring accurate ownership, status, documentation, approvals,
   dependencies, decisions, milestones, and next actions.
 * Identify and resolve duplicate, overlapping, conflicting, consolidated,
   suspended, withdrawn, infeasible, or non-Aravo requests and ensure each
   receives a clear, documented disposition. Establish requirements-quality
   standards and definitions of ready, ensuring requirements are complete,
   clear, consistent, feasible, traceable, testable, business-approved, and
   sufficiently detailed for IT assessment.
 * Lead requirements walkthroughs and design-readiness sessions with business
   owners, Dell IT, architects, developers, configuration teams, testers,
   implementation partners, and Aravo resources. Manage the business
   requirements handoff to IT, support solution-design clarification, govern
   changes to approved scope, and maintain clear accountability between business
   requirements ownership and technical delivery.
 * Maintain end-to-end traceability from the originating business need through
   requirements approval, solution design, development, test evidence,
   deployment, and final disposition. Support quarterly planning, IT sizing,
   scope lock, sprint readiness, user acceptance testing, deployment, and
   hypercare by proactively managing requirements, risks, decisions,
   dependencies, and delivery milestones. Lead requirements-governance forums
   and provide clear operational and executive reporting on portfolio status,
   readiness, priorities, blockers, dependencies, required actions, decisions,
   and delivery risks.

 

Essential Requirements 

 * 8+ years of experience in business analysis, requirements management, product
   ownership, enterprise application delivery, process transformation, or a
   related discipline.
 * Demonstrated experience owning an end-to-end requirements lifecycle for a
   complex enterprise application, platform, product, or transformation program.
 * Advanced experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating,
   prioritizing, approving, and governing complex business and functional
   requirements.
 * Strong experience developing user stories, functional requirements, business
   rules, process flows, behavior-driven scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
 * Experience establishing and managing structured demand-intake, triage,
   prioritization, backlog-governance, and requirements-approval processes.
   Demonstrated ability to translate strategic, regulatory, operational,
   process, data, control, integration, and reporting needs into actionable
   technology requirements.
 * Strong understanding of requirements quality, definition of ready,
   traceability, change control, scope management, dependency management, and
   lifecycle governance.
 * Experience leading requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews,
   cross-functional working sessions, prioritization forums, and
   design-readiness reviews.
 * Experience supporting enterprise workflow-based applications and assessing
   the impact of proposed changes on workflows, data, roles, integrations,
   reporting, controls, and user experience. Experience working across business
   stakeholders, program teams, product or platform teams, architects,
   developers, configuration resources, testers, implementation partners, and
   software vendors.
 * Experience supporting Agile, hybrid, or structured delivery methodologies,
   including planning, backlog grooming, sizing, scope lock, solution design,
   sprint readiness, testing, deployment, and hypercare. Demonstrated ability to
   manage a complex portfolio of concurrent requirements, competing priorities,
   cross-functional dependencies, and time-sensitive deliverables.
 * Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to
   establish ownership, resolve ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and drive
   timely stakeholder decisions.
 * Strong analytical skills and the ability to distinguish business needs from
   prescribed technical solutions, platform defects, process issues, governance
   gaps, and non-technology needs. Proven ability to influence without direct
   authority and drive accountability across a global, matrixed organization.
 * High degree of ownership, judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, and
   independence in an ambiguous and rapidly evolving environment. Undergraduate
   degree in business, information systems, technology, risk management, supply
   chain, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

 

Desirable Requirements

 * Direct experience with Aravo or another enterprise Third-Party Risk
   Management, supplier-risk, governance, risk, compliance, or workflow
   platform.
 * Experience with Aravo workflows, surveys, assessments, supplier profiles,
   entities, attributes, role-based access, reporting, risk scoring,
   integrations, issue management, and supplier hierarchy structures. Experience
   in Third-Party Risk Management, supplier risk, supply-chain assurance,
   security, privacy, legal compliance, responsible sourcing, environmental
   health and safety, procurement, or operational resilience. Knowledge of
   supplier onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, audits, findings,
   Corrective Action Plans, exception management, continuous monitoring,
   contract or control requirements, and supplier offboarding.
 * Experience managing requirements for regulatory or audit-driven initiatives
   where documentation, ownership, approval, evidence, testing, and traceability
   are essential.
 * Experience with supplier data, master-data structures, integrations, APIs,
   business intelligence, executive dashboards, and enterprise reporting.
 * Experience with SharePoint, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Tableau,
   ServiceNow, or comparable requirements, backlog, workflow, reporting, or
   portfolio-management tools. Experience managing implementation-partner and
   software-vendor engagement during requirements clarification, solution
   design, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
 * Experience developing governance standards, operating procedures,
   requirements templates, stakeholder guidance, and training materials.
 * Aravo product training or Aravo Academy certification. Relevant certification
   such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product
   Owner/Product Manager, PMP, ITIL, or an equivalent qualification.

 

Who we are

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put
our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an
opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced
tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. 
 
Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and
organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future
that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. 
 
Application closing date: 31 August 2026 
 
Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity
for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of
discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity
Policy here
[https://jobs.dell.com/equal-employment-opportunity-policy-statement].

Proficiency in requirements documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and familiarity with risk management platforms or supply chain operations is essential.

title: Rooms Division Manager
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Assists in managing the execution of all operations in the rooms area
departments (e.g.,Front Office, Engineering/Maintenance, Housekeeping) and
managing staff. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction
and maximize the financial performance of the department. Monitors compliance
with standards and procedures. Leads specific team while assisting with meeting
or exceeding property goals.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the guest services, front
desk, housekeeping, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant
Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years
experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related
professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Leading Room Operations Team

• Verifies that goals are being translated to the team as they relate to guest
tracking and productivity.

• Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation,
empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing
service.

• Understands employee and guest satisfaction results and developing game plans
to attack need areas and expand on the strengths.

• Verifies that the team has the capabilities to meet expectations.

• Leads by example demonstrating self-confidence, energy and enthusiasm.

• Assists employees in understanding guests’ ever-changing needs and
expectations, and exceeding them.

 

Managing Property Rooms Operations Function(s) 

• Assists in managing the execution of all operations in the rooms area
departments (e.g., Front Office, Engineering/Maintenance, Housekeeping).

• Follows property specific second effort and recovery plan.

• Publishes all guest satisfaction results in a timely fashion including all
guest satisfaction forms, comment cards and guest letters.

• Takes proactive approaches when dealing with employee concerns.

• Extends professionalism and courtesy to employees at all times.

• Communicates/updates all goals and results with employees.

• Meets semiannually with staff on a one-to-one basis.

• Assists/teaches the team scheduling against guest and hours/occupied room
goals.

• Performs hourly job functions as needed.

• Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

 

Managing and Monitoring Activities that Affect the Guest Experience

• Understands the brand's service culture.

• Provides excellent customer service by being readily available/approachable
for all guests.

• Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.

• Takes proactive approaches when dealing with guest concerns.

• Extends professionalism and courtesy to guests at all times.

• Responds timely to customer service department request.

• Verifies that all team members meet or exceed all hospitality requirements.

 

Managing Profitability

• Assists in performing required annual Quality audit with General Manager (GM)
& Regional Director (RD).

• Verifies that a viable key control program is in place.

• Reviews financial statements, sales and activity reports, and other
performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine
areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.

• Strives to maximize the financial performance of the department.

 

Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Interviews and assists in making hiring decisions.

• Receives hiring recommendations from team supervisors.

• Verifies that orientations for new team members are thorough and completed in
a timely fashion.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy, and reviews
employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or
concerns.

• Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently,
disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard
and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review
Process, where applicable.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team
members.

title: Sr. Embedded SW developer ORC2-EDC3
job_description:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Tasks / Responsibilities: 
* Safety-Critical Firmware Development: Design, develop, and validate safety-critical firmware for the Cortex-R5 MCU cores in accordance with ISO 26262 standards, including driver development for peripherals like I2C, SPI, and GPIO. Low-Level Driver and HAL Implementation: Implement and maintain hardware abstraction layers (HAL) and low-level drivers, directly interacting with SoC registers and ensuring precise hardware control.
SoC Safety Mechanisms: Configure and utilize the inherent safety features of the TI TDA4Vx SoC, such as lock-step cores, Memory Protection Units (MPUs), and error signaling modules (ESM).
System Bring-Up and Bootloader: Take a lead role in board bring-up, bootloader development (e.g., SBL), and configuring the system boot flow to establish a secure and safe operational environment.
Inter-Processor Communication (IPC): Architect and implement robust, high-performance IPC mechanisms for communication between the safety domain (R5/RTOS) and the application domain (A72/QNX), ensuring freedom from interference.
RTOS & Bare-Metal Development: Develop and optimize real-time applications on safety RTOS (ETAS RTA-OS, FreeRTOS) or bare-metal environments, focusing on interrupt handling, DMA, task scheduling, and memory management for the R5 cores.
Debugging and System Analysis: Perform deep-dive debugging of complex, system-level issues at the hardware/software interface using JTAG debuggers (Lauterbach Trace32), oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
Collaboration and Documentation: Work closely with hardware engineers to review schematics, define hardware requirements, and produce detailed technical documentation for firmware design and validation
Expected skill set:
*Technical Expertise: 8-12 years in embedded software development, with a strong focus on C programming for microcontrollers.
Proven experience in developing firmware for safety-critical systems compliant with standards like ISO 26262 or IEC 61508. Hands-on experience with the TI TDA4Vx/Jacinto 7 family, including the use of TI SDKs (Processor SDK, MCU+ SDK).
Deep expertise in developing for ARM Cortex-R5 or similar safety-oriented MCUs, including bare-metal programming.
Experience configuring and validating hardware safety mechanisms (MPU, ECC, lock-step). Proficiency with a safety-certified real-time operating system (e.g., ETAS RTA-OS, FreeRTOS).
Good to Have skills: 
Experience developing on the Cortex-A72 cores and familiarity with QNX Neutrino RTOS.
Familiarity with MISRA C/C++ guidelines and using static analysis tools (e.g., Polyspace, Klocwork)
Knowledge of secure boot processes, cryptographic accelerators, and hardware security modules (HSMs).
Experience with performance optimization, cache coherency, and multicore system tuning. Familiarity with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet.
Experience with test automation, particularly using the Robot Framework. Prior experience on projects directly related to our platform and toolchain environment.
Proficiency in low-level debugging using JTAG/SWD debuggers (e.g., Lauterbach Trace32, TI XDS probes). Experience with modern development tools including Git, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact management (Artifactory).
Qualifications
• B. E/ B. Tech E&C, EEE or any equivalent
Additional Information
8 - 12 years

Legal Entity: Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited Embedded Software Development C Programming ISO 26262 Firmware Development TI TDA4Vx ARM Cortex-R5 RTOS FreeRTOS Hardware Abstraction Layer IPC Bootloader Development JTAG Debugging Lauterbach Trace32 Safety-Critical Systems Bare-metal Programming Requires 8-12 years of experience in embedded software development with strong C programming skills for microcontrollers. Candidates must have hands-on experience with TI TDA4Vx/Jacinto 7 family and safety-certified real-time operating systems.

title: Marketing Operations & AI Specialist (Full Time, Remote)
job_description:
About Frontier
Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.
We help companies grow cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into great companies. If you're interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we'll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to connect you with the right opportunity.
About the client
Balto is building the AI Workforce for contact centers, and needs a Marketing Operations and AI Specialist who keeps the marketing engine clean, measurable, and running. You'll own the data, the attribution, and the day-to-day operations that keep the BDR team productive. This role is for someone who sees a tedious, manual process and immediately starts building a way to never do it by hand again. You'll use AI to build tools and workflows that take the busywork off everyone's plate. You understand why the work matters, not just how to do it, and you'd rather bring a solution than wait for instructions.
What You'll Own
Data Quality
Clean up and maintain contact, account, and lead data across HubSpot and Salesforce
Find the root cause of bad data, fix it, and put a process in place so it doesn't come back
Build AI-powered workflows that handle enrichment, deduplication, and cleanup so no one does it by hand
Marketing and Campaign Attribution
Own marketing and campaign attribution from first touch to closed-won
Make sure every campaign is tracked correctly so the company knows what's actually driving pipeline
Build reports that answer real questions and help the team decide where to spend time and money
List Building
Build and enrich target lists in Clay and TitanX based on Balto's ICP and target accounts
Keep lists accurate, deduplicated, and ready to use
Process and Tool Building
Spot manual, repetitive work and replace it with automations, AI agents, or simple tools
Solve problems on your own, and come to the table with a recommendation, not just the problem
Document processes, fields, and changes, and tell the right people when something changes and why it matters
BDR Operations
Build reports that show each BDR's activity: calls, emails, and who's getting contacted
Decide which lists should be sequenced, and load contacts into Outreach sequences for the BDRs
Monitor BDR task loads and sequence capacity to make sure workloads are realistic and lists are being worked effectively.
Surface gaps early, whether that's a rep falling behind on assigned tasks, a list running dry, or a sequence underperforming.
What You Bring to the Table
You don't need to have done every single one of these. But the more that sound like you, the better:
3+ years in marketing operations, sales operations, or revenue operations at a B2B company
Extremely detail-oriented. You notice the duplicate record, the broken field mapping, and the campaign that isn't tracking before anyone else does
You understand the business. You know why a report matters, who uses it, and what decision it drives
You think for yourself. Give you a problem and you'll investigate it, ask the right questions, and come back with a recommended solution.
You communicate clearly when things change: new processes, new fields, new rules, and what people need to do differently
Hands-on experience with attribution models and campaign tracking
Comfortable working with large datasets in spreadsheets, including formulas, lookups, filtering, and data cleanup.
Experience supporting BDR or SDR teams with reporting, list building, or sequencing
Tools You'll Work With
Claude
HubSpot
Salesforce
Clay
Outreach
TitanX
Balto is AI-Native
Balto doesn't just build AI, it lives it. The company needs someone who uses AI to get rid of tedious work, not someone who occasionally asks ChatGPT a question. That means you're:
Building your own AI agents, custom assistants, automations, or multi-step workflows
Using AI to clean and enrich data, build lists, analyze results, and automate repetitive work
Turning a manual process into an automated one without being asked
Keeping up with new AI tools and putting the useful ones to work fast
Bonus Points For
B2B SaaS or contact center experience
SQL or basic data skills
Salesforce or HubSpot admin experience
Building tools or scripts with Python, APIs, or no-code platforms
Why Balto
Balto is not another tech startup. It is powering a real shift in how people work, with AI doing the repeatable stuff so humans can focus on what matters. That applies to the team too. In this role, you'll help make that true for marketing and sales.
Balto is driven by a set of core values that shape the impactful work done at the company:
Anchor on Success: Every task begins by envisioning success. Ambitious goals are set, respecting both incremental and transformative progress, continuously adapting, and embracing new tools and best practices to stay at the forefront of technology and business.
Love Every Customer: Customers are the lifeblood of Balto's operations. Every interaction is treated as a chance to show passion and commitment, with tireless inventiveness in solving their problems, no matter the size, industry, or complexity.
Talk Things Out: Communication is key. Problems are solved through open, honest conversations across all levels of the organization, without the barriers of hierarchy.
Always Be Growing: Growth is a personal journey that impacts the whole company. Every teammate is encouraged to own their professional development, supported by a culture that values learning.
Own the Work: The team is empowered to take initiative and produce results they're proud of. Ownership means being proactive in identifying and solving problems, always pushing toward great outcomes.
Start with Gratitude: Work at Balto is fueled by gratitude. Every teammate's contributions are recognized and appreciated, even in challenging discussions.

Plus the good stuff: fully remote, smart and supportive AI-obsessed teammates, real ownership with a clear path to grow. 
Apply If
You work best with autonomy and don't need your hand held
Messy data bothers you enough to fix it for good
You'd rather spend an afternoon automating a task than do it by hand twice
You want to see how your work shows up in pipeline
Job Details 
Competitive Annual Salary
Shift: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.
Health Benefits, Equipment, and Paid Leaves
Type: Full-time REMOTE role. Marketing operations Sales operations Revenue operations HubSpot Salesforce AI automation Data quality Attribution modeling Campaign tracking Clay TitanX Outreach BDR support List building Workflow automation Data analysis Candidates should have 3+ years of experience in marketing, sales, or revenue operations within a B2B company. You must be highly detail-oriented, proficient with data management tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, and possess a strong aptitude for building AI-driven workflows.

title: Sr. Embedded SW developer ORC2-EDC3
job_description:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Tasks / Responsibilities:
* Safety-Critical Firmware Development: Design, develop, and validate safety-critical firmware for the Cortex-R5 MCU cores in accordance with ISO 26262 standards, including driver development for peripherals like I2C, SPI, and GPIO. Low-Level Driver and HAL Implementation: Implement and maintain hardware abstraction layers (HAL) and low-level drivers, directly interacting with SoC registers and ensuring precise hardware control.
SoC Safety Mechanisms: Configure and utilize the inherent safety features of the TI TDA4Vx SoC, such as lock-step cores, Memory Protection Units (MPUs), and error signaling modules (ESM). System Bring-Up and Bootloader: 
Take a lead role in board bring-up, bootloader development (e.g., SBL), and configuring the system boot flow to establish a secure and safe operational environment.
Inter-Processor Communication (IPC): Architect and implement robust, high-performance IPC mechanisms for communication between the safety domain (R5/RTOS) and the application domain (A72/QNX), ensuring freedom from interference. RTOS & Bare-Metal Development: 
Develop and optimize real-time applications on safety RTOS (ETAS RTA-OS, FreeRTOS) or bare-metal environments, focusing on interrupt handling, DMA, task scheduling, and memory management for the R5 cores.
Debugging and System Analysis: Perform deep-dive debugging of complex, system-level issues at the hardware/software interface using JTAG debuggers (Lauterbach Trace32), oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
Collaboration and Documentation: Work closely with hardware engineers to review schematics, define hardware requirements, and produce detailed technical documentation for firmware design and validation
Expected skill set: 
*Technical Expertise:
8-12 years in embedded software development, with a strong focus on C programming for microcontrollers. Proven experience in developing firmware for safety-critical systems compliant with standards like ISO 26262 or IEC 61508.
Hands-on experience with the TI TDA4Vx/Jacinto 7 family, including the use of TI SDKs (Processor SDK, MCU+ SDK).
Deep expertise in developing for ARM Cortex-R5 or similar safety-oriented MCUs, including bare-metal programming.
Experience configuring and validating hardware safety mechanisms (MPU, ECC, lock-step). Proficiency with a safety-certified real-time operating system (e.g., ETAS RTA-OS, FreeRTOS).
Good to Have skills: Experience developing on the Cortex-A72 cores and familiarity with QNX Neutrino RTOS.
Familiarity with MISRA C/C++ guidelines and using static analysis tools (e.g., Polyspace, Klocwork) Knowledge of secure boot processes, cryptographic accelerators, and hardware security modules (HSMs).
Experience with performance optimization, cache coherency, and multicore system tuning. Familiarity with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet. Experience with test automation, particularly using the Robot Framework.
Prior experience on projects directly related to our platform and toolchain environment. Proficiency in low-level debugging using JTAG/SWD debuggers (e.g., Lauterbach Trace32, TI XDS probes).
Experience with modern development tools including Git, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact management (Artifactory).
Qualifications
• B. E/ B. Tech E&C, EEE or any equivalent
Additional Information
8 - 12 years

Legal Entity: Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited Embedded Software Development C Programming ISO 26262 Firmware Development TI TDA4Vx ARM Cortex-R5 RTOS FreeRTOS Hardware Abstraction Layer IPC Bootloader Development JTAG Debugging Lauterbach Trace32 Bare-metal Programming Safety-critical Systems Requires 8-12 years of experience in embedded software development with strong C programming skills and expertise in safety-critical systems. Candidates must hold a B.E. or B.Tech degree in E&C, EEE, or an equivalent field.

channels-including digital and social-we at Startek value our ability to
effectively garner those interactions and CX insights, analysing, unlocking, and
providing intelligence that drives digital transformation and further revenues
for you, our client.

Put simply: we break down the complexity of your customer lifecycle and help
your customers build and sustain emotional connections with your brand.

Our tech-enabled and Human assisted digital solutions build both on your CX
requirements and our business transformation expertise and willingness to
consistently pivot, innovate, and take advantage of new digital technologies.

now -working with them across their consumer value chain and providing new age

dollar spent.

40,000 employees managing almost half a billion customer interactions every year
for over 150 clients in different industries.

success through the effective and innovative management of people for both

any aspect of workforce management and employee relations and performance.

with developments impacting employment matters, such as changes in legislation,
changes in the characteristics of the labor market.

title: Deputy Manager - Mechanical (Boiler)
job_description:
RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities of Role

 1.  Execute and supervise construction activities related to Boiler, Pressure
     Parts, and Boiler Structural systems.
 2.  Ensure timely erection of Boiler Pressure Parts including Water Wall
     Panels, Boiler Drum, Economizer, Superheater, Reheater, Headers, and
     associated components.
 3.  Monitor Boiler Structural Erection activities including columns, beams,
     platforms, galleries, buckstays, supports, and reinforcement structures.
 4.  Review construction drawings, erection procedures, technical
     specifications, and project schedules prior to execution.
 5.  Coordinate with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Safety, Stores, and
     Commissioning teams for smooth project execution.
 6.  Supervise contractors, subcontractors, and vendor personnel to ensure
     construction activities are executed as per approved standards and
     schedules.
 7.  Monitor fabrication, fit-up, alignment, welding, and erection activities to
     ensure compliance with quality requirements.
 8.  Coordinate and support hydro testing, inspection activities, preservation
     activities, and pre-commissioning checks.
 9.  Track project progress, identify execution bottlenecks, and implement
     corrective actions to achieve project milestones.
 10. Ensure availability of construction materials, manpower, cranes, tools, and
     equipment required for uninterrupted execution.
 11. Monitor productivity and optimize resource utilization to improve project
     performance.
 12. Verify measurement sheets, contractor bills, progress certifications, and
     work completion documentation.
 13. Ensure compliance with QA/QC requirements, approved welding procedures, NDT
     requirements, and statutory regulations.
 14. Participate in project review meetings and provide progress reports related
     to erection, quality, safety, and construction status.
 15. Drive implementation of EHS standards, permit systems, risk assessment
     processes, and Adani safety protocols across all construction activities.


QUALIFICATIONS

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

 * B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

Preferred

 * M.Tech Mechanical Engineering.
 * Certification in Project Management or Construction Management.

Experience Requirements (Must Have)

Mandatory Experience

 * 7-12 years of experience in Mechanical Construction of Thermal Power Plant
   Projects.
 * Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Boiler Construction activities.
 * Proven experience in Boiler Pressure Parts Erection.
 * Proven experience in Boiler Structural Erection.
 * Experience in erection and installation of Water Wall Panels, Boiler Drum,
   Economizer, Superheater, Reheater, and Headers.
 * Experience in contractor management and large-scale construction site
   execution.
 * Exposure to hydro testing, welding supervision, and pre-commissioning
   activities.
 * Experience in utility-scale Thermal Power Projects of 300 MW and above.
 * Experience in project planning, progress monitoring, and construction
   documentation.

Non-Negotiable Requirements

 * B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
 * 7-12 years of relevant Mechanical Construction experience.
 * Thermal Power Project experience is mandatory.
 * Mandatory exposure to Boiler Construction.
 * Mandatory exposure to Boiler Pressure Parts Erection.
 * Mandatory exposure to Boiler Structural Erection.
 * Experience in projects involving 300 MW+ units.
 * Contractor management experience is essential.
 * Knowledge of hydro testing and erection quality requirements.
 * Strong understanding of boiler erection drawings and construction
   methodologies. Boiler construction Pressure parts erection Structural erection Thermal power plant projects Welding supervision Hydro testing Contractor management Project planning EHS standards Quality control Construction management Technical specifications Resource optimization Project documentation Safety protocols Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 7-12 years of relevant experience in thermal power plant construction. Proven expertise in boiler pressure parts and structural erection, along with strong contractor management skills, is mandatory.

title: Staff Software Engineer
job_description:
Job Description:

Staff Software Engineer

 

Summary

The Staff Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and
implementing complex software systems on ASP capital and connected systems. This
role will work closely with architects and the verification and validation team
to ensure the quality and reliability of ASP software products. This position
reports to the Director of Software and Connectivity (ASP IDC).

 

Responsibilities

Under limited supervision, general direction, etc. and in accordance with all
applicable government laws, regulations and ASP policies, procedures and
guidelines, this position:

 * Design, develop, and implement software for our products and systems.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and implement new
   software features.
 * Interface with hardware design and development teams.
 * Conduct performance analysis and enhance efficiency, stability, and
   scalability of system resources.
 * Coordinate software system installation and monitor equipment functioning to
   ensure specifications are met.
 * Debug and resolve software defects and issues.
 * Review code and design and provide constructive feedback to team members.
 * Lead and mentor junior engineers to promote knowledge growth and ensure
   project deliverables. Interface among multiple departments and teams
   including Quality and Service etc.
 * Identify and recommend opportunities for efficiency improvements in
   department processes.
 * Conduct static analysis, code coverage analysis, and other verification
   techniques to ensure high-quality software.
 * Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to
   next management level. 
 * Performs other duties assigned as needed.

Requirements
 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant technical
   experience is required. 
 * 8 + years of experience in system-level software development
 * 8+ years of working experience in C/C++
 * Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages
 * Extensive knowledge of real-time operating systems and hardware.
 * Experience in Yocto Linux is a preferred.
 * Experience with software development tools, such as IDEs, debuggers, and
   version control systems
 * Strong understanding of software systems, software architectures, and design
   principles.
 * Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking
   tools, and peer review techniques.
 * Experience with oscilloscopes, analyzers and electronics is preferred. 
 * Knowledge of defect management tools such as JIRA or Bugzilla is required.
 * Prior work in a regulated environment like medical device industry is
   preferred.
 * Familiarity to Agile methodology is preferred.
 * Has good verbal and written communication skills. C C++ Python System-level software development Real-time operating systems Yocto Linux Software architecture Debugging Code review Static analysis JIRA Bugzilla Agile methodology Hardware integration Mentoring Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Science and over 8 years of experience in system-level software development. Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting languages like Python is required, along with knowledge of real-time operating systems and hardware.

title: Software Engineer (3-5)
job_description:
Company Description
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
Job Description
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing and building robust, highly scalable distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with product leadership, mentor junior team members, and take immense ownership of complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web-based applications. Create architectural abstractions and technical contracts with a strict adherence to the separation of concerns.
Problem Solving & High-Level Design: Drive solutions for high-level business and technical problems. Lead functional modeling, module decomposition, and system design initiatives.
Architectural Evolution: Implement incremental changes to the existing architecture and conduct comprehensive impact analyses.
Performance Optimization: Profile, tune, and improve performance across large-scale distributed systems.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business features into technical capabilities. Lead the execution of medium-sized projects and structure workflows into distinct phases to ensure predictable delivery.
Stakeholder Alignment: Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of deployed projects and features, proactively iterating on them for continuous improvement.
Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of solving problems at scale.
Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.
Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.
System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.
Scale & Data Management: Proven experience building highly scalable business applications, handling complex business flows, and processing massive volumes of data.
Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL) as well as NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike).
Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.
Working Environment: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-growth, dynamic startup environment with high levels of ownership and commitment.
Drive & Passion: A strong analytical mindset with a genuine passion for solving complex, real-world technical challenges.
Additional Information
PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. title: Lead / Senior Embedded Software V&V Engineer
job_description:
Job Description:

Senior Embedded Software V&V Engineer

 

Summary

The Senior Embedded Software V&V Engineer is responsible of the creation and
execution of software testing procedures for embedded systems on ASP capital and
connected systems, developing automated test scripts, and documenting test
results. This role will work closely with the software development team to
ensure the quality and reliability of ASP software products. This position
reports to the Manager of Software Engineering (ASP IDC).

 

Responsibilities

Under limited supervision, general direction, etc. and in accordance with all
applicable government laws, regulations and ASP policies, procedures and
guidelines, this position:

 * Designs, implements, debugs, and executes system and software level test
   protocols including automated scripts.
 * Develop software test tools for verification and validation of medical
   systems.
 * Design, recommend, and implement new tests to improve product robustness and
   quality.
 * Analyze system and embedded software-level product requirements to develop
   most effective test strategies.
 * Creates product release documentation, including verification and validation
   plans and test reports for new software releases.
 * Provides support to cross functional teams to provide analysis of challenging
   field issues.
 * Build and implement a V&V test process that is compatible with our Agile
   scrum sprints.
 * Interface among multiple departments and teams including Quality and Service
   etc.
 * Identify and recommend opportunities for efficiency improvements in
   department processes.
 * Conduct static analysis, code coverage analysis, and other verification
   techniques to ensure high-quality software.
 * Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to
   next management level. 
 * Performs other duties assigned as needed.

Requirements

 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant technical
   experience is required. 
 * 3 to 10+ years of experience in embedded and system-level software testing
 * Experience in Software Verification and Validation methodologies with
   expertise in writing testcases, test plans and test reports
 * Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages
 * Experience in RTOS/Linux is a preferred.
 * Experience with software development tools, such as IDEs, debuggers, and
   version control systems
 * Experience with communication protocols, network protocols and tools such as
   Wireshark
 * Experience with automated testing frameworks, such as Squish, Robot
   Framework, Cucumber, or Selenium
 * Experience with oscilloscopes, analyzers and electronics is preferred. 
 * Knowledge of defect management tools such as JIRA or Bugzilla is required.
 * Prior work in a regulated environment like medical device industry is
   preferred.
 * Familiarity to Agile methodology is preferred.
 * Has good verbal and written communication skills. Embedded Software Testing Python Verification And Validation Automated Testing RTOS Linux JIRA Bugzilla Wireshark Robot Framework Squish Cucumber Selenium Agile Methodology System Level Testing Medical Device Standards Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Science with 3 to 10+ years of experience in embedded software testing. Proficiency in Python, experience with RTOS/Linux, and familiarity with defect management tools like JIRA are required.

title: Services Sales Specialist
job_description:
Brief Description:
 

Role Overview

Vertiv is seeking an experienced Service Sales Manager with 8–12 years of proven
expertise in UPS service sales. The ideal candidate will be responsible for
driving service revenue growth across contracts, spare parts, batteries,
upgrades, retrofit solutions, and audit services. This is an individual
contributor role with full accountability for sales growth, P&L management, and
customer satisfaction.

 
Key Responsibilities
 * Drive service sales growth in UPS contracts, spare parts, batteries,
   upgrades, retrofit, and audit services.
 * Manage contract business with strong awareness of RCR (Recurring Contract
   Revenue) and WCR (Warranty Contract Revenue).
 * Identify and pursue opportunities in retrofit and upgrade projects to enhance
   customer infrastructure.
 * Develop and execute strategies for solution-based service sales and audit
   business expansion.
 * Handle end-to-end service sales cycle including prospecting, proposal
   preparation, negotiation, and closure.
 * Take ownership of P&L responsibilities for assigned accounts/projects.
 * Build and maintain strong relationships with customers in electrical project
   sales and service domains.
 * Collaborate with service delivery teams to ensure seamless execution and
   customer satisfaction.
 * Provide accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and participate in
   regular status calls.
 * Ensure compliance with company policies, pricing guidelines, and contractual
   obligations.

 
Required Qualifications & Skills
 * Experience: 8 –12 years in UPS service sales (contracts, spares, batteries,
   upgrades, retrofit, audit services).
 * Strong knowledge of electrical project sales and service delivery models.
 * Proven track record in sales growth and P&L management.
 * Familiarity with contract structures, RCR/WCR metrics.
 * Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.
 * Ability to work independently as an individual contributor.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 
Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience in Vertiv or similar UPS/power solutions industry.
 * Exposure to solution-based service selling and consultative approaches.
 * Technical understanding of UPS systems and retrofit solutions

 


The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to
help execute our Strategic Priorities.



OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing
services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously,
perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most
important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and
commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT
infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of
the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around
34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to
learn more.
