· Perform Analysis and Design; participates in defining and developing technical specifications to meet systems’ requirements.
· Design and Develop Moderate to Highly Complex Applications; Analyzes, designs, codes, tests, corrects, and documents moderate to highly complex programs to ensure optimal performance and compliance.
· Develop Application Documentation; Develops and maintains system documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
· Produce Integration Builds; Defines and produces integration builds to create applications.
· Performs Maintenance and Support; Defines and administers procedures to monitor systems performance and integrity.
· Support Emerging Technologies and Products; Monitors the industry to gain knowledge and understanding of emerging technologies.

· 5+ years of experience with Java, including building complex, scalable applications.
· 5+ years of experience in Spring Boot, including designing and implementing advanced microservices architectures.
· 2+ years of experience in OpenShift or Kubernetes, including CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and deployment strategies.

· Lifelong Learner. You are always seeking to improve your technical and nontechnical skills.

title: AI Visibility Specialist (SEO, AEO, GEO)
job_description:
About Recooty
Recooty is an AI-powered applicant tracking system used by hiring teams in 25+ countries, with a strong focus on the US, UK/Europe and the Middle East. We are a product-first SaaS team based in Jabalpur, building tools that help companies hire faster and smarter.
About the role
When a recruiter asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Google AI Overviews for the "best ATS for small businesses," we want Recooty in the answer. You will own Recooty's visibility across AI search platforms. You'll track where we appear today, find the sources these engines cite, and run the work that gets us cited more often. This is a hands-on role with direct access to the founders.
What you'll do
Run weekly prompt audits across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Overviews for buyer-intent queries, and report Recooty's AI share of voice against competitors
Map the third-party sources AI engines cite for our category (listicles, review sites, Reddit, YouTube, comparison articles), and build a plan to earn placements on them
Manage and optimize our presence on G2, Capterra, GetApp and software directories, keeping listings accurate and up to date with new features
Run outreach for inclusion in "best ATS" roundups, comparison pages and industry publications
Build an authentic presence for Recooty in Reddit, Quora and HR communities
Improve on-site AI readiness: structured data, crawlability for AI bots, entity consistency, and comparison and alternatives pages
Work with our content workflow to make blog posts and landing pages more citable
Track results using AI visibility tools, Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools
What we're looking for
2-4 years in SEO, preferably B2B SaaS, with at least 6 months of hands-on AEO/GEO work you can show us
A clear understanding of how AI search engines choose and cite sources
Experience with off-page SEO, digital PR or review platform management
Comfort with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console and at least one AI visibility tracker
Strong written English suited to a US and UK audience
A habit of testing, measuring and reporting rather than guessing
Nice to have
Experience marketing to US buyers
Familiarity with schema markup and technical SEO
A portfolio of brands you've helped get cited in AI answers
Hiring process
Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical task: audit how AI platforms answer one real buyer query, list the sources they cite, and outline a 30-day plan to get Recooty included.
Why join us
Ownership of a high-impact channel from day one
Work directly with the founders
Learn the newest discipline in search marketing in a real SaaS growth environment
Performance-linked growth

Job Location: Jabalpur
Note: This is a full-time, on-site role at our Jabalpur Office. Remote and hybrid applications may not be considered. SEO AEO GEO SaaS Digital PR Technical SEO Schema Markup Ahrefs Semrush Google Search Console Bing Webmaster Tools Content Strategy Data Analysis Copywriting B2B Marketing The role requires 2-4 years of experience in SEO, specifically within B2B SaaS, with hands-on experience in AEO or GEO. Job Description
Overview
This position may be offered as either a contract-to-hire or a regular full-time role, depending on your overall experience and the technical competencies demonstrated during the interview process.
Kindly proceed with your application only if you meet the job requirements.
Please do not apply if you have attended any interview with us in the past 6 months. To improve your chances of getting shortlisted, apply only for the single most suitable job that aligns with your skills and experience.
The Project & Programme Services (PPS) team is a critical component of the Global Project & Programme Management Office (GPMO). The team delivers predictable and efficient project performance management, reporting, and business intelligence across global portfolios. Operating from the Global Technology Centre (GTC) in India, PPS provides cost-effective, agile, and scalable programme services using an onshore-offshore delivery model. Our ambition is to become the global leader in Programme Management Services by building a future-ready, digitally enabled, high-performing team.
We are seeking an experienced Planning & Project Controls professional to support the successful delivery of complex projects across Process, Manufacturing & Production, Energy, Pharma, Infrastructure, Transportation (Rail, Highways, and Aviation) sectors. The role combines expertise in planning, scheduling, cost management, project controls, reporting and performance monitoring to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget while meeting client and business objectives.
Your role
Planning & Scheduling
Develop, maintain, and control integrated project schedules using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and other planning tools.
Establish and manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), activity sequencing, logic links, resource loading, and schedule baselines.
Prepare detailed look-ahead schedules and monitor progress against approved baselines.
Conduct Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis, schedule performance analysis, and delay analysis.
Identify schedule risks and opportunities and develop mitigation and recovery plans.
Support change management processes and update Performance Measurement Baselines (PMB) for approved scope and schedule changes.
Develop and maintain EPC project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
Project Controls & Cost Management
Establish and maintain Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) aligned with project WBS.
Prepare project control procedures, governance frameworks, and reporting structures.
Track and analyse project budgets, commitments, actual costs, accruals, forecasts, contingencies, and cash flows.
Perform Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis and provide performance insights.
Monitor project cost and schedule variances, identify trends, and recommend corrective actions.
Produce periodic cost reports, forecasts, dashboards, and project performance reports.
Support pricing estimates and cost planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Assist project managers with early warnings, change orders, claims support, and project controls documentation.
Risk, Change & Performance Management
Support qualitative and quantitative risk analysis activities.
Monitor project KPIs and performance indicators.
Conduct change impact assessments and schedule/cost impact analyses.
Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and project governance processes.
Support supply chain management activities and contract administration requirements.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and standardization of project controls processes.
Reporting & Data Analytics
Develop Power BI dashboards and interactive reports to support project decision-making.
Analyse project data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Monitor and report KPIs, trends, forecasts, and project performance metrics.
Utilize data analytics, Power BI, DAX, SQL, and business intelligence tools to improve project visibility and reporting effectiveness.
Support automation and digital transformation initiatives within project controls functions.
Stakeholder & Client Engagement
Collaborate with project managers, engineering teams, contractors, clients, and other stakeholders.
Serve as a key point of contact for planning and project controls activities.
Facilitate alignment on schedule, cost, risk, and performance objectives.
Participate in client meetings, steering committees, project reviews, and governance forums.
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support successful project delivery.
Leadership & Team Development
Mentor and guide junior planners and project controls professionals.
Promote best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across projects and portfolios.
Demonstrate leadership, accountability, and commitment to high-quality project delivery.
About you
Technical Competencies
Strong experience in Planning, Scheduling, Cost Management, and Project Controls.
Expert understanding of CPM scheduling techniques and Earned Value Management.
Hands-on experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and related planning tools.
Experience with cost management systems such as EcoSys or equivalent.
Proficiency in cost management tools such as EcoSys and report preparation skills
Practiced - Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS), Cash Flow, Contingency Management 
Proficient in Financial System Interface, Budget/Cost Control, Cost Change Control
Knowledge of NEC3, NEC4, and FIDIC contracts and their impact on project controls, claims, and scheduling.
Strong understanding of engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning processes.
Experience in EPC and infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
Proficiency in Power BI, data analytics, reporting, and dashboard development.
Knowledge of automation tools, VBA, and digital solutions is an advantage.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Building Technology, or a related discipline.
6-12 years of relevant experience in Planning and/or Project Controls roles on large-scale projects.
Experience supporting UK, Middle East, or US projects is preferred.
Master's degree in Project Management or related field is an advantage.
Preferred Certifications
PMP (Project Management Professional), APM / MAPM, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MRICS
Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Certified Schedule Professional (CSP)
Certified Estimating Professional (CEP) or equivalent professional certifications.
Competencies
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and report-writing abilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Excellent organizational skills and adaptability in a dynamic project environment.
Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
Rewards & benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: SW Engineer II
job_description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Title: Software Engineer
Location: Hyderabad
Grade: 10
About NCR Atleos:

NCR Atleos (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company creating exceptional self-service banking experiences. We offer all the services, software and hardware solutions needed for a comprehensive self-service channel. NCR Atleos (www.ncratleos.com) is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
YOU ARE:
Passionate about technology and see the world a little differently than your peers. Everywhere you look, there’s possibility and opportunity. You don’t see problems—you see boundaries to push and challenges to solve. Why? Because you believe software engineering changes how people live.
At NCR Atleos, we believe that, too. We’re one of the world’s first tech companies, and still going strong. Like us, you know the online and mobile worlds better than any other - and see patterns that no one else sees. Our software engineers write code that can survive under the pressure of hundreds of thousands of requests per minute.
Curious? Read on. We’re looking for software engineers like you.
PEOPLE DESCRIBE YOU AS:
Someone who just gets it. From system architecture to technical specifics, you see the big picture and how everything - and everyone - works together from start to finish.
Passionate about quality and performance, while understanding the tradeoff between time and perfection. People see you as innately curious with a desire to explore different approaches and apply them to new problems.
The one everyone wants on their team. You simply bring out the best in other people.
Others look at you as their future dream role which is sweet balance between solving technical challenges and helping others to solve their problems.
YOU CAN EXPECT TO:
Deliver high-quality large-scale applications that adhere to ever increasing demands of availability, reliability, security and performance that enable an optimal consumer experience as a strong individual contributor and/or mentor.
Contribute to development in Java, Spring boot as a major and two or more complementing skills e.g. Postgres, React, DevOps, Azure etc.
Learn and use technologies based on project and work need.
Design beyond scope if necessary to build right solution.
Exhibit outside-in & design-based thinking to identify critical customer needs beyond scope of requirements.
Consult with internal & external stakeholders to gather understanding of domain, customer & strategic requirements.
Define features to stories and effectively translate the design into software design, recognizing where gaps in understanding exist that can impact building of code.
Participate in design reviews/code walkthroughs with developers and architects to ensure testability/supportability of software.
Identify and highlight gaps in team expertise.
Participate in discussions with customer and/or product management to ensure products add value and meet customer needs.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to take ownership and drive effective technical solutions.
Be a problem solver in the team.
Be part of a global, collaborative team who is always on the hunt for ways to improve and upgrade our products. At NCR Atleos, you’ll get the feel of a start-up, but with solid corporate support.
YOU HAVE:
A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field or equivalent experience.
1+ years of experience full-stack development using Java, Microservices, Cloud.
Experience with Core Java, J2EE, Spring boot, Micro services,AngularJS, JavaScript and/or other web-based technology.
Working knowledge on two or more complementing skills e.g. GCP, Azure, Database, Python, React etc.
Practical experience incorporating AI into software engineering workflows, including leveraging GitHub Copilot, developing AI agents, and integrating AI capabilities into the development lifecycle.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies/methodologies.
Expert understanding of core computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, design patterns and concurrent programming
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical co-workers
Everything required to become a young, dynamic professional with paramount energy
Strong desire to continually learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies, including those out of your comfort zone.
Your own views and do not hesitate to speak about those.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and on diverse problems, under minimal supervision, with guidance from senior team members. You know how to balance multiple projects (with varying priorities, of course!) all at once.
Been seen as a solid professional who can own and deliver by leading a small to medium size team
Ability to be seen as a problem solver
Ability to ask challenging questions and encourage dialogue to stimulate innovative thinking in others

**Visit our careers site for a list of the benefits offered in your region in addition to a competitive base salary and strong work/family programs.

NCR Atleos is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes. EEO Statement NCR Atleos is an equal opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos' policy to hire, train, promote and pay associates based on their job-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, colour, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, or veteran status.
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.
EEO Statement
NCR Atleos is an equal-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

title: Customer Service Team Leader
job_description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. 
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place. 
About you and this role
Leads a team of customer service order management and business quality professionals, including day-to-day operations, managing talent selection and performance and interfacing with the business on order fulfillment considerations relevant to the business.
Responsibilities
Provides direct leadership to a team of order management professions that provide direct interface to customers.
Provides day-to-day coaching on Customer Service operations.
Accountable for decisions regarding employee desk complexity, performance, escalations and exceptions.
Ensures work process execution is operating effectively within the team.
Collaborates with the business to ensure business strategy and service offerings are met.
Makes hiring decisions.Collaborates across the function for leveraging best practices
Qualification:
A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. Master’s degree is preferred.
A minimum of 5-10 years of combined experience ideally in Supply chain but could also be in allied functions/teams like Purchasing, Sales/Marketing, M&E (Manufacturing & Engineering)
Strong People Leadership experience would be preferred
Strong business and financial acumen would be preferred
Passion for team building/organization building, coaching, mentoring
Expertise in Continuous improvement methodologies and/or metrics, storytelling and data analysis would be preferred
Your Skills
Requires strong influence management skills and understanding of business priorities.
Ability to persuade others (internal and external stakeholders) through effective communication skills and strong collaboration skills across colleagues and stakeholders.
An understanding of the region and its capabilities / global connect and presence and excellent data analytics & process knowledge.
Familiarity of leading improvement projects and having accountability for on-going activities or initiatives.
Exhibition of strong work ethic and responsiveness to facilitate excellent Customer Experience.
Additional notes
Relocation/visa sponsorship is not aligned with this role
The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential
Benefits – What Dow offers you 
We invest in you. 
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing. 
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: 
Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 
Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 
Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 
Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 
Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 
Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 
Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 
Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)
Join our team, we can make a difference together.
About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com. People leadership Order management Coaching Mentoring Business strategy Financial acumen Continuous improvement Data analysis Influence management Communication skills Collaboration Process knowledge Project management Customer experience Storytelling A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required, with a Master's degree preferred. Candidates must have 5-10 years of experience in supply chain or allied functions, along with strong leadership and data analysis capabilities.

title: Brand Development Executive - Salon
job_description:
Brand Development Executive – Salon
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat Experience: 0–2 Years Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Salon Brand Lead / Marketing Head
About the Company
An Indian, science-backed personal care company built around plant-based actives, performance, and formulas dosed to deliver. Across consumer and professional beauty, the company aims to replace confusing claims and trial-and-error routines with clearer, more credible, results-led care. As the company scales, it is building a high-ownership marketing and creative team that can combine consumer understanding, strong design, disciplined execution, and long-term brand building.
Role Overview
The Brand Development Executive – Salon will convert salon brand positioning and strategy into strong, usable visual systems and collaterals. The role sits between brand strategy, design, sales, education, and field execution, ensuring that every salon-facing touchpoint makes the brand easier to understand, present, recommend, and sell.
Key Responsibilities
Translate salon brand positioning, product architecture, treatment protocols, and campaign strategy into clear creative and collateral briefs.
Develop and coordinate salon-facing assets such as menus, consultation tools, diagnosis aids, treatment cards, product guides, protocol books, posters, displays, launch kits, training aids, and event materials.
Work with designers, copywriters, trainers, product teams, sales teams, printers, fabricators, and vendors to take assets from brief to production.
Ensure visual consistency, hierarchy, terminology, claims, and product accuracy across all salon collaterals.
Create modular toolkits for different salon formats, concern categories, launch priorities, and levels of investment.
Visit salons and gather structured feedback on whether materials are understandable, usable, visible, and supportive of consultation and conversion.
Audit current materials, identify gaps or duplication, and recommend simplification or redesign.
Maintain master files, version control, quantities, print specifications, vendor details, and rollout trackers.
Support salon launches, trade shows, workshops, education events, and visibility programmes with appropriate brand assets.
Work on a growing Indian beauty and personal care brand with strong product, consumer, and salon exposure.
Take meaningful ownership and see your work move quickly from idea to market.
Collaborate closely with marketing, design, product, R&D, sales, education, and leadership teams.
Build category depth while contributing to a distinctive, performance-led brand world.


Requirements
Required Skills & Qualifications
0–2 years of experience in brand development, trade marketing, retail marketing, visual merchandising, sales enablement, or creative project management.
Ability to understand strategy and convert it into a clear brief and practical market-facing tool.
Strong visual judgment, written communication, attention to detail, and cross-functional coordination.
Good understanding of print, production, dimensions, materials, finishing, and vendor workflows.
Comfort reviewing copy, claims, layouts, prototypes, proofs, and final production output.
Strong project management skills with disciplined tracking and timely follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience in professional beauty, salons, cosmetics, FMCG, retail, luxury, or B2B2C brand environments.
Understanding of stylist/beautician education, consultation journeys, treatment menus, and in-salon conversion.
Working knowledge of Adobe, Figma, Canva, or visual merchandising tools for review and minor adaptations. Brand development Trade marketing Retail marketing Visual merchandising Sales enablement Creative project management Project management Print production Vendor management Copywriting Adobe Figma Canva Brand strategy Cross-functional coordination Candidates should have 0-2 years of experience in brand development, trade marketing, or related creative project management roles. Strong visual judgment, project management skills, and an understanding of print production and vendor workflows are required.

title: Inbound Sales Executive
job_description:
scanO | Trismus Healthcare Technologies
Sales Development Representative (Inbound)
Sales · Pune or Chennai · Full-time
	

EXPERIENCE
1 to 2 years
	
REPORTS TO
VP Sales
	
WORK MODE
On-site
	
DAYS
Mon to Sat*
	
FUNCTION
Inbound Sales
	
TEAM
Sales
	
ABOUT SCANO
scanO is an AI-powered oral health screening platform, backed by the Google for Startups Accelerator. Our technology detects 40+ oral conditions from a scan and is used by dental clinics across 9+ global markets, including India, the UK, the UAE, South Africa and Singapore.
We are a team of 50+ in Pune, and we build the whole stack in-house: the computer vision models, the in-clinic hardware, the practitioner platform and the patient app.
THE ROLE
Every week, dentists and clinic owners reach out to us through our website, campaigns, webinars and expo booths. Someone has to pick up that interest quickly, understand what the clinic actually needs, explain what scanO does, and get the right prospects in front of our senior sales team.
That is this role. You are the first human voice a prospective customer hears, and the quality of that conversation decides whether a deal ever happens.
This is an inbound-first role. No cold call lists, no field visit targets. Outbound calling is limited to people who have already raised their hand: follow-ups, demo no-shows and older enquiries.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Lead handling and qualification
Respond to inbound leads from web forms, campaigns, inbound calls, event enquiries and referrals. Run first-level discovery calls to understand the clinic profile, chair count, patient volume, who the real decision-maker is, and how soon they intend to move.
Product pitching
Explain scanO’s capabilities and value clearly to dentists, clinic owners and healthcare partners. We will train you on the clinical and technical details. What you bring is the ability to make it land inside a five-minute phone call.
Pipeline management
Book qualified leads into demo slots with the senior sales team, and own the follow-up discipline that gets prospects to actually turn up.
CRM hygiene
Log call notes, lead stage, qualification detail and next actions accurately, on the same day. Our forecasting depends on it.
Market feedback
Report recurring objections, pricing pushback, competitor mentions and feature requests to the marketing, product and sales teams. You hear the market before anyone else here does.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience: 1 to 2 years in inside sales, inbound sales, lead qualification or customer engagement. Product sales experience in SaaS, healthtech, dental, edtech, fintech or B2B is strongly preferred.
Education: Any graduate. Candidates with a BDS, B.Sc or dental hygiene background who want to move out of clinical practice into a commercial role are especially encouraged to apply.
Languages: Fluent English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong plus for Pune, Tamil is a strong plus for Chennai.
Skills: Active listening over talking. Handles objections without getting defensive. Has the judgement to tell whether a lead deserves the senior team’s time, and the honesty to say when it does not.
Work style: Comfortable in a target-driven environment and on the phone for a large part of the day. Adaptable, because a startup changes its process more often than a large company does. 


Requirements
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
What we measure

The first 60 days carry ramp targets, not full quota. You will not be judged on month one numbers.
COMPENSATION
Fixed salary plus a monthly demo incentive. The monthly demo target is [ demos per month ], set with you and reviewed each quarter.

The slab rate applies retroactively to every payable demo in the month, not only to demos above the slab line. Crossing target therefore lifts the rate on the whole month.
What counts as a payable demo
An online demo is payable when it is scheduled and executed, the prospect attends for the scheduled duration, the attendee is a decision maker or influencer at a clinic, hospital or institution, and the demo is not marked disqualified by the demonstrating salesperson within 24 hours of completion.
Payout conditions
The month’s incentive is released only when same-day CRM logging is at 95% or above and the first-response SLA was met on 90% or more of assigned leads.
Incentives are paid with the following month’s salary, after the 24-hour disqualification window has closed on the last demo of the month.
Cancelled, rescheduled and no-show demos are not payable. A rescheduled demo becomes payable in the month it is actually executed.
Ramp period
Month 1: no demo target. Fixed salary plus a one-time Rs 5,000 incentive on completing product certification.
Month 2: 50% of full target, with the slab rates above applied to that reduced target.
Month 3 onward: full target.
WHAT WE OFFER
Direct exposure to a growing AI healthtech company selling into nine international markets.
Structured onboarding on the product, the clinical vocabulary and the sales process.
Regular working sessions with the VP Sales, and direct access to both co-founders. This is a 50-person company, not a call centre floor. A graduate degree is required, and fluency in English and Hindi is essential, with proficiency in Marathi or Tamil considered a strong plus.

title: Reward Partner, VP
job_description:
Join us as a Reward Partner
This is an opportunity for a driven individual to sponsor projects to drive changes to pay constructs or to meet regulatory requirements
You’ll provide expert support and technical advice and frameworks for business areas that have a high volume of compensation constructs
Joining a diverse and collaborative team, you can expect lots of variety in this fast-paced role
We're offering this role at vice president level
What you'll do
In this key role, you’ll be advising on appropriate pay constructs, collations and analysis of market data, support for business cases, advice on exit packages, annual pay review and bonus process, remuneration design, policy guidance and reward benchmarking.
Throughout the course of your work, you’ll also develop pay constructs that strike the right balance of fixed and variable pay across the bank, alongside working with business heads to design the fixed pay construct, including pensions and benefits provision.
You’ll also be:
Co-sponsoring the annual pay review process
Providing HR ExCo and bank-wide leaders with expert diagnostic, insights and challenge regarding compensation
Governing the compensation approval requests and severance approval requests processes
Working with a range of colleagues to make sure employee relations for Reward items are well managed with social partners
Managing delivery against financial plans and budgets, including forecasting, resource allocation and prioritisation
The skills you'll need
We’re looking for someone with experience gained in a banking, regulatory or commercial environment, coupled with knowledge and application of HR theories, models and best practices.
We’ll also expect:
At least twelve years of experience in compensation and benefits
Expert knowledge of compensation, regulatory reward and governance practices and their application
Knowledge of regulations and how they apply to reward and benefit structures
Understanding of attraction and retention and how that interplays with Reward and EVP
Analytical skills, stakeholder management and the ability to derive actionable insights
Knowledge of relevant legal policies, regulations and risk management

title: Structural Design Engineer - Metallics
job_description:
ABOUT COMPANY

Agnikul Cosmos is a company incubated at IIT Madras and we build rockets that can take satellites up to 500 kg to Lower Earth Orbit (LEO). In May 2024, we successfully completed our maiden launch from our own launchpad (India's first private launchpad). The launch has proven all the new technologies developed by Agnikul and also earned recognition from Honourable Prime Minister of India.

We are seeking a highly skilled Structural Design Engineer to join our Flight Structures team focused on designing and evaluating the dynamics performance of the vehicle.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible for build of initial development hardware, ensuring efficient manufacturability and modifying design as needed. 
Anticipate needed analyses and provide input throughout the design cycle.
Perform, document and present static, dynamic, model, thermo-mechanical, fatigue and fracture analyses.
Perform initial sizing analyses by hand calculation, detailed structural analysis using various FEA tools.
Perform detailed fluid system layout and/or mechanical design utilizing CAD and understanding of materials.
Seek out and evaluate state-of-the-art analysis techniques and tools.
Design, Identify and specify critical items such as Fasteners, machining parts, seals, forgings, etc.,
Coordinate and perform development and qualification efforts of hardware.
Design and build testing equipment or stands.
Manage the transition from development to production for flight quality hardware.


Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
Proficiency in finite element analysis software.
Strong understanding of concepts of Strength of Materials, Failure Criteria and Structural mechanics.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills:
Experience with rocket structure design and analysis.
A good knowledge in FEA software
A good understanding of Materials and its behaviours. Structural Design Finite Element Analysis FEA Software Strength Of Materials Failure Criteria Structural Mechanics CAD Thermo-mechanical Analysis Fatigue Analysis Fracture Analysis Mechanical Design Fluid System Layout Hardware Development Problem-solving Communication Skills Candidates must hold at least a Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Materials Engineering, with a Master's degree preferred. Proficiency in finite element analysis software and a strong understanding of structural mechanics and material behavior are required.

title: Graphic Designer
job_description:
About BLUFIG
Blufig is a full-service B2B marketing agency helping technology and enterprise brands accelerate their digital growth. With 130+ brands served globally, we combine strategic thinking, creative expertise, and data-driven digital solutions to deliver measurable business impact.



About the Role


We are looking for a Graphic Designer with strong creative skills and an eye for detail to join our growing design team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for creating engaging visual content and marketing collateral for B2B technology and enterprise brands.
You’ll work closely with content strategists, copywriters, and marketing teams to create impactful designs that strengthen brand presence, communicate ideas effectively, and drive 
engagement across digital channels. You’ll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of creative projects, from social media and digital campaigns to presentations, websites, and other marketing assets, while bringing fresh ideas and creative thinking to every project.
The role is ideal for someone who enjoys a fast-paced, collaborative environment, takes ownership of their work, and is committed to delivering high-quality designs that support business and marketing goals.

​
Key Responsibilities


Design and deliver high-quality B2B marketing collateral, including social media creatives, infographics, whitepapers, eBooks, landing pages, website designs, and presentations.
Create static and motion-based designs for marketing campaigns, digital ads, and video content.
Ensure all visuals align with brand guidelines and maintain consistency across digital channels.
Collaborate with content and account management teams to understand creative briefs and deliver projects within deadlines.
Stay updated on design trends, B2B marketing styles, and emerging creative tools and techniques.
Create visual assets for client pitches, proposals, and internal marketing initiatives.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of creativity and quality.

​


Requirements
Requirements
2–4 years of experience in graphic design, preferably within a digital marketing or creative agency.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign); Figma experience is a must, while Canva experience is a plus.
Strong understanding of layout, typography, and color theory.
Creative thinker with a strong portfolio demonstrating design versatility and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret creative briefs, manage timelines, and deliver high-quality designs under tight deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong passion for visual storytelling.

Good to Have


Experience working with B2B or technology brands.
Familiarity with basic motion design and video editing tools, such as After Effects and Premiere Pro.
Understanding performance marketing and social media design best practices.
Exposure AI-based design and creative tools, such as ChatGPT, Gamma, or Lottie.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and XD); Figma experience is a must, while Aftereffects, Premiere Pro experience is a plus.
Exposure AI-based design and creative tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, etc.


Benefits
Benefits
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Health insurance coverage for you and your family.
Opportunity to work with a creative and passionate team.
Fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative work environment.
Opportunity to work with leading global B2B technology brands. Graphic design Adobe Creative Suite Photoshop Illustrator InDesign Figma Layout design Typography Color theory Visual storytelling Motion design Video editing After Effects Premiere Pro Social media design Performance marketing Requires 2-4 years of graphic design experience with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma. Candidates should possess a strong portfolio demonstrating versatility in layout, typography, and color theory.

title: Management Accounting Lead
job_description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead management accounting activities that deliver timely, accurate financial information and insights. You will work closely with finance leaders, commercial and supply chain partners, shared services and external providers. We value clear thinking, practical problem-solving and collaboration. This role offers visible impact, steady career growth and the chance to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead the month-end management close for assigned entities, ensuring accurate P&L and balance sheet postings and timely delivery of management packs. - Own balance sheet reconciliations, investigate variances and drive timely resolution with stakeholders. - Prepare clear financial analysis and commentary to support commercial, supply chain and leadership decision-making. - Partner with commercial, supply chain, tax and shared service teams to ensure transactions are recorded and controlled correctly. - Manage relationships with shared service providers and external vendors to monitor delivery and improve process efficiency. - Support process improvements and reporting automation, including ERP updates and reporting tool enhancements. Why You? This role is based in India and follows a hybrid working pattern. You will combine on-site collaboration with agreed remote days. We are looking for a practical, curious and reliable finance professional who communicates clearly and builds strong working relationships. You will broaden your technical and leadership skills while making a direct impact on how finance supports our business and contributes to our mission. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals - Degree or professional accounting qualification (for example ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or equivalent practical experience in accounting. - Minimum 5 years’ experience in management accounting, financial reporting or statutory accounting. - Strong working knowledge of IFRS and month-end close processes. - Practical experience with SAP or similar ERP systems and strong Excel skills. - Proven ability to prepare reconciliations, variance analyses and management commentary for stakeholders. - This role is hybrid, with regular on-site collaboration as agreed with your manager. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus - Experience working with shared service providers or third-party BPOs and managing external delivery partners. - Familiarity with internal control frameworks such as SOX and experience supporting audits. - Exposure to supply chain finance, intercompany accounting or trade-related finance processes. - Hands-on experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau or SQL for data analysis and automation. - Track record of leading small teams, mentoring colleagues or managing stakeholders across regions. - Experience in finance transformation, ERP migration projects or S/4HANA deployments, including testing and cutover support. Working pattern This role is hybrid and based in India. You will work on-site regularly and have agreed remote days with your manager. Apply now If you are motivated by clear, practical finance work that supports important decisions, we want to hear from you. Please apply and tell us how your skills and experience will support our team and our mission. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will discuss any adjustments you may need during the recruitment process.

Skills
Business Acumen, Cyber Risks, Data Analytics, Digital Fluency, Driving Continuous Improvement, Financial Controlling, Financial Management Reporting, Stakeholder Management
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
Inclusion at GSK:
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Expert MS Dynamics with Hands on .Net, Dev (C# , SQL, Javascript)  || Pune
job_description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
Job Title
Expert MS Dynamics with Hands on .Net, Dev (C# , SQL, Javascript) || Pune
Experience: 5+ Years
MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
5 Days - Work from Office
Location: Pune, India

Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?
In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.

What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations
What you will need to have:
4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field
What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:
Apply using your legal name
Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).
Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 
Note to agencies:
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
Warning about fake job posts:
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address. Microsoft Dynamics 365 C# .NET JavaScript SQL Server Power Platform Power Automate Power Apps API Integration Data Migration Plugins Custom Workflows Azure DevOps CI/CD Agile Requires 4 to 10 years of IT experience with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365, C#, .NET, and JavaScript. A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field is required, along with proficiency in SQL and Power Platform.

title: Account Executive, Collaboration Architecture
job_description:
Meet the Team
Collaboration technology drives how organizations communicate and succeed. In sales, every conversation is an opportunity to build trust, solve problems, and create lasting relationships. Success here means making a real impact for our clients while growing professionally and personally. We’re excited to see you bring your unique strengths to help push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Your Impact
· Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve targets for Cisco’s collaboration products and services.
· Identify and prioritize target accounts; cultivate relationships with key decision-makers and partners.
· Engage with clients to understand business challenges and conduct detailed analyses to identify solution opportunities.
· Translate AI technical concepts into clear business value for clients.
· Lead large customer engagements, including CISO-level conversations within Cisco’s Commercial customers.

Minimum Qualifications:
· Over 10 years of experience in collaboration sales within OEM or Service Provider settings.
· Demonstrated success in developing and implementing effective strategies to drive collaboration adoption.
· In-depth knowledge of Cisco collaboration products and solutions.
· Proven experience working with Tier-1 and Tier-2 partners as well as system integrators.
· Strong network of relationships with collaboration decision - makers in enterprise organizations.
· Consistent track record of generating revenue growth and nurturing long-term client partnerships.
· Skilled in selling integrated technology solutions.
· Proficient in using CRM platforms such as Salesforce for managing sales pipelines and forecasting.
· Expertise in consultative selling, managing stakeholders, and closing high-value deals.

Preferred Qualifications
· Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
· Ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic team environment.
· Analytical mindset focused on identifying business opportunities.
· Passion for technology and innovation.
· Experience in competitive analysis within the collaboration domain.

Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
begin with screening or an interview
originate from a Cisco email address, and
be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx
Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams. Candidates must possess in-depth knowledge of Cisco collaboration products and a proven track record of generating revenue growth.

Summary of This Role
Works throughout the software development life cycle and performs in a utility capacity to create, design, code, debug, maintain, test, implement and validate applications with a broad understanding of a variety of languages and architectures. Analyzes existing applications or formulate logic for new applications, procedures, flowcharting, coding and debugging programs. Maintains and utilizes application and programming documents in the development of code. Recommends changes in development, maintenance and system standards. Creates appropriate deliverables and develops application implementation plans throughout the life cycle in a flexible development environment.
What Part Will You Play?
Develops basic code using a front or back end programming language within a platform as directed for internal and external client software solutions. Follows program specifications for routine coding and support on a project/issue with a limited understanding of the application / database.
Assists with basic application documentation, testing and validation as directed. Performs testing and validation requirements for basic code changes and corrective measures for basic code deficiencies as directed.
Applies a basic understanding of procedures, methodology and application standards to include Payment Card Industry (PCI) security compliance.
What Are We Looking For in This Role?
Minimum Qualifications
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business / Management Information Systems or related field
No experience required. Typically has a basic knowledge and use of one or more languages / technologies from the following but not limited to; two or more modern programming languages, experience working with various APIs, external Services, experience with both relational and NoSQL Databases.
Preferred Qualifications
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business / Management Information Systems or related field
Professional experience in coding, designing, developing and analyzing data
What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?
Skills / Knowledge - Learns to use professional concepts. Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues.
Job Complexity - Works on problems of limited scope. Follows standard practices and procedures in analyzing situations or data from which answers can be readily obtained. Builds stable working relationships internally.
Supervision - Normally receives detailed instructions on all work.
Operating Systems: 
Linux distributions including one or more for the following: Ubuntu, CentOS/RHEL, Amazon Linux
Microsoft Windows
z/OS
Tandem/HP-Nonstop
Database - Design, familiarity with DDL and DML for one or more of the following databases Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL Server, IMS, DB2, Hadoop
Back-end technologies - C++, GO, Python, 
Front-end technologies - HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, CICS
Web Frameworks – Web technologies like Node.js, React.js, Angular, Redux
Development Tools - Eclipse, Visual Studio, Webpack, Babel, Gulp
Mobile Development – iOS, Android
Machine Learning – Python, R, Matlab, Tensorflow, DMTK Software development Coding Debugging Testing Validation API Relational databases NoSQL Linux Python C++ Go JavaScript React.js Node.js PCI compliance Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. While no professional experience is required, familiarity with modern programming languages and database technologies is expected.

title: Integration Analyst - SAP O2C & P2P
job_description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Integrations Analyst with strong SAP functional expertise. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, customers, and partners to analyze business requirements, design and implement integration solutions, provide SAP domain expertise, and ensure successful product implementations and customer outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge of SAP FI along with experience in SD and/or MM modules, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with other Business Systems Analysts, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, Tax Research, Customers and Prospects.
Review and analyze existing integrations and business processes and develop approaches for improving or further leveraging these systems.
Provide deep SAP domain know-how and act as an SAP expert at Thomson Reuters for transaction tax solutions and coordinate with other functional areas within the ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Global Application Suite to ensure a full end-to-end Integration solution.
Perform detailed analysis of business integration with SAP modules (MM, SD, and FI) feasibility and integration support.
Perform SAP application configuration settings and options (MM, SD, and FI).
Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to other parties.
Follow product into the field to ensure customer success, providing business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.
Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Customer Support, Professional Services, and integration partners.
Analyzes customer problems of high complexity,Assesses scope of impact Mitigates customer impact of issues and defines, reviews, and executes work arounds.
Identifies options for problem resolution and initiates action engages others as appropriate and escalates as required.
Provides advice or training to users about the application systems' functionality, correct peration or constraints, and corrects user faults.
Provides input for technical plans and solutions.
Provides technical guidance to less experience analysts.
Has in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline or area and provides subject matter expertise.
Conducts root cause analysis and correlation of other system and/or application problems of high complexity.
Works on medium to large, moderately complex projects/issues that require increased skill in multiple technical environments and disciplines.
Prepares status updates for customer problems or projects.
Regularly communicates and shares knowledge with rest of the team.
Work Mode: Hybrid (2-3 days work from office is mandatory every week)
Shift Timing: 7:30pm IST to 4:30am IST
This job requires to support in US Central time.

Required Qualifications:
Bachelors in Business Administration or Computer Science or equivalent work experience; Formal education in accounting/finance is desired.
Familiarity with standard SAP accounting and G/L functionality in ECC, S/4HANA or S/4HANA Cloud a requirement.
Strong FI background a must, with experience in at least one of SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) or SAP MM (Procure-to-Pay).
At least 4-7 years of experience combining analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of large scale SAP implementations.
2 full implementation life cycles either as BSA or consultant, preferably including International/VAT deployments.
Project management experience strongly preferred.
Proficiency in SAP condition technique, pricing, and IMG configuration required.
Strong analytical and design skills.
Extensive, hands-on application configuration and design experience.
Previous work with SAP tax interface highly desired.
Previous work experience within a software company a plus.
SAP CRM and/or other ERP system experience is a plus.
Background in accounting fundamentals is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:
Ability to read and interpret ABAP code and work with database tools (such as DbVisualizer) a strong plus.
Understanding/experience with Indirect Tax/VAT a plus.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies.
Strong customer-facing experience and skills.
Strong organizational and planning skills.
Strong desire to learn & highly self- motivated.
Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment.
Possesses a professional and cooperative attitude.
Self- starter who works well both independently and on a team.
Previous experience or knowledge of working with ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Determination/ Sabrix is a plus
Previous work with US Sales and Use tax is a plus.
Self- starter who works well both independently and on a team.

#LI-GS2

What’s in it For You?
Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.
About Us
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com. Proficiency in SAP condition technique, pricing, and IMG configuration is required, along with strong analytical and customer-facing skills.

title: Team Leader
job_description:
About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech. 

The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.

What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL https://www.taskus.com/careers/. Team leadership Customer experience BPO operations People management Communication Problem solving Performance management Operational excellence Candidates should have experience in a BPO or customer service environment with strong leadership capabilities. The role requires the ability to handle challenges in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
