title: Services – Summer Analyst, India, 2027
job_description:
You're the brains behind our work.
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.

What is Services?
Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.
In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.

Your time here will look something like this:
Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth.
Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk.
Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings.
Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.
We want to hear from you if…
You are a junior in college, graduating between December 2027 and May 2028, with a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook.
You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn.
Who we think will be a great fit…
We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication skills.
A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail.
Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.
A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

Your future at Citi
Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services.

Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!

title: Design Engineer 2
job_description:
Fives Combustion System India. is actively seeking a Engineer – Engineering to join its teams in Vadodara, Gujarat.
At Fives, we are all driven by a common calling, to prove that industry can do it! We work together daily to make industry an answer to all of the major technological, environmental, social and economic challenges of our time. 
How do we do that? For over 200 years, we’ve invented and designed the solutions and technologies that substantially and sustainably improve everyone’s daily life. 
Fives Combustion System (FCS), Baroda is part of Fives Pillard (Fives Group) engaged in Designing, Engineering, Manufacturing and commissioning of various types of Burner equipment and combustion Systems, involving almost all types of fuels. FCS equipment provide optimum performance meeting all the needs in the field of Co- generation and Combined Cycle Plants, Incineration, Pyro-processing, Utility and Industrial Boilers, refinery and Petrochemicals Industries, Fertiliser and Agrochemical Industries as well as other Process Industries. FCS have also established a manufacturing Facility at Padra - Jambusar Highway, Dabhasa, Baroda. 
It is with you, that industry can do it!
We are currently seeking a Sr. Engineer – Engineering, who has the same desire to prove that “industry can do it!”At Fives we all have a part to play in achieving our common purpose. Your role will be to:
Responsibilities:•Translate product level requirements into subsystem/item/component design criteria.•Lead & Own engineering release of subsystem design including component, part CAD Drawings, and BOMs through transmittal•Develop and execute Validation & verification of Subsystem/Module/Components on schedule at required cost, quality and performance levels•Perform Engineering /Design calculations (mechanical)•Develop and capture knowledge required to deliver subsystem level excellence through Design•Creating 3D model/Reviewing the CAD drawing•Manage design trade-offs between cost, aesthetics, performance, and other design attributes.•Align current capability of architecture/supplier/manufacturing/customer solutions to meet product attribute targets and identify solutions for projects where current capability does not align to targets.•Co-ordinate to client/customer to transform their requirement in to drawing/document•Participate in and lead Technical Design Previews as needed•Communicate with interface department•Material selection & performing project planning, capital calendar & management.•Knowledge on System Engineering with Good analytical skills•Hands on experience 3D modelling and system layout, piping•Release Product / Component designs & drawings as per project targets.•Make sure correct location of Design Validation & Verification ReportsOther Essential Functions:•Hands on experience – SOLID works, AUTO CAD•Knowledge of ASME design and material code•Proficient in Strength of material and design•Convergent with customer’s specification•Preparation of documents data sheet for mechanical Buy out.•Managing operations•Working collaboratively with design engineers, operation engineers, purchasers and other internal staff•Project management within cost and time constrained environments•understanding and ensuring compliance with relevant health and safety regulations and quality standards•providing advice and consultancy support•Purchasing equipment
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE•Minimum of 2 years’ experience in 3D modeling, CAD and layout preparation•Experience in managing Mechanical engineering deliverable•Familiarity with process controls and strategy as per ISO•Ability to work well with others and lead by example•Proficient in Word, Excel, and Adobe Acrobat•Good communication skills with clients and employeesAt Fives Combustion System, and under the direction of the Dy. General Manager – Engineering who is reporting authority, you will join the Engineering team.Since we are located in Vadodara City, it will be easy for you to reach us by any transportation.If this is you, come join us, too!
We are seeking someone who has a BE/B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering / Diploma – Mech with recognized institute/university with 2 years of experience in the field of Engineering or Process Equipment as an Engineer.
If you are a self-starter, committed, confident then we are eager to change the world with you!
Why come to Fives?By becoming part of Fives, you will be joining an international group that will provide youaccess to numerous opportunities for growth and mobility, in a wide number of fields.We will give you room to learn, grow and develop, both professionally and personally,thanks to our onboarding and support programs. Indeed, you will be able to benefit froma hybrid work mode, and enjoy a number of other benefits also, for that you must contact.
Industry can do it with you! 3D modeling CAD SolidWorks AutoCAD Mechanical engineering System layout Piping ASME design Project planning Material selection Technical design Engineering calculations Validation and verification BOM management Analytical skills Communication Candidates must hold a BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with at least 2 years of experience in engineering or process equipment. Proficiency in SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and knowledge of ASME design codes are required.

At Fives, we are all driven by a common calling, to prove that industry can do it! We work together daily to make industry an answer to all of the major technological, environmental, social and economic challenges of our time. 
How do we do that? For over 200 years, we’ve invented and designed the solutions and technologies that substantially and sustainably improve everyone’s daily life. 
Fives Combustion System (FCS), Baroda is part of Fives Pillard (Fives Group) engaged in Designing, Engineering, Manufacturing and commissioning of various types of Burner equipment and combustion Systems, involving almost all types of fuels. FCS equipment provide optimum performance meeting all the needs in the field of Co- generation and Combined Cycle Plants, Incineration, Pyro-processing, Utility and Industrial Boilers, refinery and Petrochemicals Industries, Fertiliser and Agrochemical Industries as well as other Process Industries. FCS have also established a manufacturing Facility at Padra - Jambusar Highway, Dabhasa, Baroda. 
It is with you, that industry can do it!

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE•Minimum of 2 years’ experience in 3D modeling, CAD and layout preparation•Experience in managing Mechanical engineering deliverable•Familiarity with process controls and strategy as per ISO•Ability to work well with others and lead by example•Proficient in Word, Excel, and Adobe Acrobat•Good communication skills with clients and employeesAt Fives Combustion System, and under the direction of the Dy. General Manager – Engineering who is reporting authority, you will join the Engineering team.Since we are located in Vadodara City, it will be easy for you to reach us by any transportation.If this is you, come join us, too!
We are seeking someone who has a BE/B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering / Diploma – Mech with recognized institute/university with 2 years of experience in the field of Engineering or Process Equipment as an Engineer.
If you are a self-starter, committed, confident then we are eager to change the world with you!
Why come to Fives?By becoming part of Fives, you will be joining an international group that will provide youaccess to numerous opportunities for growth and mobility, in a wide number of fields.We will give you room to learn, grow and develop, both professionally and personally,thanks to our onboarding and support programs. Indeed, you will be able to benefit froma hybrid work mode, and enjoy a number of other benefits also, for that you must contact.
Industry can do it with you! Solidworks AutoCAD 3D modeling Mechanical engineering System engineering Piping layout ASME design codes Strength of materials Project planning Technical design CAD drawings BOM management Validation and verification Material selection Analytical skills Communication skills Candidates must hold a BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with at least 2 years of experience in engineering or process equipment. Proficiency in Solidworks, AutoCAD, and knowledge of ASME design codes are essential for this position.

Amazon NA Phone Voice

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our IT Services team in a dynamic role focused on delivering high-quality voice support to customers in the North American region. Join RTX and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace and defense while contributing to technologies that shape the future of flight.
About Collins Aerospace
Collins Aerospace is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace and defense solutions.
With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio, Collins Aerospace develops innovative systems and technologies that help customers meet the evolving demands of the global aerospace industry.
Our teams work on mission-critical avionics and safety-critical systems, where engineering excellence, innovation, quality, and safety are at the heart of everything we do.
Join Collins Aerospace and help shape the future of flight through advanced avionics systems and technologies.
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior Systems Engineer with strong expertise in the Avionics domain, particularly in Flight Display Systems & Applications (FDSA), Flight Management Systems (FMS), or Flight Control Systems (FCS).
In this role, you will contribute to the development, integration, verification, and certification of complex avionics systems. You will apply your strong systems-engineering knowledge to translate customer and system requirements into robust, safe, and compliant aerospace solutions.
The ideal candidate will have a strong aerospace engineering background, hands-on experience with avionics systems, and a passion for learning and applying systems engineering principles to increasingly complex aerospace products.
This is an exciting opportunity to work on next-generation avionics technologies and collaborate with experienced engineers, architects, customers, and cross-functional teams in a highly regulated aerospace environment.
What You Will Do
Avionics Systems Engineering
Apply strong systems-engineering expertise across FDSA, FMS, FCS, or related avionics domains.
Work on the development, integration, verification, and certification of complex avionics subsystems.
Analyze system requirements and translate them into clear and traceable engineering requirements.
Support system architecture, interface definition, integration, verification, and validation activities.
Collaborate with software, hardware, systems, verification, and certification teams to deliver integrated avionics solutions.
Avionics Communication & Interfaces
Work with avionics communication protocols such as ARINC 429 (A429) and AFDX.
Understand avionics interfaces, data communication, and system-level integration.
Exposure to I/O-related activities, including IOCF, will be an added advantage.
Requirements & Engineering Processes
Develop, manage, review, and maintain system requirements using tools such as Jama and DOORS.
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and aligned with system and customer needs.
Support requirements verification, validation, traceability, and change management throughout the product lifecycle.
Testing, Verification & Certification
Support testing and verification of avionics subsystems such as FDSA, FMS, and FCS.
Analyze test results and support resolution of system-level issues.
Apply aerospace engineering standards and processes to ensure compliance and product quality.
Work with certification teams to support safety-critical avionics development and certification activities.
Systems Safety & Compliance
Apply knowledge of ARP4754 and relevant aerospace systems-engineering processes.
Support system development activities within a highly regulated and safety-critical environment.
Participate in engineering reviews, assessments, audits, and continuous improvement activities.
Experience with IPA/IQA audits will be an added advantage.
Collaboration & Continuous Learning
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and stakeholders to solve complex system-level challenges.
Communicate technical issues, analysis, risks, and recommendations effectively.
Demonstrate a strong interest in learning and expanding systems-engineering expertise.
Contribute to engineering best practices, process improvements, and technical knowledge sharing.
What You Will Learn
Gain deeper expertise across advanced avionics systems and architectures.
Expand your knowledge of FDSA, FMS, FCS, and other safety-critical avionics systems.
Develop stronger systems-engineering skills across the complete product lifecycle.
Gain exposure to system requirements, architecture, integration, verification, and certification.
Strengthen knowledge of avionics communication protocols such as A429 and AFDX.
Build deeper expertise in ARP4754 and aerospace systems-engineering processes.
Gain experience working with requirements and traceability tools such as Jama and DOORS.
Collaborate with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams on complex aerospace programs.
Develop expertise in engineering audits, assessments, process compliance, and continuous improvement.
Continue building your career in next-generation avionics and aerospace systems engineering.
Qualifications You Must Have
10+ years of relevant experience in an avionics engineering domain such as FDSA, FMS, FCS, or related avionics systems.
Strong experience in Systems Engineering within the avionics/aerospace industry.
Proven experience in the testing, integration, verification, or development of avionics subsystems such as FDSA, FMS, or FCS.
Strong knowledge of avionics communication protocols, particularly ARINC 429 and AFDX.
Strong understanding of system requirements and requirements management.
Hands-on experience with requirements-management tools such as Jama and/or DOORS.
Strong knowledge of ARP4754 and its application in aerospace systems engineering.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Demonstrated interest and willingness to learn and grow in Systems Engineering.
Experience in a highly regulated aerospace or safety-critical engineering environment.
Qualifications We Prefer
Experience across multiple avionics domains such as FDSA, FMS, and FCS.
Experience with I/O-related engineering activities, including IOCF.
Experience participating in IPA/IQA audits, assessments, and compliance activities.
Experience with avionics system integration and interface management.
Strong understanding of system-level verification and validation.
Experience working with global customers and geographically distributed engineering teams.
Experience supporting complete avionics product lifecycles from requirements through integration, verification, and certification.
Strong understanding of aerospace engineering standards and processes.
Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive resolution of complex system-level issues.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Preferred qualifications include B.Tech / BE in Aerospace or Aeronautical Engineering or M.E / M.Tech in Avionics or a related aerospace discipline.
For engineering and technical positions, a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) with relevant professional experience is typically required, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.
Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field with a minimum of 5 years of experience.

title: Software Engineering Manager
job_description:
Software Engineering Manager
Ecolab is looking for an experienced Software Engineering Manager to manage a team supporting Ecolab’s GBS (Global Business Services) and Corporate Platforms organization. This team creates, implements, enhances and maintains multiple business applications including vendor hosted as well as Ecolab hosted solutions. These solutions support Ecolab GBS organizations around the world. 
What’s in it For You:
The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments
The ability to make an impact and shape a career for local team members with a company that is passionate about growth
The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best
undefined
undefined
Drive technical excellence across multiple GBS solutions
Participate in technical design reviews to ensure high-quality platforms.
Develop and implement plans to fill skillset gaps on the team and within the broader global organization
Contribute to the technical roadmap by identifying gaps in our technical implementation and opportunities for improvement.
Identify and cross-train technical solution members within the team to provide platform support coverage
Directly manage all work flowing through the team
Focus on timely delivery/issue resolution while ensuring quality, overseeing work through to acceptance by the originating team/requestor.
Ensure that all work completed by the team undergoes thorough peer review, testing, and adheres to Ecolab best practices.
Measure performance of the team through reporting of KPIs and other metrics
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide insights into team progress, delivery timelines, and individual professional goals.
Develop and maintain reporting frameworks to communicate team metrics and progress effectively to stakeholders.
Communicate clear expectations regarding work completion timelines, including prompt communication of any anticipated delays.
Grow talent and manage team composition
Conduct weekly 1:1s with core team members to support their professional development.
Make recommendations regarding missing or inadequately staffed skill sets to optimize team capabilities.
Hire, mentor, and grow passionate individuals who thrive in strong teams and facilitate the onboarding process for new members.
Provide learning opportunities and guidance for team members.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, MIS) or equivalent work experience
Minimum 3 years’ experience managing teams
5+ years’ experience supporting global IT technology solutions, where installation, upgrades, coding, performance tuning, support and administration were required
Experience developing or supporting system integrations, ETL solutions
Experience with applications running on Windows/UNIX Operating System
Experience developing and managing SQL databases
Experience working with third-party support teams and vendors
Able to act independently, seeking guidance and advice as appropriate
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with SAP integrated applications
Experience with SaaS solutions
Experience with ServiceNow and ITIL principals
Experience with Source to Pay or other global business services or shared services pillars
Experience mentoring and professionally developing software engineers, with a focus on creating formal learning opportunities
Adaptive to changing priorities and managing multiple tasks effectively
Strong communication, interpersonal, and project leadership skills, with an ability to articulate and execute a philosophy for building effective, cohesive, and collaborative cross-functional teams
Ability to think strategically while managing day-to-day execution
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Knowledge of application concepts/make-up such as security, database, servers, networks and cloud & virtualization concepts
A trusted partner at nearly three million commercial customer locations, Ecolab (ECL) is the global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services. With annual sales of $13 billion and more than 45,000 associates, Ecolab delivers comprehensive solutions, data-driven insights and personalized service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world.
When you come to work at Ecolab, you get to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges and have the opportunity to learn and grow, shape your career, make an impact and quickly see the importance of your work. Team Management Software Engineering Technical Design System Integration ETL Solutions SQL Databases KPI Reporting Vendor Management ITIL ServiceNow SAP Project Leadership Mentoring Cloud Concepts Virtualization Performance Tuning Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and at least 5 years of experience supporting global IT technology solutions. Additionally, a minimum of 3 years of team management experience is required, along with proficiency in system integrations, SQL databases, and vendor management.

title: Network Platform Development Engineer (Switch, SAI, NOS/SDK, Routing/Tunneling/Overlay protocols, L2/L3 Development, C, Linux Kernel, DPDK)
job_description:
About Marvell
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 
Your Team, Your Impact
Marvell is a leading provider of innovative technologies, including ultra-fast read channels, high-performance processors, leading edge transceivers, highly efficient analog designs, and powerful cryptographic engines. These solutions address all segments of the hard disk drive (HDD) and solid-state drive (SSD) electronics markets, providing complete solutions including controllers, product firmware, and reference board designs. Many of the same technologies have been utilized in Marvell system solutions products, powering PCs, servers, cloud, and enterprise systems.
What You Can Expect
Architect next-generation switching and DPU-based solutions tailored for enterprise and cloud-scale environments.
Implement and optimize control plane and data plane functionalities for switch platforms.
Advance Layer 2/3 networking capabilities including VLANs, VXLAN, L2GRE, MPLS, BGP, OSPF, and multicast for scalable, resilient infrastructure.
Design high-performance switching fabrics with sophisticated packet processing pipelines, QoS, congestion control, and telemetry support.
Develop and integrate robust security features such as 802.1X, MACsec, NAC, micro-segmentation, and threat detection mechanisms.
Contribute to and influence open-source initiatives (e.g., SONiC, SAI, OVS, DPDK, ODP, Linux kernel) and help define future networking standards.
Collaborate with hardware teams to bring up new Switch SoC platforms and ensure seamless hardware-software integration.
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and continuous integration processes.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of experience. OR Master’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience.
Proficiency in C, C++, Python, and Lua scripting.
Deep understanding of Ethernet switching, Layer 2/3 protocols, DPUs and networking standards.
Strong hands-on experience with SONiC, SAI, Cumulus Linux, OVS, DPDK, ODP, and DPU technologies.
Familiarity with ARM multicore SoC architecture and high-speed packet I/O.
Solid grasp of networking constructs such as ACLs, LPM, EM, routing, MAC learning, QoS, bridging, and load balancing.
Exposure to cloud networking, SDN, or network virtualization technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in distributed team environments.
Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and deliver complex technical projects.
A passion for continuous learning and thriving in fast-paced, innovation-driven settings.
This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 
Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

About Marvell
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 
Your Team, Your Impact
Marvell is creating the cloud data protection and security space. We partner with some of the major public cloud providers and make it easy for their customers to protect, secure, and encrypt their data simply and scalably in public, private, hybrid cloud environment. As cloud continues to grow at an astounding rate, businesses are constantly facing new threats and breaches. There is a greater need to provide end-to-end, next generation security products. We’ll be solving some of the most interesting challenges while building a product unlike anything seen before. This is a massive challenge and we’re just getting started so there is a lot of opportunity for personal growth and contribution. 

We are looking for passionate engineers that are just starting out their career and want to be challenged, in the domain of practical cryptography, quantum crypto, payment security and want to work on meaningful projects with an amazing team, that want a lot of responsibility, that want to create a massive impact.
What You Can Expect
Definition and implementation of product improvements, analyzing and troubleshooting deployment, configuration and product issues, proposing short term workarounds and implementing product fixes.
Functional and technical design of the software, developing and validating entire functional components and modules, collaboration with the team on integrating the product and its infrastructure, code reviews and improvement of the software development processes. 
Collaborate with Support, R&D and Technical marketing Engineers to diagnose and troubleshoot escalated customer issues and orchestrate development and testing of patches/hot-fixes. 
What We're Looking For
BS/BE/B.Tech, MS/ME/M.Tech or PhD in Computer Science or related field of study.
Strong in cyber security, data security, symmetric/asymmetric key cryptography, data structures, algorithms, and software design.
Expert knowledge developing and debugging in C, C++ and RUST
Embedded systems design and development experience is a bonus.
Strong interest in learning new technologies.
This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

title: Technical Support Executive
job_description:
Job Title: Technical Support Executive 
Department: Technical Operations
Location: Indore (On-site)
Experience: 1–3 Years
Company: Robro Systems
About Robro Systems 
Robro Systems is a fast-growing innovator in AI-powered automation and machine vision, specializing in web inspection solutions for technical textile manufacturers.
Our flagship Kiara Web Inspection System (KWIS) helps manufacturers with real-time defect detection, quality inspection, and operational efficiency.
At Robro, we are driven by Vision, Intelligence, and Control.
Role Overview 
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Support Executive who can understand and troubleshoot technical issues related to industrial automation, machine vision systems, electrical/electronic components, software, system connectivity, and Robro's products and solutions.
The person will be responsible for receiving and managing customer technical issues through Zoho Desk, understanding the actual problem, performing first-level ticketing support, guiding customers through basic troubleshooting, and coordinating with the Engineering/Service teams for further resolution.
This is a product and system technical support role, not a generic IT helpdesk, customer service, or call-center support role.
The candidate should be able to understand a technical problem from a customer, identify the possible cause, document the issue properly in Zoho Desk, communicate it clearly to the internal technical team, and track the ticket until resolution.

Key Responsibilities 
Receive and understand customer technical complaints through support tickets, calls, email, or other communication channels.
Analyse customer-reported issues related to Robro's machine vision and automation systems.
Perform first-level troubleshooting of hardware, electrical/electronic, software, communication, and system-level issues.
Maintain a proper history of customer issues and resolutions in Zoho Desk.
Understand symptoms, error messages, alarms, system behaviour, and operating conditions to identify possible root causes.
Guide customers or on-site technicians through basic troubleshooting and corrective steps.
Check and troubleshoot issues related to:
Industrial cameras and vision systems
Sensors and other field devices
Industrial PCs and system hardware
Cables, connectors, power supply, and communication connections
Network and device connectivity
Software/application-related issues
Machine/system configuration
Basic PLC/automation-related issues
Collect required technical information such as photos, videos, error screenshots, logs, machine status, error codes, and configuration details from customers.
Clearly document the problem, troubleshooting performed, observations, and current status in the support ticket.
Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Engineering, Service, QA, or Product teams with complete technical information.
Explain the customer's issue clearly to internal teams so that unnecessary back-and-forth can be avoided.
Follow up on open technical issues and ensure timely resolution as per defined SLA.
Provide remote technical assistance and coordinate with field/service engineers whenever required.
Assist the technical team during system installation, commissioning, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
Maintain records of recurring technical issues and their solutions.
Prepare and update SOPs, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and knowledge-base documentation.
Identify recurring problems and provide feedback to Engineering/Product teams for system or product improvement.
Be willing to travel to customer sites whenever required for technical support activities.


Requirements
Required Technical Skills 
The candidate should have a practical understanding of:

Basic electrical and electronic troubleshooting
Zoho Desk or similar technical support/ticketing platforms
Industrial hardware and control systems
Sensors, cameras, cables, connectors, and power systems
Industrial PCs and peripheral devices
Basic networking and communication troubleshooting
Hardware/software integration
System installation and configuration
Reading and understanding technical diagrams/manuals
Troubleshooting using a systematic, step-by-step approach
Basic understanding of automation and machine vision systems
Must-Have Qualifications 
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Computer Science, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Automation, or related technical discipline.
1–3 years of experience in technical support, field service, industrial automation, machine maintenance, equipment support, machine commissioning, electronics support, or a similar technical role.
Practical troubleshooting experience with hardware and technical systems.
Ability to understand a technical issue reported by a customer and identify the possible cause.
Ability to communicate technical problems clearly with Engineering/Service teams.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to work from the Indore office and travel to customer sites when required.

Important – Role Fit 
This position requires hands-on technical/product support experience.
Profiles primarily focused on the following will not be considered relevant:
Call Center / BPO Technical Support
Voice Process / Customer Care
Generic Customer Support
Telecom Customer Support
Banking/Insurance Customer Support
Non-technical Helpdesk roles
Desktop/IT Helpdesk Support
Customer Service Executive roles without hands-on technical troubleshooting experience Technical Support Industrial Automation Machine Vision Electrical Troubleshooting Electronic Troubleshooting Zoho Desk Hardware Troubleshooting System Connectivity PLC Sensors Industrial PCs Network Troubleshooting System Installation Technical Documentation SOP Development Field Service Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech degree in a relevant technical discipline and possess 1–3 years of experience in industrial automation or equipment support. Strong practical troubleshooting skills for hardware and electrical systems are essential, along with the ability to communicate technical issues clearly.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API testing, automation framework development, and CI/CD integration.

Testing: Functional, Regression, Integration, E2E, Smoke Testing

title: Manager
job_description:
Job Description:
About Us
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


Global Business Services
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

Process Overview*
Quantitative Strategies is a part of GBS India and works for Quantitative Strategies & Data Group (QSDG) and Global Markets Data Management Group.
QSDG partners with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Technology teams to identify business opportunities and challenges, develop quantitative models and analytics, build scalable pricing and risk solutions, perform testing and validation, and deploy production-ready tools that support trading, portfolio management, regulatory requirements, and strategic decision-making across Global Markets.

Job Description*
The quant associate is expected to support trading desks, risk management, and business stakeholders through the development of analytics, pricing tools, risk models, and automation solutions. The role involves partnering closely with traders, quantitative strategists, risk managers, and technology teams to enhance decision-making, improve risk management capabilities, and deliver scalable solutions that support business growth and regulatory requirements

Responsibilities*
Develop and maintain quantitative models for pricing, risk measurement across financial products
Partner with trading, risk, and technology teams to deliver analytical solutions that support business and regulatory objectives
Build and enhance Python-based tools, data pipelines, and automation frameworks to improve operational efficiency and scalability
Perform quantitative analysis of market, credit, counterparty risk exposures and communicate findings to stakeholders
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and business opportunities using statistical and data science techniques.
Assist in implementation of regulatory frameworks, capital models, stress testing, and risk reporting methodologies
Produce clear documentation, presentations, and management reporting to communicate analytical insights and recommendations
Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure, controls, and analytical capabilities across the business
Education*
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field
Experience Range*
24+ months experience
Foundational skills*
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business problems into quantitative solutions
· Proficiency in Python and familiarity with software development best practices, including testing, debugging, and version control
· Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets, identify trends, and derive actionable insights
· Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Trading, Risk, and Technology teams
· Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, well-controlled solutions
Desired skills:
Solid understanding of mathematics, statistics, probability, and numerical methods
Work Timings*
11-8 PM
Job Location*
Mumbai Python Quantitative analysis Risk management Data science Statistical modeling Pricing models Automation Data pipelines Financial products Regulatory frameworks Stress testing Capital models Problem-solving Communication Software development Numerical methods Requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline and at least 24 months of relevant experience. Candidates must possess strong analytical skills, proficiency in Python, and the ability to interpret large datasets.

Job Description 
The Principal Software Engineer on this Experience team drives the visual modernization of an established application with a Vue front end backed by PHP, where newer pages are built in Vue and legacy pages remain in jQuery, as part of isolved's Suite Experience initiative. This is a hands-on senior development role focused on refreshing and elevating the user interface of a live product: modern, responsive, and accessible interfaces delivered within the application's existing technology stack. This is a visual modernization effort, not a ground-up rewrite. You will improve the experience of a running application where it lives, which means you pair strong, transferable front-end engineering fundamentals with real depth in the application's stack. A significant part of the work is modernizing legacy jQuery pages into modern, component-based Vue.
This role requires strong architecture thinking, but the day-to-day is hands-on coding, not high-level design from a distance. The expectation is that you design solutions and then implement them yourself. Our modernization strategy is built on hiring fewer, highly senior engineers who use AI-assisted development as a force multiplier, and we expect you to leverage agentic coding, spec-driven development, and AI-augmented code review as a core part of how you work, including to ramp quickly on an unfamiliar codebase. You will partner closely with product management and UX to translate experience goals into performant, consistent, and maintainable interfaces, and you will integrate cleanly with isolved's evolving service architecture.
Core Job Duties
Refreshing and elevating the interface within a Vue and PHP application, including modernizing legacy jQuery pages into modern, component-based Vue, while preserving existing behavior
Building modern, responsive, and accessible UI improvements with a focus on performance and consistency
Establishing and elevating front-end quality across the team, including component structure, CSS architecture, state management, and performance
Performing code reviews to ensure front-end implementations meet quality standards and follow established patterns
Collaborating with product management and UX design to translate experience goals into scalable technical solutions
Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in the UI layer, including load times, rendering performance, and client-side resource management
Integrating cleanly with backend services through RESTful APIs
Raising the bar on modern front-end development practices across the team through code reviews, pairing, and leading by example
Using AI-assisted development tools, including agentic coding, spec-driven development, and AI-augmented code review, as a core part of your daily workflow to maximize velocity and code quality, and to ramp quickly on unfamiliar legacy code
Job Complexity
As an expert in the field, uses professional concepts in developing resolution to critical issues and broad design matters. Anticipates broad changes pertaining to their area of expertise and ensures isolved is always ahead of the curve. Significant barriers to entry (e.g., top management review, approval) exist at this level.
Experience
Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years developing web applications
3+ years developing cloud-native applications
Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of professional development workflows
Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar legacy codebases. Be prepared to walk through a specific example
Ability to work independently to research and solve complex problems
Strong skills in: 
Expert-level Vue 3, including component libraries and design systems
Component-driven UI architecture
Modern JavaScript and TypeScript
CSS architecture
Responsive and accessible web design
State management patterns
Front-end performance
Experience with: 
RESTful API consumption and clean backend integration
Azure
SOLID principles
Unit and integration testing for front-end applications
Experience with the following a plus:

title: Director - RF Hardware Engineering
job_description:
Important pre-read:
This job description will take ~15 minutes to read and ~15 minutes to apply. You increase your chances of selection by 10x if you read this to the end, slowly. Trust us on this.

What is Armory?
What we are building requires hard work, tenacity, ownership, creativity and way more man-hours than an everyday job.

If you are a savant at what you do, love autonomy, have high agency and genuinely want to impact the future of this country, we want you to work with us starting yesterday!

Modern conflicts waged remotely demand a radical rethinking of strategy as adversaries deploy inexpensive drones and technology to inflict maximum damage with minimal risk.

If you prefer routine over the dynamic unpredictability of innovation, Armory isn't for you. Our fast-paced environment requires genuine curiosity, resilience, a passion for continuous learning, and comfort with rapid change.

Armory is a new age defence tech startup building next-generation products to strengthen Indian forces in the modern battlefields.

About the founder

Amardeep Singh is an IIT Bombay alumnus & an aerospace engineer by education. He was a founding member of ideaForge - currently India’s biggest drone company & the first drone company to get listed on the Indian stock exchange. 

His 16-year entrepreneurial journey is marked by a series of ambitious ventures spanning across diverse tech domains like Drones, Consumer Hardware, B2B SaaS & AI.


Problems we solve

Our country’s defence systems, conceived in a bygone era, have been outpaced by the rapid advancements in technology, revealing critical gaps that we, at Armory, are poised to bridge.

At Armory, we identify and solve the most critical, complex & specific challenges in modern warfare. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and diving deep into specific problems, we create innovative defence technologies and products that protect our nation and allies.


Why you should NOT join us:


If high stakes, tight deadlines, and significant challenges don't excite you, then our mission to revolutionise defence technology might not align with your career goals. We seek individuals who are ready to push boundaries and are motivated by the urgency of now.


Why you SHOULD join us:

We offer the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects that strengthen national defence, supported by a team of A players.

Join Armory if you're drawn to solving hard problems and want to create a meaningful & profound impact to the national security.

At Armory, you will do the best work of your life. Period.

Requirements
About this role
You will own the RF engineering function at Armory. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the RF technical vision, build and lead a team of RF engineers, and personally stay close to the hardware. You will be accountable for taking RF systems from architecture to fielded product.
Define and own the RF architecture and technical roadmap across our product lines, including radar, sensing, communications, and counter-UAS systems.
Lead the design and development of RF hardware from scratch (0→1), including transmitters, receivers, PAs, LNAs, filters, RF front-end modules, and phased-array antenna systems.
Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, size, cost, reliability, and manufacturability, and make the final call on RF specifications and component selection.
Build, mentor, and scale the RF team: hire top talent, set the technical bar, and grow future technical leads.
Own the full RF product lifecycle: architecture → schematic → PCB → fabrication → bring-up → test and validation → production handoff.
Establish RF design, simulation, test, and review processes, including design reviews, test benches, and characterization practices that let the team move fast without cutting corners.
Partner with systems, embedded, firmware, antenna, mechanical, supply chain, and manufacturing leads to integrate RF hardware into products.
Stay hands-on where it matters: debug critical issues, review designs, and get on the bench with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.
Work with the founders and leadership team to shape the product roadmap, set timelines, and manage RF technical risk.
Evaluate and manage vendors, foundries, and component suppliers for RF-critical parts.
Must haves
15+ years of proven experience in RF hardware design and development, with at least 5 years leading teams or programs
A track record of taking RF products from concept to production, not just prototypes
Deep understanding of RF theory, principles, and techniques
Proficiency in RF design and simulation tools such as ADS, HFSS, or CST
Hands-on experience with RF test equipment, including network analyzers and spectrum analyzers
Experience with phased-array systems and RF front-end design
Ability to hire, mentor, and retain strong engineers
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Strong communication and collaboration abilities, from the bench to the boardroom
Bonus points for
Experience designing and developing radar systems
Knowledge of radar architectures, including pulsed, continuous wave (CW), and frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radars
Understanding of antenna design principles for radar applications
Familiarity with radar performance metrics, such as range resolution, Doppler resolution, and sensitivity
Experience in defence, aerospace, or other high-reliability environments, including qualification and environmental testing
Experience building an RF function from the ground up in a startup or high-growth setting
What will make you successful in this role?
Deep technical expertise in RF theory and practice, and the credibility that comes with it
Building a team and assembling an RF system in record time
Making clear decisions with incomplete information
Getting s**t done
How will we set you up for success in this role?
A live project: You will jump straight into live programs as soon as you join. No dummy or test projects.
State-of-the-art tools and technologies: You will have access to the latest RF simulation and design software, along with advanced testing and measurement equipment.
Real ownership: You will have the mandate and the budget to build the function the way you believe it should be built.
Access to resources: You name it, we will do everything to get it for you.
Direct access to leadership: You will work closely with the founders and the CTO on what we build next.
Supportive team: You will be surrounded by the best minds ready to help you.

Our Hiring Process
We target to close the hiring process within 14 days of your application.
Round 1: Screening Application
Duration: At your own pace, but if it takes you less than 15 minutes to apply, you are unlikely to move to the next round.
How to ace: Do not copy-paste your answers from a website or ChatGPT. Be specific in your answers. It’s about you.
Codeword: Use RFLEADS in the application form where it asks you for Codeword. This way we know you have read the JD :)
Round 2: Introduction round
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Be yourself. We want to know YOU, not some ideal unrealistic person. Demonstrate your expertise in the area we are evaluating. Ask good questions.
Round 3: Culture Fitment
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Help us understand your goals and aspirations. Share some of the stories that have made you what you are, including how you have built and led teams. Ask good questions.
Round 4: Technical Interview
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Show curiosity. Walk us through an RF system you architected end to end, including what went wrong. Mention your unconventional projects, interests and more.
Round 5: Leadership Conversation
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Tell us how you would build and run RF engineering at Armory in your first 12 months. Be opinionated. Ask good questions.
Offer Stage
Congratulations! You are now a part of Armory. You will build something that lets you sleep at night with a feeling you did something meaningful. Buckle up for a ride into the future.
Work Location
Armory highly values having employees working in-office. We are establishing a collaborative work environment and company culture, and that simply does not happen from home. We are based out of Gurgaon and require employees to be in office.


Benefits
What we expect from you
Genuine curiosity
Founder’s mindset
First principles thinking
Execution, not just ideas
Bias for action
High energy
High agency
Highest level of integrity
Getting your hands dirty
Audacious state of mind

What your first 3 months at Armory will look like
30 Days
Complete onboarding, learn our mission and values, and meet the founder, the CTO, and your cross-functional counterparts.
Audit the current state of RF: live projects, tools, equipment, vendors, and open technical risks.
Meet every RF engineer one-on-one and form a view of the team’s strengths and gaps.
Own the RF system specs for the priority program and present your assessment of the current architecture.
Make the key architecture, component, and procurement calls so no time is lost waiting.
60 Days
Have a working RF hardware prototype assembled, with the team executing under your direction.
Collaborate with the DSP and firmware teams to showcase a “Hello World” of the working prototype.
Put core RF processes in place: design reviews, test benches, and characterization standards.
Present the RF hiring plan and get the first interviews moving.
90 Days
Show the product’s intended functionality.
Integrate RF hardware with the broader system alongside cross-functional teams.
Optimize and tune RF performance based on test results.
Identify cost-reduction and manufacturability improvements, and ready the design for production.
Lead IP development and patent discussions.
Present your 12-month RF roadmap to the founder and discuss your career aspirations with him.

Tips

Irrespective of you applying at Armory or not, some of the following tips will definitely help you in your job search.


How to get hired

Targeted Applications: Ensure your application is tailored specifically for the job you're applying for by understanding its requirements and showcasing relevant experiences and skills. Apply for THIS job, not some job.

Quality Over Quantity: Instead of applying to 100 jobs casually, it’s far better to apply to 4 seriously.

Stand out: Most people don’t put any efforts in applying to jobs, their applications look exactly the same. It’s easy to stand out from them just by putting a little effort and showcasing your relevant experience and interest for the said job.


How to NOT get hired

If your cover letter starts with _“Honestly, I possess all the skills and experience that you’re looking for”_, then you are not going to make it.

Join our team in Aman-i-Khás. The domain of the majestic Bengal tiger, Ranthambore National Park is starkly beautiful, its green and gold hues the perfect backdrop to Aman-i-Khás. Situated on the threshold of the reserve, this intimate tented camp offers incomparable privacy and daily safaris seeking out the reserve’s wildlife. Back at camp, spa therapies, swimming and dining take centre stage. 
Serve as the main contact point for guest complaints and emergencies, coordinating responses and ensuring resolution. Oversee daily logbook records and liaise with various departments, contributing to guest satisfaction and smooth property operations. Guest Relations Conflict Resolution Emergency Management Operations Management Logbook Management Communication Interdepartmental Liaison Customer Service The role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage daily camp operations and guest interactions. Candidates must be capable of handling high-pressure situations and coordinating across different functional teams.

title: SVP - Strategic Sourcing Manager
job_description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
 
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
 
Procurement Category Manager – Workspace Design & Construction
 
On a global basis, the Procurement Category Manager shall drive the category strategy management and planning for the Workspace Design & Construction (WD&C) category to deliver competitive advantage for HSBC’s business through cost savings, lifecycle value generation, demand management and innovation. Additionally, the Procurement Category Manager shall execute Sourcing projects to deliver saving targets and other key business outcomes set out above.
 
This is a Global role covering all HSBC countries and regions, however, to ensure the WD&C Procurement Category Manager has close proximity to the significant capital works Real Estate Services have planned across the AME region, this role will be based in India to enable strong on-the-ground engagement and support.
 
The Sourcing projects will be delivered globally or locally in accordance with the category strategy and will leverage the full range of supply and demand-side levers. In-depth sourcing and contracting knowledge will be applied in the execution of these plans across all category areas whilst ensuring the risks associated with the purchase of goods and services are mitigated commercially, contractually, and operationally. It is expected that post contact value opportunities will be identified and delivered through working with business supplier managers and the relevant supply base making sure that these opportunities align with Category Strategies at all times.The role will support the Global Category Lead to provide Category Management expertise and execute sourcing projects across a range of sub-category areas. Leveraging specific Workspace Design & Construction Category knowledge, the projects will be delivered through the deployment of strategic sourcing disciplines, excellent project management and relationship management skillsThe role is required to manage the following categories across all HSBC countries and regions, so previous experience of leading comparable spend areas is important.
 

Capital Works/Construction

Construction Contractors
Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing Services
Engineering Services
Quantity Surveyor Services
Programme Management
Surveys
Professional Services



 

Design

Workplace Furniture
Interior Design Services
Architect Services



The role will develop influential senior level relationships (generally at a level below those held by the Global Category Lead) with designated businesses and functions on behalf of all of the Procurement sub- functions including ownership of the sourcing process. Key to success are advanced skills in analysis/synthesis in the application of a range of commercial models, with a focus on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
Technical qualifications and experience :

RICS (Royal Institute of Chartered Surveyors)
CIPS (Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply)
MSC in Quantity Surveying and/or Construction Project Management
15yrs+ in construction industry project management

Additional Notes :
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
 Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
 
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
 
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
 
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
 
 
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India Strategic sourcing Category management Construction project management Procurement Contracting Total cost of ownership Project management Relationship management Capital works Supply chain management Demand management Commercial modeling Risk mitigation Stakeholder management Budgeting AI-enabled tools Candidates must have over 15 years of experience in construction industry project management and hold relevant professional qualifications such as RICS or CIPS. A Master's degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Project Management is required.

title: Client Relationship Manegement - Support
job_description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
 
Role Purpose
Credit & Capital Management (C&CM) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model.  A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO)
The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated. 
The BCO Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage and facilitates client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process. In discharging their duties the role holder must ensure a common, reliable, and predictable underwriting and lending process, that protects the business from exposure, whilst responding to clients borrowing needs.  They are also responsible for co-ordination and completion of credit applications or renewals and risk escalation management.  The role holder will report to the BCO Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.
The BCO manager will need to be an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.
 
Key Responsibilities 
•    Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs•    Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders•    Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk•    Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.•    Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives•    Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk or the Regional sector team as required •    Strong execution and implementation ability in line with business priorities set out by the Business. •    Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders. •    Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls•    Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators•    Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management •    Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds
Knowledge and Experience
•    Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field•    3-6 years corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge •    CRE Sector knowledge and experience will be good to have. •    Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking•    Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders•    Strong analytical skills and ability to read legal documents. Prior experience in specialised lending will be considered positive. •    Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances•    Strong commercial mindset •    Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization
 
Additional Notes :
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
 Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
 
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
 
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
 
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Application Support Engineer
job_description:
Project Role : Application Support Engineer
Project Role Description : Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems. 
Must have skills : SAP Flexible Real Estate Management (RE-FX)
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 
We are seeking an experienced SAP RE-FX Consultant with strong expertise in SAP Flexible Real Estate Management (RE-FX), Lease Accounting, and Contract Management. The consultant will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting real estate and lease management processes while ensuring seamless integration with SAP Finance and related modules.

Key Responsibilities
SAP RE-FX Functional Expertise
Configure and support SAP Flexible Real Estate Management (RE-FX) solutions.
Manage end-to-end real estate and lease administration processes.
Support lease contract lifecycle management, including creation, modification, renewal, termination, and reporting.
Configure business entities, rental objects, contracts, and occupancy management.
Support rent calculations, periodic postings, and contract-based accounting processes.
Lease Accounting
Implement and support Lease Accounting processes in compliance with accounting standards such as:
IFRS 16
ASC 842
Configure lease valuation, right-of-use (ROU) asset calculations, and lease liability accounting.
Support lease measurement, reassessment, modifications, and periodic accounting postings.
Perform lease accounting reconciliations and reporting.
Contract Management
Configure and support:
Lease-in contracts
Lease-out contracts
Property contracts
Service contracts
Manage contract creation, amendments, renewals, terminations, and settlements.
Ensure proper integration between RE-FX contracts and Finance processes.
Sales Enablement & Customization Support
Support sales enablement processes and business requirements within RE-FX.
Participate in minor enhancements and customizations related to real estate processes.
Work with technical teams on functional specifications, testing, and deployment of enhancements.
Integration & Support
Ensure integration between RE-FX and:
SAP FI (Financial Accounting)
SAP CO (Controlling)
SAP Asset Accounting (AA)
SAP Project Systems (PS), where applicable
Conduct system testing, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, training materials, and process documentation.
Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP RE-FX (Flexible Real Estate Management).
Expertise in Lease Accounting and Contract Management processes.
Experience with lease lifecycle management and accounting compliance requirements.
Knowledge of IFRS 16 and/or ASC 842 lease accounting standards.
Experience in contract creation, contract amendments, and settlement processes.
Understanding of RE-FX integration with SAP FI/CO and Asset Accounting.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and user support.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP S/4HANA Finance and RE-FX experience.
Experience in multiple implementation and support projects.
Exposure to real estate, retail, commercial property management, or facilities management industries.
SAP certification in Finance or Real Estate Management is an advantage.
15 years full time education

We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.
