title: Engineering Program Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
You will be part of the Distributed Systems Engineering (DSE) Engineering Operations PMO Team that is responsible for managing software projects for the Cisco routing, optical and automation portfolio. We are looking for a seasoned Program Manager to contribute to the delivery of innovative software solutions within our fast-paced CNE group. The CNE group is at the forefront of developing products and network orchestration and automation solutions that power the largest networks in the world. We work hard, have fun, and are making a big difference at Cisco.

Your Impact

Managing cross-functional programs and delivering ground breaking SW for Cisco Networking Engineering (CNE). Manage software programs, complex solutions and releases in close collaboration with cross-functional teams spanning geographic regions, product areas and functions.
As a Technical/Engineering Program Manager you would be described as a driven and results oriented leader. Self-starter; willing to roll-up your sleeves to get things done.
Master of orchestration, able to balance various priorities at the same time.
You have a keen ability to work with a broad range of cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Vendors, Customer Experience, Technical Support, Documentation and frequently with peers within PMO teams.
Collate information across disparate activities and distill it into clear communications for senior leaders and executives.
Adapt to change, proactively manage risks, clear roadblocks, and drive outcomes with product management and engineering.
Problem-solver; someone that is comfortable working with ambiguity and dealing with complex problems in an evolving landscape
Role model for Relationship Management and have the ability to drive alignment with technology and business goals.

Responsibilities

Work in an agile/waterfall environment, collaborating with engineering and product teams to plan requirements, develop timelines, identify, and mitigate risks to product deliveries.
Work with Cross-functional Program Teams, drive technical tradeoff discussions in collaboration with cross-functional leaders across Cisco.
Drive process improvements and implementation of guidelines and standards. Find opportunities to optimize program planning and development.
Provide expertise to support other Program Managers in driving end-to-end engineering planning & development across multiple product and engineering teams.
Collaborate with customers, partners, and team members across Cisco globally.
Maintain tight control of cross functional dependencies and program execution, ensuring completion of project on schedule, with quality and within budget constraints.
Track KPIs, results, breakthroughs, action items, technical dependencies, risks and mitigation plans across programs and solutions.
Utilize in-depth knowledge of industry-standard software quality measurements, defect tracking and categorization methodologies, testing methodologies to track quality.

Minimum Qualifications

Engineering Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience or Master's degree with 10+ years experience with 5+ years in program management.
Experience in methodologies water fall/agile/hybrid stakeholder leadership skills.
Drive multiple engineering programs
Experience in ALM tools like Jira, Confluence
Solid experience in product development lifecycle management, SDLC Methodologies, Software release management, software product engineering, deployment, and integration and tracking execution with JIRA.
Demonstrable experience in identifying, analyzing, and resolving program issues and driving end- to- End Program Execution.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong Presentation Skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

Executive presence/good communication skills to establish trust with engineering stakeholders.
Ability to make informed decisions and prioritize tasks based on business objectives and constraints.
Comfortable with ambiguity and able to navigate through uncertainty while maintaining focus on program objectives.

Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

begin with screening or an interview
originate from a Cisco email address, and
be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Lead and manage the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across the organization.

Conduct periodic plant and branch visits to review IT infrastructure, security controls, and network availability.

Collaborate with business leaders and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) to support business and digital transformation initiatives

title: HR Recruiter -  International Recruitment
job_description:
About Navinyaa Solutions
Navinyaa Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a global solutions and services organization delivering world-class solutions across Engineering Design, Finance & Accounting, IT Solutions, Business Process Outsourcing, and Consulting Services.
With a global mindset, Navinyaa helps businesses scale faster through innovative strategies, advanced technologies, cost-effective solutions, and customized service models.
Our expertise spans diverse industries, including manufacturing, consumer products, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, and industrial equipment, enabling us to deliver specialized and scalable solutions aligned with our clients’ business needs.
As part of our continued growth and expansion of our staffing and talent acquisition capabilities, Navinyaa Solutions is hiring an experienced HR Recruiter – International Recruitment to join our growing team.
Position Details
Position: HR Recruiter – International Recruitment
Experience: 3–7 Years
Location: Doddaballapura, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment and staffing process for international hiring requirements across different countries and regions. The role involves understanding manpower requirements, developing sourcing strategies, identifying and screening candidates, coordinating interviews across time zones, managing offers, and supporting onboarding.
The recruiter will work closely with international clients, hiring managers, business stakeholders, and candidates across different geographies to ensure timely closure of positions while delivering a professional and positive candidate experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Acquisition & Staffing
Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for international positions.
Understand manpower requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
Source candidates through LinkedIn, international job portals, social media, referrals, professional networks, and recruitment databases.
Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across international markets.
Handle volume hiring and specialized recruitment requirements as needed.
2. Candidate Sourcing & Screening
Identify and attract qualified candidates across different countries and talent markets.
Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
Conduct initial screening interviews to evaluate qualifications, experience, communication skills, availability, compensation expectations, and overall suitability.
Use Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify suitable candidates.
Maintain regular candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process.
3. International Recruitment
Manage recruitment requirements across international markets.
Understand talent availability, recruitment practices, and candidate expectations across different countries.
Coordinate with candidates and clients across multiple time zones.
Familiarize yourself with country-specific employment practices, work authorization requirements, and hiring procedures.
Coordinate recruitment documentation, verification, interview scheduling, and pre-joining formalities as required.
4. Interviewing & Assessment
Conduct structured recruiter screening interviews based on defined job requirements.
Coordinate technical, managerial, and client interviews.
Schedule interviews across different locations and time zones.
Collect interview feedback and ensure timely communication with candidates and stakeholders.
Follow up with candidates and clients to ensure smooth progress throughout the selection process.
5. Client & Stakeholder Management
Work closely with international clients, hiring managers, and business stakeholders to understand recruitment requirements.
Coordinate candidate submissions, interviews, feedback, and recruitment updates.
Provide regular updates on open positions, candidate pipelines, interview status, and hiring progress.
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders across different geographies.
6. Offer Management & Negotiation
Coordinate the offer process for selected candidates.
Communicate compensation, benefits, employment terms, and joining requirements.
Negotiate offers within approved guidelines.
Manage candidate expectations and minimize offer dropouts through effective engagement.
Follow up with selected candidates until successful joining.
7. Recruitment Operations & Technology
Maintain accurate candidate information in ATS/CRM systems and recruitment databases.
Track candidate pipelines, interviews, feedback, offers, and joining status.
Prepare recruitment reports and dashboards covering hiring progress, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, and other recruitment metrics.
Leverage recruitment technology and sourcing tools to improve hiring efficiency.
8. Compliance & Documentation
Follow applicable recruitment policies, client requirements, and relevant hiring procedures.
Coordinate candidate documentation and verification as required.
Ensure appropriate handling of work authorization information and country-specific recruitment documentation.
Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date recruitment records.
9. Candidate Experience & Relationship Management
Represent Navinyaa professionally throughout the recruitment process.
Ensure a positive candidate experience from initial interaction through onboarding.
Maintain timely and transparent communication with candidates.
Build long-term relationships with candidates across international talent markets.
10. Recruitment Strategy & Market Research
Identify new talent pools and sourcing channels across international markets.
Research talent availability, compensation trends, and recruitment market developments.
Develop alternative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.
Stay updated on recruitment technologies, sourcing techniques, and international hiring practices.
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Master's degree/MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field is preferred.
Experience
3–7 years of proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing.
Hands-on experience in US, Uk and International Recruitment Experience.
Experience managing end-to-end recruitment for international clients and overseas positions.
Experience handling multiple recruitment requirements across different geographies.
Experience working with staffing companies, recruitment consultancies, or international clients is preferred.
Recruitment & Technical Skills
Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills.
Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, international job portals, recruitment databases, and other sourcing platforms.
Good understanding of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Ability to prepare recruitment trackers, reports, dashboards, and recruitment analytics.
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interviewing, candidate engagement, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with international clients, candidates, and stakeholders.
Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Skills
Experience in overseas recruitment and international staffing.
Exposure to recruitment across multiple countries or regions.
Familiarity with international hiring processes and documentation.
Experience working with international clients and stakeholders.
Flexibility to work across different time zones based on business requirements.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Why Join Navinyaa Solutions?
Opportunity to work on international recruitment and staffing requirements.
Exposure to diverse industries, roles, and global talent markets.
Opportunity to work with international clients and stakeholders.
Exposure to multiple business verticals, including Engineering, IT, Finance & Accounting and Consulting.
Opportunity to grow in recruitment, staffing, and talent acquisition.
Dynamic and growth-oriented work environment.
Join Us
If you are passionate about recruitment, enjoy connecting with talent, and have hands-on experience in international recruitment, we would love to hear from you.
Join Navinyaa Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and be part of our growing global talent acquisition team! A bachelor's degree in HR or a related field is required, with a master's degree preferred.

title: Management Accounting Associate Director
job_description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead management accounting activities that support accurate financial reporting and smart business decisions. You will work closely with finance leaders, business partners, and shared services to deliver timely month-end close, analysis, and improvements. We value integrity, clear thinking, and a focus on developing people and processes. This role offers strong growth, visible impact on business performance, and alignment with GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead month-end close for assigned entities and deliver accurate profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting. - Provide commercial and variance analysis to explain performance and support business decisions. - Partner with business leaders and shared services to build budgets, forecasts, and monthly reforecasts. - Drive improvements in accounting processes, controls, and automation to increase efficiency and reduce risk. - Support external and internal audits and ensure compliance with accounting standards and local regulations. - Coach and develop team members, and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture. Why You? This role is hybrid, combining time at an office in India with remote work as agreed with your manager. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline. - Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CA, or equivalent). - 5+ years of experience in management accounting, finance controlling, or similar finance roles. - Strong knowledge of IFRS and relevant local accounting rules. - Practical experience with ERP systems such as SAP and familiarity with Excel-based analysis. - Clear communicator in English with the ability to work with cross-functional and multicultural teams. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus - Experience leading or coaching a small to medium finance team. - Hands-on experience with financial planning and analysis processes, including driver-based forecasting. - Experience with process automation tools or reporting platforms (for example, Power BI or similar). - Prior exposure to audits, tax reporting, and regulatory filings in an international environment. - Strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate data into clear business actions. - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment and supporting transformational change. What we offer You will join a purpose-driven company where your work helps shape decisions that matter. You will have access to development opportunities, mentorship, and the chance to grow your career across finance and broader business roles. We welcome people of all backgrounds and encourage applications from anyone who believes they can contribute. How to apply If this role sounds like you, please apply and tell us why you would be a strong addition to our team. We look forward to learning about your experience and motivations.

Business Acumen, Cyber Risks, Digital Fluency, Driving Continuous Improvement, Enterprise Thinking, Financial Controlling, Operational Governance, Services Management, Stakeholder Management
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) is a part of the Tata Group and is one of South Asia's largest and most iconic hospitality companies. With a legacy of over 120 years, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our guests through our diverse portfolio of hotels, resorts, and palaces.
Careers at IHCL
At IHCL, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a dynamic work environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. Join us in creating memorable experiences and shaping the future of hospitality. Explore exciting career opportunities with us and be a part of a vibrant team that values passion, excellence, and diversity. 
Job Objective
An apprentice will support daily departmental activities and gain hands-on experience in a hotel. This role is designed to provide foundational knowledge of hospitality operations through structured training, job rotation, and on-the-job learning under supervision.
Essential Job Tasks
'- Assist in the execution of day-to-day departmental tasks under guidance, such as guest check-in/check-out, room cleaning, food service, administrative support, or kitchen prep, depending on the assigned department.
- Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to service delivery, cleanliness, safety, and quality.
- Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards at the workstation and ensure proper handling of equipment and supplies.
- Engage professionally with guests and internal stakeholders to ensure a positive service experience.
- Attend and participate in departmental briefings, on-the-job trainings, and workshops to enhance understanding of hotel operations.
- Adhere to grooming standards, punctuality, and conduct expectations as defined by the organization.
- Support smooth departmental handovers and communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.
- Monitor supplies or inventory where applicable and inform the supervisor about shortages or requirements.
- Respond promptly to instructions and feedback from trainers or team leaders, demonstrating willingness to learn and improve.
- Maintain a learning log or progress sheet as part of the apprenticeship program requirements.
Areas of Responsibility
An apprentice will support daily departmental activities and gain hands-on experience in a hotel. This role is designed to provide foundational knowledge of hospitality operations through structured training, job rotation, and on-the-job learning under supervision.

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - FAAS - Financial&AccountingAdv :
Assurance’s purpose is to inspire confidence and trust to enable a complex world to work. We do so by protecting and serving the public interest, promoting transparency, supporting investor confidence and economic growth and nurturing talent to provide future business leaders . We help clients by : 
1) Ensuring their accounts comply with the requisite audit standards 
2) Providing a robust and clear perspective to audit committees and 
3) Providing critical information for stakeholders. 
Our Service Offerings include External Audit,  Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) , IFRS & US GAAP conversion , IPO and other public offering, Corporate Treasury - IFRS 9 accounting & implementation support etc.
Your key responsibilitiesTechnical Excellence
 

Manage / execute FAAS projects, develop and implement solutions (see above)
Identify and develop business opportunities; manage accounts (depending on level)
Coach junior team members, encourage technical excellence and learning
Integrate with other EY service lines on multi-disciplinary projects
Contribute to thought leadership and participate in marketing activities To qualify for the role you must have
A qualified CA (or equivalent e.g. CPA/ICAEW/ACCA)
Good academic record (1st/2nd time passes for ICAI or equivalent)
Strong IGAAP and/or IFRS and/or US GAAP financial reporting experience in complex/large companies, most likely in audit/advisory/transaction vertical or MNC finance/M&A environment
Minimum of 6 years of relevant post qualification experience
Ability to explain complex accounting and financial reporting issues simply
Advisory mindset, ability to develop solutions for the client with support from technical subject matter experts
Business development skills and aptitude, depending on level. In applicants at Senior Manager and above, a strong track record of business development is expected
Specific financial reporting experience in at least one of the following: o Transactions (acquisitions, carve outs, demergers, restructuring) o Preparation for IPO including listing rules in India/UK/US o Complex consolidation structure in an MNC environment including implementation of ERP/consolidation IT system o Tax planning and complex structures o Developing and delivering technical training o Specific financial reporting topics: revenue recognition; financial instruments; off balance sheet financing; consolidation and SPEs; banking; insurance; Strong project management skills
Excellent communication skills

 
Skills and attributesTo qualify for the role you must haveQualification

CA

Experience

6+ years

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.What we offerFuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant - Database QA / ETL Test Engineer to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).Job Title: Technology Consultant – Database QA / ETL Test Engineer
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Database QA / ETL Test Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in database testing, ETL validation, SQL, data reconciliation, and data quality testing. The ideal candidate should have experience validating complex data pipelines, source-to-target transformations, and enterprise data warehouse solutions.
The role will collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and application teams to ensure the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and reliability of data across enterprise systems.
Day to Day Job Duties

Perform end-to-end Database and ETL testing across source and target systems.
Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, transformation logic, mappings, and business rules.
Develop complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
Perform source-to-target data validation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Validate large-volume data loads, batch processes, and scheduled ETL jobs.
Perform database testing including tables, views, stored procedures, functions, and data integrity.
Validate data transformation rules, aggregations, calculations, and business logic.
Perform data quality testing, including completeness, uniqueness, accuracy, referential integrity, and consistency checks.
Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and regression suites.
Identify data discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and work with Data Engineers/ETL Developers to resolve defects.
Perform backend validation for reports and downstream applications.
Track and manage defects using Jira or similar tools.
Support SIT, regression testing, UAT, and production validation.
Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, traceability matrices, and quality metrics.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, requirement reviews, and release activities.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Database QA, ETL Testing, and Data Validation.
5+ years of hands-on experience with SQL, complex queries, database testing, and data reconciliation.
4+ years of experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines, source-to-target mappings, and data transformations.
3+ years of experience with data warehouse testing, data quality validation, and large-volume data processing.

Core Technical Skills

Database Testing: SQL, Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, Data Validation
Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar
ETL Testing: Source-to-Target Validation, Transformation Testing, Reconciliation
ETL Tools: Informatica, DataStage, Talend, SSIS or similar
Data Warehouse: Dimensional Models, Fact/Dimension Tables, Data Marts
Testing: SIT, Regression, Integration, UAT Support
Defect Management: Jira, Azure DevOps or similar
Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC, STLC

Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse.
Experience with cloud ETL tools such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or Databricks.
Knowledge of Python for data validation and test automation.
Experience automating ETL and database testing.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, SCD, and CDC.
Experience validating batch and real-time/streaming data pipelines.
Understanding of data quality, lineage, governance, and metadata management.
Experience working with large and complex datasets.
Experience with CI/CD and automated data testing.
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or other enterprise environments.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Head of Finance
job_description:
About the role
Kantiv is a US SaaS company for the AEC industry. We sell an annual platform subscription. We recently launched AI agents, which customers buy as prepaid credit packs. This hybrid model makes billing, revenue recognition and commissions more complex every month.
You are our first in-house finance leader. You take over all finance work from our fractional CFO, our outsourced accounting firm and our Chief of Staff. You own accounting and the monthly close, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, commissions and forecasting. You build the finance team as the company grows, starting with your first accountant hire.
We have not billed usage yet. Our price plan is designed. You lead the build of our usage billing on Stripe through the first invoice. You then use real usage and margin data to help us improve pricing.
Location: India (remote), employed by Kantiv's India entity. You work with US-based leaders and US customers.
Responsibilities
Accounting and monthly close
Own the general ledger in QuickBooks and the US GAAP accrual close. Deliver monthly financial statements by business day 10.
Reconcile bank, credit card, payment processor and balance sheet accounts each month.
Post accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue, depreciation and commission entries.
Prepare for a first financial audit or investor due diligence.
Billing, collections and sales tax (order-to-cash)
Issue all customer invoices: platform fees in advance, agent credit packs in advance.
Reconcile credit use in the product to credits sold and to remaining balances each month.
Own collections. Track AR aging, send reminders and escalate overdue accounts.
Manage US SaaS sales tax. Monitor economic nexus by state, apply the correct tax on invoices and prepare filings with our tax tool or advisor.
Collect and store customer tax-exemption certificates.
Revenue recognition and commissions
Prepare monthly revenue schedules under ASC 606: platform fees ratably, usage as consumed.
Track deferred revenue, prepaid credit balances, credit expiry and breakage, and minimum commitments.
Calculate sales commissions on platform and usage revenue each month. Resolve disputes with sales.
Prepare commission capitalization schedules (ASC 340-40).
Post revenue and commission entries in the monthly close.
Accounts payable and vendor management
Process and pay vendor bills on a weekly payment cycle.
Collect W-9s and issue 1099s.
Keep a vendor and contract register: renewal dates, notice periods and owners.
Review SaaS and infrastructure spend. Recommend cuts and negotiate renewals.
Track AI model and cloud costs, which change with agent usage.
Forecasting and FP&A
Own the operating model. Forecast revenue, headcount, spend and cash runway.
Model usage revenue separately from platform revenue: adoption, volume per customer, price per unit.
Prepare monthly budget-vs-actual analysis and explain variances.
Analyze usage, margin and adoption data to recommend price and packaging changes. Build models for hiring decisions.
Metrics and reporting
Track ARR, usage revenue, net revenue retention, gross margin, burn, runway and CAC payback.
Report gross margin with and without AI inference costs.
Own the monthly management pack, the board finance section and investor reporting.
Systems and process
Lead the Stripe Billing build with product and engineering: usage meters, price plans, credits, invoice templates and Stripe Tax. Write the requirements, test the output and sign off before the first usage invoice.
Connect CRM, billing and QuickBooks so that data flows without manual re-entry.
Write the finance policies: approvals, expenses, revenue and commissions.
Team and external partners
Hire and manage your first accountant. Plan the finance team as revenue grows.
Manage external partners: US tax return preparer, 409A valuation firm, auditors and the India CA firm.
Own US sales tax filings, 1099s and annual state reports with these partners.
Own India entity finance with the CA firm: GST, TDS, payroll, ROC filings, statutory audit and transfer pricing.
Support the CEO on fundraising: data room, financial model and diligence answers.
Requirements
Must have
9+ years in finance. At least 4 years at a B2B SaaS company, including time as the senior finance person.
Direct experience with a hybrid model: subscription or platform fee plus usage-based billing. You must give examples of prepaid credits, usage billing or overage billing that you ran, and a billing setup that you helped design.
Revenue recognition under ASC 606 for subscription and usage revenue.
Order-to-cash and AP for US customers and US vendors.
Forecast models that you built and owned, not only updated.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. QuickBooks Online experience.
Clear written English for US customers and executives.
3–4 hours of overlap with US Pacific or Eastern time each working day.
Owned a US GAAP monthly close, not only reviewed it.
Built or rebuilt finance processes at a startup with no existing finance team.
Hired and managed at least one accountant.
Nice to have
CA, CPA or CMA.
US state sales tax for SaaS (economic nexus, Anrok or Avalara).
Stripe Billing and Stripe Tax, ideally an implementation of usage-based pricing. Metronome, Orb or Chargebee experience also counts.
Commission tools: QuotaPath, CaptivateIQ or similar. ASC 340-40 experience.
HubSpot or Salesforce data.
SQL, to pull usage data without help from engineering.
Experience with a financial audit, 409A valuation or fundraising diligence. Financial Accounting US GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606 Stripe Billing QuickBooks Online Financial Forecasting FP&A Sales Tax Compliance Commission Calculation Accounts Payable Accounts Receivable Budgeting Financial Reporting Team Leadership SaaS Metrics Candidates must have 9+ years of finance experience, including at least 4 years in a B2B SaaS company with direct experience in hybrid subscription and usage-based billing. Proficiency in US GAAP, ASC 606, QuickBooks Online, and advanced financial modeling is required.

title: Software Engineer II
job_description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
Job Summary
At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.
As a Software Engineer II at OpenGov, you’ll build best-in-class SaaS solutions that enable efficiency, transparency, and accountability within government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS in an AI first engineering culture.
Responsibilities
Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.
Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.
Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members for both Human and AI generated code.
Develop, test, and deploy high-quality software with minimum supervision
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.
Contribute to continuous improvement and operational excellence
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation within the team
Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality
Requirements and Preferred Experience
Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment
Experience 3 to 5 years.
Experience gathering and incorporating feedback from users, teammates, or stakeholders to improve the quality and usability of products or projects.
Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end
Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)
BA/BS in a computer-science-related discipline or equivalent experience required
Demonstrate a strong understanding of data structure, algorithms
Why OpenGov?
A Mission That Matters.

title: Recruiter
job_description:
Scientific Games:
Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.
Position Summary
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct end-to-end recruitment for both IT and functional roles, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates.
Develop and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates through proactive sourcing strategies, including job boards, social media, networking, and employee referrals.
Collaborate with hiring managers to understand job requirements and tailor recruitment reports to meet specific needs.
Manage vendor relationships, including engaging with recruitment agencies, negotiating contracts and tracking vendor performance.
Review and analyze resumes, conduct initial phone or video interviews, and assess candidate qualifications and cultural fit.
Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers while managing communication throughout the recruitment process.
Manage salary negotiations, and provide market insights to ensure competitive compensation.
Maintain candidate databases and track recruitment metrics to report on hiring progress and effectiveness.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
4-8 years of experience in recruitment, with expertise in hiring for both IT and
functional roles.
Strong experience in vendor management, including working with external
recruitment agencies and tracking performance.
Proven success in recruiting across multiple domains, including software
development, engineering, data science, HR, finance, and operations.
Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS), job boards, and sourcing tools.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build
relationships with candidates and stakeholders.
Familiarity with recruitment best practices, including diversity hiring and
maintaining a positive candidate experience.
Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that values innovation and excellence in talent acquisition!

title: IT Enterprise Architect
job_description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
Your day at NTT DATA
The IT Enterprise Architect is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for operating at an enterprise and strategic level and is responsible for consulting with internal stakeholders, around complex information technology enterprise architecture.

This role works with stakeholders, both leadership and subject matter experts, to build a holistic view of the organization’s strategy, processes, information, and information technology assets.

The IT Enterprise Architect provides enterprise architecture consulting services to analyze and provide holistic strategies and solutions on all aspects of enterprise architectural requirements.

This role is accountable for translating business strategic intent into holistic capability blocks, the level of capability required and roadmap for delivery to enable business strategic outcomes.

Key responsibilities:
Responsible for the capability maturity roadmap and investment plan which includes technology.
Develops digital blueprint strategy and roadmap, architecture and digital principles.
Responsible for new technology governance and digital portfolio management.
Serves as an advisor to senior business management on business and information integration strategies.
Evaluates internal functions, business development strategies and IT processes and suggest improvements.
Creates business architecture models to reflect the organization's strategies and goals and creates and implements business vision and goals.
Improves the current IT infrastructure, optimizing business operations, and setting the direction and approach for integrating information applications and programs.
Responsible for cataloguing, developing, coordinating, communicating, maintaining, and enforcing overall enterprise architecture models, representations, initiatives, capabilities, and components to adequately perform the organization's business and technology activities.
Provides business architecture and systems processing, as well as technology selection guidance.
Creates methods for compliance architecture, such as data storage, metadata management, and change control.
Provides consultancy in business process analysis and design, and service delivery, particularly with respect to the use of information, trends, and directions.
Updates and maintains key enterprise architecture deliverables.
Creates architecture and technology standards, taxonomy and reference models (operating models, process frameworks, fit to standard, data).
Performs any other related task as required.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
Seasoned understanding of business strategy, operating models, business capabilities and value streams.
Seasoned understanding of technologies or solutions with the intent to identify capability (and maturity) improvement potential.
Ability to integrate big data analytics into the existing IT landscape.
Seasoned knowledge of architectural methodologies and frameworks to be able to implement strategies effectively.
Ability to stay on top of the latest trends and technologies that may improve business.
Good communication skills to work with various leaders throughout the organization to support the goals and objectives of the organization.
Good project and program management skills.
Seasoned knowledge of information technology governance.
Demonstrate problem analysis and solution formulation skills.
Demonstrates systems and design thinking skills.

Academic qualifications and certifications:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computer Science or related field.
Required certification(s) such as TOGAF / ITIL/ COBIT.

Required experience:
Seasoned demonstrated experience as an Enterprise Architect gained within a similar matrixed information technology environment (development or digital transformation environment).
Seasoned demonstrated experience in appropriate enterprise architecture domain.
Seasoned demonstrated experience in system architecture.
Workplace type: 
Hybrid Working
About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune 
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through 
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with 
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and 
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move 
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more 
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as 
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each 
year in R&D.

Equal Opportunity Employer
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters 
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an @nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us. Enterprise Architecture Business Strategy Digital Transformation IT Governance Systems Thinking Big Data Analytics Project Management Program Management Technology Governance Business Process Analysis Digital Portfolio Management Architecture Modeling Stakeholder Management Strategic Planning Solution Formulation Data Management Candidates must possess a bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, along with professional certifications such as TOGAF, ITIL, or COBIT. Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, system architecture, and matrixed IT environments is required to succeed in this role.

title: HR & Recruitment Executive — Zoho HR, Talent Acquisition & AI
job_description:
HR & Recruitment Executive — Zoho HR, Talent Acquisition & AI
JNB Bearings Pvt Ltd | Chennai – Mannady (near Mannady Metro), office-based | Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Experience: 2–5 years | Reports to: Directors | Compensation: competitive, based on experience and hands-on Zoho skills + performance incentives
About JNB Bearings
JNB Bearings Pvt Ltd imports industrial bearings and markets them under its own brand, J&B. With our group company Jain Bearing Centre (since 2008; Chennai, Bellary, Rajahmundry) we supply stone crushers, rice mills, cement plants, workshops, dealers and OEMs across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Maharashtra. HR runs fully on Zoho Recruit, People, Payroll, Sign and Forms, with written SOPs and monthly KPIs.
The Role in One Line
Own hiring and HR operations end-to-end on Zoho — fill roles fast with the right people, onboard them digitally, keep employee data and payroll inputs accurate, and run a fair performance and grievance process.
What You Will Do
1. Talent Acquisition (Zoho Recruit)
Full-cycle hiring: requisition → JD/KRA approval → posting → screening → interviews → offer → joining
Manage 15–20 concurrent openings: Field Sales Executives across TN / AP / Karnataka / Maharashtra, telecallers and office staff
Source via Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna/WorkIndia, referrals, WhatsApp groups and local networks
Action every application within 48 hours; keep pipeline and notes updated daily
Track time-to-fill, offer-to-join and 90-day retention — not just resume counts
2. Onboarding & Documentation (Zoho Sign, Zoho Forms)
Offer and appointment letters via Zoho Sign — 100% signed digitally before Day 1
Joining documents only through Zoho Forms / People — never on WhatsApp or personal email
Day-1 readiness: employee record, system access, induction and reporting-manager briefing
3. HR Operations (Zoho People, Zoho Payroll)
100% accurate employee master data, attendance and leave
Attendance regularisation closed by the 1st; LOP inputs to Accounts by the 2nd (salary is paid on the 7th)
Coordinate PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, bonus and TDS / Form-16 with Accounts and the CA as applicable
4. Performance, Policy & Employee Relations
Set KRAs / KPIs in Zoho People for every employee within 30 days of joining; run quarterly and annual reviews
Maintain HR policies, handbook and SOPs with 100% acknowledgement
Grievances acknowledged within 24 hours and closed within 7 working days; manage exits and exit interviews
5. HR MIS, Automation & AI
Monthly HR MIS to Directors by the 5th
Use AI tools daily for JDs, screening questions, interview kits, policy drafts and MIS summaries
At least one HR automation / process improvement every quarter
How You Will Be Measured (Key KPIs)
Time-to-fill: field sales / telecallers ≤ 15 working days; office roles ≤ 30 days
100% applications actioned within 48 hours
Offer-to-join ≥ 80%; 90-day retention ≥ 85%
100% digital onboarding via Zoho Sign before Day 1
Attendance / LOP inputs to Accounts by the 2nd with zero errors
100% KRAs set within 30 days; HR MIS by the 5th
What You Bring
Must-have
2–5 years in recruitment + HR generalist work; graduate (MBA-HR / MSW / BBA preferred)
Hands-on Zoho Recruit and Zoho People in a real job — be ready to show real examples
Proven volume hiring results, ideally field sales or distributed teams
Working knowledge of PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, bonus and TDS basics
Daily, practical use of AI tools; strong Excel / Google Sheets
Fluent Tamil and English; Telugu or Kannada is a strong plus
Good to have: Zoho Payroll, Sign, Forms, Flow or Analytics; recruitment dashboards or HR automations.
This Role Is Not For You If...
You have only HR admin / documentation experience with no recruitment targets
You know Zoho only from training, or use Excel as your main HR system
You rarely use AI tools at work, or need constant supervision
What We Offer
Full ownership of a modern all-Zoho HR stack — rare, resume-building expertise
Direct work with the Directors; fast decisions, no bureaucracy
Performance incentives and a clear path: HR Executive → Senior HR Executive (HR Ops & Automation) → HR Manager
Selection Process (2 stages + interviews)
Stage 1 — Pre-screening: 20 short questions on the application form (about 10 minutes)
Stage 2 — Knowledge test: online test link emailed to shortlisted candidates (about 15 minutes)
HR interview — walk us through your real Zoho Recruit / People work
Director interview → digital offer via Zoho Sign
How to Apply
Apply online: https://jnbbearings.zohorecruit.in/jobs/Careers → open "HR & Recruitment Executive" → click "I'm interested" → upload your CV and complete the Stage 1 questions. Applications without Stage 1 are not considered.
Can't use the link? Email your CV to 771b85jbqzc5@jnbbearings.zohorecruitmail.in with the subject HR Executive | [Your Name] | [Years of Experience] — we will email you the Stage 1 questions.
HR (Call / WhatsApp): 93810 77728 | Landline: 044-47946473
JNB Bearings Pvt Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. Every application is evaluated on merit and role fit. Zoho Recruit Zoho People Talent Acquisition HR Operations Payroll Management Performance Management Employee Relations HR MIS AI Tools Documentation Compliance Excel Google Sheets Recruitment Onboarding Candidates must have 2-5 years of experience in recruitment and HR generalist functions with hands-on proficiency in Zoho Recruit and Zoho People. A graduate degree is required, with a preference for MBA-HR, MSW, or BBA qualifications.

title: PE - SWIMMING COACH
job_description:
Job Description
CSA – PE Swimming Coach
Purpose of Role
To provide professional swimming coaching to students, developing their swimming techniques, physical fitness, confidence, discipline, and competitive skills while ensuring a safe and positive learning environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Plan and conduct structured swimming coaching sessions based on students' age, ability, and skill level.
Teach and develop proper swimming techniques, strokes, breathing, starts, turns, and endurance.
Assess students' abilities and monitor their individual progress and performance.
Provide regular technical guidance, correction, and feedback to improve swimming skills.
Ensure strict adherence to pool safety rules and water safety procedures during all sessions.
Maintain effective supervision and discipline to ensure student safety and well-being.
Prepare and train students for swimming competitions, sports meet, and inter-school events.
Maintain records of student attendance, participation, skill development, and performance.
Ensure swimming equipment and training areas are safe, clean, organized, and properly maintained.
Coordinate with the PE Coordinator, teachers, and School Management regarding student progress, competitions, training schedules, and other sports activities.
About CS Academy
CS Academy, Coimbatore has three campuses. Two are in Kovaipudur (Main) in adjacent facilities and the third primary campus is in the heart of the city at Red Fields. Our boarding house in Kovaipudur is open for boys and girls from class IV for both CBSE and Cambridge International students. The picturesque main campus located in the foothills of the Western Ghats is ideally suited for exploring and learning
Our team brings a wealth of expertise in education. Our CBSE and Cambridge programmes and teaching methodology are proven and time tested. We have built on vast experience and developed a programme that encompasses modern tools while adhering to traditional principles.
Our mission is to equip our students with the knowledge and skills required to succeed in the real world by providing practical and holistic education in a challenging, yet nurturing environment. We prepare students for success by focusing on four pillars: Academic excellence, Skill building, Core Values and Healthy competition.
In 2024, CS Academy Coimbatore joined the prestigious International Schools Partnership (ISP) group. With over 116 schools in 25 countries, ISP is a leading global network of educational institutions. As a member of this esteemed network, CS Academy Coimbatore enjoys unparalleled international learning connections, unwavering quality assurance, and exceptional governance.
Location: CS Academy, Kovaipudur, Coimbatore - 641 042, Tamil Nadu, India.

ISP Principles

Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding
and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.

Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.

Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.

Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.

Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.
ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles
ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.
ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging
ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply. Swimming coaching Water safety Stroke development Physical fitness training Student supervision Lesson planning Performance monitoring Competitive swimming training Safety compliance Communication The role requires expertise in swimming instruction and a strong commitment to student safety and well-being. Candidates must be able to coordinate effectively with school management and staff to support the overall sports program.

title: PE Assistant Teacher
job_description:
Job Description
CSA – PE Assistant Teacher
Purpose of Role
To support the delivery of Physical Education and sports activities, helping students develop physical fitness, sports skills, teamwork, discipline, and healthy lifestyle habits in a safe and encouraging environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Assist PE teachers in planning and conducting Physical Education and sports sessions for students.
Support students in developing basic sports skills, physical fitness, coordination, and teamwork.
Conduct and supervise sports activities, drills, games, and fitness exercises under the guidance of the PE teacher.
Ensure students follow sports rules, safety procedures, and appropriate conduct during activities.
Supervise students during sports periods, breaks, competitions, practices, and school events.
Assist in organizing and conducting inter-house, inter-school, and other sports competitions.
Support students in preparing for sports events and competitions based on their interests and abilities.
Maintain and organize sports equipment, facilities, and activity areas, reporting any damage or safety concerns.
Monitor student participation and provide appropriate encouragement, guidance, and feedback.
Perform other PE and sports-related duties assigned by the PE Coordinator or School Management.
About CS Academy
CS Academy, Coimbatore has three campuses. Two are in Kovaipudur (Main) in adjacent facilities and the third primary campus is in the heart of the city at Red Fields. Our boarding house in Kovaipudur is open for boys and girls from class IV for both CBSE and Cambridge International students. The picturesque main campus located in the foothills of the Western Ghats is ideally suited for exploring and learning
Our team brings a wealth of expertise in education. Our CBSE and Cambridge programmes and teaching methodology are proven and time tested. We have built on vast experience and developed a programme that encompasses modern tools while adhering to traditional principles.
Our mission is to equip our students with the knowledge and skills required to succeed in the real world by providing practical and holistic education in a challenging, yet nurturing environment. We prepare students for success by focusing on four pillars: Academic excellence, Skill building, Core Values and Healthy competition.
In 2024, CS Academy Coimbatore joined the prestigious International Schools Partnership (ISP) group. With over 116 schools in 25 countries, ISP is a leading global network of educational institutions. As a member of this esteemed network, CS Academy Coimbatore enjoys unparalleled international learning connections, unwavering quality assurance, and exceptional governance.
Location: CS Academy, Kovaipudur, Coimbatore - 641 042, Tamil Nadu, India.

ISP Principles

Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding
and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.

Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.

Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.

Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.

Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.
ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles
ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.
ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging
ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply. Physical education Sports coaching Student supervision Teamwork Fitness training Safety procedures Sports equipment maintenance Communication Mentoring Event organization The role requires an individual capable of assisting in the development of physical fitness, coordination, and sports skills among students. Candidates must be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

title: Senior Electrical Designer – SolidWorks
job_description:
Navinyaa Solutions is hiring a Senior Electrical Designer – SolidWorks (Wiring Harness & Systems) with 8 to 12 years of hands-on experience in 3D wire harness design, electrical schematic engineering and cabinet-level system integration using the SOLIDWORKS.
Role Summary
Job Title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer - Harness & Systems
Experience: 8 – 12 years (core hands-on)
Location: Doddaballapur, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka (work from office)
Domain: Gaming cabinets, slot machines, EGM - high-reliability electro-mechanical products
Design Platform: SolidWorks Electrical only (Schematic + Electrical 3D / Routing)
Education: Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech - both routes accepted
Engagement: Full-time or Contract
Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred

About the Role
You will own the electrical architecture, 3D cable and wire harness design, schematic generation, component selection and design validation for next-generation slot machines and gaming cabinets.
This is a role for an engineer who works comfortably in both worlds - the schematic and the physical assembly. You will route harnesses through cabinets where space is tight, doors swing and drawers slide, and where a wire that chafes through after two years in the field is a failure the operator will feel. Everything is designed in SolidWorks, and the harness you draw is the harness the shop floor builds.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities
A. 3D Wire Harness & Cable Design
Spatial routing: Design and route complex 3D wiring harnesses, looms and cable assemblies within tight, high-density cabinet spaces using SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing.
Dynamic kinematics: Engineer harness paths across moving parts - hinged display doors, retractable player-tracking modules and bill validator drawers - with correct strain relief, bend radii and anti-chafing protection.
Assembly integration: Work inside the live SolidWorks cabinet assembly to validate clearances, service access and interference against mechanical and sheet-metal models.
Production deliverables: Generate 2D formboard and nailboard drawings, Bills of Material (BOM), wire cut lists, sleeve specifications and bundle breakdown sheets for manufacturing.

B. Electrical Schematics & Architecture
Schematic design: Create and maintain multi-sheet electrical schematics and power single-line diagrams in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic - AC mains entry, 12V / 24V DC supplies, UPS backup and logic isolation.
System interconnections: Map wiring between main logic boards (EGM controllers), bill acceptors, thermal printers, player panels, topper displays and RGB LED controllers.
Data integrity: Maintain the project database, component libraries, cabling and terminal-strip data so schematics and 3D routing stay synchronised through design change cycles.

C. Connector & Component Selection
Interconnect specification: Select connectors, pins, headers and terminals (Molex, TE Connectivity, Hirose, Amphenol) for low-power signals, high-speed data and high-vibration environments.
Cable sizing & protection: Define wire gauges, insulation types, shielding, ferrites and sleeving rated for continuous operation.
Manufacturing standards: Ensure every harness design conforms to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2/3.

D. Testing, ESD, Safety & Compliance
ESD protection: Implement chassis grounding, shielding and ESD suppression routes that protect sensitive electronics from static discharge at player touch points.
Regulatory compliance: Ensure the electrical layout passes gaming certification such as GLI-11, alongside FCC Class A/B, CE, UL 62368-1 and UL 2200.
Verification testing: Oversee continuity testing, high-voltage insulation and Hi-Pot tests, thermal load limits and signal integrity checks on harness prototypes.

Mandatory Criteria
Education - either route accepted
Route A: Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, supported by 8 to 12 years of hands-on wiring harness design and schematic engineering experience.
Route B: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering.
Diploma candidates who meet the experience requirement are assessed on demonstrated project capability, not on qualification. Both routes are evaluated against the same technical bar and the same software requirement below.

Software Platform - SolidWorks, no equivalents
You must be independently productive in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic for 2D authoring and SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing for harness work, including bidirectional schematic-to-3D synchronisation and automated formboard generation.
Coming from EPLAN Electric P8, AutoCAD Electrical, Creo Pro-Cabling, CATIA V5 EHI, Autodesk Inventor or VeSyS? You are welcome to apply - but you will need to demonstrate working SolidWorks Electrical capability at interview, as these platforms are not treated as substitutes here.

What You Bring
Experience: 8 to 12 years in electrical harness design, schematic engineering and cabinet-level system integration.
SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing: Proven 3D harness routing, flattened-route creation and formboard output within live assemblies.
SolidWorks Electrical Schematic: Multi-sheet schematic authoring, library and symbol management, terminal-strip and cabling definition, report generation.
Standards: Working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620, crimp validation, pull testing and harness manufacturing processes.
Domain background (advantage): Slot machines, gaming cabinets, ATMs, self-service kiosks, medical consoles or high-density industrial control panels.

About Navinyaa Solutions
Navinyaa Solutions delivers engineering design, IT, finance and BPO services to clients across manufacturing, consumer products, automotive, aerospace, medical devices and industrial equipment. Our engineering practice covers the full product lifecycle - concept development, CAD modelling, analysis, prototyping, design transfer and sustenance engineering. SolidWorks Electrical 3D Wire Harness Design Electrical Schematic Engineering System Integration Cabinet Design IPC/WHMA-A-620 Connector Selection Cable Routing Bill of Materials ESD Protection Regulatory Compliance Thermal Load Analysis Signal Integrity Electro-mechanical Design Schematic Generation Formboard Drawing Candidates must have 8 to 12 years of hands-on experience in electrical harness design and schematic engineering using SolidWorks. A degree or diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering is required, along with a strong understanding of manufacturing standards like IPC/WHMA-A-620.

title: Associate or Senior Editor, BMC Nursing
job_description:
Job Title: Associate or Senior Editor, BMC Nursing
Location: Shanghai or Pune – hybrid working model
Application Deadline: 30th October 2026

About Springer Nature 
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature. 

About the Brand
BMC has more than 20 years of experience in developing open access and provides high-quality, impactful research and a supportive publishing experience for authors. We are committed to publishing the best open access journals in our portfolio of over 250 titles and we strive to drive progress in biology, health sciences and medicine. Visit https://link.springer.com/brands/bmc and follow @BioMedCentral
About the Role 
You will contribute to the success of the BMC Series by supporting editorial handling of content in BMC Nursing and by driving the content development of the journal. This is a dynamic and varied role that will give you the opportunity to see content across a broad range of topics and contribute to the success of BMC as a whole.

Communication is a key part of this role, as you will need to build excellent and productive relationships with the external Editorial Board who manage the peer review process and with internal teams responsible for journal editorial office support such as Editorial Operations and Marketing.

Role Responsibilities
Content Development – Scientific Comprehension 
· Develop a journal development strategy for BMC Nursing, taking into account individual journal performance and development needs, as well as the overall strategy of the BMC series.
· Work with colleagues across the Journals group to support subject-specific strategy development at Springer Nature.
· Identify and commission reviews, collections and supplements, and work with the scientific community to drive these forward.

Peer Review Quality – Decision Quality, Manuscript Assessment, Critical Scientific Evaluation, Publishing Workflows & Systems 
· Oversee the handling of the content published in BMC Nursing, primarily by advising on content handled by editorial board members, but also by handling individual submissions yourself where required.
· Investigate and resolve publishing or research ethics cases, both pre- and post-publication, with the guidance of Springer Nature Research Integrity Group when needed.
· Engage effectively with other teams to support the resolution of editorial issues and to prioritise author service while maintaining editorial standards
· Advise on editorial policy development as appropriate.

Editorial Board Management – Communicates Effectively 
· Build excellent communication and relationships with Editorial Board Members and authors.
· Call Senior Board Members to discuss journal policy, specific content-related issues, editorial board recruitment etc. 
· Contribute to the recruitment and training of new editorial board members 
· Contribute to editorial board engagement initiatives across the journals 
· Host regular Senior Board and Editorial Board Meetings, either in person or online. 
· Ensure that all members of the Editorial Board are fully aware of the ethos and editorial policies of the journal and the BMC series, and have all necessary training and information to perform their roles. 

Building Awareness of the BMC Series - Communicates Effectively, Scientific & Academic Writing 
· Develop journal website content and features that are of interest to the community and raise the profile of the journal websites in the online environment. 
· Attend conferences to promote the journals and develop a network of contacts within relevant fields. 
· Increase journal visibility by writing blogs and participating in social media activities to promote journal content and BMC values. 

Contribute to the BMC team – Collaboration, Interpersonal Awareness, Being Resilient 
· Contribute to the culture of the BMC editorial team by supporting your colleagues, covering for them when needed and sharing expertise and experience. 
Experience, Skills & Qualifications:
Essential 
· Educated to PhD level (or equivalent), nursing, healthcare, public health, or a related discipline.
· An interest in open access publishing 
· An interest in scientific research and current knowledge of a relevant field 
· Knowledge of editorial process and related matters 
· Excellent communication and influencing skills 
· Highly customer focused 
· Strong analytical/critical appraisal skills 
· Willing to travel occasionally and represent BMC at external events 
· Able to respond to non-routine circumstances 
· Excellent time management and prioritization skills, able to balance short-term deadlines with long-term goals 
· Self-starter with a positive, can-do approach to problem-solving 
· Ability to adapt to changing circumstances 
· Ability to work cooperatively with colleagues at all levels 
· Ability to work in a team 
· Editorial experience (for Senior Editor) 

To Apply: You Must Submit
· a CV
· a cover letter where you also explain how your skills and knowledge could be applied to the role.

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion

For more information about career opportunities in Springer Nature please visit https://springernature.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SpringerNatureCareers/
