About Our Company
Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
Job Description
The Service and Incident Management Manager will lead the Ameriprise Incident Management Team with Critical/Major incident management being the primary responsibility. This resource will be working with multiple teams across business and technologies to manage incidents and run bridges with the primary objective of reducing MTRS of incidents. 
Provide operational leadership and direction to technology operations team(s) including employees, contract personal and strategic vendor partners. Accountable for the availability and performance of applications and services and the seamless business consumption of them. Own production support, front-line management of incidents, small enhancements, and proactive/preventative testing and analysis (to include solution ideation, recommendation and implementation). Serve as escalation point and operational expert for issues, needs and operational requirements.
Key Responsibilities
- Act with decisive confidence and exercise influence over a wide range of individuals at all levels of business and technical leadership
- Ensure incidents are fully documented both during and after the incident, including gathering and recording the full incident timeline of events
- Collaborate with multiple teams across business and technology to ensure processes are in compliance with guidelines
- Communicate to affected business areas as well as executives
- Produce documents that outline incident protocols such as how to handle cybersecurity threats

Production Support 
- Prioritize incidents according to their urgency and impact to the business and escalate (technical and/or hierarchical) as needed
- Engage team, partners and stakeholders appropriately to ensure full collaboration, multiple viewpoints and full transparency
- Maintain a professional demeanor and attitude while being assertive when leading an incident investigation
- Apply technical acumen to ask the right questions, collect the responses, set actions based on information, and to follow-up with probing questions if the response does not fit the situation
- Establish and manage goals, reporting needs, key performance indicators / early indicators and dashboards for measurement of operation success
- Ensure operational readiness thru effective handoff of technologies and services into production
- Develop and/or oversee development of configurations, monitoring procedures and break/fix documentation
- Collaborate on system health evaluations to address performance issues and establish action plans
- Drive proliferation of existing technology investments and capabilities to enable business efficiencies
- Escalation point with vendors or users on current product capabilities and enhancement requests
- Escalation contact for assigned incident & problem workgroups. 
- Monitor and perform routine performance/service-level audits to ensure optimal utilization. 
- Accountable for scheduled and unscheduled operational maintenance tasks.
- Ensure escalation processes in place and utilized. 

Leadership
- Provide oversight and leadership to technology operations team 
- Delegate and prioritize work to ensure effective execution of team/function deliverables
- Ensure knowledge transfer and cross-training of team to effectively support the business
- Develop and maintain a high-performing team through effective hiring, vendor partner management, coaching and performance management
- Develop, manage and champion policies and standards.
- Build, nurture and maintain relationships with key cross-commit teams

Operational Requirements
- Provide insight into operational requirements / needs and funding conversations. 
- Participate in the annual budget and project planning process. 
- Review and approve vendor/supplier invoices, as applicable, to ensure services provided/business activity translates accurately to spend.
- Work with finance and business management teams to manage overall operational finance plan for voice & contact center technologies.
- Manage all business as usual changes work requests thru Service Catalog, critique volumes and trends on an ongoing basis. Respond to escalations and SLA misses

Vendor & Service Level Management
- Primary day-to-day liaison with suppliers and vendors for assigned portfolio(s) of applications/services. 

Maintain Skill-Set & Relationships
- Maintain a broad understanding of business, business needs, and how assigned technologies drive and support the business.
- Maintain strong relationship with key business partners driving technology consumption – understand their road map and align technologies capabilities to achieve


Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar field; or equivalent work experience. 
- 7-10 years of relevant experience required. 
- Understanding of ITIL - Change, Incident, Problem, Knowledge Management
- Solid understanding of basic infrastructure design and operation
- Experience supporting applications within the Financial Services industry (e.g. broker-dealer, asset management, insurance, etc.).
- Experience working in Command center set up. 
- Hands on experience with monitoring tools (Dynatrace, SumoLogic).
- Strong analytic skills including ability to identify patterns and potential issues 
- Situation management and decision-making skills 
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to multi-task and remain calm in critical situations
- Detail oriented


Preferred Qualifications
- Certifications preferred: ITIL Foundation Certification
- Previous experience in a Critical/Major Incident Management role
- Experience working with the following tools: MS Office, ServiceNow, Power BI, JIRA, Confluence
- Experience with event correlation and interpretation, utilizing various monitoring tools (Dynatrace, SumoLogic)
- Solid understanding of business functional areas, systems, and capabilities
In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process

title: Sr Director Analyst (HR Strategy & Transformation)
job_description:
About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

A Senior Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the transformation of the HR function — evolution of the HR functional structure, HR roles, and HR technology strategy — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders. Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise.

What you will do: 
Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on HR functional transformation, HR strategic planning, and HR technology strategy and use cases.
Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act.
Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts
Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video-based presentations and discussions
Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
Provide high quality and timely content peer review
Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions


What you will need: 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
12+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or HR technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience; with the below subject matter expertise:
Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities
Experience successfully designing and leading HR functional transformations.
Knowledge of the HR technology landscape, including market dynamics and vendors, particularly with respect to AI, and their impact on HR strategies and workflows.
Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
Strong business and financial acumen
Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

title: Principal Analyst (Equity or Investment research, Technology research)
job_description:
What makes Gartner Research a GREAT fit for you?
When you join Gartner Research, you’ll be part of a leading-edge team that values expert insights, bold ideas and intellectual courage. You’ll deliver must-have research and contribute to our double-digit growth by providing our clients worldwide the unbiased insight they need to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Through constant learning, discovery and collaboration you’ll not only help clients deliver on the promise of digital, you’ll grow your career and the scope of your impact across industries. Our culture demands hard work — and rewards it with exceptional opportunity. If you are intellectually curious and principally motivated by ideas, Gartner is looking for you.
About this role:
Gartner is searching for an India-based Principal Analyst to join our global Invest Practice, serving our Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking clients withing our Emerging Technology research group. Operating as a critical engine in Gartner’s 24/7 "follow-the-sun" model (NY–London–India), you will track daily investment activities, decode early-stage tech innovations, and rapidly synthesize Gartner's proprietary research into tailored, high-impact deliverables for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives. This individual will work on a wide range of written deliverables. The specialist must be interested in all types of technology innovation and combine strong business and financial acumen with an agile mindset: immersing yourself in one technology trend today, and seamlessly pivoting to the next to match the market's relentless pace. This role is a key feeder to careers reaching the highest levels of Gartner.
What you will do:
▪ Track Daily Invest Activity & Enable Follow-the-Sun Support: Monitor global financial and market developments daily across Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking to support Gartner’s 24/7 global delivery model (NY–London–India).
▪ Curate & Customize Content for Invest Analysts: Translate and tailor Gartner’s technology research, market data, and insights into high-impact, actionable deliverables as well as lead author publications tailored specifically for Invest Analysts and clients.
▪ Fuel Sales-Led & Timely Content Creation: Leverage business and economic acumen to rapidly identify relevant and timely published research for Invest clients that support sales initiatives.
▪ Partner Across Global Stakeholder Teams: Collaborate seamlessly with core Invest analyst team and leadership to ensure timely delivery.
Who you are:
We are looking for creative, analytically sharp, articulate, and self-motivated individuals who want to build a career tracking emerging technology signals and translating them into actionable intelligence for the investment community. You possess a strong passion for tech innovation, early-stage startups, and financial markets, with a keen interest in how emerging trends impact Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking.
Unlike traditional buy-side/sell-side finance, investment banking, or management consulting, our strategic research positions do not depend on deal sourcing or business development targets. Our search for talent centers on your ability to track daily market activity, analyze emerging tech innovations, and deliver rigorous, customized insights that power our 24/7 global delivery model.
Key characteristics of successful hires include:
Strong Business & Tech Acumen: A deep appetite to track investment activities daily and explore early-stage tech trends to extract high-value market insights.
Analytical & Customization Capabilities: Ability to gather, analyze, and restructure complex qualitative and quantitative data to tailor Gartner content specifically for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives.
Precision Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex market and technology concepts clearly, logically, and persuasively.
Agility Under Fast-Paced Conditions: Proven competence in meeting tight daily deadlines, multi-tasking across dynamic market trends, and delivering high-quality work in a "follow-the-sun" global workflow.
Continuous Curiosity & Ownership: A drive to constantly learn, adapt to shifting market signals, and take self-motivated ownership of research deliverables.
Preferred Qualifications:
Education: Master’s degree (Business, Economics, Finance, MBA, or Technology-related field) or PhD preferred.
Experience: 5-8 years of experience in market research, equity/investment research (highly preferred), corporate strategy, or management consulting within the technology or financial services sectors.
Methodology: Proven expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, data synthesis, and insight generation.
Domain Knowledge: General understanding of financial markets, investment lifecycles, and emerging technology ecosystems.

Who are we? 
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
What makes Gartner a great place to work? 
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
Gartner is the world authority on AI
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
What do we offer? 
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: QA Lead Drive 9th Oct 2026
job_description:
We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer with expertise in Python to build and maintain automation frameworks for desktop applications. You will drive test automation, integrate CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high-quality software delivery while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain automation frameworks for desktop applications using Python.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites to ensure high product quality, reliability, and comprehensive test coverage.
Define and implement test strategies, test plans, and quality assurance processes throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, ensuring seamless integration of automated tests into the release process.
Collaborate with developers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Analyze test execution results, investigate failures, perform root cause analysis, and work with engineering teams to drive timely issue resolution.
Lead QA activities across multiple projects, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining high quality standards.
Mentor and coach QA engineers, promoting best practices in test automation, quality engineering, and software testing methodologies.
Drive continuous improvements in automation frameworks, testing processes, and overall QA efficiency.
Track quality metrics, prepare test reports, and effectively communicate project status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.


Requirements
Required Skills
7-10 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, with strong expertise in test automation.
Strong hands-on experience in Python for developing and maintaining automation frameworks.
Proven experience in automating desktop applications across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
Strong understanding of test automation frameworks, software testing methodologies, and industry best practices.
Hands-on experience with Jenkins and CI/CD pipeline and Git management.
Experience in creating and executing test strategies, test plans, and test execution reports.
Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile methodologies, and software quality assurance processes.
Good knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including Windows, macOS, and Linux/UNIX.
Excellent analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience leading QA initiatives and mentoring junior QA engineers.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Exposure to API automation and REST API testing.
Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with cloud-based CI/CD environments.
Knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts and authentication protocols, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Single Sign-On (SSO).
Exposure to performance, security, or accessibility testing.
Experience working with virtualization or remote desktop environments.
ISTQB or equivalent QA certification.


Benefits
Opportunity to work with a dynamic and fast-paced IT organization.
Make a real impact on the company's success by shaping a positive and engaging work culture.
Work with a talented and collaborative team.
Be part of a company that is passionate about making a difference through technology. Candidates must possess a deep understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD tools like Jenkins.

Design, develop, test, and maintain reusable TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs and libraries.
Build secure authentication and authorization capabilities for web applications.

title: Product Owner
job_description:
Your role
What you'll be doing
What We Need
Corpay Inc. is seeking a Product Owner within our Corporate Payments division to drive clear, outcome-focused delivery within a Scrum team. This role owns backlog priorities and delivery outcomes, translating business goals and customer needs into actionable work that produces measurable value. The Product Owner serves as the single accountable owner for intent translation, connecting strategy, customer problems, and execution. You will report directly to the Director of Product Management and regularly collaborate with Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.
How We Work 
As a Product Owner, you will work in an onsite environment, reporting to our Nagpur office location 5 days a week.
Corpay will set you up for success by providing: 
Assigned workspace in Nagpur office location
Company-issued equipment 
Formal, hands-on training
Role Responsibilities 
The responsibilities of the role will include: 
Own Product Intent and Backlog
Translating business goals and customer needs into clear, actionable backlog items
Ensuring every item is tied to a defined outcome and measurable value
Maintaining a well-prioritized, continuously refined backlog
Drive Delivery and Decisions
Serving as the final decision maker on scope, priorities, and trade-offs
Balancing short-term delivery with longer-term product outcomes
Ensuring delivered work meets intended business and customer outcomes
Speaking directly to clients on features and design
Lead Team Alignment
Aligning the team on priorities, scope, and expected outcomes
Driving clarity and accountability across the delivery lifecycle
Working with the horizontal team to ensure flow of work aligns to priorities and release dates
Leverage Modern Tools and Practices
Be on the front line of building everything through an AI-First product strategy from prototyping to execution
Partner with engineering to ensure work is structured for effective execution and validation through AI code generation
Partner Across Stakeholders
Aligning priorities across Product, Engineering, and Business partners
Managing expectations and trade-offs to maximize delivered value
Ensure Quality and Outcomes
Validating readiness for release in partnership with Engineering
Tracking progress against defined success measures and adjust as needed
Tracking delivery metrics to ensure continued improvement
Experience in AI-DLC
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Management, or similar roles
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into structured backlog items
Experience in Commercial Card, Expense Management, and API integrations
Mobile application development experience
What Good Looks Like
Consistent delivery of high-quality features aligned to defined outcomes
Clear linkage between delivered work and business or customer value
Predictable execution with strong alignment across stakeholders
Continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery impact

About Corpay
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Transparency & Compliance
Equal Opportunity Employer
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring
Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
Candidate Privacy Notice
For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy-policy.
Pay Philosophy
Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable. The Executive Operations (Shiprocket Implant) serves as the dedicated regional point of contact between Blue Dart and Shiprocket, ensuring seamless execution of operational requirements, service delivery, shipment prioritization, and resolution of customer escalations.

To act as a dedicated regional operations representative for Shiprocket, enabling effective coordination between customer and operations teams, driving service excellence, managing escalations, monitoring performance metrics, and improving overall customer experience across the region.

Customer Relationship Management
Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for Shiprocket within the assigned region.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with Shiprocket operational and business stakeholders.
Participate in regular review meetings and performance discussions..
Operational Coordination
Coordinate with service centres, hubs, gateways and regional operations teams to ensure smooth shipment movement.
Facilitate shipment prioritization and operational interventions wherever required.
Support implementation of customer-specific operational requirements within approved SOPs.
Escalation Management
Handle customer escalations related to pickup, delivery, RTO, POD, NDR and service failures.
Ensure timely closure of escalations through coordination with relevant operational teams.
Track and communicate resolution status to stakeholders..
Service Performance Monitoring
Monitor daily operational performance against agreed service metrics.
Identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions.
Highlight network constraints and operational challenges affecting customer service levels.
Enterprise Support & Visibility
Provide operational visibility and actionable updates to Shiprocket stakeholders.
Monitor enterprise shipment trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
Support peak season planning and enterprise business readiness.
Reporting & Analytics 
Track key customer performance indicators and prepare periodic MIS reports.
Analyse shipment trends, service failures, escalation patterns and operational exceptions.
Publish dashboards and actionable reports for stakeholders.
Process Compliance 
Ensure adherence to Blue Dart operational processes and SOPs.
Support implementation of customer-specific initiatives approved by management.
Drive operational discipline and process compliance across locations.
Stakeholder Management

Regional Operations Teams
Service Quality Teams
Hub & Gateway Operations
Customer Service Teams
Commercial Teams
Key Account Managers
Shiprocket Operations Team

Experience in customer-facing operational roles preferred.
Exposure to escalation management and service performance monitoring will be an advantage.

Express Logistics & Ground Operations Knowledge

title: SAP PS Trainer
job_description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP PS (Project System) Trainer to deliver comprehensive training to individuals who want to build their careers in SAP. The trainer will be responsible for explaining SAP PS concepts, providing practical demonstrations, guiding learners through real-time business scenarios, and preparing candidates for SAP PS project opportunities.
Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured training on SAP PS (Project System) modules and functionalities.
Explain SAP PS concepts, configuration, business processes, and project lifecycle management.
Provide hands-on demonstrations using SAP systems and practical exercises.
Cover project planning, project structures, budgeting, cost planning, scheduling, and project execution.
Explain Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), Networks, Activities, Milestones, and Project Profiles.
Train candidates on integration between SAP PS and other SAP modules, including FI/CO, MM, SD, and PP.
Explain project cost tracking, settlement, results analysis, and reporting.
Provide real-time business scenarios and practical implementation examples.
Guide learners through SAP PS configuration and end-user processes.
Prepare training materials, assignments, exercises, and assessments.
Conduct mock interviews and help candidates prepare for SAP PS consultant roles.
Monitor learner progress and provide feedback and career guidance.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of SAP PS (Project System).
Understanding of SAP PS configuration and business processes.
Knowledge of WBS, Networks, Activities, Milestones, and project scheduling.
Experience with project planning, budgeting, cost planning, and cost monitoring.
Knowledge of project settlement and integration with SAP FI/CO.
Understanding of integration with SAP MM, SD, and PP.
Ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.
Strong communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
Ability to deliver practical, hands-on SAP training.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience as an SAP PS Consultant, SAP PS Functional Consultant, or SAP Trainer.
Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA Project System.
SAP implementation or support project experience.
Experience preparing candidates for SAP PS interviews.
SAP certification is an advantage.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
Relevant SAP PS implementation, support, or training experience.
Strong communication skills and the ability to conduct interactive training sessions.
Ideal Candidate
An experienced SAP PS Functional Consultant or SAP PS Trainer who can provide practical, project-oriented training and help learners understand SAP PS concepts, configuration, integration, and real-world business scenarios. SAP PS Project System WBS Networks Activities Milestones Project Planning Budgeting Cost Planning SAP FI/CO SAP MM SAP SD SAP PP Configuration Training Delivery Mentoring Candidates should have strong knowledge of SAP PS configuration, integration with other modules like FI/CO, MM, SD, and PP, and experience in project planning and budgeting. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field and prior experience as an SAP PS consultant or trainer are preferred.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job_description:
About Us
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
About the Role
DriveWealth is seeking a hands-on Senior QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team supporting post-trade platforms: clearing, custody, settlement, and the back-office systems that follow trade execution. This role is embedded within a product engineering team and focuses on scalable automation, high-quality releases, and stronger testing practices across the SDLC.
The ideal candidate has strong technical automation experience and prior exposure to post-trade processing, reconciliation, and margin products in a broker-dealer or clearing environment.

What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Java, Cucumber (BDD), and RestAssured
Build and execute automated tests across API, event/messaging (Kafka, queue-based integrations), and data layers, with UI coverage where applicable
Validate end-to-end post-trade workflows, including trade settlement, positions and cash, corporate actions, options lifecycle (exercise, assignment, expiration), margin, asset transfers (ACATS), and cost basis/tax lots
Design and automate reconciliation tests between DriveWealth systems and clearing/custodian platforms, validating positions, balances, and transactions
Validate downstream outputs such as trade confirmations, statements, and regulatory reports (e.g., CAT/FINRA)
Create test plans, scenarios, and regression suites for financial systems, including migration and parallel-run validation
Build and maintain CI/CD test pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
Performance Testing experience
Analyze test results, troubleshoot defects, and improve test coverage
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams on testing strategy and quality improvements
Participate in test reviews, bug triage, and production issue analysis

You Bring
8+ years of QA experience in financial services, with direct exposure to post-trade, clearing, or back-office platforms
Strong hands-on programming in Java
Automation experience with Cucumber/BDD and RestAssured
Experience testing REST APIs and event-driven systems (Kafka; RabbitMQ or SQS a plus)
Strong SQL (Postgres) skills for data validation and reconciliation
Working knowledge of post-trade concepts: settlement cycles, corporate actions, margin, options lifecycle, and books-and-records requirements
Experience with AWS, Git, and Jenkins
Familiarity with JIRA and test management tools (Allure TestOps)

Special Knowledge (Nice to Have, But Not Required)
Playwright and TypeScript for UI automation
Experience with a clearing system conversion or platform migration
Exposure to FIX protocol, crypto asset workflows, or data tools such as Databricks

Location
This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Bangalore, India - Hybrid 
If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
Working at DriveWealth
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
Work Authorization
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
How We Think About AI
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
Compensation
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.
Equal Employment Opportunity
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 
Agency Disclaimer
DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Java Cucumber RestAssured API testing Kafka SQL Postgres CI/CD Jenkins GitHub Actions Performance testing Test automation Financial services Post-trade processing Reconciliation Margin products Requires 8+ years of QA experience in financial services with strong hands-on programming skills in Java. Candidates must have experience with automation tools like Cucumber and RestAssured, as well as proficiency in SQL and event-driven systems.

title: Frontend Engineer
job_description:
The people here at Apple don't just build products—they craft the kind of wonder
that has revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people
and their ideas that encourage the innovation that runs through everything we
do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join
Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! Do you want to help
build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer
technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology
(IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for
customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous
system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of
secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running
flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building
solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could
do here. Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind
Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the
software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates
AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year,
delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.


DESCRIPTION


Build and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications that deliver
seamless and intuitive user experiences. Collaborate with cross-functional teams
including designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate
product requirements and designs into responsive, accessible, and user-centric
interfaces. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and reusable code using HTML,
CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue,
Angular, React. Contribute to frontend architecture and engineering best
practices while ensuring applications meet performance, accessibility, security,
and cross-browser compatibility standards. You will own frontend features
end-to-end, from understanding requirements and implementing solutions to
testing, debugging, deployment, and production support. You will also
participate in code reviews, identify opportunities for improving application
performance and reliability, and stay current with evolving web technologies and
development practices.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field,
or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of professional experience in
frontend/web application development. Hands-on experience with JavaScript,
TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Experience with modern frontend frameworks, such as
Vue, Angular, React Experience building responsive, accessible, and user-centric
web applications


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Experience developing reusable UI components and implementing frontend design
patterns Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
Experience with frontend state management frameworks such as Redux or equivalent
Familiarity with frontend build and development tools such as Webpack, Rush,
ESLint, and related tooling Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated
frontend build and deployment processes. Experience with web performance
monitoring, profiling, and optimization. Experience with modern testing
frameworks and tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or
Playwright. JavaScript TypeScript HTML5 CSS3 Vue Angular React Web Development Frontend Architecture Responsive Design Accessibility RESTful APIs State Management CI/CD Unit Testing Performance Optimization Requires a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Candidates must have 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development with proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks.

title: Senior Product Designer
job_description:
About EarnIn
As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.
We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.
POSITION SUMMARY
We're looking for a versatile Senior Product Designer who can move easily between website/UI design, ad creative, and video editing - and who knows how to use AI tools and prompt engineering to work faster and produce better creative. This is a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges depend on role, level, and location. We cannot provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Design simple, clean UI concepts for websites and landing pages
Create images and graphics for digital ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
Edit and produce short videos for ads and social content
Use AI tools (image generation, video generation, prompt engineering) to speed up and enhance design and content creation
Build reusable prompts, modular inputs, and templates to produce high-fidelity creative variations at scale
Rapidly iterate on new campaign ideas and refresh evergreen assets to avoid creative fatigue
Maintain brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all formats and platforms
Document prompt logic, chaining, and template design so the team can scale content production
Stay current on emerging AI tools and pilot promising new techniques
Use performance data to refine creative — test variations and double down on what works
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 
4+ years of experience designing UI/website concepts
4+ years of experience creating ad creative (images/graphics)
Strong working skills in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and a video editing tool (Premiere, After Effects, or similar)
Comfortable using AI creative tools and prompt engineering as part of your everyday workflow
Thinks structurally - comfortable with prompt engineering, JSON-like inputs, logic trees, and template systems
Working knowledge of visual production basics (camera types, lenses, lighting, composition) to craft detailed, high-quality prompts
Experience in fast-paced, high-output creative environments with rapid iteration cycles
A portfolio showing examples of the above
#LI-Hybrid
At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant. 
EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team. UI design Web design Ad creative Video editing AI tools Prompt engineering Figma Adobe Creative Suite Premiere After Effects Visual production Graphic design Content creation Performance data analysis Candidates must have 4+ years of experience in UI/website design and ad creative production. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and video editing software is required, along with a strong understanding of AI creative tools and prompt engineering.

title: People Systems Engineer
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
At GitLab, People technology never stands still, and as a People Systems Engineer, you’ll build what keeps it moving. Reporting to the Senior Director, People Technology, and working alongside our Lead People Systems Engineer, you’ll design, build and maintain the automations, integrations and AI-powered workflows that connect Workday, Greenhouse, Slack and the tools that power our global workforce. You’ll own features from request through tested code, deployment and ongoing reliability across Workato, Google Cloud and Claude. With an AI-forward mindset, you’ll rethink how People work gets done, eliminating manual effort and creating streamlined, delightful experiences for team members. If you think like a software engineer, love solving puzzles and want to grow your career at the intersection of people systems, AI and automation in an all-remote, async-first environment, this is your role.
What You’ll Do 
Build, test and maintain People system automations and integrations across Workato, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Workday, Greenhouse and GitLab, owning your features from design through deployment.
Develop integrations between Workday, Greenhouse, Slack and internal tools using Workday Web Services (WWS) and Slack’s API and Bot SDK, and build Slack apps and bots that turn manual steps into simple, automated workflows for team members around the world.
Write clean, readable automation code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language, stored and versioned in GitLab, with clear documentation and peer code reviews.
Keep pace with a high-growth company by monitoring integration health, troubleshooting failures quickly and fixing root causes so our automations stay reliable at scale.
Ship changes safely through GitLab CI/CD pipelines, following testing, change-management and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT general controls (ITGC) standards with care.
Lead with AI: use AI tools, large language models (LLMs) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, including Claude, every day to accelerate development, prototype AI agents and reimagine how People work gets done, then share what you learn so the whole team moves faster.
Look past the surface of a request to find the real problem, then recommend and build solutions that are durable, scalable and easy to support. Partner with People Technology Analysts on configuration, testing and releases, and with Information Security, IT and AI Engineering on security and standards.
Raise the bar for how automations are architected, documented and maintained, learning from and contributing alongside our Lead People Systems Engineer.
What You’ll Bring 
Hands-on experience building automations or integrations, ideally with human resources or business systems.
Experience writing and maintaining code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language, such as Python or JavaScript, and a willingness to learn Ruby if you haven’t already.
Hands-on experience with Workato or a comparable integration platform as a service (iPaaS) in a production environment.
Experience working with APIs and web services, including REST and SOAP, and an understanding of how data moves between systems.
Proficiency with Git for version control and code review; you treat automation code like production software.
A forward-thinking, AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools every day to automate tasks, speed up development and improve processes, and you’re energized by what AI makes possible next.
The ability to work independently, solve problems with curiosity, come with options and a recommendation, and collaborate openly. You protect highly confidential information and take ownership of code quality, reliable outcomes and the end user’s experience.
Additional relevant experience includes Workday integrations (WWS, Reporting as a Service or Workday Studio), Slack apps or bots, CI/CD pipelines, Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, Docker or Kubernetes, building with LLMs, AI agents or MCP frameworks, SOX ITGC controls, Greenhouse, Serval, Google Workspace, or all-remote and asynchronous work. A related computing degree or equivalent experience is also welcome; none of these is required.
About the team
The People Technology team is building the systems foundation that lets GitLab scale as a global, all-remote company. We’re always raising the bar for what People technology can do, improving reliability, usability and intelligence across the platforms that power our People organization. We work across core systems, integrations, reporting and compliance, and partner closely with stakeholders across time zones to move fast, build with purpose and create seamless experiences that empower people to do their best work. If you want to grow your career building something that matters at a company working at the edge of what’s possible, this is the team.
How GitLab will support you
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off 
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave 
Home office support
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Flexible Paid Time Off

Growth and Development Fund

If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job_description:
About MasterControl
MasterControl Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based quality and compliance software for life sciences and other regulated industries. Our mission is the same as that of our customers to bring life-changing products to more people sooner. The MasterControl Platform helps organizations digitize, automate and connect quality and compliance processes across the regulated product development life cycle. Over 1,000 companies worldwide rely on MasterControl solutions to achieve new levels of operational excellence across product development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing and postmarket surveillance. For more information, visit www.mastercontrol.com.
SUMMARY
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will be a key driver in designing, building, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes-based platforms. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure our systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and efficient.
A strong candidate will embrace AI-assisted engineering — leveraging tools like Anthropic Claude and AWS Kiro to accelerate infrastructure development, SRE operations, cost management, and software delivery lifecycle (SDLC) workflows.

RESPONSIBILITIES
AWS Infrastructure
• Design, provision, and manage scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and AWS CDK.
• Own and optimize AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, ALB/NLB, and more.
• Design and manage robust AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, subnets, routing tables, and network ACLs for high-availability and security.
• Configure and optimize Route 53 for DNS management, failover strategies, and multi-region routing policies.
• Deploy and manage API Gateways for REST and HTTP APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, request/response transformation, and integration with backend services.
• Implement and manage AWS Load Balancers (Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Classic Load Balancer) for traffic distribution, session management, and high availability.
• Define and enforce AWS security policies including security groups, NACLs, WAF rules, and compliance requirements across network infrastructure.
• Enforce AWS security best practices including least-privilege IAM policies, security group management, and network segmentation.
• Monitor infrastructure health, costs, and performance; continuously identify and implement optimizations.
• Lead cloud architecture reviews and contribute to Well-Architected Framework assessments.
Azure Infrastructure & Multi-Cloud
• Design and provision Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual networks, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and managed databases.
• Manage Azure IAM, resource groups, and implement security best practices across Azure environments.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code for Azure using Terraform and Azure Resource Manager templates.
• Integrate Azure services with AWS environments for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments where applicable.
System Administration (Linux & Windows)
• Administer Linux-based systems (AWS Linux and Ubuntu) including kernel management, package management, user/group administration, permissions, and access control.
• Configure and maintain Linux services, systemd, and daemon processes for reliability and performance.
• Administer Windows Server environments including Active Directory integration, Group Policy, patching, and security hardening.
• Manage both Linux and Windows across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Implement configuration management and automation for consistent system provisioning and lifecycle management.
Amazon EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)
• Design, deploy, and manage production-grade EKS clusters with a focus on security, scalability, and high availability.
• Manage Kubernetes resources including Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ConfigMaps, Secrets, RBAC, and Network Policies.
• Implement and maintain cluster autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler, Karpenter), node group management, and pod disruption budgets.
• Integrate EKS with AWS services such as IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA), AWS Load Balancer Controller, EBS/EFS CSI drivers, and AWS Secrets Manager.
• Deploy, configure, and manage Istio service mesh on EKS, including traffic management, mutual TLS (mTLS), observability, and security policy enforcement.
• Oversee Kubernetes upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management across environments.
ArgoCD & GitOps
• Implement and maintain GitOps workflows using ArgoCD for continuous delivery to Kubernetes environments.
• Design and manage ArgoCD Application and ApplicationSet configurations for multi-cluster and multi-environment deployments.
• Establish GitOps best practices including environment promotion strategies (dev → staging → production), rollback procedures, and drift detection.
• Manage ArgoCD RBAC, SSO integration, and security hardening.
• Collaborate with development teams to onboard services into the GitOps delivery model.
CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions & Jenkins)
• Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins for build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows.
• Configure and manage Jenkins infrastructure, including master/agent architecture, plugin management, and security hardening.
• Design Jenkins declarative and scripted pipelines for complex multi-stage deployments across environments.
• Integrate Jenkins with container registries, artifact repositories, testing frameworks, and deployment tools.
• Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions to standardize pipelines across teams.
• Create reusable Jenkins shared libraries and pipeline templates for consistency and maintainability.
• Integrate pipelines with container registries (Amazon ECR), security scanning tools (Trivy, Snyk, etc.), and deployment tooling.
• Implement pipeline best practices including secrets management, environment protection rules, and workflow approvals.
• Monitor pipeline performance and drive improvements in build reliability and deployment velocity.
Container Development & Registry Management
• Build, optimize, and maintain Docker containers with strong emphasis on Dockerfile best practices including multi-stage builds, minimal base images, layer optimization, and security hardening.
• Design efficient container images that minimize size, reduce startup time, and optimize resource consumption.
• Manage container image repositories using Amazon ECR, including image lifecycle policies, tagging strategies, image retention policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control.
• Integrate container building and registry management into CI/CD pipelines, automating image builds, security scanning, tagging, and registry pushes.

• Leverage Anthropic Claude as an AI engineering assistant to rapidly generate, review, and refactor Terraform modules and AWS CDK stacks, reducing toil and accelerating infrastructure delivery.
• Utilize AWS Kiro to automate and streamline infrastructure provisioning, SRE workflows, and cloud operations tasks through AI-driven assistance.
• Apply AI tooling across the SDLC — from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and incident resolution — to improve team velocity and code quality.
• Use Claude and Kiro to assist with SRE work including runbook generation, automated root cause analysis drafting, postmortem write-ups, alert tuning, and on-call automation.
• Employ AI-assisted tooling to monitor and optimize AWS costs — analyzing Cost Explorer data, identifying waste, rightsizing recommendations, and generating cost reports and savings proposals.
• Establish team best practices and guardrails for responsible, secure, and effective use of AI coding and operations tools.
• Continuously evaluate emerging AI-powered DevOps tooling and champion adoption of high-value capabilities across the engineering organization.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on DevOps practices, tooling, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflows.
• Define and enforce standards for observability including logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
• Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and postmortem processes.
• Champion a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
• Collaborate with security teams to implement DevSecOps practices throughout the SDLC.

• 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure role.
• Deep hands-on expertise with AWS, including core services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS) and advanced services.
• Strong expertise with AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, Route 53, API Gateways, Load Balancers (ALB/NLB), and AWS security policies.
• Hands-on experience with Linux system administration (AWS Linux and Ubuntu), including kernel management, package management, services, and security hardening.
• Hands-on experience with Windows Server administration including Active Directory, Group Policy, patching, and security configuration.
• Experience with Azure infrastructure and cloud services.
• Strong Kubernetes experience, including production EKS cluster management, networking, and storage.
• Proficiency with ArgoCD and GitOps principles for Kubernetes-based continuous delivery.
• Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
• Strong Docker experience including building, optimizing, and maintaining production container images with emphasis on Dockerfile best practices and security.
• Proficiency with Amazon ECR (Elastic Container Registry) including image management, lifecycle policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control.
• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform and AWS CDK.
• Hands-on experience using Anthropic Claude and/or AWS Kiro for infrastructure development, SRE operations, cost analysis, and SDLC acceleration.
• Production experience with Istio service mesh, including traffic management, mTLS, Envoy proxy configuration, and Istio-based observability and security policies.
• Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages (TypeScript/Python experience with AWS CDK a strong plus).
• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, load balancing, and firewalls.
• Experience with secrets management solutions (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or External Secrets Operator).

• Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
• Docker and container security certifications or demonstrated expertise in securing containerized applications.
• Demonstrated experience using AI tools to drive measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability, or cost efficiency.
• Contributions to open-source projects or internal developer platforms.
• Experience in a high-growth startup or large-scale production environment.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

title: Staff Backend Engineer (FDE)
job_description:
Engineering, Platform
Full-time
About Meeru AI
Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems, including ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, and HRIS, and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.
We deploy on customer terms: SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises, across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.
The Role
The Staff Backend Engineer owns the application and API services layer: the services through which everything the platform computes actually reaches a person.
Multi-tenant APIs, authentication and authorization, and the review and approval workflows where a controller accepts a result, challenges it, or sends it back. The computation layer produces the numbers. This layer is where a finance team sees them, interrogates them, approves them, and acts on them.
That means your services carry the same correctness and auditability requirements as the computation beneath them, plus the access control and tenancy guarantees that let a Fortune 500 finance organization trust the platform with their close cycle.
Every action taken through your services is part of an audit trail that sits next to externally reported financials. Who approved what, when, on the basis of which underlying result, and what changed afterward. That is not logging you add later. It is a product requirement, and it shapes how the services are designed from the first commit.
This is hands-on and high-ownership. You own major services end to end, set backend patterns alongside the Senior Staff engineers, and partner with data, AI, and product on the contracts between layers.
Key Responsibilities
1. Own the multi-tenant APIs through which the platform's results are consumed. Design the service contracts between the application layer and the computation, data, and AI layers, and own the versioning discipline that lets those contracts evolve without breaking consumers who cannot all move at once.
2. Build the review, approval, and exception-handling workflows finance teams operate in. This is where the product either earns trust or loses it. A controller who cannot see why a number is what it is will not approve it, and will not use the platform twice.
3. Build and maintain multi-tenant isolation at the service layer. Own authentication, authorization, and role-based access across the application surface. Cross-tenant leakage should be impossible by construction rather than prevented by convention.
4. Build the audit trail. Who saw what, who approved what, on the basis of which result. Guarantee that every user-facing figure links back to its computation and its source, and support the enterprise security and compliance reviews Fortune 500 finance customers run before they buy.
5. Build for a multi-cloud-ready, multi-tenant-ready, customer-hosted deployment model. Services that run inside a customer's environment with strong isolation and no data egress.
6. Own performance, reliability, and cost of the services you build, including observability and operational health. You should be able to answer why a request is slow rather than guessing.
7. Set backend patterns, review designs, and mentor mid and senior engineers. Partner with data, AI, and product on cross-layer service design.
A note on accountability: this role owns the application and API services, tenancy and access control, and the audit trail. It does not own the core computation layer, the data foundation, the AI layer, or product prioritization.
Seven or more years in backend forward deployment engineering, with significant Staff-level time owning complex production services. Owning them, including what happens when they fail.
Demonstrated ownership of services in a multi-cloud SaaS environment, and a clear account of how you guaranteed isolation rather than assumed it.
An obsession with correctness and traceability. You treat "who did what, when, and on what basis" as a first-class requirement rather than an audit checkbox.
Strong API and service design, including versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. You have evolved an interface other teams depended on without breaking them.
Practical security engineering: authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. Not theory.
Python
FastAPI, Django, or Flask; PostgreSQL and Redis; 
REST API design; Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
SQL against Snowflake or PostgreSQL.
Nice to Have
Finance, accounting, or fintech domain, or a genuine willingness to learn how financial statements are built and reconciled.
Multi-tenant, customer-hosted deployment at scale.
Supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 review.
Building auditable systems in a regulated environment.
Exposure to ML or LLM application patterns, enough to integrate them well.
Health and wellbeing. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with MeeruAI covering 50 % of employee premiums 
Flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts with a company contribution
Unlimited PTO and 12 paid holidays.
401(k) with company matching Backend engineering API design Python FastAPI Django Flask PostgreSQL Redis Docker Kubernetes Terraform SQL Snowflake Security engineering Authentication Authorization Candidates must have seven or more years of experience in backend engineering with a focus on complex production services and multi-tenant SaaS environments. Strong expertise in Python, API design, security engineering, and cloud infrastructure is required, along with a commitment to data traceability and auditability.
