title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
job_description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE 

About OnVUE 

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the
secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s
certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates
to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification,
monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE
environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform
modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery,
candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational
practices. 

Role summary 

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter
expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution
work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and
technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable
architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through
implementation. 

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced
solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and
resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of
knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer
architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior
architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain,
ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that
materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts. 

Key responsibilities 

Solution architecture and technical leadership 

 * Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements
   into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs. 

 * Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation
   and production adoption. 

 * Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features,
   product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities. 

 * Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project,
   domain, or broader solution footprint. 

 * Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security,
   resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs,
   and business value. 

Implementation and delivery guidance 

 * Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving
   architectural intent. 

 * Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the
   assigned scope. 

 * Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations,
   and solution approaches. 

 * Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical
   mitigation. 

 * Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution
   stability, security, or long-term maintainability. 

Standards, influence, and capability building 

 * Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned
   domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks,
   standards, and guidelines. 

 * Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound,
   practical outcomes. 

 * Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical
   practices, and architectural decision-making. 

 * Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs
   clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 * Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical
   or enterprise direction. 

Required education and experience 

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or
   equivalent practical experience. 

 * Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a
   related technical discipline. 

 * Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding
   delivery from inception through implementation. 

 * Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure,
   scalable, maintainable architecture. 

 * Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal
   authority. 

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities 

 * Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical
   problem-solving skills. 

 * Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business
   value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health. 

 * Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native
   design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers,
   orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and
   operational readiness. 

 * Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns,
   versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend
   systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture
   patterns. 

 * Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills. 

 * Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical
   approaches. 

Success measures 

 * Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure,
   scalable, stable implementation. 

 * Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain
   durable in production. 

 * Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and
   reduce preventable technical risk. 

 * Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and
   resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery. 

 * Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles. 

 * Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve
   team effectiveness. 

 * Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and
   tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery. 

Leadership behaviors 

 * Customer Centricity — Tailors architecture decisions to real operational and
   business needs and responds quickly when issues threaten outcomes. 

 * Raise the Performance Bar — Applies advanced design techniques, strengthens
   technical practices, and shares approaches that improve solution quality. 

 * Exceptional Collaboration for Value — Guides technical discussions,
   incorporates different perspectives, and supports alignment and integration
   across the assigned scope. 

 * Our Leaders Inspire — Models technical curiosity, sound judgment, visible
   accountability, and a commitment to developing others. 

 

Location & Working Pattern 

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact
hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process. 

 

Why Join Pearson? 

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and
quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working
across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale. 

 

  Solution architecture System design Technical leadership Java Cloud-native design API-first integration Microservices Event-driven architecture CI/CD Observability Security Data consistency Mentoring Stakeholder management Scalability Resilience Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and possess progressive experience in software engineering or solution architecture. Strong expertise in designing sophisticated, scalable systems and the ability to influence technical outcomes without formal authority are required.

title: Software Engineering, Team Manager
job_description:
Job Title - Software Engineering, Team Manager 

 

Description - Lead engineering teams that support critical assessment services,
with two opportunities across Vue Testing Services and Test Delivery in India.
You will combine people leadership, delivery oversight, technical judgement and
responsible AI adoption to strengthen team performance and customer outcomes.
Also known in the market as: Engineering Manager; Software Development Manager;
Technology Manager; Software Engineering People Manager. 

 

About the Role 

Pearson is hiring two Software Engineering Team Managers in India through one
recruitment campaign. The roles share a common leadership profile but support
different product areas: Vue Testing Services (VTS) and Test Delivery. 

VTS supports services around a candidate’s assessment journey, including
registration, payment and score reporting. Test Delivery powers the delivery of
assessments in test centres and online, in a high-volume environment where
quality, reliability and operational readiness matter. 

In either opportunity, you will lead through clarity, coaching, accountability
and partnership. You will translate priorities into achievable plans, strengthen
engineering and delivery practices, develop people, manage risk and help teams
adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is a management role with
minimal hands-on coding expected. 

 

What You’ll Do 

 * Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain engineers and technical
   professionals. 

 * Set clear goals, feedback rhythms, development plans and team operating
   practices. 

 * Translate product and department priorities into achievable team plans,
   capacity choices and ownership. 

 * Track sprint and release progress, dependencies, blockers, defects, quality
   and immediate delivery risks. 

 * Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Security,
   Operations and business stakeholders. 

 * Maintain strong standards for design, testing, automation, security,
   observability, documentation and operational readiness. 

 * Use engineering, delivery, quality and team signals to identify patterns and
   drive improvement. 

 * Guide deliberate adoption of AI-assisted development, testing, review and
   documentation while protecting quality and security. 

 

What We’re Looking For 

 * A hands-on technical foundation in software engineering, quality engineering,
   architecture, technology solutions or a closely related discipline. 

 * Demonstrated experience leading, coaching or managing technical professionals
   and building effective teams. 

 * Experience delivering software products, platforms or technology services in
   Agile or similarly iterative environments. 

 * Evidence of leading meaningful change, making sound decisions and improving
   delivery or team effectiveness. 

 * Working knowledge of modern software delivery, cloud, DevOps, CI/CD,
   automation, security, reliability, observability and operational readiness. 

 * Experience making people, capacity, priority and delivery decisions in a
   cross-functional environment. 

 * Experience working across distributed teams, functions or time zones. 

 * Practical experience using or introducing AI-assisted engineering tools, with
   sound judgement about quality and risk. 

 * Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving and
   stakeholder-influence skills. 

 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems,
   Business, or equivalent practical experience. 

 

The Opportunities 

VTS Lead teams supporting services around the assessment journey, including
registration, payment and score reporting. Product and service-platform
leadership experience may be particularly useful. 

 

TEST DELIVERY Lead teams supporting the delivery of assessments in test centres
and online. Experience with high-volume, operationally critical or
reliability-focused platforms may be particularly useful. 

 

Location & Working Pattern 

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact
hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process. 

 

Why Join Pearson? 

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and
quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working
across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale.

title: Data Client Support Analyst
job_description:
Who We Are
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role
As part of the broader Addepar Data Management & Quality organization, the Data Client Support team is responsible for ensuring our customers receive first-class support experience and are able get the most value out of their data in Addepar. The Data Client Support team sits at the nexus of Addepar's activity and requires daily communications with clients, data providers, and other personnel across the company.
Important: The working schedule for this position is from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST, US business days.
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
What You’ll Do
Address client inquiries related to Addepar’s portfolio data feeds and on general data product functionalities within established SLAs.
Manage and complete requests from internal Data teams that require client outreach and/or action to resolve data verification issues.
Investigate client reported bugs and data processing issues, and triage with Engineering & Product when needed.
Partner with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and other members of GTM to drive alignment on data related escalations and ensure positive outcomes for clients.
Participate in multi-org projects to improve internal processes and in broad company initiatives to stand up new product functionality or services.
Who You Are
3+ years of work experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with solid understanding of capital markets, portfolio accounting and customer relationship management.
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with excellent attention to detail.
Track record of demonstrating self-motivation to take on responsibility, a strong team-player mentality, and passion for delivering client-centric outcomes.
Proactive and diligent in documenting team processes and finding opportunities to team optimize workflow efficiencies
Willing to work flexible hours.
Familiarity with using MS Suite, Salesforce, Atlassian, SQL, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, or other common financial services systems and applications is preferable.
Our Values 
Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 
In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com. Portfolio accounting Capital markets Customer relationship management Data analysis SQL Salesforce Atlassian Bloomberg Thomson Reuters Communication Problem solving Data verification Client support Workflow optimization Candidates must have at least 3 years of experience in the financial investment or advisory industry with a strong understanding of capital markets and portfolio accounting. Proficiency in financial systems and excellent communication skills are required, along with the ability to work a specific night shift schedule.

title: Payroll Specialist
job_description:
Overview
SSOE provides unparalleled opportunities for professional growth, offering the advantages typical of a large firm combined with the collaborative and supportive culture commonly associated with smaller organizations. We prioritize an employee-centric atmosphere that fosters a healthy work-life balance, exceptional benefits, and a commitment to continuous learning.
When you work at SSOE, you work with the best and you're a part of something bigger than yourself. Our commitment to providing the best possible workplace for our employees gives us a competitive advantage—helping us attract and retain top talent and drive better business results.
We are particularly seeking individuals with strong in-house payroll experience for a 12 months contractual role. As a key member of our team, you will independently manage and execute in-house end to end payroll processing and administration. Your expertise in maintaining accurate payroll records, ensuring compliance with payroll regulations, and addressing payroll-related inquiries will be crucial in supporting our financial operations and contributing to our overall success.
AI and Innovation
As part of our commitment to innovation, all team members will be trained on Microsoft Copilot and empowered to use it as a core tool in their everyday work.
Responsibilities
The following duties are typical of the position, but are not all encompassing. Responsibilities include those required to deliver quality service on schedule and within budget in a team environment.
Main responsibilities will include:
Independently manage and execute end to end in-house payroll processing and administration.
Prepares accurate payroll tax returns and other year-end reports.
Initiates and processes payroll tax deposits internally to ensure accurate and timely compliance.
Gathers and prepares payroll data and creates payroll reports using KEKA software.
Maintains Employee Profiles in prevailing accounting payroll software.
Balances, controls and processes earnings and voluntary/involuntary deductions; Corrects out of balance conditions.
Ensure accuracy and compliance with local, state, and federal regulations governing payroll and employee benefits.
Prepares and/or assists with daily Time Balancing process.
Coordinate with internal HR and Finance teams to collect and verify payroll data (hours worked, salaries, bonuses, deductions, etc.).
Initiates creative solutions for continuous improvement.
Responsible for communicating with employees regarding payroll-related inquiries and issues.
Assists with various non-payroll duties accounting activity as necessary and assigned (A/P, A/R, etc.), including daily cash receipts, bank reconciliation, and client billings.
Works independently with little supervision. Coordinates all payroll related needs to Controller.
Handles highly proprietary information in confidential manner.
May be required to work overtime to meet accounting closing schedules.
Work timings:
This position will follow a split-shift schedule as outlined below:
Monday & Tuesday (Work from Office): 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
Wednesday to Friday (Remote): 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 4:30 PM to 8:30 PM.
Qualifications
What You Will Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant field (Bcom / BAF).
5 to 8 years of experience executing payroll with a strong focus on independently managing in-house payroll processes.
Familiarity with KEKA software is desirable.
In-depth understanding of local and government payroll regulations and accounting rules.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in processing payroll and financial transactions.
Proven experience with office software including Excel and cloud-based payroll software is required.
Fluency in English communication.
The candidate should be comfortable working the specified split-shift schedule.
Additional Perks Offered:
A collaborative and supportive culture where you’re not just a number—you’re a critical and highly valued member of our team!
Hybrid work module.
As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will experience exciting projects from start to finish and interface directly with some of the most forward-thinking clients in the world.
A mindset of continuous learning where you are encouraged to ask questions, bring fresh ideas to the table, and pursue your professional development goals.
A diversity of market sectors, project types, and geographic locations that help insulate your career from economic ups and downs.
A formal career path and real opportunities for advancement.
A holistic approach to compensation and benefits that supports your physical and mental health, encourages work-life balance, and empowers your career advancement and financial success. Payroll processing Payroll administration Payroll tax returns Payroll tax deposits Keka software Accounting Financial reporting Compliance Time balancing Bank reconciliation Accounts payable Accounts receivable Microsoft Copilot Data analysis Excel Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance and possess 5 to 8 years of experience in in-house payroll management. Proficiency in payroll software, strong knowledge of local tax regulations, and the ability to work a specific split-shift schedule are required.

job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
As the Principal AI/ML Engineer for GTS , you will drive the architectural design, hands-on development, and production delivery of scalable, resilient, and secure software solutions that integrate AI/ML capabilities into healthcare applications and workflows. Combining deep software engineering expertise with applied AI/ML engineering, you will build cloud-native services, reusable components, and robust APIs that embed intelligent capabilities into enterprise applications. You will develop and integrate machine learning models, generative AI solutions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents that support workflow automation and decision-making. Using AI-powered development tools and cloud AI services, you will accelerate engineering delivery and establish automated pipelines for model evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with responsible AI practices. In this principal technical role, you will guide engineering decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and advance software modernization and engineering excellence turning promising AI/ML use cases into reliable, maintainable production solutions that deliver measurable
Primary Responsibilities:
Translate business needs into measurable ML tasks. Validate data, establish simple baselines, and integrate suitable models. Demonstrate whether AI improves outcomes over simpler approaches
Integrate generative AI and large language models (LLMs) where they add value. Use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which supplies relevant source content to a model, when appropriate. Evaluate accuracy, unsupported claims, latency, and cost
Build model-serving interfaces and machine learning operations (MLOps) workflows for versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback
Track changes in data and model performance, then improve models, prompts, or product design
Apply responsible AI practices through documented evaluations, bias and robustness checks, privacy safeguards, and human review where needed. Address prompt injection and sensitive-data leakage, define safe fallback behavior, and explain model limitations
Design and build distributed services, application programming interfaces (APIs), and reliable data integrations. Make clear trade-offs across scalability, performance, cost, and maintainability
Write and review production code, automate unit and integration tests, and build continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for safe, repeatable cloud releases
Build security and privacy into software design through access controls, secrets management, and safe data handling. Identify technical risks before release and address them with product and security partners
Own production readiness and service health through logs, metrics, and traces. Troubleshoot incidents, remove recurring failure points, and improve reliability and response times
Lead cross-team architecture decisions and deliver reusable components. Document trade-offs, mentor engineers, and break complex requirements into manageable releases that meet agreed product and quality goals
Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements


Required Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
15+ years of relevant engineering experience, including 8+ years of hands-on software engineering and 3+ years delivering AI/ML capabilities in production
Experience taking ML or generative AI capabilities from evaluation to production, including model integration, deployment, monitoring, and measurable quality assessment
Solid coding skills in at least one production backend language, with working proficiency in Python for AI/ML development
Demonstrated delivery of distributed systems, APIs, data integrations, automated tests, and cloud deployments, including practical security and operational ownership
Ability to explain technical decisions clearly, influence architecture across teams, and mentor engineers while continuing to contribute production code
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience building healthcare applications or working with other regulated or sensitive data
Experience delivering shared services or platforms used by multiple engineering teams

title: Daily Substitute Teacher
job_description:
About the Team
ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified Daily Substitute Teacher at Parma Academy School in Parma, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.
Be part of the difference at Parma Academy! Founded in 2019, Parma Academy is a premier early learning school for EK-3rd grade students. The award-winning public charter school ranks in the top 12% of Ohio charter schools and features a safe and secure campus, small class sizes, and technology in the classroom. Nurturing teachers and staff support a hands-on, project-based approach to college prep education. Parma Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.
About the Opportunity:
Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-
Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year
Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students
Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development
Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction
Manage student behavior in the classroom
Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in
Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students
Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms
Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child
Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning
Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed
Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues
Perform other duties as assigned
About You:
Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area
Bachelor’s degree in education or related field
High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to properly manage confidential information
Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)
Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks 
Experience working within an urban environment
About Us
“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder
ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.
We offer the following benefits:
Compensation 
This position is paid at a daily rate of $130 per day. Factors which may affect starting pay may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
Career benefits – keep growing
Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job_description:
Job Title - Senior Quality Assurance Engineer – ExamDeveloper 

Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual
contributor recognized as a technical authority for quality within your area.
You lead quality engineering strategy and execution for one or more product
squads, combining hands-on testing and automation with release-quality
accountability and technical guidance for other quality engineers.

You design advanced test strategies that anticipate complex system interactions,
integration risks, and failure modes, and you establish an automation-first
approach with complete, visible coverage. You are frequently consulted on the
most challenging defects, complex integrations, performance and reliability
concerns, and critical release decisions. You lead through expertise rather than
formal authority — mentoring quality engineers, improving practices, and helping
teams make sound quality and release decisions. You partner closely with Product
Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Dev Leads, DevOps, security,
accessibility, and vendor teams to protect candidate experience, delivery
reliability, and product quality.

The Product

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows customers to
write, review, and manage questions on their exams. Customers rely on
ExamDeveloper to support the full workflow around item writing, collaborative
review, scoring, and test management for certification and professional
assessment programs.

ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify
test-takers in the professional skills they require. The Senior Quality
Assurance Engineer plays a critical role in protecting workflow accuracy,
automation reliability, delivery confidence, and product quality as the platform
continues to support complex exam-development workflows.

Key responsibilities

Quality strategy and test design

 * Lead test strategy and coverage planning for assigned squad initiatives,
   releases, and platform changes.

 * Design advanced test approaches spanning functional, regression, integration,
   negative, accessibility, and API coverage.

 * Define quality gates and test readiness criteria for stories, defects,
   releases, and production-impacting changes.

 * Ensure stories and defects include clear testing evidence, including test
   cases executed, edge cases considered, environment details, data notes, and
   traceability where appropriate.

 * Use metrics, defect trends, and production signals to continuously improve
   the test strategy.

Hands-on testing and automation

 * Contribute directly to hands-on testing for high-risk, complex, cross-team,
   or automation-critical work.

 * Create, improve, and review automated tests across UI, API, integration, and
   regression coverage.

 * Review regression results, identify failure patterns, and drive resolution of
   flaky, missing, or outdated tests.

 * Use manual, exploratory, accessibility, usability, or complex workflow
   testing when automation is not practical or sufficient.

 * Promote automation-first practices and ensure tests are reliably incorporated
   into regression suites.

Quality ownership and collaboration

 * Lead defect triage, retesting, and resolution follow-through, and escalate
   major quality concerns early.

 * Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, environment details, test data,
   supporting evidence, and business or user impact where possible.

 * Serve as the technical authority on quality within your domain and inform
   critical release decisions.

 * Mentor and coach quality engineers in automation, test design, accessibility,
   and release validation.

 * Provide quality perspective during backlog refinement, design reviews,
   technical planning, and release readiness.

 * Surface QE capacity, coverage, or dependency risks early when testing scope
   may affect sprint or release timelines.

Required education and experience

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or
   equivalent practical experience.

 * 5+ years of professional quality engineering, software testing, or test
   automation experience.

 * Demonstrated experience leading quality for complex, distributed,
   cloud-based, or customer-facing platforms.

 * Strong experience with test strategy, test design, defect management,
   regression planning, and release validation.

 * Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship within Agile
   engineering squads.

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

 * Experience with Gauge-style BDD automation, Selenium/WebDriver, C# step
   implementations, and sustainable web application test automation.

 * Experience maintaining automated test suites that run on virtual machines,
   with awareness of potential cloud-based testing infrastructure.

 * Experience with relational databases, test data validation, defect
   investigation, and evidence-based quality review.

 * Experience with SQL, log analysis, telemetry, dashboards, and production
   issue investigation.

 * Demonstrated technical leadership in Agile quality engineering, including
   test planning, automation review, and continuous improvement.

 * Willingness and ability to incorporate artificial intelligence technologies
   into QA responsibly, including validation of AI-assisted outputs.

 * Experience working with offshore teams, vendors, and globally distributed
   delivery models.

Success measures

 * Quality strategy and test design are visible, current, and used by the squad.

 * Stories and defects close with clear, reviewable evidence of testing and
   coverage.

 * Regression coverage and automation reliability improve; missed scenarios
   trend down.

 * Achieves near-zero critical defect leakage post-release for owned areas.

 * Quality risks are surfaced early and resolved through clear ownership and
   follow-through.

 * Improves the capability of the broader quality team through mentorship.

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity  Ensures advanced and edge-case scenarios are considered so
user-impacting failures are prevented before release.

Raise the Performance Bar  Pilots new methodologies, strengthens test
architecture and automation, and sets a high standard for quality rigor.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value  Mentors peers, contributes strong input
during reviews, and aligns quality priorities across product and engineering.

 Our Leaders Inspire  Provides informal leadership during complex releases,
steps up during    peak workloads, and models expert problem-solving. Test Strategy Test Automation Quality Assurance API Testing Regression Testing Agile Methodologies SQL C# Selenium WebDriver Defect Management Cloud-based Testing Accessibility Testing Technical Leadership Mentorship Telemetry Requires a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems with at least 5 years of professional quality engineering experience. Candidates must demonstrate expertise in test strategy, automation, and leading quality initiatives within complex, distributed, or cloud-based platforms.

title: Senior Analyst - Underwriting Support
job_description:
Introduction

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

Overview

The role supports the efficient, accurate and controlled operation of Pen's Smart Follow & Facility Underwriting division, an in-house, rules-based Smart Follow facility, to include the overseeing the administration of business from submission intake through to binding, endorsements and reporting.
Responsibilities include data validation, workflow management, maintenance of the system of record, and the production of bordereaux and management information to support operational, underwriting and regulatory requirements.
The target operating model is expected to combine London-based broker and underwriting activity with operational processing, record maintenance and reporting delivered through the GCoE. As the facility evolves, the role will play a key part in embedding processes, controls and reporting capabilities.

How you'll make an impact

Responsibilities:
Submission intake and validation
Review incoming submissions and proposal data for completeness, consistency and accuracy (in manual workaround, months 0-6) Record incoming submissions in a clear and structured format
Manage sanctions checking if appropriate
Check each submission against defined facility requirements and identify missing or conflicting
information
Route cases to the appropriate workflow, including straight-through quoting, referral or decline
Communicate data or documentation requirements to London colleagues promptly
System and workflow administration
Maintain accurate records for enquiries, quotes, referrals, endorsements, bound premium and status changes
Update the facility system of record and supporting trackers in line with agreed procedures and service standards
Monitor work queues, ageing items and outstanding actions, escalating exceptions when required
Maintain complete documentation and a clear audit trail for each transaction
Bordereaux and reporting
Produce and validate premium, risk and claims bordereaux in the required (high likelihood) Lloyd'sformat and timetable
Support facility reporting to capacity providers, Gallagher Specialty and other internal stakeholders
Reconcile source data to bound records and investigate data-quality exceptions
Provide data for utilisation, conversion, referral, endorsement and service-level reporting
Quality and controls
Complete data-quality checks and prescribed operational controls
Support underwriting file reviews, internal audits, Coverholder oversight and remediation activity
Follow documented procedures, authorities and escalation routes
Identify recurring data or process issues and raise improvement opportunities
Team and stakeholder support
Work closely with London Underwriters and the Smart Follow & Facility Underwriting Lead
Respond to operational queries clearly and maintain effective hand-offs between teams
Contribute to knowledge materials, standard operating procedures and team training

About you

Qualifications:
Essential
Strong experience and understanding of Lloyd's underwriting procedures, systems etc
Strong attention to detail and confidence working with structured data
Experience in insurance operations, underwriting support, policy administration or a comparable controlled processing environment
Ability to follow rules, procedures, service levels and escalation requirements consistently
Good Excel capability and experience maintaining operational records or reports
Clear written communication and ability to collaborate across locations

Desirable
Experience within a GCoE, shared services or offshore insurance operation
Knowledge MGA, delegated authority or Coverholder business
Experience producing or validating bordereaux
Exposure to underwriting, policy administration or workflow systems

Core Competencies
Accuracy and data discipline
Operational control
Planning and prioritization
Problem identification and escalation
Team collaboration
Service orientation
Continuous improvement

Additional Information

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.
Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being 
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning 
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership 
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact 
At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking
job_description:
Company Description
About Mirantis
Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/
Job Description
About the role
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.
You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.
As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.
This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.
Key Responsibilities
Reference architecture
Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.
Host and platform networking
Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.
Research and exploration
Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.
Code and proofs of concept
Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib_write_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.
Customers, partners and community
Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.
Qualifications
Education and experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.
Required technical skills
Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.
Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.
Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.
Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.
Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.
How you work
We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.
Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.
Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.
Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.
Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.
Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.
Communication and collaboration
Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.
Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.
Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.
Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.
Nice to have
Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.
Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.
Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.
Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.
Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).
Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).
Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.
Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.
Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.
Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.
Location, travel and working model
This role is remote, open to candidates based in he United States (East Coast).
You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.
Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.
Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.
Additional Information
Why you’ll love Mirantis
Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to [email protected]
By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

title: Grocery Clerk (Part-Time) - Timberlands Food Store - Central Alberta Co-op
job_description:
Join Our Team at Timberlands Food Store!

Are you enthusiastic about delivering outstanding customer service? Do you excel
in fast-paced environment? Our Timberlands Food Store, in Red Deer is offering
an excellent opportunity for you! We’re currently looking for a casual Grocery
Clerk to join our dynamic team. 

We are participating in the Alberta Youth Incentive Program which supports
hiring youth from the ages 15-24.

Position: Grocery Clerk

Part-time: 24 - 36 hours per week. Beneﬁt eligible after 3 months. If you are
coming from out of province, please remember you need to have AB Health coverage
to be covered by our plan provider.

Availability: Weekdays and weekends - mornings, afternoons, and evenings

Responsibilities:

 * Provide exceptional customer service

 * Address customer requests in an efficient and friendly manner

 * Unload grocery shipments

 * Receive, organize, and display merchandise

 * Be alert for unauthorized merchandise removal 

 * Maintain a clean and safe work environment

 * Perform additional duties as assigned by the manager

Qualifications:

 * Excellent communication skills

 * Exceptional attention to detail and quality

 * Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

 * Team player with the ability to work independently

 * Ability to lift up to 50 lbs; some heavy lifting is required

 * Applicants must be over 14 years old. (Employment Standards mandates a
   permit to employ a person aged 14 or under, thus disclosure is required)

Total Rewards:

At Central Alberta Co-op, we value our team members and are committed to their
well-being and success. As part of our dedication to providing a supportive
working environment, we offer a range of Total Rewards:

 * Loyalty Discount Program: Enjoy discounts on merchandise as a token of
   appreciation for your dedication.

 * Employee and Family Assistance Program: Access confidential counseling,
   resources, and support services for you and your family.

 * Team Member Volunteer Program: Get involved in community initiatives and make
   a positive impact through volunteer opportunities.

 * Long Term Service Awards: Recognize and celebrate milestones in your career
   with us.

 * Leadership Development Program: Take advantage of growth opportunities and
   advance your career within our organization. Select the link for more
   information: 

https://www.centralalbertaco-op.crs/sites/centralalberta/local/detail/leadership-development-program
[https://www.centralalbertaco-op.crs/sites/centralalberta/local/detail/leadership-development-program] 

Central Alberta Co-op is proud to uphold our Brand Values of Integrity,
Responsibility, and Community. We offer competitive salaries, opportunities for
advancement and personal growth, and benefits based on employment status. As a
COR certified organization, we are dedicated to providing our team members and
customers with a safe working and shopping environment.

How to Apply:

If you're ready to join our team and deliver exceptional service to our
customers, please submit your resume online, along with three references and a
cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and availability.

Application Deadline:

This posting will remain open until filled.

Important Note:

Successful candidates must provide their Social Insurance Number before their
first shift.

We appreciate your interest in joining our team. However, only applicants
selected for an interview will be contacted.

 


Central Alberta Co-op is here to serve our members and customers with products
and services that help build, feed, and fuel individuals and communities. We are
a different kind of business, being member-owned means that any profits are
returned to our members and stay in the local economy. We live where you live,
work where you work, and help grow the economy right here.


At Central Alberta Co-op, our Leadership Development Program
[https://www.centralalbertaco-op.crs/sites/centralalberta/local/detail/leadership-development-program] supports
team members - whether new to the organization or growing within it - in
building the skills, confidence, and experience needed for leadership roles. The
program aligns with our values and culture, helping you grow, take on new
challenges, and advance your career at Central Alberta Co-op.

 Customer service Communication skills Attention to detail Teamwork Inventory management Heavy lifting Time management Organization Applicants must possess excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Candidates must be at least 14 years old and capable of lifting up to 50 lbs.

title: Service Head
job_description:
Role- Service Head
Department: Service / Operations
Reporting To: Managing Director / Business Head
Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (with pan-India travel as required)
Experience
10–15+ years in electronic security / ELV / service operations; leadership experience preferred
1. Role Purpose
The Service Head will own Zinq Electronics’ end-to-end service delivery function across India, ensuring timely resolution of customer complaints, strong AMC execution, preventive maintenance, effective field-force utilisation, technical quality, customer satisfaction and profitable service operations. The role will be accountable for building a disciplined, technology-driven service organisation with clear SLAs, escalation mechanisms, dashboards and measurable team performance.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Service Operations & SLA Management
· Own the complete lifecycle of service complaints—from ticket creation, allocation and diagnosis to resolution, closure and customer confirmation.
· Ensure agreed response and resolution SLAs are consistently achieved, with a target of 48-hour complaint closure wherever contractually applicable.
· Establish daily monitoring of open, ageing, repeat and escalated complaints.
· Create a structured escalation matrix for critical customers, high-value sites and SLA breaches.
· Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to reduce turnaround time and repeat complaints.
· Ensure proper service documentation, closure reports, visit reports and customer sign-offs.
B. AMC & Preventive Maintenance
· Own execution of all AMC contracts and ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.
· Plan and monitor preventive maintenance schedules across customer sites.
· Track AMC renewals, pending visits, service commitments and site-level compliance.
· Coordinate with Sales/Commercial teams for AMC renewal opportunities, scope changes and service-related commercial issues.
· Ensure AMC profitability through effective manpower, travel, spares and subcontractor management.
· Develop customer-wise service performance reports and renewal risk indicators.
C. Team Leadership & Field Force Management
· Lead, mentor and manage service managers, engineers, technicians, coordinators and regional service teams.
· Define KRAs, KPIs and individual performance targets for all service personnel.
· Ensure optimum technician allocation based on geography, skill, workload and customer priority.
· Monitor attendance, productivity, first-time-fix rate, repeat visits and field utilisation.
· Build technical capability through structured training, certification and knowledge-sharing programs.
· Take ownership of recruitment requirements, onboarding and performance management within the service function.
D. Customer Management & Escalations
· Act as the senior escalation point for key customers and strategically important accounts.
· Conduct periodic service review meetings with major customers and present performance dashboards.
· Build strong relationships with facility, security, operations, procurement and technical stakeholders.
· Proactively identify dissatisfied customers, recurring issues and renewal risks.
· Drive customer satisfaction, retention and service quality across the organisation.
· Ensure customer complaints are handled professionally, with clear communication and ownership until closure.
E. Technical & Quality Control
· Maintain high technical standards across CCTV, access control, fire alarm, intrusion detection and related ELV/security systems.
· Ensure engineers follow OEM specifications, installation/service standards and safety procedures.
· Analyse recurring technical failures and drive root-cause analysis and permanent corrective action.
· Coordinate with OEMs, distributors and technical partners for complex issues, warranties and escalations.
· Standardise troubleshooting processes, checklists and service SOPs.
F. CRM, MIS & Process Discipline
· Ensure 100% service tickets, activities, engineer visits and closures are recorded in Edify CRM or the designated service platform.
· Own service dashboards covering open complaints, ageing, SLA compliance, repeat complaints, productivity, AMC visits and customer escalations.
· Conduct daily/weekly/monthly service reviews and publish actionable MIS.
· Use data and analytics to identify trends, capacity gaps and improvement opportunities.
· Drive process automation and eliminate manual follow-up wherever practical.
G. Spares, Vendor & Cost Management
· Ensure availability and controlled utilisation of critical service spares.
· Coordinate with procurement/stores for timely material availability and replacement requirements.
· Monitor warranty claims, RMA processes and material returns.
· Manage service vendors/subcontractors and evaluate them on quality, turnaround time and cost.
· Control service operating costs while maintaining agreed customer service levels.
3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
SLA Compliance- ≥ 95% or as defined by customer contract
Complaint Closure- Majority of standard complaints closed within committed SLA
Open Complaint Ageing- Continuous reduction; no unexplained critical ageing
First-Time Fix Rate- Progressive improvement; target defined by service category
Repeat Complaints- Continuous reduction through RCA and preventive action
AMC PM Compliance ≥ 95% on-time completion
Customer Escalations - Reduction month-on-month
Customer Satisfaction- Improving CSAT / retention / renewal performance
CRM Discipline- 100% ticket and visit documentation
Team Productivity- Measured through utilization, closures and field efficiency
4. Required Qualifications & Experience
· Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Engineering, IT or a related technical discipline.
· 10–15+ years of relevant experience in electronic security, ELV, systems integration, facility technology or technical service operations.
· At least 5 years of experience managing service teams and field operations.
· Strong understanding of CCTV, access control, fire alarm, intrusion detection, networking and related security systems.
· Experience managing multi-location / pan-India service operations is strongly preferred.
· Experience with AMC businesses, SLA-driven contracts and enterprise customers is preferred.
· Strong working knowledge of CRM/service management systems and MIS reporting.
5. Key Competencies
· Leadership and people management
· Customer-centric mindset
· Strong technical and troubleshooting orientation
· SLA and process discipline
· Problem-solving and root-cause analysis
· Planning and resource optimisation
· Vendor and OEM management
· Data-driven decision making
· Excellent communication and escalation management
· Ownership, accountability and execution focus
6. Authority & Decision-Making
· Allocate service resources based on priority, skill and customer commitments.
· Escalate manpower, inventory, vendor and technical requirements to management with clear business justification.
· Recommend recruitment, training, performance actions and organizational changes within the service team.
· Approve service priorities and corrective actions within the authority delegated by management.
· Recommend process, technology and service-contract improvements to improve customer experience and profitability.
7. Ideal Candidate Profile
A hands-on service leader who can build a high-accountability service culture, manage large field teams, handle demanding enterprise customers, understand the technical realities of electronic security systems, and use data to improve SLA performance, customer retention and service profitability. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented organisation and should take end-to-end ownership rather than functioning only as an escalation manager.
8. Success in the First 90 Days
· Complete a diagnostic review of the current service organisation, customers, SLAs, manpower and processes.
· Establish daily service dashboards and a clear complaint-ageing/escalation mechanism.
· Identify the top recurring complaint categories and implement corrective action plans.
· Review technician productivity, territory allocation and skill gaps.
· Bring AMC preventive-maintenance schedules under disciplined tracking.
· Create a monthly service review format covering SLA, ageing, repeat complaints, AMC compliance, manpower and customer escalations.
· Present a 90-day service improvement roadmap to management.

Job Highlights
To ensure the availability, security, performance, and efficient operation of LANXESS’s on-premises and Azure server infrastructure. The role will be responsible for administering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise Windows Server and Microsoft Azure environments, ensuring reliable IT services and operational excellence.
Key requirement Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server, Microsoft Azure, and ManageEngine OpManager for infrastructure monitoring. Linux administration experience is an added advantage.

Provision and configure cloud servers according to organizational requirements and best practices.

Generate regular reports on server performance, security posture, and compliance status. 
Global PRTG & OPManager Administration and Support

title: Supply Chain Senior Analyst
job_description:
* Analyze supply chain and business data to identify trends, insights, and
   improvement opportunities.
 * Collect, validate, consolidate, and maintain data from multiple sources to
   support business reporting requirements.
 * Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and
   management presentations.
 * Perform data analysis to support supply chain operations, purchasing
   activities, and business decision-making.
 * Partner with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders to understand
   reporting requirements and deliver actionable insights.
 * Utilize Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions and macros, to perform
   data analysis and automate repetitive tasks.
 * Leverage analytics and automation tools such as Alteryx and similar platforms
   to improve process efficiency and data accuracy.
 * Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide recommendations for
   continuous improvement.
 * Support business reviews by preparing reports, presentations, and analytical
   summaries.
 * Troubleshoot data-related issues and ensure the quality and integrity of
   reporting outputs.
 * Maintain effective communication with stakeholders and provide timely
   responses to business requirements.
 * Demonstrate flexibility to work across different shift schedules based on
   business needs.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Understand business objectives and deliver analytical solutions aligned with
   operational and strategic goals.
 * Analyze supply chain, procurement, and operational data to support informed
   decision-making.
 * Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics for
   stakeholders.
 * Work closely with global teams and cross-functional teams to support business
   initiatives and reporting requirements.
 * Drive process improvements through automation and data-driven
   recommendations.
 * Support stakeholder engagement through effective communication,
   collaboration, and presentation of insights.
 * Coordinate with operations teams and business partners to ensure timely
   delivery of data and reporting requirements.
 * Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data used in business
   reporting.
 * Identify risks, trends, and opportunities through data analysis and provide
   actionable recommendations.
 * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity,
   quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.


QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Supply Chain Management,
   Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
 * Minimum 4 years of experience in data analysis, supply chain analytics,
   procurement analytics, or related business functions.
 * Strong knowledge of supply chain processes and business operations.
 * Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Macros, Pivot Tables,
   Lookup Functions, and Data Analysis techniques.
 * Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office
   applications.
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
 * Proven experience collaborating with global teams and cross-functional
   stakeholders.
 * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a
   fast-paced environment.
    

Preferred Qualifications
 * Knowledge or digital adaptability with Alteryx or similar analytics and
   automation tools.
 * Knowledge or digital adaptability with dashboarding and reporting platforms
   such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent visualization tools.
 * Knowledge of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain performance metrics.
 * Experience in process automation and continuous improvement initiatives. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong analytical skills are required, with preference given to those familiar with automation and visualization tools.

DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS

About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

Overview:
Join Xerox as an HR Analyst, People Operations, within our Global Business Services (GBS) team in India. In this role, you will coordinate employee onboarding activities, from pre-onboarding documentation through new-hire integration, ensuring a smooth and timely employee experience. You will also support employee data management, payroll coordination, HR service requests, documentation, reporting, and employee lifecycle activities while collaborating with Recruitment, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and other People Operations teams.

Why Join This Team:
 * Play a key role in delivering a positive and consistent onboarding experience for new employees
 * Collaborate with Recruitment, HR, Payroll, and business stakeholders across the organization

 * Generate employee letters, maintain confidential documentation, and coordinate payroll inputs and employee data discrepancies with Payroll teams
 * Manage HR service requests through ServiceNow or approved channels, ensuring timely resolution, accurate case documentation, and appropriate escalation
 * Prepare HR reports, maintain operational trackers, support audits, and identify opportunities to improve processes and data quality

What You Need to Succeed:
 * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related discipline
 * 2 to 5 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Onboarding, People Operations, or HR Shared Services
 * Practical experience managing onboarding documentation, employee records, HR transactions, or new-hire coordination
 * Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and task management skills with attention to detail and confidentiality
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office; experience with HRIS platforms, ServiceNow, or document management systems preferred

How We Set You Up for Success:
 * Opportunity to develop expertise in employee onboarding and end-to-end HR operations
 * Collaboration with Recruitment, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and People Operations teams
 * Exposure to HRIS platforms, HR service management tools, and employee document management systems
 * Opportunities to contribute to process improvements, reporting, and data quality initiatives
 * Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes within a Global Business Services environment
