title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Payroll
job_description:
DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS

About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

Overview:
Join Xerox as a Payroll Analyst within our Global Business Services (GBS) People Operations team in India. In this role, you will support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing while ensuring a positive employee experience. You will collaborate with HR Operations, Finance, Benefits, and external payroll providers to manage payroll transactions, maintain data integrity, resolve inquiries, and identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and service delivery.

Why Join This Team:
 * Contribute to essential payroll operations supporting employees across the organization
 * Collaborate with HR Operations, Finance, Benefits, and external payroll providers
 * Gain exposure to payroll systems, compliance requirements, and shared services operations
 * Support process improvements through automation, standardization, and operational efficiency initiatives
 * Develop expertise in payroll reporting, analytics, and employee lifecycle processes

What You Will Do:
 * Process and validate payroll transactions, including new hires, salary changes, promotions, transfers, allowances, deductions, bonuses, and other employee updates
 * Execute pre-payroll and post-payroll activities, including reconciliations, off-cycle payments, retroactive adjustments, reporting, and payroll validations
 * Ensure compliance with Indian statutory payroll regulations, tax requirements, company policies, internal controls, and audit standards
 * Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee inquiries while maintaining accurate, confidential payroll records and master data
 * Prepare payroll reports and operational metrics, support audits, and collaborate with internal teams and vendors to improve payroll accuracy and efficiency

What You Need to Succeed:
 * Degree in Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline
 * 2 to 7 years of experience in payroll operations, payroll administration, or shared services
 * Strong knowledge of Indian payroll processes, statutory compliance, payroll validation, and reconciliation
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office, with experience using payroll or HRIS platforms such as Oracle HCM, ADP, or CloudPay preferred
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities

How We Set You Up for Success:
 * Opportunity to develop expertise in end-to-end payroll administration and compliance
 * Collaboration with experienced HR Operations, Finance, Benefits, and payroll teams
 * Exposure to payroll systems, reporting tools, and process automation initiatives
 * Opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement and payroll process optimization
 * Experience supporting employee lifecycle transactions and cross-functional payroll operations

job_description:
Job Title: Technical Support Specialist
Department: Customer Support
About the Role
UniTriTeam is seeking a curious, solutions-focused Technical Support Specialist to support Socialive’s growing customer base. In this role, you’ll investigate technical issues, guide customers toward resolutions, and coordinate with internal teams when an issue needs escalation. You’ll help make every support interaction clear, considerate, and effective.
Key Responsibilities
Respond to customer inquiries accurately, professionally, and in a timely manner.
Triage and de-escalate inbound support requests while maintaining a high standard of customer care.
Troubleshoot issues across Socialive’s platform, including video, audiovisual setups, networks, and security configurations.
Reproduce and document complex issues so they can be escalated effectively.
Work with Support, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to resolve issues and keep relevant stakeholders informed.
Maintain support documentation for internal teams and customers.
Help improve support processes, best practices, and peer training.
Advocate for customers and help them get the most from Socialive’s software.
What We’re Looking For
Advanced spoken and written English skills.
3+ years of B2B software customer support experience.
Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to assess, reproduce, document, and escalate technical issues.
Experience troubleshooting video, AV software and hardware, and related setups is highly preferred.
Experience diagnosing complex network and security issues.
Clear communication skills, a personable approach, and a collaborative mindset.
Why Join UniTriTeam
At UniTriTeam, we believe people make the difference. We support our clients with talented professionals who become an integral part of their teams. You’ll have the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges, support customers directly, and help shape a better support experience. Technical Support B2B Software Support Troubleshooting Network Diagnostics Security Configuration AV Software AV Hardware Video Conferencing Customer Communication Documentation Triage Escalation Management Collaboration Candidates must have 3+ years of B2B software customer support experience and advanced English communication skills. Strong technical troubleshooting abilities, specifically regarding networks, security, and audiovisual setups, are required.

title: Senior Software Engineer
job_description:
Senior Software Engineer - ExamDeveloper

About Pearson

About ExamDeveloper

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows our customers
to write, review, and manage questions for their exams
(https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/test-owners/develop.html). ExamDeveloper is a
leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the
professional skills they need. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support their
full workflow around question writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test
management.

Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor
and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation,
optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and
platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide
design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient
solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance
optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead
through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving
practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You
partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects,
Quality Engineering, and DevOps to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable
solutions.

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership (through expertise)

 * Lead design and implementation for complex software components, services, and
   platforms.
 * Drive technical decision-making for major features and engineering
   initiatives.
 * Influence software architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards
   within your domain.
 * Lead technical design sessions and contribute to architectural discussions
   with Product Architects.
 * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and
   technical guidance.
 * Participate in interviews to help assess and hire engineering talent.
 * Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to stakeholders
   outside your immediate team.


Software development

 * Design and deliver enterprise-scale, secure, maintainable, and scalable
   software solutions.
 * Evaluate design alternatives and recommend approaches balancing value, risk,
   performance, and maintainability.
 * Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for critical production
   issues.
 * Identify and mitigate technical debt, performance bottlenecks, reliability
   concerns, and operational risk.


Quality, delivery, and collaboration

 * Champion engineering best practices across testing, automation, deployment,
   observability, and security.
 * Partner with Quality Engineering to advance quality-by-design and automation.
 * Support release planning, deployment, and operational readiness.
 * Contribute to roadmap planning, technical estimation, and platform
   modernization.


Required education and experience

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical
   experience.
 * 5+ years of professional software development experience.
 * Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of complex,
   distributed systems.
 * Experience providing technical leadership and mentorship within Agile
   engineering teams.
 * Experience designing and operating within cloud-native environments.


Technology stack

This is the current stack for the team you would join. Direct experience is
preferred, and strong experience with comparable languages, frameworks, and
toolsets will also be considered.

 * .NET / C#
 * Angular, including an in-house Angular-based UI framework
 * Microsoft Azure
 * Containerized services orchestrated by Kubernetes
 * Microsoft SQL Server and relational databases
 * AI-assisted development tools, as provided by Pearson


Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

 * Strong software design and system architecture skills.
 * Experience building highly available and scalable enterprise applications.
 * Cloud-based DevOps workflows, CI/CD, application security, observability, and
   performance engineering.
 * Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering capability.
 * Familiarity with LLMs / ML concepts and practical use of AI-assisted
   development tools in day-to-day engineering work, preferred.
 * Experience supporting accessibility compliance and WCAG standards, preferred.
 * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining
   technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.


Success measures

 * Delivers complex technical solutions that support critical business
   objectives.
 * Builds software with strong reliability, maintainability, scalability,
   security, and performance.
 * Influences technical direction through sound engineering judgment and
   well-supported recommendations.
 * Is sought out by other engineers for guidance on difficult technical
   problems.
 * Improves the capability of the broader engineering team through mentorship.
 * Contributes to hiring quality through active participation in the interview
   process.
 * Communicates technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders outside
   engineering, building trust and alignment.
 * Identifies and addresses technical risks before they impact delivery,
   operations, or customers.


Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity  Anticipates customer needs by designing solutions that
improve reliability, usability, performance, and scalability.

Raise the Performance Bar  Sets a high standard for engineering quality and
continuously explores better tools, frameworks, and approaches.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value  Builds strong technical partnerships and
helps teams make better decisions through knowledge sharing and constructive
challenge.

Our Leaders Inspire  Leads through credibility, expertise, and mentorship,
creating an environment where engineers grow and solve hard problems together.  .NET C# Angular Microsoft Azure Kubernetes SQL Server Software Architecture System Design Cloud-native CI/CD Mentorship Agile Distributed Systems Performance Engineering Application Security Technical Leadership Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering and at least 5 years of professional software development experience. Proficiency in .NET/C#, cloud-native environments, and experience leading the design of complex distributed systems are required.

title: Product Designer
job_description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Own the end-to-end product design lifecycle from discovery to delivery.
 * Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, and usability testing.
 * Define user personas, customer journeys, and information architecture.
 * Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
 * Design intuitive, visually appealing, and scalable user interfaces.
 * Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Business Analysts, and
   QA teams.
 * Translate business requirements into meaningful user experiences.
 * Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and UX standards.
 * Analyze user feedback and product metrics to drive continuous improvements.
 * Ensure accessibility, responsiveness, and usability best practices are
   followed.
 * Present and communicate design concepts effectively to stakeholders.


REQUIRED SKILLS

 * Strong experience in:
   * Product Design
   * UX Design
   * UI Design
   * Interaction Design
   * User Research
   * Design Thinking
 * Hands-on experience with:
   * Figma
   * Adobe XD
   * Sketch
   * Miro
   * InVision
 * Expertise in:
   * Wireframing
   * Prototyping
   * Usability Testing
   * Information Architecture
   * Responsive Design
   * Design Systems
 * Strong understanding of:
   * Human-Centered Design
   * Customer Journey Mapping
   * Accessibility Standards (WCAG)
   * Product Development Lifecycle
 * Experience using data and customer insights to influence design decisions.


PREFERRED SKILLS

 * Basic understanding of:
   * HTML5
   * CSS3
   * JavaScript
   * React
 * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 * Knowledge of product analytics tools such as:
   * Google Analytics
   * Mixpanel
   * Hotjar
   * Amplitude
 * Experience designing enterprise, SaaS, retail, or e-commerce applications.


RESPONSIBILITIES


EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),
   Computer Science, Fine Arts, Product Design, or a related field.


SOFT SKILLS

 * Strong communication and presentation skills.
 * Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
 * Ability to influence stakeholders and advocate for users.
 * Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.
 * Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 * Creative mindset with attention to detail.


NICE TO HAVE

 * Experience building and managing enterprise design systems.
 * Exposure to AI-powered, conversational, or data-driven products.
 * Certification in UX Design, Product Design, HCI, or Design Thinking.
 * Portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design case studies and measurable

title: Process Manager
job_description:
Senior Graphic Designer 

Location: Pune / Mumbai / Chandigarh

 Employment Type: Full-time (FT) 

Function: Digital Shift Timings: EMEA / US 

Management Level: SA 

Travel Requirements: NA 

Role Overview The ideal candidate must possess strong communication skills, with
an ability to listen and comprehend information and share it with all key
stakeholders, highlighting opportunities for improvement and concerns, if any.
The candidate must be able to work collaboratively with teams to execute tasks
within defined timeframes while maintaining high-quality standards and superior
service levels. The ability to take proactive actions and willingness to take up
responsibility beyond the assigned work area is a plus. 

Roles & Responsibilities 

• Participate in designing and redesigning computer graphics, web page graphics,
logos, illustrations, advertisements, web-page mock-ups, infographics,
brochures, and other forms of visual communication using Adobe Creative Suite
for both print and digital media. 

• Conceptualize and develop creative designs based on project requirements,
brand guidelines, and established specifications. 

• Design engaging email creatives, email campaigns, newsletters, promotional
emails, and other email marketing assets for digital communication. 

• Create visually appealing email layouts while ensuring consistency with brand
guidelines, typography, imagery, and overall visual identity.

 • Collaborate with marketing and content teams to develop email designs aligned
with campaign objectives and target audiences. 

• Design responsive email creatives that provide a consistent visual experience
across desktop and mobile devices.

 • Work closely with email developers/marketing teams to ensure designs are
practical for email development and implementation. 

• Ensure email designs follow appropriate layout, hierarchy, readability,
accessibility, and visual communication principles.

 • Analyze and plan the framework of designs according to the laid-out concept
and established specifications of the project.

 • Ensure that all delivered designs and services adhere to client policies,
brand guidelines, and quality standards. 

• Manage seamless delivery and ensure client deliverables meet defined SLAs and
quality thresholds. 

• Stay updated with the latest design trends, techniques, and tools and identify
opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of creative output. 

• Collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients to understand
requirements and deliver high-quality creative solutions. 

Technical & Functional Skills 

•Bachelor's Degree with 3–5 years of Graphic Design experience. 

• Strong experience in designing for both digital and print media. 

• Expert knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. 

• Experience designing email creatives, email campaigns, newsletters, and
digital marketing assets. 

• Understanding of email design principles, responsive layouts, visual
hierarchy, typography, and mobile-friendly design. 

• Basic understanding of how email designs are translated into HTML/email
templates would be an added advantage. 

• Good knowledge of Graphic Design and User Design principles, standards, and
concepts. 

• Thorough understanding of typography and printing. 

• Strong understanding of branding and visual communication. 

• Experience with UX/UI design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Framer, or
Axure. 

• Experience in User Experience Design.

 • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to confidently
interact with clients. 

• Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into effective
creative solutions.

 • Strong attention to detail and ability to work within tight deadlines. 

• After Effects and Premiere Pro would be an added advantage. 

Preferred Skills

 • Experience working on email marketing campaigns and digital marketing
communications. 

• Familiarity with email development workflows and collaboration with email
developers. 

• Understanding of responsive email design and cross-device considerations.

 • Knowledge of accessibility standards for digital and email creatives would be
an added advantage. Graphic Design Adobe Creative Suite Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Email Marketing Typography Visual Communication Responsive Design UX/UI Design Figma Sketch Adobe XD Branding Print Media Digital Media Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree and possess 3-5 years of professional graphic design experience. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, strong typography skills, and experience with digital marketing assets are essential requirements.

title: Expert, Finance Application Analyst

SE develops connected technologies and solutions to manage energy and process in ways that are safe, reliable, efficient and sustainable. SE provides an integrated approach, designed for the reality of digital economy (Plant-to-Plug). The versatile product portfolio addresses all energy needs of industries as well as residential. 
Schneider Digital (SD): All IT needs for SE are managed by SD; spread across 303 locations in 60 countries with over 5000 staff; along with engagements with all major Global IT Service Providers.

CEO->CDO->CIO->SVP GSC & Fin->VP Dig Fin->Capability Owner for Finance Tax and Accounting ->ALM.

Manage the application landscape for the Finance, Tax and Accounting scope (usage, costs, obsolescence, target)
Contribute to (propose and/or perform) rationalization activities to reduce legacy applications.
Transform the IT landscape to make it best in class and future ready.
Define IT strategy to address current and future finance processes/requirements.
Ensuring strategy is executed by defining and deploying the appropriate digital IT landscape.
Primary point of contact of SD to the Process Owners, work with them to drive Business/Digital transformation through effective collaboration of both internal and external IT professionals.

Define the IT application strategy securing the future of the relevant applications through effective archiving, performance optimization, effective database management, upgrade strategy, and Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Plans
Go-to-person for all technical information
Excellent knowledge of Enterprise Architecture
Good problem-solving skills
Digital Solutioning Skills
Managed application landscape for Finance, Tax and Accounting
Good knowledge of SDLC and various Software development frameworks
Experience/good knowledge of SAP ERP

Total experience of 14-16 years, with excellent communication and coordination skills.

Experience of working in a highly matrixed organization

title: Senior Graphic Designer
job_description:
Careerflow.ai is an AI-powered career platform helping job seekers improve their resumes, optimize their LinkedIn profiles, track job applications, and navigate their career journeys more effectively.

We’re looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can create high-quality visual content for our marketing campaigns, social media, website, and product promotions. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Social Media Design: Create graphics, carousels, banners, and other visual content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and other social media platforms.

 * Marketing Creatives: Design creatives for paid advertising campaigns, email marketing, product launches, and promotional campaigns.

 * Branding: Maintain consistency in Careerflow’s visual identity across all marketing channels.

 * Website & Landing Pages: Design website banners, landing page graphics, and other digital marketing assets.

 * Video & Motion Graphics: Create basic animations, GIFs, and motion graphics for social media and marketing campaigns when required.

 * Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and content teams to turn ideas and briefs into effective visual designs.

 * Creative Research: Stay updated on design trends, competitor creatives, and new tools to improve the quality of our visual content.

 * Project Management: Manage multiple design requests, meet deadlines, and maintain quality across deliverables.


REQUIREMENTS

 * 4+ years of experience in graphic design, preferably in a startup, SaaS, technology, or digital marketing company.

 * A strong portfolio showcasing social media designs, marketing creatives, and branding work.

 * Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe Illustrator.

 * Good understanding of typography, color theory, layouts, and visual hierarchy.

 * Experience creating designs for social media and digital advertising campaigns.

 * Ability to understand briefs and translate them into clear, engaging visuals.

 * Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects independently.

 * Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with cross-functional teams.


GOOD TO HAVE

 * Basic knowledge of motion graphics or video editing.

 * Experience with AI-powered design tools.

 * Familiarity with SaaS products and digital marketing campaigns.

 * Understanding of social media trends and performance-driven creative design.


WHY JOIN CAREERFLOW.AI?

 * Work with a growing AI-powered career platform.

 * Take ownership of creative projects and contribute to brand development.

 * Collaborate with a team focused on helping job seekers succeed.

 * Work in a fast-paced environment with opportunities to experiment and grow. title: Senior Manager, People Technology & Analytics
job_description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will... 
Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place. 
Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing. 
Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward. 
Location: Remote in India
Role Description: 
ShipBob is building a People Technology & Analytics function from the ground up, and this is the role that leads it. 
Right now, our HR technology and people analytics capabilities exist, but they are distributed and not yet operating with a single coherent strategy. Core HCM lives in one place, Talent in another, Performance and OD systems in another, and a variety of other point system solutions throughout the People function. The data those systems generate is underutilized, integrations between them are inconsistent, and the opportunity to apply AI and automation thoughtfully across this landscape is full of opportunity. The goal for this role is to lead the efforts to close these gaps. 
This is not an HRIS administration role nor a pure analytics function. You will lead building the operating model and function that ShipBob needs while doing meaningful technical work yourself along the way. If you are a player-coach who is energized by building something, who thinks in systems and roadmaps rather than tickets and configurations, and who has a genuine point of view on where AI creates real leverage in HR operations, this role was designed for you. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards & HR Tech. 
What you’ll do: 
People systems strategy and roadmap: You are the strategic owner of how ShipBob thinks about its HR technology stack. That means making the build vs. buy calls, sequencing the investments, rationalizing what we have, and developing a point of view on what we need grounded in what the business requires. You will develop and maintain a People Technology & Analytics roadmap that reflects both near-term operational priorities and longer-term capability goals. 
HR technology administration and architecture: ShipBob's current stack includes ADP Workforce Now as core HCM, Greenhouse for recruiting, Lattice for performance and goal management, and a range of point solutions across the HR function. You will be responsible for the configuration strategy, integration architecture, and overseeing the ongoing administration of the full stack. You will also oversee and contribute toward building internal tooling and AI-powered workflows that close gaps. 
People analytics program: ShipBob does not yet have a structured people analytics capability. You will oversee development of data management, metric architecture, standard reporting cadences, and a roadmap of deeper workforce studies. 
AI and automation strategy: ShipBob is actively deploying AI agent tooling through our HR service center and enabling employees across the People team with access to AI-enabled tooling to build self-service solutions for process improvements and automations. You will partner with IT and People Leadership to develop a point of view on to drive long-term value in this space while avoiding redundancy and overspend. 
Organizational design and team building: You will assess the current state of People Technology & Analytics capability across ShipBob and develop a recommendation for what the right team structure looks like over the next 12 to 18 months. You will build the internal case for that structure and navigate the organizational dynamics required to bring it to life. 
People Service Center partnership model: ShipBob's People Service Center (PSC) is responsible for Tier 1 HR ticket resolution, data entry, and knowledge base management and operates adjacent to this function. This work is deeply intertwined with the systems and data this team owns. You will be accountable for defining a clear operating model for how PT&A and PSC work together: what each team owns, how they hand off, and how they complement each other. 
Team leadership: You will carry direct management responsibility for HRIS and analytics talent within this function and are expected to be an active, invested leader in developing the people on your team. As the function grows, so will your team. Building a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance within People Technology & Analytics is part of the mandate. 
Other duties/responsibilities as necessary. 
What you’ll bring to the table: 
8+ years in HR technology, HRIS, and people analytics, with at least 3 years in a formal leadership or team management role 
Direct experience with multiple HCM platforms across your career, not just deep expertise in one. You should be able to speak fluently about at least two to three different platforms and articulate how you evaluate which system is right for a given context. 
A demonstrated track record of operating as a player-coach: managing a team while personally owning meaningful technical deliverables. 
Experience developing and owning an HR technology roadmap, including build vs. buy decisions, vendor selection, and sequencing logic. 
Experience navigating organizational influence, driving technology change or consolidation with stakeholders who did not report to you and had their own stake in the current state. 
Independent people analytics capability: you can build a metrics framework, design a workforce study, or interpret a complex dataset without a dedicated analyst doing the work for you. 
Genuine curiosity and a specific point of view on how AI and automation apply to HR systems and operations. 
Strongly preferred 
ADP Workforce Now, Greenhouse, and Lattice experience at an implementation or deep administration level 
Preferred 
Experience at a multi-site, operationally complex company with both corporate and hourly/warehouse employee populations — logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or similar 
Exposure to agentic AI platforms, workflow automation tooling, or no-code/low-code build environments applied to HR workflows 
Experience building an org design case and presenting headcount recommendations to senior leadership 
This role requires a work schedule that covers at minimum 10am–2pm US Eastern time daily 
Perks & Benefits: 
Medical, Term & Accidental Insurance 
All Purpose Leave (casual & sick time): 12 days 
Earned Leave: 15 days 
Public Holiday: 12 days 
Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave 
Quarterly Wellness Day 
Work From Home Allowance 
See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob) 
We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 
About You: 
Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you. 
Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/). 
About Us: 
ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago. 
At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.
Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment
We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.
ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. 
There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis. HR technology HRIS People analytics Strategic planning Team leadership Change management Data management AI strategy Automation Vendor management Organizational design Project management Stakeholder management System architecture Process improvement Candidates must have 8+ years of experience in HR technology and people analytics, including at least 3 years in a leadership role. Proficiency in multiple HCM platforms and a strong background in building technical roadmaps and organizational design are required.

title: Senior Manager
job_description:
The role involves accounting and reporting as per USGAAP and IFRS, managing
internal, SOX, and statutory audits, preparing and filing LGAAP financial
statements, accurately recording accruals, prepaid expenses, and other journal
entries impacting financials, performing GL reconciliations and backups,
conducting variance analysis for P&L and BS, and adhering to SOX controls and
policies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Key functions include GL accounting and finalization of financials on a monthly
basis, ensuring timely and clean closure of quarterly and annual audits with no
surprises, performing GL reconciliations, reviewing and derisking the balance
sheet, driving process improvements and automation, leading local audits to
ensure timely closure and filings, and ensuring SOX audit closure including
adherence to controls and policies.


QUALIFICATIONS

Graduate/ Post Graduate. (Mcom/ MBA), CA 7 - 10 Years Accounting USGAAP IFRS Internal Audit SOX Compliance Statutory Audit Financial Reporting GL Reconciliation Variance Analysis P&L Analysis Balance Sheet Review Process Improvement Automation Accruals Prepaid Expenses Financial Statements Candidates must hold a graduate or postgraduate degree such as an M.Com, MBA, or CA qualification. The position requires 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in accounting and financial management.

title: Data Migration Specialist-Manufacturing
job_description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.
Data Migration Specialist-Manufacturing 

JOB PURPOSE:
The Data Migration Specialist will play a key role in Bayer’s CORE SAP S/4HANA Transformation Program by driving end-to-end data migration activities across the assigned value stream. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate, complete, and high-quality migration of master and transactional data from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA through data mapping, validation, cleansing, and governance activities. Working closely with business stakeholders, value stream leads, functional teams, and implementation partners, the incumbent will help deliver a seamless transition to the target system while maintaining data integrity and supporting business readiness.
JOB PROFILE:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Migration and Mapping Coordinator to lead the data migration activities as part of CORE S/4 HANA Transformation project. This role will focus on ensuring accurate, efficient, and seamless data mapping, validation, cleansing, and coordinating with value stream leads / teams - while aligning with organizational and CORE program goals. The ideal candidate will have good experience with SAP MFG Processes, SAP ECC and S4HANA ,data structures ,data mapping , Cleansing and cross-functional team collaboration across different cultures

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Mapping, Migration:
Support in executing entire scope of data within respective MFG value stream 
Co-ordinate and support data migration including Prepare > Map > Enrich > Transform > Validate > Correct > Implement > Hypercare > Handover 
Plan & Execute data scoping and mapping workshops from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring alignment with Value streams , business, and migration teams 
Supports verifying extraction criteria, clarity on data availability and ensuring that data migration as per data object complies with defined approach

Data Quality & Validation:
Drive data requirements and ensures that right set of data gets identified, gathered, and translated with right data quality and data integrity 
Establish data quality criteria and oversee data cleansing activities to ensure the migration of accurate and reliable data.
Co-ordinate the data Validation activities with Bayer and implementation partners to ensure timely completion of data validation.
Perform sanity check in the target system based on configuration specification as part of data migration activities

Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with Business , Value streams , functional and technical teams to understand data requirements and business needs.
Tracks progress , pushes roadblocks. Provide regular updates to leadership on data mapping, challenges, and resolutions.

Documentation and Compliance:
Maintain detailed documentation of mapping rules which includes Data Migration Specification(DMS) , Field Mapping Document(FMD) & XREF and Validation results.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance policies and SAP standards.
Risk Management:
Identify potential data migration risks and develop mitigation strategies.
WHO YOU ARE:
• Overall 8+ years of experience with minimum 4+ years of experience in SAP data migration projects, preferably with a focus on S/4HANA. 
• SAP Functional knowledge of PP Module 
• Familiarity with data migration tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Domain Expertise:
• Comprehensive understanding of business processes across SAP MFG value stream.
Technical Expertise :
• Proficiency in SAP ECC and S4HANA
• Strong expertise in data mapping, validation, cleansing and transformation processes for Master and transaction data as part of S4HANA transformations
• Experienced in creating DMS and FMD documents 
• In-depth knowledge of SAP data structures
• Familiar with SQL and any data migration tools
• Proven experience in managing or coordinating SAP data migration projects, preferably with SAP S/4 HANA.
• Proven experience in data mapping from SAP ECC to S/4 HANA
• Excellent knowledge of relevant best practices and standards related to data migration
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams , levels and cultures.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools
		
YOUR APPLICATION		
		
Bayer is an equal opportunity employer that strongly values fairness and respect at work. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, age, physical characteristics, disability, sexual orientation etc. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.
		
		
Location:	India : Karnataka : Bangalore 		
Division:	Enabling Functions 		
Reference Code:	882150 			
	
	
Contact Us	
	
+ 022-25311234 SAP S/4HANA SAP ECC Data Migration Data Mapping Data Cleansing Data Validation SAP PP Module Manufacturing Processes SQL Data Governance Project Management Agile Methodologies Data Integrity Business Process Analysis Cross-functional Collaboration Technical Documentation The ideal candidate possesses over 8 years of experience, with at least 4 years specifically in SAP data migration projects including S/4HANA. Strong functional knowledge of the SAP PP module, data structures, and proficiency in mapping and validation tools are required.

title: Process Automation Developer – AI & n8n (m/f/d)
job_description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 
Our Global Accounting Process Excellence team is a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of finance operations and cutting-edge technology. We build real solutions — Python scripts, RPA workflows, AI agents — that save our global accounting teams hours of manual work every week. 
We're looking for a hands-on technical Business Analyst who loves building things, not just documenting them. You'll work directly with our global accounting teams (Germany, Sofia, Mexico) to understand their pain points and turn them into automated, AI-enabled solutions — using Python, RPA tools, and AI agents as your primary toolkit. 
You'll be the first direct report to our lead of Digital Process Automation function — a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership end-to-end, and is excited to be part of building something from the ground up. 
About the Role
Build automation solutions: Develop and deploy practical automations using Python, n8n, UiPath and approved AI technologies — including workflow logic, system integrations, and exception handling 
Develop AI-enabled features: Build applied AI components using LLM services (Claude or equivalent), structured outputs, tool calling, and agent workflows — with clear, measurable business value 
Create data processing pipelines: Write Python and SQL-based solutions for reconciliations, validations, data transformations, and operational controls 
Integrate enterprise systems: Work with REST APIs, JSON, databases, files and connectors to integrate with enterprise systems such as Oracle Fusion and automate end-to-end processes 
Use AI-assisted development tools: Leverage tools like Claude Code to accelerate prototyping, testing, and deployment — build MVPs fast, validate with users, and evolve into maintainable solutions 
Own production readiness: Implement proper testing, access management, error handling, logging, and audit trails — you ship things that actually work in production 
Maintain and improve: Take long-term ownership of delivered solutions; coordinate with platform, security, and tech teams as needed 
Translate business to technical: Engage directly with accounting stakeholders, understand manual processes, and independently define the right automation approach 
About You
5+ years of hands-on experience in automation, technical business analysis, or solution delivery, with strong, production-ready Python skills and experience building maintainable, robust applications —not just one-off scripts. 
Automation & RPA experience — practical hands-on work with at least one workflow or RPA tool such as UiPath, n8n, or equivalent 
Integration & API skills — experience building reliable system integrations using REST APIs, including authentication, data exchange, error handling, and troubleshooting. 
Practical AI/LLM exposure — you've actually built something using an AI tool, agent, or LLM framework — not just read about it 
Independent delivery mindset — you take a problem from definition to working, deployed solution without handholding; fluent English and comfortable working in Central European business hours 
A Strong Advantage:
Finance & enterprise platform knowledge — exposure to accounting processes (GL, AP, AR, reconciliations, invoice processing) and/or enterprise tools like Oracle Fusion, Snowflake, or Power BI 
AI agent frameworks & cloud basics — familiarity with LangChain / Mastra agentic AI frameworks, MCP, and similar; cloud deployment (AWS/Azure), containerization, or CI/CD experience is a bonus; Engineering/CS degree with certifications in Data Science, AI, or RPA (e.g. UiPath Developer Certification) is a plus 
We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 
What We Offer
Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 
To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
Why Join Flix?
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Lead Product Manager(SaaS + AI)
job_description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes
Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.
Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
What will I be doing?
Develop and articulate a clear vision and strategic direction for our data products. Work closely with senior management to ensure alignment with the organization’s overall objectives and the specific needs of our customers.
Oversee the technical design and architectural decisions for building scalable and efficient data products. Ensure products are designed to leverage our data assets effectively.
Implement data governance frameworks and establish data quality and consistency standards across Data Lake and other platforms. Ensure compliance with data security and privacy standards.
Facilitate collaboration across engineering, data science, and business teams. Translate business needs into technical specifications and ensure that developed solutions meet these specifications.
Conduct user research to gather insights into user needs and pain points. Use this information to guide product development and prioritize features that deliver significant value to users.
Define and monitor key performance indicators for data products to evaluate success and identify opportunities for improvement.
Write detailed functional specifications and collaborate with engineering teams to deliver features release after release.
What skills do I need?
8+ years of work experience as a Product manager in Reporting and Analytics areas of the product
Working knowledge of current analytical technologies, data warehouse design and business intelligence best practices
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
Effective communication skills, capable of explaining complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
A good understanding of mobile, web and cloud technology space
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
Why Zenoti?
Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry. 
Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth. 
Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti’s platform. 
Attractive compensation. 
Medical coverage for yourself and your immediate family. 
Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions. We also include your family in benefit awareness initiatives. 
Regular social activities, and opportunities to give back through social work and community initiatives.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. title: Embedded Infrastructure Engineer, Chanakya
job_description:
ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is
developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research,
models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI
genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public
institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam
partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED,
IDFC, and LIC.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Embedded Infrastructure Engineers design, build, and maintain the data
infrastructure that underpins AI system deployments at client sites. You work
alongside Embedded Data Scientists and Strategic Deployment Engineers to ensure
that terabyte-scale datasets can be ingested, stored, queried, and served to AI
reasoning engines reliably and performantly.

This means building and operating data platforms that handle terabyte-scale
persistent data stores and sustained large daily ingestion volumes across
structured records, documents, imagery, audio, and geospatial data. You will
design and maintain the databases, object stores, ingestion pipelines, and
processing layers that make this possible.

You will make critical decisions about storage architecture, indexing
strategies, pipeline orchestration, and system performance — often in
constrained, air-gapped, or operationally sensitive environments where you
cannot rely on managed cloud services or standard enterprise tooling. You will
own the reliability and performance of the infrastructure layer in your assigned
accounts.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

•   Design and operate data storage architectures (relational, document, vector,
object storage) capable of managing terabyte-scale datasets across multiple
modalities

•   Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that reliably process daily data
influx — including batch and streaming workloads — with monitoring, error
handling, and backpressure management

•   Implement indexing, partitioning, and query optimisation strategies that
allow AI systems and data scientists to retrieve and reason over large datasets
with acceptable latency

•   Work with Embedded Data Scientists to translate ontologies, schemas, and
semantic structures into performant physical data models and storage
configurations

•  Deploy and manage database systems, vector stores, and search infrastructure
in air-gapped, on-premise, or security-constrained environments

•  Build observability into the data platform: monitor pipeline health, storage
utilisation, query performance, and ingestion lag

•  Own capacity planning and scaling decisions for data infrastructure across
assigned client deployments

•  Collaborate with product and engineering teams to feed infrastructure
learnings back into the core platform and tooling

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

•   4–8 years in data infrastructure, data engineering, platform engineering, or
site reliability engineering, ideally at organisations operating at significant
data scale

•   Direct experience managing multi-terabyte data stores — you have personally
built or operated systems handling 10TB+ of persistent data and sustained
high-throughput ingestion

•   Deep working knowledge of at least two of: PostgreSQL, MongoDB,
Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, or comparable systems — including tuning, indexing,
partitioning, and operational management

•   Experience building production data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka,
Apache Spark, Airflow, Flink, dbt, or equivalent frameworks

•  Strong proficiency in Python and/or Go, with experience writing production
infrastructure tooling and automation

•  Solid understanding of storage systems and formats: object storage
(S3/MinIO), columnar formats (Parquet, ORC), and how to choose the right storage
layer for the workload

•  Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in
production settings

•  Experience with infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation (Terraform
or similar)

 


BONUS POINTS

•  Experience with vector databases or embedding stores (Milvus, Weaviate,
Qdrant, pgvector, or similar)

•  Experience deploying and operating infrastructure in air-gapped, on-premise,
or hybrid environments

 

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not

people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you
and

you believe you can do this work; we want to hear from you.

 


WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for
India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real
population-scale impact.

•  Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who
move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

•  High ownership and high impact, from day one

•  Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we
think about problems

•  You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns,
works, and communicates

 

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the
place to be.

  Data infrastructure PostgreSQL MongoDB Elasticsearch ClickHouse Apache Kafka Apache Spark Python Go Kubernetes Docker Terraform Data engineering Site reliability engineering Vector databases System performance Requires 4–8 years of experience in data or platform engineering with expertise in managing large-scale data stores and high-throughput ingestion. Proficiency in Python or Go and deep knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch is essential.

title: Backend Engineer, Chanakya
job_description:
ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is
developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research,
models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI
genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public
institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam
partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED,
IDFC, and LIC.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Backend Engineers on this team are builders, not maintainers. You will design
and implement the core system infrastructure that powers Sarvam's 'atoms': MCP
servers, on-prem deployment tooling, document ingestion pipelines, agentic
backends, and API layers. These systems run in classified, air-gapped, and
operationally constrained environments — or in enterprise environments with
their own security, compliance, and integration constraints.

The architecture decisions you make will be inherited by every deployment that
follows. You will ship real systems, not prototypes — and you will be
accountable for how they behave in the field.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

•  Design and build backend systems for Sarvam's atoms: MCP servers, document
ingestion pipelines, agentic frameworks, NL-to-action APIs, and on-prem
deployment tooling

•  Build robust, well-designed API layers that connect Sarvam's AI stack to
client-side frontends and operational systems

•  Implement data ingestion and processing pipelines for unstructured data:
PDFs, audio transcripts, imagery metadata, and geospatial feeds

•  Build for constrained deployment environments: containerised,
minimal-dependency, auditable — systems that a deployment engineer can operate
without you in the room

•  Write clean, well-tested, documented code that other engineers can extend and
deployment teams can operate

•  Collaborate with frontend engineers, the data scientist, and MLOps to ship
complete atoms end-to-end

•  Support Strategic Deployment Engineers with debugging, operational tooling,
and field-level troubleshooting

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

•  3–6 years in backend engineering with production systems in continuous
operation

•  Strong Python: FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic — production-grade; Go or Rust is a
strong plus

•  System design proficiency: distributed systems, job queues, async processing,
caching, and failure handling

•  API design: RESTful and/or GraphQL; gRPC experience is a plus

•  Containerisation: Docker, Kubernetes or K3s; experience deploying in
minimal-dependency environments

•  Database experience: PostgreSQL, Redis, and vector databases (Qdrant, Chroma,
Weaviate, or equivalent)

•  Experience integrating with LLM APIs and building agentic pipelines —
LangChain, LlamaIndex, or direct API integration

 


BONUS POINTS

•  MCP protocol familiarity

•  Security-hardened API design and on-prem deployment experience

•  Comfort with air-gapped network constraints

•  Experience with enterprise security and compliance requirements (SOC2, ISO
27001, or equivalent)

 

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not
people who

match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you
believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

 


WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for
India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real
population-scale impact.

•  Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who
move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

•  High ownership and high impact, from day one

•  Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we
think about problems

•  You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns,
works, and communicates

 

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the
place to be.

  Python FastAPI Asyncio Pydantic System design Distributed systems API design Docker Kubernetes PostgreSQL Redis Vector databases LLM APIs LangChain LlamaIndex Backend engineering Requires 3–6 years of backend engineering experience with production systems and strong proficiency in Python. Candidates should have expertise in system design, containerization, and integrating with LLM APIs.

title: Green Building Specialist (Onsite in Noida, India)
job_description:
HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

----------------------------------------

As a Green Building Specialist (LEED Technical Group), you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping advance the goals of Technical Customer Service (TCS) for USGBC & GBCI. In this role, you will provide expert guidance and problem-solving support for complex technical inquiries, ensuring a positive experience for both new and experienced users, and you will drive key initiatives to improve products and processes for our customers in alignment with our mission and strategic goals.




You will report to a Team Lead in the TCS Technical Group and be part of a specialized and collaborative team environment where your contributions will help shape impactful outcomes. You will work closely with other divisions of our organization including Products and Operations and may regularly partner with GBCI review and USGBC Technical Development staff to explain points of confusion for customers and help clarify LEED requirements. You will also coordinate with our India-based staff from other teams to build a strong technical customer support network for them and help our US-based TCS staff identify opportunities for improving customer and staff support across the Eastern Hemisphere.




Key Responsibilities

 * Answer customer inquiries about LEED and other USGBC & GBCI products. 
 * Meet case-resolution, turnaround-time, quality, and customer-satisfaction targets. 
 * Partner with the TCS team and internal stakeholders to resolve customer issues and identify trends.
 * Serve as a LEED technical subject matter expert and share customer insights to improve guidance and services. 
 * Support special projects--including user acceptance testing, content development, policy updates, and staff training--to improve customer service processes. 
 * Maintain and enhance our team’s library of rating system expertise, standard operating procedures, Help Center content, stock responses, and best practices.
 * Represent the voice of the customer in USGBC and GBCI initiatives.

 

Assessment Notice

 * Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete a written skills assessment; more details will be provided as the time approaches.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

----------------------------------------

Experience 

 * A minimum of 5 years of professional experience working in a client-facing role in a field related to green design and construction, sustainable operations and maintenance, and/or sustainability education.
 * Experience with LEED project applications or green building consulting.
 * Experience working on cross-functional teams or contributing to process improvement projects.




Education

 * Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, such as sustainability, architecture, engineering, landscape design, building management, environmental science, environmental education, etc.
 * Master’s Degree or commensurate experience in one of these related fields of study is preferred.
    
    

Technology/System(s)

 * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning new technology.
 * Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
 * Familiarity with LEED Online and Arc is preferred.




Skills

 * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information to a global audience.
 * Demonstrated customer-first mindset and proven problem-solving abilities.
 * Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
 * Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to change, and accept feedback.




Certifications

 * Current USGBC or GBCI credential or professional certificate (e.g., LEED Green Associate or AP), or a commitment to earn one within the first year of Employment.




Language

 * English
 * Proficiency in Hindi, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic or other languages of the Eastern Hemisphere would be beneficial.




TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

----------------------------------------

Salary 

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

 

Benefits

We offer you:

 * Competitive compensation
 * Professional development reimbursement
 * Comprehensive benefits package aligned with local and national legislation.
 * 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service
 * Annual pay increase
 * Performance Bonuses




LOGISTICS

----------------------------------------




Location: This position is hybrid in Noida, India and will be required to work onsite about 3 to 4 times a week. 

Work Schedule: This is a salary-based position that will involve working at least 40 hours a week. Standard work hours are Monday – Friday 9 AM to 5:30 PM based on candidate’s time zone with some flexibility needed to attend calls with customers & staff in different time zones.

Travel %: 5 % of work time may involve travel for conference support, professional development, or team building meetings or other work-related tasks.

 

EEO STATEMENT

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.







ABOUT US

----------------------------------------




U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.




Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI) is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates including LEED [https://www.usgbc.org/leed], PERFORM [https://www.usgbc.org/perform], SITES [https://www.sustainablesites.org/], and TRUE Zero Waste [https://true.gbci.org/]..

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.




Our Global Impact

 * Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
 * Millions of square feet of certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
 * Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices




Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

 * A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
 * Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
 * A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
 * We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.




Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

 * U.S. Green Building Council Leaders [https://www.usgbc.org/about/mission-vision]
 * Green Business Certification Inc Leaders [https://www.gbci.org/about]




Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization. LEED Green building consulting Technical customer support Problem-solving Customer service Salesforce Microsoft Office Project management Communication Cross-functional collaboration Process improvement Content development Staff training Technical writing Sustainability education Candidates must have at least 5 years of professional experience in green design, construction, or sustainability education, along with a bachelor's degree in a related field. Proficiency in CRM systems like Salesforce and strong communication skills are required, with a preference for LEED-related credentials.
