title: Workforce Planner
job_description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design,
engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving
quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many
curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and
deliver more impact together.

Role description:

The Resource Planner will drive workforce planning from the front lines,
supporting pursuits and projects through identification and deployment support
of talent. This role will support both Sector and Service leaders and WFP
Directors to manage conflicts, drive contribution and drive data quality. The
role will also be responsible for building and establishing strong networks on
the ground, knowing people and capabilities.

Role accountabilities:

 * Engage regularly with team managers to maximize billability and reliability
   of forecasts.
 * Monitor and actively manage the demand market-place, owning demand within
   remit while also supporting the wider network with requests that may
   otherwise be missed.
 * Own the quality and accuracy of the 12-week look ahead for team managers
   within remit.
 * Proactively engage team managers to identify work and demand that can be
   planned in advance for Design & Engineering.
 * Provide regular feedback and insight from dashboards to key stakeholders to
   enable them to make informed decisions.
 * Identify and recommend recruitment needs to relevant stakeholders in a timely
   manner.
 * Maximize the use of soft booking and pre-planning practices.
 * Actively support mobilization and de-mobilization of talent to projects
   across.
 * Act as the primary point of contact for talent looking for new opportunities
   and ensure all information is documented in the system.
 * Develop a strong understanding of the team you are aligned to sufficiently to
   provide strong recommendations and be known to them.
 * Build strong and approachable relationships with pursuit leaders or project
   managers and support by identifying suitable resource options.
 * Establish and maintain a strong network with Team managers and take a
   solution driven approach while holding others to account.
 * Understand how and where to engage.
 * Identify gaps or inaccuracies in workforce planning data and seek to resolve
   issues.
 * Support the onboarding of new joiners and complete profile on WFP Tags.
 * Engage regularly with Sector and Industry leads who commonly engage with
   talent to understand client talent requirements.
 * Actively manage the demand marketplace and continuously enrich workforce
   data.
 * Identify and escalate supply and demand risks.
 * Address behaviours or practices that may compromise the best outcomes for
   Arcadis where possible and escalate concerns appropriately. 
 * Provide early warning and visibility to Sector WFP Directors on supply gaps
   or oversupply. 
 * Escalate unexpected changes and leverage WFP network to find solutions.
 * Act as the key point of contact within pursuits to find suitable talent or
   profiles that support sales.
 * Identify key attributes clients are looking for and integrate into WFP Tags
   to maximize value.
 * Support the prioritisation of top tier clients or major opportunities.
 * Act as the point of contact for Tier 3-4 client teams.

Qualifications & Experience:

 * Experience in workforce planning, resource planning, deployment coordination
   or similar operational planning roles within the AEC or related professional
   Services Industry.
 * Deep understanding of workforce analytics and forecasting, including how
   demand signals, forecast accuracy and billability influence deployment
   decisions.
 * Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to
   build strong relationships with Team Managers, Project Managers, Pursuit
   Leaders, Account Leaders and Talent Acquisition partners while maintaining
   appropriate challenge and accountability.
 * Knowledge of regional talent trends, labor markets and basic employment law
   relevant to workforce planning and deployment.
 * Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to identify gaps in data, manage
   planning inputs and improve accuracy and completeness of workforce
   information.
 * Change management and transformation expertise, with the ability to support
   evolving processes, behaviors and adoption of workforce planning tools and
   ways of working.
 * Detailed knowledge of processes and systems that drive workforce planning
   data, WFP tags and demand matching, or the ability to quickly build that
   knowledge in a comparable environment.
 * Client oriented, solution driven mindset, with the ability to understand
   client and pursuit needs and translate them into practical resource planning
   actions.
 * Strong communication skills, able to provide timely feedback, recommendations
   and early warnings on supply and demand risks.
 * Ability to manage competing priorities, escalate risks appropriately and
   leverage networks to identify suitable talent for pursuits and projects.
 * Understanding of commercial drivers such as utilization, billability, project
   margins, and their impact on resource planning decisions.
 * Ability to influence stakeholders and drive adherence to workforce planning
   practices without direct authority.
 * Ability to make informed resource allocation recommendations, balancing
   competing priorities, business needs, and workforce constraints. 
 * Leadership style that empowers Arcadians, promotes accountability and
   continuous improvement, and supports a healthy, inclusive and high engagement
   culture aligned to the Arcadis Leadership profile of being curious, driving
   success and igniting passion.
 * Degree level education in a relevant technical or commercial discipline such
   as business, operations, human resources, analytics or a related field, or
   equivalent practical experience.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We
believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a
skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and
expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make
together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver
sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your
career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why
equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition
is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our
people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with
disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of
non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed,
colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and
gender identity.

title: Digital Solutions Manager (Recruiting Tech & Learning Platforms)
job_description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Digital Solutions Manager (Recruiting Tech & Learning Platforms) 
This role sits within People Experience & AI transformation and serves as the strategic technical and functional capability lead for Okta's Recruiting and Learning ecosystem. As a Digital Solutions Manager with deep expertise in enterprise systems, integrations, automation, data architecture, and AI, you will define and execute the technology vision that enables scalable hiring, workforce development, and organizational growth.
In this role, you will establish the long-term technical and technical strategy for recruiting and learning systems, ensuring our platforms, integrations, data architecture, and AI capabilities work together seamlessly to support global operations. You will translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions, balancing user experience, operational efficiency, governance, and future-state innovation.
You will operate at the intersection of systems architecture, automation, and user experience—building solutions that improve efficiency, enable better decision-making, and support global growth. This role also requires strong AI fluency, with a focus on leveraging AI-driven capabilities to enhance recruiting processes, learning experiences, and operational automation.
What You'll Own
Roadmap & Systems: Define & execute the roadmap for Recruiting and Learning systems, ensuring alignment with business goals. Serve as the primary SME across ATS, CRM, LMS and AI tools. Design scalable, future-ready architectures, evaluate emerging technologies, and translate complex business needs into strategic technical solutions through partnership with People Technology and Business leaders.
Integrations, Automation & Optimization: Partner with Technology teams to define requirements for integrations across systems using APIs, middleware, and data pipelines. Drive automation of manual processes across recruiting and learning workflows to improve efficiency and reduce operational overhead. Lead the business side of system implementations—including requirements gathering, process mapping, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and change management/readiness—while partnering with the technology team for solution design, configuration, and deployment. Continuously identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve system performance.
Data Integrity, Reporting & Insights: Establish and maintain data integrity standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes. Ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and consistency across systems. Partner with analytics teams to align on reporting frameworks and enable actionable insights.
AI Enablement & Innovation: Leverage AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., candidate matching, chatbots, recommendations, content generation) to optimize recruiting and learning processes. Evaluate and implement AI-driven tools and features across systems. Identify high-impact use cases for AI to improve efficiency, personalization, and decision-making. Partner with stakeholders to drive responsible and scalable adoption of AI solutions.
Troubleshooting, Governance & Best Practices: Troubleshoot complex system issues and perform root cause analysis using structured problem-solving approaches. Partner with IT and Security to ensure system reliability, compliance, and scalability. Establish and document best practices for system configuration, usage, and maintenance. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation (system architecture, data flows, configurations).
Leadership & Cross-Functional Impact: Act as a technical subject matter expert for recruiting and learning systems within People. Partner with Recruiting and Learning & Development teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with Business Technology / IT on integrations, architecture, and system performance. Engage with vendors and external partners to support implementations and roadmap alignment. Support global users through issue resolution, training, and documentation to drive adoption and effectiveness.
What You Bring
Deep expertise in recruiting systems (ATS, CRM, interview platforms) and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
Strong experience in system configuration, architecture, and administration
Experience leading system implementations and managing medium-to-large complexity technical initiatives
Strong understanding of data models, reporting, and system governance
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex issues and perform root cause analysis
Experience leveraging automation to improve operational efficiency
AI fluency, including familiarity with AI/ML applications and AI-enabled features in recruiting and learning platforms
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and translate business needs into technical solutions
Why This Role Matters
This role is foundational to how Okta scales its recruiting and learning capabilities. You will build and maintain the systems that enable efficient hiring, effective learning, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. Your work will directly impact operational efficiency, user experience, and the company's ability to grow with the right talent and capabilities.

title: Career Accelerator Program - Digital IC Design Engineer
job_description:
Change the world. Love your job. 
In your first year with TI, you will participate in the Career Accelerator
Program (CAP), which provides professional and technical training and resources
to accelerate your ramp into TI, and set you up for long-term career success.
Within this program, we also offer function-specific technical training and
on-the-job learning opportunities that will encourage you to solve problems
through a variety of hands-on, meaningful experiences from your very first day
on the job. The TMG Development program is a 12-month program for new college
graduates in the TMG organization.

As a Digital IC Design Engineer, you'll architect new TI products and make our
customers' visions a reality. You'll define, design, model and verify digital
circuits, which fully meet the performance, power, cost and schedule
requirements. You'll define, design, model, implement and document the world
first 64-bit DSP processor, MMU and heterogeneous multicore shared memory and
cache systems including coherent TI DSP and ARM processors. You'll have the
opportunity to work in exciting areas such as CPU simulator development, 64-bit
vector processor ISA architecture, development and verification etc.


As a Digital IC Design Engineer, some of your responsibilities may include:

 * Partner with business teams and system engineering to develop mutually
   agreeable design specifications
 * Provide high-level analysis on chip architecture trade-offs to ensure spec
   compliance and superior performance at a competitive cost
 * Participate in design reviews and creating the necessary design and product
   documentation
 * Supervise IC layouts to ensure a high-performance standard
 * Characterize prototypes, developing test specifications and coordinating with
   test/product engineering to drive product releases
 * Drive behavioral models

Put your talent to work with us as a Digital Design Engineer !

Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work
authorization for this position.


QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum requirements:

 * Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology,
   Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical and Computer Engineering or
   related field
 * Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher

Preferred qualifications:

 * Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to
   success, both internally and externally
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills
 * Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes
 * Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different
   functions
 * Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
 * Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery


Why TI?
 * Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and
   development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world
   to shape the future of electronics.
 * We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push
   innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice,
   and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
   [https://edbz.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX/pages/4012]
 * Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to
   help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to
   us. Please find our country-specific benefits here
   [https://careers.ti.com/en/sites/CX/pages/benefits]



About Texas Instruments
Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company
that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for
markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and
communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better
world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion
is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our
technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible
for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com
[https://www.ti.com/].


Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse,
inclusive work environment.


If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.


TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship,
immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that
information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and
regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first
obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a
license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require
an export license or decline to move forward with your employment. Strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills are required to succeed in this collaborative engineering environment.

title: Team Lead, Technical Customer Service (Onsite in Noida, India)
job_description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

----------------------------------------

As a Team Lead for Technical Customer Service (TCS), you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping advance our goals at USGBC & GBCI. In this role, you will manage a small team of technical customer service specialists that focus on LEED, perform critical responsibilities such as triaging customer support inquiries, answering customer questions, supporting coordinating user acceptance testing, initiating and implementing process improvements, and executing other special projects in alignment with our mission and strategic goals.

You will report to the Director of the TCS Technical Group and be part of a specialized yet collaborative team environment where your contributions will help shape impactful outcomes. You’ll work closely with our other divisions including Products and Operations, and may regularly partner with GBCI review and USGBC Product Management and Technical Development team members to identify points of confusion for customers and help clarify LEED requirements. You will also coordinate with our India-based staff from other teams to build a strong technical customer support network for them and help our US-based TCS staff identify opportunities for improving customer and staff support across the Eastern Hemisphere.




Key Responsibilities

 * Lead, coach, and develop up to four direct reports through performance management, training, mentoring, and workload planning to meet or exceed team productivity goals, while ensuring high-quality responses.
 * Triage incoming customer inquiries to minimize turn-around time.
 * Perform periodic quality assurance assessments of the work of your team.
 * Contribute to customer support goals by meeting and exceeding case resolution targets through your own casework and that of your team.
 * Partner with TCS leadership team to implement strategies, processes, and service offerings that advance team objectives.
 * Lead assigned special projects and continuous-improvement initiatives. 
 * Develop and share LEED and sustainability subject matter expertise within the Technical Customer Service team. 
 * Provide clear, expert written guidance and maintain team resources, procedures, and best practices. 
 * Represent the voice of the customer by providing feedback on USGBC and GBCI initiatives. 
 * Design and refine customer-service processes that help customers achieve their goals and advance USGBC’s mission.




Assessment Notice

 * Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete a written skills assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

----------------------------------------

Experience 

 * A mininum of 2 years of experience leading a team of 2 or more employees
 * A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in a client-facing role, directly interacting and communicating with customers in green design, construction, sustainable operations, and maintenance, or sustainability education
 * Customer service experience




Education

 * Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study (e.g., sustainability, architecture, interior design, engineering, landscape design, building management, environmental science, environmental education)
 * Master’s Degree or commensurate experience in a related field of study or work, such as sustainability, architecture, engineering, landscape design, building management, environmental science, environmental education, etc. is strongly preferred




Technology/System(s)

 * Proficiency with Microsoft Office
 * Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
 * Familiarity with LEED Online and Arc is preferred
 * Ability to create and evaluate reports on various platforms such as PowerBI is beneficial




Skills

 * Prior experience developing or maintaining SOPs, support content, or training documentation
 * Demonstrated ability to prioritize responsibilities, navigate ambiguity, adapt to change, and accept feedback
 * Experience working on cross-functional teams or contributing to process improvement projects




Certifications

 * Current USGBC or GBCI credential or professional certificate (e.g., LEED Green Associate or AP), or a commitment to earn one within the first year of employment.




Language

 * English
 * Proficiency in Hindi, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic or other languages of the Eastern Hemisphere would be beneficial.




ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

----------------------------------------

Salary 

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.




Benefits

We offer you:

 * Competitive compensation
 * Professional development reimbursement
 * Comprehensive benefits package aligned with local and national legislation.
 * 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service
 * Annual pay increase
 * Performance Bonuses




LOGISTICS

----------------------------------------

Location: This position is hybrid in Noida, India and will be required to work onsite about 3 to 4 times a week. 

Work Schedule: This is a salary-based position that will involve working at least 40 hours a week. Standard work hours are Monday – Friday 9 AM to 5:30 PM based on candidate’s time zone with some flexibility needed to attend calls with customers & staff in different time zones.

Travel %: 5 % of work time may involve travel for conference support, professional development, or team building meetings or other work-related tasks.

 

EEO STATEMENT

----------------------------------------

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.







ABOUT US

----------------------------------------

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.




Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI) is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates including LEED [https://www.usgbc.org/leed], PERFORM [https://www.usgbc.org/perform], SITES [https://www.sustainablesites.org/], and TRUE Zero Waste [https://true.gbci.org/]..

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.




Our Global Impact

 * Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
 * Millions of square feet of certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
 * Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices




Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

 * A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
 * Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
 * A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
 * We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.




Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

 * U.S. Green Building Council Leaders [https://www.usgbc.org/about/mission-vision]
 * Green Business Certification Inc Leaders [https://www.gbci.org/about]




Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization. Team leadership Customer service Performance management Training Mentoring Workload planning Quality assurance Case resolution Process improvement Subject matter expertise Technical support Salesforce Microsoft Office LEED Online Arc PowerBI Candidates must have at least 2 years of team leadership experience and 5 years of professional experience in a client-facing role within sustainability or related fields. A bachelor's degree is required, with a master's degree preferred, along with proficiency in CRM systems and strong communication skills.

title: Client Reporting - Associate
job_description:
Shape the client experience by delivering accurate reporting and driving process
improvements that strengthen service outcomes and controls.

As a Global Client Reporting Associate in the Global Client Reporting team, you
oversee manual client reporting across multiple traditional asset groups and
support transformation initiatives. You ensure reporting requests are
understood, completed accurately, and delivered on time while building strong
product and domain knowledge. You partner with local and global teams to improve
processes, enhance controls, and escalate issues appropriately to support
consistent client servicing.

Job Responsibilities:

 * Oversee end-to-end delivery for manual reporting requests, ensuring
   requirements are understood and outputs meet accuracy and timeliness
   expectations
 * Complete ad hoc and custom client reports and other assigned tasks to support
   business needs
 * Drive strategic initiatives focused on process improvement, transformation
   execution, and control enhancement across the reporting function
 * Build domain expertise by understanding the figures being reported and
   strengthening product knowledge across assigned asset groups
 * Escalate issues and concerns to senior management as needed, supporting
   resolution while managing expectations across stakeholders
 * Prepare management information reporting and internal reporting packs as
   assigned

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

 * Hold a postgraduate degree
 * Demonstrate 10+ years of relevant experience in client reporting, investment
   reporting, or related operational reporting roles
 * Apply intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint,
   Word, Adobe Acrobat, and Outlook
 * Communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal English,
   including strong business writing capability
 * Exhibit a strong work ethic and a positive, collaborative attitude
 * Collaborate effectively with local and global teams, demonstrating
   sensitivity to different cultures and working styles
 * Initiate work independently as a self-starter and contribute ideas to improve
   how work is delivered
 * Prioritize key tasks effectively while managing multiple deliverables

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

 * Pursue the Chartered Financial Analyst credential
 * Earn a Master of Business Administration degree
 * Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or
   intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or
   improve accuracy in operational processes.


JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative
financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the
world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the
J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are
a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial
banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring
to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal
opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our
company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute,
including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation,
gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or
disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make
reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and
beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs
[https://careers.jpmorgan.com/us/en/how-we-hire/faqs] for more information about
requesting an accommodation.

spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment
professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations
take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define,
focus and realize their goals. title: Cloud Network Engineer
job_description:
Charger Logistics Inc. is a leading asset-based transportation company with over 20 years of experience delivering innovative logistics solutions. We have evolved into a world-class transport provider and continue to expand across North America.
We're looking for a Cloud Network Engineer to design, build and run the network that connects our cloud platforms, offices and terminals across North America. Our systems run 24/7 to support trucking and logistics operations, so the network has to be fast, secure and always available. You'll work closely with our infrastructure, SRE, security and development teams in Canada.
Please note this is a Contract opportunity for potential to convert in a permanent role..

Design, build and manage cloud networks (VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing, peering) across GCP, Azure and AWS.

title: People Generalist
job_description:
Who we are 
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as Twilio’s next People Generalist. 
About the job
This position is needed to support delivery of People priorities. This role supports a number of business functions and HRBPs located in the APJ region. You will be an integral part of the People Generalists team, reporting to the Global People Generalists Manager, and partnering closely with and supporting the work of international and functional HRBPs and COEs across the People team. 
Twilio is looking for a People Generalist who lives the Twilio Magic and has a demonstrated track record of providing advice and assistance with HR queries in a wide variety of areas including benefits & compensation, offboarding, global mobility and employee relations.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
Partner with the HRBP team supporting our APJ region functions to support program roll-outs and on-going process execution
Analyse HR data and trends across the organisation they support (e.g. headcount, attrition, performance) to generate insights, trends and prepare clear and customised reports, metrics and presentation materials for HRBPs and senior leadership to support decision-making
Own and manage performance management cases end-to-end, partnering with managers to ensure fair, consistent, and timely outcomes in line with company policy
Coach and guide managers through the performance management process, providing advice, documentation support, and best practice to build manager capability and ensure a positive employee experience
Support HR Leaders on ad hoc projects
Help to execute and where required lead business led initiatives (re-orgs, job role and level assessments, etc)
Partner cross functionally with key stakeholders: Talent Management, IT, ER, HR operations, Compliance, Recruiting, Compensation, etc. to ensure communications, program, and process alignment
Program Management- annual cyclical events such as calibration, pulse surveys etc
Maintain confidentiality of core HR data and projects
Qualifications 
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
Required:
3+ years experience in an HR role in a matrixed organisation
Ability to take initiative and be a self-starter
You are a decisive problem solver with a "get it done" attitude who will thrive in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
Strong ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and exercise judgment with sensitive and confidential issues
Strong data analysis skills and ability to share recommendations with stakeholders
Data Storytelling: Connects internal data with external benchmarks to provide actionable executive insights
AI-Enabled Efficiency: Enhances productivity through the sensible and strategic usage of AI tools.
Demonstrates employee focus and managing proactive communication to ensure optimum HR support
Leads the alignment between GTM and marketing HRBPs and COEs to ensure programs are scalable and reflect unique functional needs.
Keen to continue learning and developing their skill set, having a growth mindset
Strong ability to identify process gaps and improvement opportunities 
Desired:
Proficiency with HR systems, such as Workday and ServiceNow 
Location
This role will be remote, and based in India.
Travel 
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.
Stay alert to recruitment fraud
We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. 
Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. HR generalist Performance management Data analysis Data storytelling HR metrics Employee relations Global mobility Compensation Benefits administration Offboarding Stakeholder management Process improvement Growth mindset Workday ServiceNow AI tools Candidates must have at least 3 years of HR experience in a matrixed organization and possess strong data analysis and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in HR systems like Workday and ServiceNow is desired, along with a growth mindset and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

title: Asset Management - Fund Controller - Vice President
job_description:
Unlock your potential to shape valuation rigor and reporting that improves
controls, transparency, and investment decision-making across private markets.

As a Private Asset Valuation Vice President in the Global Special Situations
team, you own periodic valuations across a range of private credit and private
equity assets and deliver reporting to a broad stakeholder base. You serve as
the primary point of coordination between external valuers, the investment team,
the finance team, and the Chief Investment Officers to ensure accuracy, robust
controls, and timely delivery in line with fund governing documents and fair
value standards. You partner with the Head of Finance, the Chief Operating
Officer, deal support, and marketing to translate portfolio activity into clear
financial insights.

Job Responsibilities:

 * Lead end-to-end periodic valuations across the private asset portfolio,
   spanning private credit (performing, stressed, and distressed) and private
   equity investments
 * Coordinate the valuation process across external valuers, the investment
   team, the finance team, and the Chief Investment Officers to ensure timely
   and accurate delivery aligned to fund governing documents and fair value
   standards
 * Direct preparation and reconciliation of quarterly net asset values,
   financial statements, income and expense accruals, commitments, and related
   fund accounting activities
 * Oversee accounting for portfolio companies, including wholly owned fund
   subsidiaries and operating companies
 * Review fund administrator work outputs to confirm quality standards and
   delivery timelines are met
 * Produce daily reporting covering profit and loss, cash, and expenses,
   highlighting key drivers and trends
 * Partner with the broader team and key stakeholders to deliver portfolio and
   investor information that supports decision-making
 * Prepare materials for valuation and risk committees and support fund board
   meetings, including board packs and minute-taking
 * Support audit coordination and completion, including resolution of open items
   and alignment to annual audit timelines
 * Implement the new fund accounting system and build automated solutions to
   drive efficiencies across finance workstreams
 * Manage relationships with investors and internal stakeholders as a key point
   of contact, ensuring consistent, accurate, and timely reporting

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

 * Hold a recognised professional accounting qualification or demonstrate active
   progress toward qualification
 * Earn an Accounting and Finance degree with a strong academic background
 * Demonstrate experience in, or strong exposure to, valuation of private assets
   across private credit and private equity
 * Apply familiarity with International Private Equity and Venture Capital
   valuation guidelines and United States Generally Accepted Accounting
   Principles fair value principles
 * Evidence ability to coordinate multi-party valuation processes involving
   external valuers, investment professionals, and senior leadership
 * Show understanding of alternative fund structures, including distressed and
   special situations, opportunistic performing credit, and event-driven
   strategies
 * Communicate complex financial information clearly and confidently to senior
   stakeholders while working independently with cross-functional teams
 * Prioritize competing deliverables under pressure with strong organisation,
   attention to detail, and problem-solving skills

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

 * Demonstrate ability to identify opportunities for artificial intelligence and
   automation integration within operational workflows, including experience
   evaluating, implementing, or governing solutions to achieve scalable process
   improvements and strategic objectives
 * Evidence experience implementing a fund accounting system and delivering
   automation to reduce manual effort and improve controls
 * Show exposure to supporting fund formation and structuring activities for new
   fund launches
 * Demonstrate experience preparing materials for valuation and risk committees
   and supporting fund board governance activities


JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative
financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the
world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the
J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are
a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial
banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring
to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal
opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our
company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute,
including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation,
gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or
disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make
reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and
beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs
[https://careers.jpmorgan.com/us/en/how-we-hire/faqs] for more information about
requesting an accommodation.


J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment
management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals,
advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full
spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment
professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations
take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define,
focus and realize their goals. Private asset valuation Fund accounting Private credit Private equity Financial reporting Valuation controls Stakeholder management US GAAP Financial analysis Portfolio management Audit coordination Automation Risk management Fund governance Reconciliation Candidates must hold a professional accounting qualification and possess a degree in Accounting and Finance with strong experience in private asset valuation. Proficiency in US GAAP and the ability to communicate complex financial data to senior stakeholders are essential for this role.

title: Director, International Tax Accounting & Reporting
job_description:
Key Responsibilities

 * Coordinate with service providers and tax team members to prepare, review,
   and assess quarterly and annual ASC 740 tax provisions and FIN 48 uncertain
   tax position requirements for the Company's foreign entities. 
 * Support the implementation and ongoing compliance of SOX 404 tax-related
   internal controls associated with quarterly and annual tax provision
   processes. 
 * Respond to quarterly and annual audit inquiries and provide technical
   analysis and supporting documentation for tax accounting positions. 
 * Assist in the preparation and review of tax provision entries, tax accounting
   analyses, and tax disclosures included in local GAAP statutory financial
   statements for foreign entities. 
 * Coordinate with service providers and the accounting team to ensure the
   timely preparation, review, and filing of corporate income tax returns and
   estimated tax payments for foreign entities. 
 * Review and analyze corporate income tax returns and related filings for
   foreign entities, including assessing significant tax positions, identifying
   technical issues, and ensuring appropriate documentation of filing
   positions. 
 * Perform return-to-provision (RTP) analyses, including reconciliations,
   identification and analysis of material adjustments, supporting
   documentation, and preparation of related journal entries. 
 * Support the management of international tax audits and tax authority
   inquiries, including responding to information requests, conducting technical
   research, and assessing potential tax exposures. 
 * Analyze and document intercompany transactions and operating structures to
   support transfer pricing compliance and identify potential tax risks. 
 * Prepare and review OECD Transfer Pricing Master Files, Local Files,
   benchmarking studies, and intercompany agreements to ensure alignment with
   the Company's transfer pricing policies. 
 * Prepare technical analyses and supporting documentation related to OECD and
   international tax requirements, including BEPS Pillar Two, Country-by-Country
   Reporting (CbCR), and EU Public CbCR compliance. 
 * Monitor international tax legislation, regulatory developments, and tax
   authority guidance, assess their impact on the Company, and support
   management in evaluating potential tax consequences and opportunities.

 

Qualifications
Education

 * Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or an equivalent
   educational background.
 * Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, ACCA, or other relevant professional
   certification.

 

Experience

 * Minimum of 8 years of experience in international tax, tax accounting,
   corporate taxation, public accounting, or a related finance function.
 * Significant experience with ASC 740 tax provision reporting, international
   tax compliance, transfer pricing, and tax accounting requirements.
 * Experience managing external service providers, auditors, and tax authorities
   across multiple jurisdictions.
 * Experience supporting multinational organizations and complex cross-border
   tax structures preferred.

 

Technical Skills

 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
 * Experience working with ERP and financial systems such as Oracle, SAP,
   Workday, or similar platforms.
 * Experience with tax provision, compliance, and reporting systems.
 * Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex tax
   regulations and evaluate financial and tax impacts.
 * Ability to analyze large data sets, perform reconciliations, and prepare
   detailed technical documentation.

 

Key Competencies

 * Strong technical knowledge of international taxation, tax accounting, and
   transfer pricing principles.
 * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain
   complex tax matters to a variety of stakeholders.
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced global
   environment.
 * Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills with the ability to
   work effectively across functions and geographies.
    


Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services
and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments -
creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who
count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference
and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.


Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all
positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national

of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

title: Product Marketing Manager
job_description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Experience: 4-5
Location: Bengaluru, India (hybrid)
AppViewX is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX ONE platform that provides complete certificate lifecycle management and PKI-as-a-Service using streamlined automation workflows to prevent outages, reduce security incidents, and enable crypto-agility. AppViewX is also certified as a Great Place to Work in India, cementing us as an employer of choice.
Our Values
At AppViewX, our values reflect how we work together in practice—not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.
Clarity: We interact with transparency, simplicity, and shared purpose.
Unity: We build unity through mutual respect, trust, and collaboration.
Innovation: We stay curious, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement.
Speed: We act with urgency, focus, and follow-through to deliver results fast.
Precision: We bring accuracy, consistency, and care to everything we do.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who can translate technical product capabilities into clear customer value, compelling positioning, and practical go-to-market content. This role is ideal for someone with strong product marketing experience in a cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology environment, and a solid understanding of security fundamentals.
You will work closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Project Management teams to support product launches, enable sales conversations, build competitive insights, and create customer-facing and sales-facing content that helps move opportunities through the funnel.
You are customer-focused, collaborative, curious, and comfortable working across technical and business stakeholders. You bring strong communication skills, a practical understanding of how sales teams sell, and a “will get the job done” attitude.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop clear messaging, positioning, value propositions, and product narratives for AppViewX solutions and key capabilities.
Create sales enablement content such as pitch decks, solution briefs, battlecards, talk tracks, objection handling guides, sales plays, FAQs, and customer-facing assets.
Partner with sales teams to understand buyer pain points, deal challenges, competitive pressure, and content needs across different stages of the sales cycle.
Support product launches by working closely with Product Management, Project Management, Marketing, and cross-functional teams on launch messaging, content, enablement, and internal readiness.
Work with the marketing team to support campaigns, events, webinars, and integrated programs with persona-relevant messaging and content.
Build and maintain competitive intelligence, including competitor positioning, battlecards, win/loss insights, market trends, and differentiation points.
Help define and execute sales plays by identifying target personas, pain points, triggers, messages, proof points, and supporting assets.
Collaborate with Customer Success and customer-facing teams to capture customer use cases, outcomes, stories, and feedback that can inform content and messaging.
Develop compelling presentations, web copy, product collateral, campaign content, and enablement materials that communicate the product story clearly.
Stay current on cybersecurity trends, market dynamics, buyer priorities, and customer needs to continuously improve messaging and go-to-market execution.
Key Skills & Competencies:
6 to 8 years of experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, sales enablement, field marketing, customer marketing, sales, or customer success, with meaningful exposure to product marketing responsibilities.
Experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, enterprise software, infrastructure, identity, cloud, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, machine identity, or related technology categories is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of security fundamentals and the ability to explain technical concepts in simple, customer-relevant language.
Ability to understand customer pain points, translate them into messaging, and create content that helps sales teams progress opportunities.
Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to create crisp, structured, and compelling content for both technical and business audiences.
Experience creating sales enablement assets such as battlecards, sales plays, pitch decks, solution briefs, competitive positioning, and objection handling content.
Ability to work cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Project Management teams.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, managing multiple priorities, and balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Customer-centric mindset with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders, synthesize feedback, and turn insights into actionable content.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Technical degree or engineering background is preferred; MBA or marketing degree is a plus.
Success Measures:
Sales teams are equipped with clear, practical, and up-to-date content that helps them communicate value and address buyer objections.
Product launches are supported with strong messaging, enablement, collateral, and cross-functional readiness.
Campaigns and events are strengthened with persona-relevant messaging, differentiated value propositions, and compelling content.
Competitive intelligence and battlecards are current, actionable, and regularly used by the field.
Product marketing content is clear, customer-focused, and aligned with AppViewX’s platform narrative and go-to-market priorities.
Why AppViewX?
AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law. Product Marketing Cybersecurity SaaS Sales Enablement Go-to-market Strategy Competitive Intelligence Messaging Positioning Content Creation Cross-functional Collaboration PKI Certificate Lifecycle Management Enterprise Software Technical Writing Market Analysis Stakeholder Management Requires 6 to 8 years of experience in product marketing or related fields, preferably within cybersecurity or enterprise software. Candidates should possess strong communication skills and a bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business field.

title: Sr Software Engineer (Kubernetes Operators & Controllers, Go)
job_description:
Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
What you get to do in this role:
You will design, build, and operate features and services within the cloud-native platform, delivering well-defined work from implementation through to production with limited guidance.
You will break features down into clear, executable tasks and deliver them iteratively, raising risks and trade-offs as you find them.
You will collaborate with staff and senior engineers to align your work with the team’s designs and the platform’s standards.
You will contribute to the reliability, scalability, and operability of what you build — writing tests and instrumentation, improving runbooks, and participating in on-call.
You will spend nearly all of your time hands-on building — automation, tooling, and platform services that other teams depend on.
You will support junior engineers through code review, pairing, and sharing what you learn.
Qualifications
To be successful in this role you have:
Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering work — whether using AI-powered coding and operational tooling, automating workflows, or reasoning about how AI changes the way software and infrastructure are built.
3+ years building production software, with exposure to deploying and operating workloads on Kubernetes.
Some hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) and its core compute and networking primitives.
A track record of reliably delivering features and improvements as a productive member of an engineering team.
Working knowledge of containers, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based development workflows.
Good programming skills in Go (or another systems language with a willingness to work primarily in Go).
It also helps if you have:
Experience running workloads on managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
Familiarity with GitOps-based delivery and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
Exposure to observability tooling — metrics, logging, and dashboards.
Familiarity with networking and security fundamentals — DNS, TLS, and IAM.
Experience participating in an on-call rotation.
Additional Information
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [email protected] for assistance. 
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Regional Network & Firewall Manager (EEME)
job_description:
Company Description
SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.
Job Description
Join SGS as a Regional Network & Firewall Manager and play a key role in securing and evolving network infrastructure across the EEME region. You will work with regional and global IT teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable connectivity services supporting business operations across multiple countries.
Key Responsibilities
Manage and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, VPN, and next-generation firewalls.
Lead network security initiatives aligned with global cybersecurity standards and Zero Trust principles.
Design, implement, and support network solutions in both on-premises and cloud environments (primarily Azure).
Provide expert-level troubleshooting and technical leadership for complex networking and firewall environments.
Support regional infrastructure projects, cloud transformation programs, and business-critical deployments.
Collaborate with country IT teams, vendors, and global stakeholders to improve performance, resilience, and security.
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, or infrastructure operations.
Strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking technologies.
Hands-on experience with Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, or similar platforms.
Good understanding of cloud networking and security in Microsoft Azure.
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an international environment. 
Fluent English.
Nice to Have
CCNP or equivalent certifications.
Experience with SD-WAN, Zero Trust, UC/VoIP solutions, and cloud transformation projects.
Additional Information
Why Join Us?
Regional impact across EEME.
Exposure to modern networking, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies.
Participation in strategic global IT initiatives.
Opportunities for technical leadership and professional growth. Network engineering Network security WAN LAN Wi-Fi SD-WAN VPN Firewalls Azure Routing Switching TCP/IP DNS DHCP Zero Trust Infrastructure operations Requires at least 5 years of experience in network engineering or infrastructure operations with strong expertise in routing, switching, and firewall platforms. Candidates should have a solid understanding of cloud networking, specifically within Microsoft Azure, and possess strong communication skills.

title: Lead Material Planner - Bulk Material Mgmt (DMD)
job_description:
Requisition ID: 295045 
Relocation Authorized: National/International - Single 
Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project 
Work Location: Dahej
Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects:
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. 
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations. 
Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report. 
Bechtel’s India offices support the execution of projects and services around the world. Working seamlessly with Bechtel’s global business units, project sites, customers, and suppliers, our teams have delivered more than 125 projects since 1994. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world.
Project Overview:
Bechtel is seeking to work with a major Indian corporation to provide Project Management Consultant (PMC) Services and Engineering Procurement and Construction Management (EPCM) Services for offsites and utilities (OSBL) for a multi-billion-dollar upgrade / expansion of their existing petrochemical facilities in India. The PMC Services will be led out of India with personnel deployed in Mumbai region, the project sites in India, as well as several key contractor locations across India. The EPCM Services for OSBL will be led out of Bechtel’s India offices. You will bring your experience and expertise to the PMC role while working within the customer’s organization as part of an integrated team. As part of this team, you will commit to supporting the client’s goals while promoting our values of fairness, diversity, inclusion, trust, and collaboration guided by our Vision, Values and Commitments.
Job Summary:
The Lead Field Planner- Bulks is responsible for supporting the Bulk Materials Manager with planning and scheduling for the jobsite; schedule development, maintenance, monitoring and recovery planning; 3-week and 90-day lookaheads; subject schedule development; assimilation of reports and general support activities. 
Major Responsibilities:
Develop and coordinate quantity estimates using parameters for all bulk commodities. 
Performs routine data analysis and development, as directed. 
Support in the implementation of the project Integrated Materials Management Program, and monitor its execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Controls and Construction. 
Coordinate the project plan for identifying bulk materials with Engineering, along with information and data that will be exported from Engineering automation tools to downstream Supply Chain, Construction, and Project Control systems Monitor acquisition progress for items on the equipment list for completeness, progress, and that requisition issue dates support project detail schedules. 
Establish and facilitate coordination with commodity-specific functions in Engineering, Supply Chain, Construction, and Project Controls, ensuring adherence to execution plan and performance in the right sequence, and material availability in support of installation plans.
Monitor data integration execution for consistency with plan and that exchange timing support the project requirements.
Prepare commodity-specific cross-functional reports communicating acquisition progress identifying issues requiring attention or escalation.
Interface between Construction and Supply Chain to identify and acquire goods and establish delivery dates for material requirements resulting from design changes, rework, contingency/work arounds, scope changes. 
At jobsite locations, provide detailed coordination with Field Engineering, acting as a liaison to upstream Engineering functions, design office Supply Chain functions, and suppliers and subcontractors, as necessary, to facilitate timely delivery of materials to support planned installation.
Determines work sequences for a specific discipline or specialty. Identifies inter-discipline constraints or interfaces that define activity sequence.
Reports schedule deviations for an assigned discipline or specialty and recommends corrective action/work around solutions for project considerations.
Liaises with Engineering and Supply chain to carry out analysis regarding material substitution when originally Engineered materials are not available to meet Construction needs.
Education and Experience Requirements:
Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Engineering, Business, Finance, Construction Management, with a minimum of 10 years of Planning & Scheduling experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience, The ideal candidate will have 4 years of field material planning experience.
Required Knowledge and Skills:
Demonstrated ability to be proactive in determining project direction and communicating that direction to the supervisor.
Must have an advanced working knowledge of Excel and Intermediate to advanced knowledge of the remainder of the Microsoft Office Suite.
Intermediate knowledge of Primavera (P6), TeamWorks, and SetRoute.
Proficient in other Bechtel Project Controls tools and processes.
Knowledge of standard industry automation tools used in construction planning. 
Skilled in oral and written communication, with demonstrated ability to present Project Controls information to management/client.
Demonstrated ability to motivate and interact with team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations.
Experience in planning supporting a Downstream Petrochemical/Refinery projects in the Americas, India or Middle-East.
Any experience in planning supporting a PMC project. Any experience in planning supporting a heavy industrial direct hire construction project.
Intermediate knowledge and understanding of engineering, procurement, contracts, construction, and startup work processes, as performed by Bechtel. 
Total Rewards/Benefits:
For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards
Diverse teams build the extraordinary:
As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.
We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.
Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Applicants with a disability, who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, may e-mail their request to acesstmt@bechtel.com Material planning Scheduling Primavera P6 Excel Project controls Supply chain management Construction planning Data analysis TeamWorks SetRoute Bulk material management Engineering coordination Procurement Reporting Problem-solving Communication Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Construction Management with at least 10 years of relevant planning and scheduling experience. Proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Office, and industry-standard automation tools is required.

title: Regional Network & Firewall Manager (EEME)
job_description:
Company Description
SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.
Job Description
Join SGS as a Regional Network & Firewall Manager and play a key role in securing and evolving network infrastructure across the EEME region. You will work with regional and global IT teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable connectivity services supporting business operations across multiple countries.
Key Responsibilities
Manage and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, VPN, and next-generation firewalls.
Lead network security initiatives aligned with global cybersecurity standards and Zero Trust principles.
Design, implement, and support network solutions in both on-premises and cloud environments (primarily Azure).
Provide expert-level troubleshooting and technical leadership for complex networking and firewall environments.
Support regional infrastructure projects, cloud transformation programs, and business-critical deployments.
Collaborate with country IT teams, vendors, and global stakeholders to improve performance, resilience, and security.
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, or infrastructure operations.
Strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking technologies.
Hands-on experience with Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, or similar platforms.
Good understanding of cloud networking and security in Microsoft Azure.
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an international environment. 
Fluent English.
Nice to Have
CCNP or equivalent certifications.
Experience with SD-WAN, Zero Trust, UC/VoIP solutions, and cloud transformation projects.
Additional Information
Why Join Us?
Regional impact across EEME.
Exposure to modern networking, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies.
Participation in strategic global IT initiatives.
Opportunities for technical leadership and professional growth. Network engineering Network security Firewall management WAN LAN Wi-Fi SD-WAN VPN Azure Routing Switching TCP/IP DNS DHCP Zero Trust Cloud networking Requires 5+ years of experience in network engineering or infrastructure operations with expertise in routing, switching, and firewall platforms. Candidates should have a strong understanding of cloud networking and security, particularly within Microsoft Azure.
