title: Senior Executive - Quality Auditor
job_description:
ADDITIONAL AND ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

 * Follow every aspect of SOP without fail. 
 * Complete received Audits for quality review and ensure quality output.
 * To achieve Quality SLA and quality production target.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication.
 * Follow project related protocols and instructions. 
 * Escalate issues, identify error trends.
 * Update all the required monitoring trackers. 
 * All emails from Leads/Manager should be answered promptly without fail.
 * Ensure to adhere with HIPAA compliance.
 * Good excel skills. 
 * Flexibility
 * Good Communication


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Perform comprehensive secondary quality audits on inpatient medical records
   reviewed by DRG Auditors.
 * Validate accuracy of principal and secondary diagnoses, procedures, POA
   indicators, discharge disposition, and final DRG assignment.
 * Ensure compliance with IPPS regulations, ICD-10-CM/PCS guidelines, official
   coding conventions, and payer/client-specific requirements.
 * Adhere strictly to all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without
   deviation.
 * Ensure 100% compliance with HIPAA and data security standards at all times.
   
   Use quality tools, 3M software, NLP tools, and internal systems effectively
   for audit and reporting activities.
 * Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
   for documentation and reporting.
 * Follow all project-specific protocols, workflows, and client instructions.


QUALIFICATIONS

Education - Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Nursing.

Certifications

One or more of the following mandatory certifications:

CCS – Certified Coding Specialist

CIC – Certified Inpatient Coder

CPC – Certified Professional Coder

Experience - 

Minimum 5 years of experience in Inpatient DRG coding or auditing.

Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a Quality Analyst or Quality Auditing role.

Preferred Qualifications (Desirable Criteria)

Prior experience conducting IP DRG quality audits.

Hands-on exposure to 3M encoder software and NLP tools.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including trackers, analysis, and
reporting.

Experience working in SLA-driven, high-compliance healthcare environments. Quality Auditing Inpatient DRG Coding ICD-10-CM/PCS IPPS Regulations HIPAA Compliance Microsoft Excel 3M Encoder Software NLP Tools Data Security Medical Record Review Communication Reporting Clinical Documentation Mentoring Training Requires a Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Nursing and mandatory certifications such as CCS, CIC, or CPC. Candidates must have at least 5 years of experience in Inpatient DRG coding and 1-2 years in a quality auditing role.

title: Business Development Associate (Freshers)
job_description:
Company Description
Playto Labs is a startup by IIT Kanpur alumni working to make kids future-ready through innovative curriculum and hardware kits.
We are pioneers in developing next-gen STEM and Robotics toys, games, and curriculum. Our products stand out as they enable kids to acquire future-ready skills through play, a unique approach in the market.
Playto Labs is building world-class products from India and has customers in 38 countries.
The current core team at Playto Labs has earlier built Skyfi Labs, where they developed 100+ experiential learning products for UG level students, authored papers in experiential learning and won awards. Those products have paying customers from 67 countries and are rated 4.6+/5 on Google and FB with 1000+ reviews. With such a background, the team is now working on building highly engaging learning-by-doing products for kids. Playto Labs has raised funding from some amazing angel investors who have successfully built and exited startups. Many of them are our customers too and love our products for their kids!
Job Description
We are seeking a motivated fresher to join our Business Development team as a Pre-sales Associate. In this entry-level role, you will support the sales cycle by researching prospects, qualifying leads, preparing proposals, and assisting in client demos. This is a great opportunity to learn sales strategies, client engagement, and business tools while working alongside experienced professionals.
Key Responsibilities:
● Qualify leads by initial outreach via calls, emails, and social media to understand client needs.
● Assist in scheduling demos, client meetings, and follow-ups to support the sales team.
● Track leads and opportunities in CRM systems.
● Collaboration with product team and team lead to gather information for client queries.
● Participate in team meetings to learn sales techniques and market trends.
● Achieve weekly/monthly targets for lead generation and outreach.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or any related field.
Only 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduates are eligible to apply.
Freshers only – candidates who are passionate about starting and building a career in Business Development.
Strong verbal communication skills in English.
Enthusiastic, proactive learner with excellent time management and a results-driven mindset.
No prior work experience required – comprehensive training will be provided.
Comfortable working with the international (US) market.
Willing to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast-paced sales environment.

Compensation: INR 4 - INR 4.25 - yearly Lead Qualification Sales Prospecting CRM Systems Client Engagement Verbal Communication Time Management Market Research Proposal Preparation Lead Generation Business Development Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in a business-related field and be a 2024, 2025, or 2026 graduate. Strong English verbal communication skills and a proactive, results-driven mindset are required for this entry-level role.

title: Fund Services. Supervisor Loan Operations
job_description:
Your Role:

 * Oversee and support a team of analysts, to ensure Service Level Agreements
   are met in an effective and efficient fashion.
 * Escalate client or staffing issues to your Manager in a timely manner.
 * Work with your Manager on KRIs and KPIs and collaborate on mitigating plans
   around risk and resource constraints.
 * Liaise with service providers, vendors, agents, counterparties and clients to
   ensure the timely resolution of issues and exceptions.
 * Review and assess the materiality of portfolio risk with respect to
   unsupported cash and position differences, as part of the sign off process.
 * Contribute towards projects and initiatives that aim to drive the business
   forward, as it relates to Loan Administration and processing.
 * Engage in the migration of tasks from other locations into your team, to
   ensure of a seamless transition, along with the conversion or launches of any
   new clients, as it relates to Loan holdings.
 * Actively engage in staff development conversations with the analyst team on a
   regular basis, to ensure members of the team understand their goals and
   continuously working towards them.
 * Contribute to the hiring process and seek the right candidates for the team.

About You:

 * Bachelor or Master level degree.
 * 4+ years in Financial Services with experience in leading people
 * Product knowledge, Domestic, Global and OTC security markets, Fixed Income
   and derivative product knowledge.
 * Excellent communication skills.
 * Strong customer service skills
 * Experience mentoring and coaching staff.
 * Knowledge of Hedge or Mutual Funds.
 * Professional accounting designation is an asset.

Our Benefits

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We
provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible
working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing
personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse

innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities.
Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all
aspects of the selection. title: Customer Experience Engineer, L1
job_description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
About the role
Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.
This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.
What you will do
Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.
Who you are
A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.
Even better if you have
Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third-party integrations.
Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
Contributed to an open-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.
You will thrive here if
You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.
You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.
You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.

Experience: 2+ yrs
Location: Bengaluru
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for a proactive and people-focused Associate / Senior Associate – HR to support and strengthen the organisation’s people function as the business continues to grow. This role combines HR business partnering, employee engagement, performance management, employee relations, and HR operations.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on HR professional who can build strong relationships with employees and managers, address people-related challenges, and help establish effective HR processes. You will play an important role in creating a positive employee experience, supporting business leaders, and developing scalable people practices in a fast-paced, multi-location operating environment.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with managers and employees to address day-to-day HR matters, workplace concerns, and employee relations issues.
Build strong relationships with business teams to understand workforce requirements, team structures, employee challenges, and talent needs.
Support managers with performance conversations, goal-setting, feedback, team dynamics, and people-related decisions.
Identify employee-related risks and collaborate with HR leadership to develop appropriate interventions.
Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, employee connects, pulse surveys, and feedback mechanisms.
Monitor employee feedback, identify recurring concerns, and coordinate timely resolution.
Manage key employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, confirmation, internal transfers, role changes, and exits.
Coordinate performance management cycles, including goal-setting, performance reviews, feedback, and performance improvement plans.
Identify learning and development needs and support training programmes and manager development initiatives.
Assist in developing, documenting, and implementing HR policies, processes, and people programmes.
Maintain accurate employee records, HR dashboards, and reports covering attrition, engagement, performance, and onboarding.
Support HR compliance, audits, documentation, and operational activities.
Collaborate with business leaders to improve employee experience, strengthen workplace culture, and support organisational effectiveness.
Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows and establish consistent, scalable people practices.
What Makes You a Great Fit
2–5 years of experience in HR, preferably in an HR generalist, HR Business Partner, or People Partner role.
Strong understanding of employee engagement, performance management, onboarding, employee relations, and HR operations.
Experience partnering with managers and employees across different levels of an organisation.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion, empathy, and sound judgement.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, hands-on approach to resolving workplace challenges.
Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where processes and systems are still evolving.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Familiarity with HR dashboards, people metrics, reporting tools, and HR information systems.
Experience in a startup, retail, FMCG, consumer internet, logistics, or other operations-intensive environment is an advantage.
A strong sense of ownership, adaptability, and commitment to building a positive employee experience. HR Business Partnering Employee Engagement Performance Management Employee Relations HR Operations Stakeholder Management Problem Solving Communication Onboarding HR Compliance Data Analysis Reporting Policy Development Talent Management Conflict Resolution The ideal candidate has 2–5 years of experience in HR generalist or business partner roles within fast-paced environments. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills are essential for this position.

title: UX Specialist
job_description:
Role Overview  
We are looking for a UX Specialist to collaborate with our team on a variety of
projects. This role involves designing seamless user experiences, creating
visually appealing interfaces, and ensuring usability across platforms. The work
may span multiple projects at once, so adaptability and strong collaboration are
key. We are also open to partnering with a group or agency specializing in UX,
in addition to individual applicants.  


This role requires approximately 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (ET) to
ensure effective collaboration with the team.  
This is an active opportunity, looking to hire immediately in India.


Key Responsibilities:  
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business goals and user
   needs.  
 * Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.  
 * Conduct a thorough audit of the existing website to identify usability gaps,
   design inconsistencies, and performance flaws.  
 * Ensure consistency in brand and design standards across projects.  
 * Conduct user research and usability testing to inform design decisions.  
 * Translate feedback into design iterations and refinements.  
 * Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.  
 * Develop a detailed UX improvement roadmap with clear, actionable
   recommendations to be handed off to the development team.  

Qualifications:  


 * Proven experience as a UX Designer, Specialist, or similar role.  
 * Strong understanding of UX principles, with a focus on best practices in the
   e-commerce domain. 
 * Strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design across web and mobile
   platforms.  
 * Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe
   XD).  
 * Demonstrated expertise in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), including
   experience using analytics and behavioural insights to drive design
   decisions.  
 * Understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and usability best
   practices.  
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
 * Ability to manage priorities across multiple projects.  


 UX Design Wireframing Prototyping User Research Usability Testing Conversion Rate Optimization Figma Sketch Adobe XD Responsive Design Accessibility E-commerce Data Analytics Behavioral Insights Interaction Design Candidates must have proven experience in UX design with a strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design across web and mobile platforms. Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD and expertise in Conversion Rate Optimization are essential for this role.

title: Data Scientist - Evaluations, Chanakya
job_description:
ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is
developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research,
models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI
genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public
institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam
partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED,
IDFC, and LIC.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an intellectually demanding role. The Data Scientist anchors the
evaluations function for this vertical — designing, building, and maintaining
evaluation frameworks that measure model and system quality in operational
context. You are not running standard benchmarks. You are building
domain-specific eval harnesses for high-stakes use cases where a wrong answer
carries real consequences.

You will work closely with the MLOps Engineer, the PM, and the deployment team.
The evaluations you design are the mechanism by which the team determines
whether what we've built is good enough to deploy — and whether it stays good
after deployment.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

•  Design and build evaluation frameworks for Sarvam's AI outputs across
domain-specific requirements: document comprehension, command summarisation,
geospatial reasoning, enterprise workflow automation, and others as they emerge

•  Define quality metrics in collaboration with domain experts and clients;
translate operational requirements into measurable, defensible signals

•  Run structured evaluation cycles pre- and post-deployment; build dashboards
that surface model quality in production

•  Identify failure modes, edge cases, and distribution shifts — with the bias
of someone looking for what's wrong, not confirming what's right

•  Collaborate with the MLOps Engineer to operationalise eval pipelines —
automated, triggered by deployment events, versioned, and reproducible

•  Build and manage domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning, evaluation, and
benchmarking — including human annotation workflows where needed

•  Publish internal findings and quality reports that feed the product and
engineering roadmap

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

•  3–6 years in data science, ML research, or applied AI; at least 2 years
working with LLMs in production contexts

•   Strong statistics and probability fundamentals — you understand what makes
an evaluation valid and what makes it misleading

•   Experience designing evaluation frameworks from scratch: custom metrics,
inter-rater reliability, red-teaming methodologies

•   Python proficiency; comfort with pandas, NumPy, HuggingFace datasets, RAGAS,
EleutherAI Eval Harness, LangSmith, or equivalent

•   Experience with prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, or RLHF in applied
settings

•   Ability to work with unstructured domain data: PDFs, doctrine documents,
transcripts, and field reports

 


BONUS POINTS

•  Prior work in high-stakes domains (healthcare, legal, defence, finance) where
output quality carries real-world consequences

•   Red-teaming or adversarial evaluation experience

 

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not
people who

match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you
believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

 


WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for
India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real
population-scale impact.

•  Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who
move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

•  High ownership and high impact, from day one

•   Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we
think about problems

•   You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns,
works, and communicates

 

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the
place to be. Data Science Machine Learning LLMs Evaluation Frameworks Python Statistics Probability Prompt Engineering Model Fine-tuning RLHF MLOps Pandas NumPy HuggingFace RAGAS Red-teaming Candidates should have 3–6 years of experience in data science or ML research, with at least 2 years specifically working with LLMs in production. Strong proficiency in Python, statistical fundamentals, and experience building custom evaluation frameworks are essential for this role.

title: Frontend Engineer, Chanakya
job_description:
ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is
developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research,
models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI
genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public
institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam
partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED,
IDFC, and LIC.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

These are not form-and-table frontend roles. The frontend engineers on this team
build the interfaces that sit on top of Sarvam's AI stack in some of the most
demanding environments in the country. You will own the frontend layer of
multiple 'atoms' — replicable, deployable product components — and work closely
with backend engineers, the PM, and the deployment team. These interfaces must
work in offline-first, low-bandwidth, hardened client environments, not just on
a MacBook over broadband.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

•  Design and build performant, production-grade frontend interfaces for
strategic sector and enterprise AI use cases: geospatial overlays, simulation
UIs, natural language access layers, ontology viewers, data ingestion
dashboards, and complex enterprise workflows

•  Own the frontend layer of atoms end-to-end — from component architecture to
deployment in client-embedded environments

•  Collaborate with backend engineers and the PM to ship complete, scoped atoms
into the hands of real users

•  Build for constrained environments: offline-first, low-bandwidth, limited
hardware — not the idealised development environment

• Contribute to shared frontend infrastructure: component libraries, design
system, and state management patterns

•  Participate in field testing and client feedback loops with Strategic
Deployment Engineers across strategic sector and complex enterprise accounts

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

•  3–6 years in frontend engineering with shipped, production-grade products

•  Deep React proficiency; TypeScript; modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent);
strong component architecture instincts

•  State management proficiency: Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or equivalent; strong
async data patterns

•  Data visualisation experience: D3.js, Mapbox/Leaflet, Deck.gl for geospatial,
Recharts, or equivalent — at least one in production

•  REST and WebSocket API integration; sufficient backend awareness to debug
across the boundary

•  Performance engineering: bundle optimisation, lazy loading, and rendering
performance in low-resource environments

 


BONUS POINTS

•  WebGL or Three.js for 3D visualisation

•  Electron or desktop app experience

•  Offline-first or PWA architecture

•  Prior work on dashboards, command-and-control UIs, or complex enterprise
tooling

 

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not
people who

match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you
believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

 


WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for
India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real
population-scale impact.

•  Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who
move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

•  High ownership and high impact, from day one

•  Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we
think about problems

•  You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns,
works, and communicates

 

 

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the
place to be. Candidates must have experience with state management, data visualization, and building for low-resource or offline-first environments.

title: Actuarial
job_description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟰𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟰𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟰-𝟭𝟰 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
Experience: 1+ yrs
Location: India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Actuarial Analyst with a strong interest in health insurance, statistical modelling, and risk assessment. The ideal candidate will support actuarial analysis, pricing, reserving, product development, and portfolio performance evaluation to help drive informed business decisions.
This role is suited for a professional with a strong quantitative foundation and an understanding of insurance principles who can translate complex data into meaningful insights. You will work with actuarial, underwriting, claims, finance, and product teams to evaluate risk, improve pricing accuracy, monitor profitability, and support the development of sustainable health insurance products.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse health insurance policy, premium, claims, and customer data to identify trends, patterns, and emerging risks.
Support the development and review of actuarial pricing models for health insurance products.
Assist in estimating claims frequency, severity, expected claims costs, and loss ratios.
Conduct experience studies to evaluate actual performance against actuarial assumptions.
Support reserving activities, including the analysis of incurred claims, outstanding claims, and claims development patterns.
Evaluate portfolio profitability and identify factors affecting underwriting performance and claims costs.
Develop statistical models and analytical tools to support pricing, forecasting, risk assessment, and business planning.
Assist in monitoring key actuarial metrics, including claim ratios, premium adequacy, and portfolio performance.
Prepare actuarial reports, dashboards, presentations, and analytical summaries for internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with underwriting, claims, finance, product, and data teams to support business decisions.
Support health insurance product development by analysing pricing assumptions, benefits, customer segments, and risk profiles.
Validate data quality, maintain accurate analytical documentation, and ensure consistency in modelling assumptions.
Assist with regulatory reporting and compliance-related actuarial requirements, as applicable.
Identify opportunities to improve actuarial models, analytical processes, and reporting efficiency.
What Makes You a Great Fit
1+ years of relevant experience in actuarial analysis, insurance analytics, risk modelling, or a related quantitative role.
Strong interest in health insurance, including claims analysis, pricing, underwriting, and product profitability.
A degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
Progress toward professional actuarial qualifications from bodies such as the Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI) or the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) is an advantage.
Strong analytical, mathematical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience analysing structured datasets.
Familiarity with SQL, Python, R, or statistical modelling tools is an advantage.
Understanding of insurance concepts such as premiums, claims reserves, loss ratios, risk pooling, and underwriting.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret complex data accurately.
Good communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly.
Ability to collaborate across teams, manage multiple priorities, and work independently when required.
A proactive learning mindset and interest in developing expertise in health insurance actuarial practices. Actuarial analysis Health insurance Statistical modelling Risk assessment Pricing Reserving Product development Portfolio performance Microsoft Excel SQL Python R Data analysis Underwriting Claims analysis Financial reporting Candidates should have at least one year of experience in actuarial analysis or a related quantitative field and a degree in a relevant discipline. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required, with additional skills in SQL, Python, or R considered an advantage.

title: Corporate Planning & Management-Bengaluru-Associate-Risk Governance
job_description:
The Lifecycle Management team (LCM) sits within Global Procurement under
Corporate Planning & Management (CPM). 

Professionals in CPM have an analytical mindset, exhibit intellectual curiosity
and are from diverse academic backgrounds. The Analyst role is based in
Bengaluru and sits within TPRM’s Lifecycle Management Team capability, which
acts as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders helping them
understand and deliver on the firm’s third party risk framework.

The role requires collaboration with different functions across the firm on a
regular basis, for example, Program Design and Compliance (PDC), Quality
Assurance (QA), Data Analytics and Reporting (DAR), Tooling, Transformation and
Risk Management, in addition to other Global Procurement functions such as
Sourcing and Global Procurement Operations.

Additionally, the role requires an ability to work independently, managing TPRM
Business processes by reviewing/validating/approving TPRM workflows, engaging
business stakeholders to provide guidance on the various processes to ensure
program compliance and simultaneously maintaining a consistent book of work.

OUR IMPACT

The Lifecycle Management team plays a critical role in protecting the firm while
enabling business activity. We ensure vendor usage is appropriately authorized,
accurately recorded, and used in accordance with contractual terms, regulatory
requirements, and firm policies. By maintaining disciplined controls, scalable
processes, and robust documentation, LCM supports audit readiness, regulatory
compliance, and financial transparency.

At the same time, LCM is a key contributor to the firm’s overall client and
supplier experience. Through timely issue resolution, proactive communication,
and ongoing process improvements, the team helps internal stakeholders navigate
systems and workflows efficiently and confidently.

Key Responsibilities

 1. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
    policies, standards, and systems, including vendor onboarding, offboarding,
    and oversight requirements.

 2. Address stakeholder inquiries promptly and accurately, providing clear
    guidance on vendor workflows and program requirements.

 3. Monitor queues and complete tasks across all vendor workflows accurately,
    efficiently, and in a timely manner.

 4. Build strong relationships firmwide by serving as a key advisor to internal
    stakeholders helping divisions understand and navigate third-party risk
    requirements.

 5. Provide transparency and support to divisions to ensure consistent
    compliance with the firm’s Vendor Management program.

 6. Engage with Risk Partners across the organization (e.g. compliance,
    technology), as needed, to assist the divisions if required

 7. Deliver on regional expectations and contribute actively to the goals of the
    TPRM Bengaluru team.

 8. Drive continuous process improvement and innovation, proactively identifying
    operational gaps and providing input for framework enhancements.

 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 1. Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification with an excellent
    academic record.

 2. 1 to 4 years’ experience in risk management, third-party risk management.

 3. Strong risk management and control mindset, with the ability to support and
    enable commercial outcomes.

 4. Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and
    exemplary attention to detail.

 5. Highly organized with the ability to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver
    under pressure to tight deadlines.

 6. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (both written and verbal),
    with the ability to adapt to a dynamic and changing organization.

 7. Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to de-escalate
    challenging situations and build consensus across divisions.

 8. Collaborative team player capable of coordinating complex activities with
    multiple interdependencies across global, cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 1. Third Party Risk Management experience

 2. Strong customer service mindset and user experience focus

 3. Exposure to control and risk management processes

 4. Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

 5. Prior experience supporting audits, internal reviews, or regulatory
    examinations.

About GS 

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities
and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services
to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations,
financial institutions, governments and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm
is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial
centers around the world. Third-party risk management Risk governance Vendor management Compliance Stakeholder management Analytical thinking Problem-solving Process improvement Data analytics Quality assurance Regulatory compliance Communication Interpersonal skills Documentation Audit readiness Candidates must hold a relevant bachelor's degree and possess 1 to 4 years of experience in risk management or third-party risk management. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills are essential for success in this role.

title: Senior Tax Analyst - Sales and Use Tax Compliance and Reporting
job_description:
Key Responsibilities

 * Review monthly state sales and use tax returns, tax payments, and other tax
   filings. 
 * Gather, analyze, and validate sales and use tax data to support compliance
   and reporting requirements. 
 * Prepare tax accounting entries related to sales and use tax activities. 
 * Research, analyze, interpret, and apply sales and use tax laws to support tax
   filing positions. 
 * Manage sales and use tax registrations, renewals, and account closures. 
 * Monitor sales and use tax accounts to ensure ongoing compliance with
   applicable regulations.
 * Assist in the management of state sales and use tax audits, including
   gathering supporting documentation, responding to information requests, and
   performing related research and analysis. 
 * Respond to sales and use tax notices and communicate with state and local
   taxing authorities as needed. 
 * Maintain the tax notice log and participate in regular reviews with tax team
   members to ensure timely resolution of notices and minimize assessments. 
 * Respond to sales and use tax inquiries and support internal business groups
   with tax-related requests and documentation. 
 * Prepare and maintain resale and exemption certificates and ensure records are
   accurately stored and maintained within Vertex Series O. 
 * Support the state income tax team with the review of current and amended
   state income tax returns.

 

Qualifications
Education

 * Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or an equivalent
   educational background.

 

Experience

 * Minimum of 4 years of experience in indirect tax, sales and use tax
   compliance, tax accounting, public accounting.
 * Experience supporting multi-state sales and use tax filings, tax audits, and
   tax reporting activities preferred.
 * Experience working in a multinational or shared services environment
   preferred.

 

Technical Skills

 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
 * Experience working with ERP and financial systems such as Oracle, SAP,
   Workday, or similar platforms.
 * Experience with indirect tax compliance and reporting systems such as Vertex,
   OneSource, Avalara, or similar tax applications preferred.
 * Ability to analyze large data sets, prepare reconciliations, and maintain
   accurate tax records.

 

Key Competencies

 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced
   environment.
 * Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
    


Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services
and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments -
creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who
count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference
and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

title: Lead Offline Marketing
job_description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟳𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟮𝟱𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟳-𝟭𝟮.𝟱 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
Experience: 7+ yrs
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Lead – Offline Marketing to plan, lead, and scale localised offline marketing initiatives across multiple regions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in pharma, healthcare, or doctor-centric events, along with the ability to develop structured marketing programmes that strengthen brand visibility, build strategic partnerships, and generate measurable business outcomes.
This role focuses on centralised strategy, funnel-based campaign planning, team leadership, and governance rather than day-to-day event logistics. You will work closely with branch leaders and local marketing coordinators to develop proactive marketing calendars, establish repeatable engagement models, and ensure consistent brand experiences across locations.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and manage annual and quarterly offline marketing strategies and calendars aligned with business goals and sales funnel targets.
Identify regional marketing opportunities proactively and develop structured playbooks for top-, mid-, and bottom-of-funnel initiatives.
Plan local brand awareness campaigns, sponsorships, association partnerships, and healthcare ecosystem engagement programmes.
Design educational seminars, knowledge-sharing sessions, curated group engagements, and relationship-building events.
Develop high-intent engagement formats, including invitation-only roundtables and curated meetings with doctors, high-net-worth individuals, and other priority audiences.
Lead, mentor, and support branch-level marketing coordinators responsible for on-ground execution.
Provide event briefs, target audience guidelines, messaging frameworks, and performance metrics to regional teams.
Build strategic relationships with hospitals, medical associations, healthcare professionals, and relevant local partners.
Create repeatable event formats and scalable engagement models that can be implemented consistently across cities.
Establish premium brand experience guidelines, event standards, and SOPs to maintain consistency across regions.
Allocate and monitor regional marketing budgets, assess ROI, and optimise spending based on engagement and funnel performance.
Develop vendor frameworks and negotiation guidelines to improve cost efficiency and event quality.
Establish compliance protocols, approval workflows, documentation standards, and audit-ready processes.
Review regional performance reports, identify improvement opportunities, and share insights with senior marketing leadership.
What Makes You a Great Fit
7+ years of experience in offline marketing, event marketing, or field marketing, preferably within pharma, healthcare, or doctor-centric events.
Proven experience planning and managing marketing programmes across multiple branches, regions, or locations.
Strong understanding of funnel-based marketing, brand awareness initiatives, relationship marketing, and audience engagement.
Experience coordinating with senior stakeholders, healthcare professionals, hospitals, associations, and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, provide strategic direction, and drive accountability for execution.
Strong expertise in event planning frameworks, partnership development, vendor management, and budget oversight.
Ability to define success metrics, evaluate ROI, and connect offline marketing activities with business outcomes.
Excellent communication, coordination, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Understanding of compliance requirements, approval processes, and documentation practices for healthcare-related engagements.
Ability to handle confidential client information with discretion and professionalism.
Willingness to travel as required to support regional marketing initiatives and stakeholder engagements.
A graduate degree in any discipline is required. Candidates must possess strong strategic planning, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with a graduate degree.

title: Senior Tax Analyst - Tax Accounting & Reporting
job_description:
Key Responsibilities

 * Assist in the preparation of workpapers and supporting documentation for
   quarterly and annual income tax provision requirements. 
 * Support SOX 404 compliance activities and internal control requirements
   related to quarterly and annual tax provision processes. 
 * Assist in responding to external auditor inquiries and requests during
   quarterly and annual audits. 
 * Prepare workpapers supporting the consolidated federal income tax return,
   estimated tax payments, and other federal tax filings, and assist with the
   review of deliverables prepared by co-sourcing partners. 
 * Research, analyze, interpret, and apply federal, state, and international tax
   laws to support tax filing positions. 
 * Prepare and maintain GILTI and Subpart F calculations and related supporting
   documentation for U.S. international tax reporting.

 

Qualifications
Education

 * Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or an equivalent educational background.

 

Experience

 * Minimum 4 years of experience in corporate taxation, tax accounting, public
   accounting.
 * Experience supporting income tax provision processes, tax compliance, and tax
   reporting activities.
 * Experience working with multinational organizations and U.S. tax regulations
   preferred.

 * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

   financial systems.
 * Experience working with tax compliance, tax provision, and reporting

 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced

job_description:

Experience: 3+ yrs
Location: Bengaluru
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for a skilled and product-oriented Backend Engineer – Platform & Integrations to design, develop, and maintain reliable backend services and API-driven systems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Python, backend development, REST APIs, relational databases, and third-party integrations.
This role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building dependable systems, and taking ownership of features from initial requirements through deployment and production support. You will contribute to developing scalable platforms that coordinate external service providers, process data reliably, and support critical business workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Python.
Build reliable workflows for third-party service orchestration, verification processes, and case-management systems.
Integrate external APIs, handle authentication, validate responses, normalise data, and manage integration failures.
Design and maintain relational database schemas, data models, and efficient queries using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar databases.
Build reliable data-processing pipelines with appropriate error handling, retries, timeouts, and logging.
Develop scalable backend components with a focus on performance, maintainability, security, and service reliability.
Take ownership of features throughout the development lifecycle, from requirement analysis and technical design to deployment and ongoing support.
Monitor production systems, investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
Collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Write clean, reusable, testable code and participate in code reviews to maintain engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, containerisation, and application monitoring.
Contribute to event-driven workflows and asynchronous processing where required.
Document APIs, integration patterns, architectural decisions, and operational procedures.
Help improve development workflows, testing practices, and overall platform reliability.
What Makes You a Great Fit
3–6 years of full-time professional software engineering experience, excluding internships.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and backend application development.
Experience designing and building REST APIs and integrating third-party services.
Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design and query optimisation.
Knowledge of reliable integration patterns, error handling, retries, timeouts, and API failure management.
Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, and container technologies such as Docker.
Understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, event-driven architectures, and distributed-system fundamentals is an advantage.
Experience in fintech, payments, KYC/KYB verification, compliance platforms, or other API-intensive products is preferred.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and take end-to-end ownership of technical deliverables.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a lean, fast-moving engineering team. Python Backend Development REST APIs PostgreSQL MySQL AWS Docker CI/CD Git API Integration Data Processing Distributed Systems Event-driven Architecture System Reliability Database Schema Design Requires 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python and relational databases. Candidates should have experience with API-intensive products and modern development practices like CI/CD and containerization.

job_description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟰𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟲𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟰-𝟲 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
Experience: 2+ yrs
Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for an exceptionally strong Senior Systems Architect with deep expertise in high-performance application architecture, cross-platform engineering, real-time data processing, and graphics rendering. The ideal candidate will have experience building latency-sensitive applications where performance, responsiveness, and reliability are critical, preferably within the gaming industry or other performance-intensive domains such as financial trading, real-time analytics, or interactive applications.
This role requires a combination of systems-level thinking, advanced programming skills, and a strong understanding of modern web and mobile rendering technologies. You will architect shared, high-performance client-side systems across web, native mobile, and cross-platform frameworks, ensuring consistent functionality and exceptional responsiveness across platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Architect a unified cross-platform client-side system that shares core business logic, order-book management, and binary data parsers across web, native mobile, Flutter, and React Native.
Design high-performance data ingestion pipelines for WebSocket streams using binary protocols such as Protocol Buffers, FlatBuffers, and Simple Binary Encoding (SBE).
Implement zero-copy data processing techniques to minimise memory allocations, data copying, and processing latency.
Move intensive parsing and data-processing operations off the main UI thread using Web Workers, native background threads, and Dart Isolates.
Design hardware-accelerated charting, graphics, and order-book rendering systems using Canvas, WebGL/WebGPU, Flutter Impeller/Skia, and native graphics APIs such as Metal and Vulkan.
Optimise rendering pipelines to achieve consistent, low-latency performance, targeting 120 FPS where supported by the platform and hardware.
Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, including garbage-collection pauses, UI thread blocking, excessive memory allocation, and dropped frames.
Apply memory pooling, lock-free data structures, concurrency patterns, and efficient resource management techniques.
Establish performance benchmarks, profiling practices, and automated testing to validate responsiveness, stability, and scalability across devices.
Lead architecture reviews, define engineering standards, and guide teams in implementing maintainable, high-performance systems.
Collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to translate demanding functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and optimisation techniques across web, mobile, graphics, and systems programming.
What Makes You a Great Fit
9+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing high-performance applications or complex client-side systems.
Experience in the gaming industry is strongly preferred, particularly in real-time rendering, graphics optimisation, game engines, or performance-critical applications.
Strong understanding of cross-platform architecture spanning web, native iOS/Android, and frameworks such as Flutter or React Native.
Hands-on experience with WebAssembly, Web Workers, JavaScript/TypeScript, Dart, or native mobile development.
Strong knowledge of streaming architectures, WebSockets, binary protocols, and efficient data-processing pipelines.
Experience with zero-copy processing, memory pooling, concurrency, multithreading, and lock-free programming techniques.
Practical experience with graphics rendering technologies such as WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, Skia, Impeller, Metal, or Vulkan.
Proven ability to profile and optimise CPU, memory, rendering, and network performance in latency-sensitive applications.
Strong understanding of garbage collection, memory allocation, thread scheduling, and platform-specific performance constraints.
Experience building responsive, real-time interfaces that handle high-frequency data updates without compromising usability.
Excellent architectural judgement, debugging skills, and the ability to solve complex systems-level engineering problems.
Strong communication and technical leadership skills, with the ability to guide engineering teams and drive architectural decisions.
A strong focus on performance measurement, engineering precision, reliability, and continuous optimisation. Systems Architecture High-performance Computing Cross-platform Engineering Real-time Data Processing Graphics Rendering WebAssembly JavaScript TypeScript Dart WebGL WebGPU Metal Vulkan WebSocket Protocol Buffers Concurrency Requires 9+ years of software engineering experience with a strong background in high-performance application architecture and graphics optimization. Candidates should have expertise in cross-platform development, binary protocols, and memory management techniques.

Experience: 1+ yrs
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for a technically strong and solution-oriented Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build and deploy AI-powered solutions for enterprise customers. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience or a strong foundation in Machine Learning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, and enterprise AI applications.
This role combines software engineering, applied AI, customer collaboration, and end-to-end solution delivery. You will translate complex business challenges into practical AI solutions, develop working prototypes, integrate enterprise data sources, and help deploy reliable applications that deliver measurable business value.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI opportunities, and translate requirements into technical solutions.
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Machine Learning, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent systems.
Build RAG pipelines involving document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and context-grounded response generation.
Integrate enterprise knowledge sources, APIs, databases, and internal systems into AI applications.
Develop multi-agent workflows for task orchestration, information retrieval, decision support, and business process automation.
Experiment with LLMs, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and retrieval strategies to improve accuracy and reliability.
Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts, validate them with stakeholders, and convert successful solutions into production-ready applications.
Develop backend services and APIs to integrate AI capabilities with existing enterprise platforms.
Implement testing, observability, performance optimisation, and evaluation frameworks for AI systems.
Address challenges involving hallucinations, retrieval quality, latency, scalability, data privacy, and access control.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and customer teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption.
Document technical designs, deployment processes, and solution architecture while incorporating feedback to improve outcomes.
What Makes You a Great Fit
1+ years of experience in software engineering, Machine Learning, applied AI, or a related technical role.
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with software development fundamentals.
Understanding of Machine Learning concepts, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application development.
Hands-on experience or practical project exposure to RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
Familiarity with multi-agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, or similar technologies.
Experience integrating APIs, databases, and enterprise data sources into software applications.
Understanding of REST APIs, backend development, Git, testing, and deployment workflows.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and production monitoring is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams.
A proactive, hands-on mindset with an interest in building practical, scalable enterprise AI solutions. Python Machine Learning LLMs RAG Multi-agent systems Prompt engineering Vector databases Semantic search LangGraph LangChain REST APIs Backend development Git Software engineering Data integration Requires at least 1 year of experience in software engineering or applied AI with strong Python programming skills. Candidates should have practical project exposure to RAG pipelines, vector databases, and modern AI orchestration frameworks.

title: Senior Design Engineer
job_description:
About aion
aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.
We're hiring a design engineer who builds like a founder. You see what's missing and make it exist: you design it, build it, ship it and own it. Code is your design material, and you write a shader when CSS runs out. The bar is an interface that feels physical: it tracks the finger, carries momentum and never drops a frame.
What you'll do
Take ideas from a blank file to production: decide what's worth building, prototype it in code, and own it once it ships.
Build production UI in React and TypeScript, from primitives to complete surfaces.
Build the custom tools that make the team faster: design-system tooling, motion tuners, debug overlays and internal apps.
Tune motion and gestures until they feel physical: momentum, weight and interruption.
Create 3D, shader and generative work where it lifts the experience.
Review every build on real devices at 1× and 2×, and keep it fast, accessible and robust under abuse.
Interaction
You treat interaction design as thinning the layer between intent and software, and your work has moments where the interface inferred what someone wanted instead of asking.
Physics is a toolkit to you, not a style: springs tuned by stiffness, damping and mass; velocity projected on release so a flick finishes the job; rubber banding where a hard stop would feel broken; secondary elements interpolated from the gesture driving them.
You give movement conceptual weight: light things settle quickly, heavy and destructive things resist, and bounce appears only where something was thrown.
Your gestures have three beats, constrain on start, track 1:1 on move, resolve on end, and stay contained: no stray text selection, no triggered neighbours, no pointer lost at the edge.
Choreography is second nature: the primary element answers instantly, secondary elements follow late, exits clear faster than entrances arrive, and a touch of blur hides the seams.
Your restraint scales with frequency and input: touch gets the most feedback, the pointer some, the keyboard almost none, and anything used a hundred times a day loses its animation.
Craft
You build without waiting: when a tool, component or prototype doesn't exist, you make it, and you've shipped things of your own that people use.
Code is your design material. You judge an idea by building and using it, prototype in the browser rather than in static frames, and polish only once the idea has earned it.
You iterate until nothing is left to explore, then have the discipline to choose the simple version from many iterations back.
Robustness is binary to you: you spam every state, scroll too fast, drag past every edge, and cut any detail that can't work every time.
You see at the pixel: optical alignment at high zoom, animations scrubbed frame by frame, and before-and-after captures on every change.
Native first: real scroll over hijacked wheel events, clip-path over animating width, CSS keyframes before reaching for a library.
You study the work you admire by rebuilding it, then make something unmistakably your own.
Engineering
5+ years shipping production front ends, with live work you can link to.
React and TypeScript at expert level, with component APIs that don't lie: contextual props, derived state, variants over boolean flags and compound components.
Motion values and direct DOM updates for anything high-frequency, so gestures and scroll never wait on a render.
CSS in depth: clip-path, masks, backdrop filters, blend modes, scroll-driven animations, container queries and the View Transitions API.
Type and pixels in code: variable fonts, optical sizing, OpenType features, and layouts free of shift and subpixel blur at 1×, 2× and 3×.
Performance as a feature: an 8 ms frame budget at 120 Hz, compositor-only animation, and pages that load instantly because every byte was questioned.
Accessibility as craft: focus rings styled rather than removed, focus moved into overlays and back, full keyboard paths and reduced-motion settings honoured.
3D and creative
Real-time 3D with Three.js or React Three Fiber on WebGL or WebGPU.
Shaders in GLSL or WGSL: noise, signed distance fields, glass, refraction, lighting and post-processing, all inside the frame budget.
Motion studies in After Effects and 3D in Cinema 4D or Blender, so ideas move before a line of production code exists.
Generative and data-driven work in Canvas and SVG, and interactive animation in Rive.
Building for AI
Interfaces for streamed, non-deterministic output: progressive rendering, interruption and retry.
You build daily with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, use them to ship whole tools and products on your own, and review every line they write.
Good to have
Custom tools you built that others rely on: plugins, design and motion tooling, debug overlays, generators or internal apps.
Something you started and shipped yourself: a product, a studio, a library or a side project with real users/customers.
Writing and articles about your craft: essays, breakdowns or notes that show how you think.
Creative coding or generative art.
Open-source work in motion, graphics or UI components.
Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits. React TypeScript Three.js WebGL GLSL CSS Interaction design Motion design Prototyping Performance optimization Accessibility Generative art React Three Fiber WGSL UI engineering Component architecture Candidates must have 5+ years of experience shipping production front-end code with expert-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. A strong portfolio demonstrating real-time 3D, shader work, and high-fidelity interaction design is required.

locations_derived: ['Gurugram, Haryana, India', 'Bengaluru, Karnataka, India', 'Hyderabad, Telangana, India']
job_description:
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or
   equivalent practical experience.
 * 15 years of experience in technical vendor strategy and operations, solutions
   consulting, software engineering, technical program management, or technical
   delivery management.
   
 * 3 years of experience working in projects leveraging generative AI, Large
   Language Models (LLMs), and agentic automation to transform enterprise
   business workflows and support operations.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Ability to deliver business transformation AI programs in a fast-paced,
   dynamic environment with excellent organizational and project management
   skills.
 * Ability to build strong relationships with clients and act as a trusted
   advisor and strategic partner cross-functionally and at the executive level.
 * Deep subject matter expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Gemini
   Enterprise architecture, or enterprise cloud support ecosystems.
 * Demonstrated track record of managing large-scale global vendor partnerships
   (GSIs) and leading multi-disciplinary cross-functional technical or
   innovation initiatives.
 * Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to
   influence without direct authority across a complex matrixed organization.


ABOUT THE JOB:

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next
for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are
developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from
infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated
to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational
institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come
to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business,
you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help
shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with
customers, employees and partners.

As an AI Transformation Solutions Consultant, you will embody a high-agency,
founder-mindset to bridge frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities
with global vendor operational delivery. You will move beyond legacy vendor
oversight to co-create, test, and jointly deploy automated, high-velocity
support AI solutions directly alongside strategic Global System Integrator (GSI)
delivery partners. You will drive strategic direction with a deep understanding
of technical capabilities, resolve operational blockers, and work through the
complexities required to shift vendor service models from traditional labor
arbitrage to AI-first intelligence orchestration. You will have a proven track
record for developing elegant solutions with evidence of domain expertise (e.g.,
quality, training, support operations, knowledge), a passion for generating
impact by leveraging AI and automation, and a skill for delivering on
improvement opportunities inside a process or organization.Google Cloud
accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and
industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s
cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably.
Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as
their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business
problems.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 * Develop a multi year AI roadmap and strategy to transform a high-volume
   transactional environment into an automated, strategic engine to enable cloud
   Value Management Office (VMO) to drive value realization and performance.
 * Partner with internal Google Cloud Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), and
   Support teams to co-create and embed agentic AI-motivated VMO modules,
   including AI-Assisted Case Review, Autonomous Support Agents, and
   Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-grounded diagnostic tools.
 * Design and implement next-generation governance and quality frameworks,
   shifting from managing to agreement to consultative, outcome-based
   performance metrics.
 * Act as a strategic leader and technical advisor for vendor strategy,
   addressing execution gaps and increasing partnership maturity.
 * Drive outcomes focus on operational efficiency, tokenization, automation
   realized through Gemini Enterprise, and measurable business impact. Generative AI Large Language Models Agentic Automation Google Cloud Platform Gemini Enterprise Technical Program Management Vendor Strategy Solutions Consulting Software Engineering Cloud Architecture Retrieval-Augmented Generation Business Transformation Project Management Stakeholder Management Operational Efficiency Data Analytics Requires a bachelor's degree in a technical field and at least 15 years of experience in technical strategy, operations, or software engineering. Candidates must have at least 3 years of specific experience with generative AI, LLMs, and agentic automation in enterprise workflows.

title: Benefits Analyst
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Benefits Analyst on GitLab's Total Rewards team, you'll support global benefits administration and take ownership of day-to-day benefits operations in India, partnering closely with a Senior Benefits Analyst. Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. This role reports to the Manager, Global Benefits and focuses on benefits programs, not leave administration. You'll need to be based in Bangalore, with periodic office presence for hosting and managing benefits events, and flexibility to collaborate across time zones, including Pacific time.
What You’ll Do 
Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.
Review benefits and team-member data from multiple sources, research discrepancies and root causes, and recommend next steps for manager or senior team-member review.
Work with brokers and vendors on day-to-day benefits operations, and support the Senior Benefits Analyst with renewals, plan changes, implementations, testing, launches, and post-launch improvements. Benefits plan decisions remain with the Senior Benefits Analyst.
Plan, host, and manage benefits events at the Bangalore hub, and coordinate assigned benefits activities across selected countries and employment arrangements. Apply documented processes and escalate questions that require deeper local or technical expertise.
Partner with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, and People Technology on accurate reporting, billing reconciliation, eligibility data, and compliance-related processes.
Support People Operations in resolving team-member benefits inquiries, explain moderately complex benefits topics in accessible language, and escalate cases appropriately.
Analyze benefits utilization, cost, survey, and qualitative data to identify trends and prepare summaries, insights, and recommendations that support team priorities.
Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. Protect accuracy and team-member experience, communicate progress and risks, and seek guidance on prioritizing improvements.
What You’ll Bring 
Experience supporting benefits administration, including enrollment, reporting, and audits, and working with benefits brokers or vendors. Experience supporting benefits in more than one country is required; global technology company experience is preferred. Strategic benefits plan design experience isn't required.
Working knowledge of core benefits concepts, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits.
Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.
Intermediate or stronger Excel or Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUPs, filters, pivot tables, and data analysis; macros aren't required. Ability to evaluate multiple sources, identify patterns or discrepancies, and develop evidence-based recommendations with appropriate guidance.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.
Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.
A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.
Ability to be based in Bangalore and go to our Bangalore hub to host and manage benefits events, with flexibility for collaboration across time zones, including Pacific time.
About the team
The Benefits team within Total Rewards supports global benefits programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. You'll work closely with the Senior Benefits Analyst and colleagues in India, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Pacific time zones to support India's growing benefits needs. The team's tools include Workday, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. The role emphasizes accurate administration, team-member support, and practical process improvements, with opportunities to build deeper benefits expertise.
How GitLab will support you
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off 
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave 
Home office support

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
