Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:
At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.
We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
The Sr. AWS Developer — Products builds the AI backbone of Pulse, NeuraFlash's AI agent monitoring, insights & evaluation platform, and NeuraFlash Desktop for Amazon Connect, our contact center product suite. This is an AI product engineering role with contact center DNA: you ship the LLM pipelines, agentic services, and MCP surfaces that let customers monitor, evaluate, and improve their AI agents grounded in real contact center conversations flowing out of Amazon Connect. 
The ideal candidate pairs strong Amazon Bedrock ecosystem experience with hands-on Amazon Connect knowledge, is proficient in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, and treats security, scalability, and deployment portability as first-class requirements. If you love building GenAI products for the contact center on AWS end-to-end, we'd love to talk to you!
Responsibilities:
Build Pulse's AI core: conversation ingestion, topic detection, LLM-based evaluations and scoring, PII redaction, and the insights/recommendation engine
Develop on Amazon Bedrock — model invocation, Agents, AgentCore (gateways, runtimes), Knowledge Bases/RAG, and Guardrails — plus third-party LLM APIs
Design and build Pulse's MCP server and agentic interfaces so AI assistants and customer tooling can consume Pulse data and actions
Engineer agent observability: session/trace capture, evaluation harnesses, quality scoring, and health metrics for production AI agents
Build the supporting serverless backend: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora/RDS, S3, Kinesis, Step Functions
Own product infrastructure as code (AWS CDK): reusable, hardened constructs that deploy cleanly into customer-owned AWS accounts
Own the Amazon Connect integration layer: CTR, Contact Lens, agent event streams, Lex bots, and contact flow touchpoints that feed Pulse and power ACE features
Drive security posture: Cognito/OIDC auth, IAM least privilege, encryption everywhere, SAST/DAST/CSPM remediation, third-party security assessments
Lead code reviews, mentor developers, and take technical ownership of product epics with minimal direction
Required Skills:
Minimum 5+ Years of experience 
Strong hands-on programming in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js
Hands-on GenAI/LLM application engineering: prompt design, RAG, structured outputs, LLM-as-judge evaluation, guardrails, token/cost optimization
Experience with Amazon Bedrock (or equivalent LLM platforms) in production workloads
Deep experience with AWS serverless architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EventBridge/Kinesis)
Experience with AWS CDK or CloudFormation and CI/CD pipelines
Amazon Connect experience (contact flows, Lex, CTR/Contact Lens data streams)
AWS Developer / Solutions Architect certification (Associate or Professional)
Experience building AI agents using Amazon Connect, Lex, and Bedrock (voice/chat self-service, agent assist)
Experience building and operating REST APIs and event-driven integrations across multiple systems
Security-minded development: IAM, Cognito, KMS encryption, VPC/network design, secure SDLC
Nice to haves:
MCP server development or agentic frameworks (Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph, Strands, CrewAI, etc.)
AI agent evaluation/observability experience (evals, tracing, scoring pipelines)
Experience shipping multi-tenant SaaS or products deployed into customer cloud accounts
Contact center platform breadth (WFM, voice protocols like WebRTC/SIP, or other CCaaS platforms)
Salesforce platform/API familiarity (Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce)
AWS AI Practitioner or Machine Learning Specialty certification

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together. title: Senior Product Designer
job_description:
aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

We're hiring a product designer for whom UX and UI are one craft. You take a vague problem to a flow that feels obvious, then to screens where every pixel, word and transition is placed on purpose. The bar is software that feels inevitable: nothing missing, nothing extra, nothing a pixel out of place.

What you'll do
Turn ambiguous problems into clear flows, information architecture and interaction models.
Design every state of every screen: empty, loading, partial, error and the edge cases nobody listed.
Own the visual layer: typography, layout, colour, iconography and hierarchy.
Specify interactions and motion precisely enough that engineers ship them as designed.
Build and evolve the design system.
Review what ships at 1× and 2×, and catch the 1 px misalignment, the wrong easing and the clipped label before anyone else does.
Test with real users and iterate until nothing is left to remove.
UX
6+ years in product design, with complex products shipped end to end.
User research: interviews, contextual inquiry and usability testing, planned and run yourself and turned into decisions.
Problem framing: user needs, jobs to be done and success measures defined before any screen is drawn.
End-to-end journeys: journey maps and service blueprints covering every touchpoint, handoff and failure path.
Task flows and wireframes that account for every branch, edge case and error, tested before visual design.
Information architecture: content models, navigation and labelling, validated with card sorts and tree tests.
Interaction design: mental models, affordances, feedback and system status, consistent across the product.
Evaluation: heuristic reviews and usability metrics such as task success, time on task and error rate.
UI
Visual hierarchy: one clear focal point per screen, built with scale, weight, contrast and space rather than decoration.
Typography: type scales, optical sizes, tracking that tightens as type grows, tabular figures, and layouts that hold up at larger text sizes.
Layout: grids, a strict spacing scale, every edge on the pixel grid, and optical corrections where the measurements are right but the result looks wrong.
Colour: semantic colour systems for light and dark themes, and perceptually even palettes in OKLCH or Display P3.
Depth and materials: elevation, shadows, translucency and blur, continuous corner curves and concentric radii, used to show what is interactive and what sits on top of what.
Component states: default, hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, loading and error, designed for every component.
Design systems: primitive and semantic tokens, variables and modes, components with real variants, and documentation teams use.
Iconography: a consistent grid, stroke and corner language, with icons drawn to read at small sizes.
Motion: springs rather than fixed durations; fluid, interruptible motion that follows the finger and keeps its momentum on release; clear choreography of what moves first, what follows and what leaves.
Platform conventions: deep knowledge of desktop, web and mobile patterns, and the judgement to know when to break them.
Accessibility designed in from the start to WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast, focus order, larger text, reduced motion and screen-reader labels.
Tools
Figma at expert level: variables and modes, component properties, auto layout, advanced prototyping and Figma Motion.
After Effects, Rive or ProtoPie when an interaction has to be felt, not described.
Designing for AI
Interfaces for output that is non-deterministic, streamed and sometimes wrong.
Patterns that keep people in control: review, correction, undo and honest failure states.
Trust built through clarity, not decoration.
Good to have
Illustration, iconography or brand identity work.
Industrial, print or type design, where tolerances are unforgiving.
Dense professional tools: editors, dashboards, developer products.
Public work: writing, talks or side projects.
Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits. title: Customer Success Manager
job_description:
At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture. Here, you can positively impact the careers of millions of test-takers and reshape the education technology landscape by working toward one vision: 

“To provide life-long learners across the globe the freedom to pursue their academic dreams and career aspirations safely, securely, and conveniently.”

Meazure Learning was established when testing industry giants Proctor U and Yardstick joined forces in 2020. Our goal is to better serve both our higher-ed and professional testing clients by creating the most comprehensive and transformative full-service online test development and delivery solution on the market. As the demand for remote proctoring has grown, we’ve expanded our footprint to 16 offices in 8 countries, staffed by the largest certified proctor and support workforce in the world.




Meazure Learning uses technology to make education accessible to all regardless of ability or location while building trust in the expansion of access to education. Our team is responsible for building and supporting digital solutions trusted by over 1,000 institutions in 129 countries who administer over 2,000,000 exams per year, and we are continuing to grow!

The Role:

The Manager, Customer Success is a people leadership position responsible for leading, developing, and managing a team of approximately 10 Customer Success Associates (CSAs) based in India. The Manager is accountable for the performance, development, engagement, and day-to-day leadership of the team while ensuring consistent, high-quality support for Meazure Learning’s clients and Customer Success organization.
 
 This position does not carry an individual client portfolio as a primary responsibility. Rather, success is achieved through the performance and effectiveness of the team the Manager leads.
 
 The Manager serves as the primary people leader for the India-based CSA team and partners closely with Customer Success leadership and other global stakeholders to align team priorities, capacity, performance, and development with broader business and client needs. 

The Responsibilities:

People Leadership & Team Development 

 * Directly manage a team of approximately 10 Customer Success Associates.
 * Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and development to strengthen individual and team performance.
 * Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, team meetings, performance reviews, and career-development discussions.
 * Establish clear expectations and hold team members accountable for performance, behaviors, service standards, and business objectives.
 * Recognize strong performance and proactively address performance concerns.
 * Partner with HR and Customer Success leadership on performance management, employee relations, development planning, and other people-related matters.
 * Identify high-potential talent and support career development, succession planning, and internal mobility.
 * Support the onboarding and successful integration of new team members.
 * Build an engaged, accountable, collaborative, and client-focused team culture.

Team Performance & Client Success 

 * Own overall performance and service delivery for the India-based Customer Success Associate team.
 * Ensure CSAs consistently provide responsive, accurate, and high-quality support to clients and Customer Success partners.
 * Monitor individual and team performance against established goals, service levels, client expectations, and other Customer Success measures.
 * Provide management support and escalation leadership for complex client or service issues.
 * Identify performance trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to strengthen the client experience.
 * Partner with Customer Success leadership to support client satisfaction, retention, relationship health, and overall Customer Success objectives.

Workforce & Operational Management 

 * Manage workload, capacity, assignments, and priorities across the team to ensure appropriate client coverage and effective utilization of resources.
 * Use data, reporting, and performance metrics to identify trends, performance gaps, resource needs, and development opportunities.
 * Ensure consistent execution of Customer Success processes, standards, and expectations.
 * Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, scalability, and quality.
 * Support workforce planning and hiring activities as the team evolves. 

Global & Cross-Functional Leadership 

 * Serve as the primary local people leader for the India Client Success Associate team.
 * Act as a key connection between India-based CSAs and Customer Success leadership.
 * Partner effectively with Customer Success Managers and leaders as well as Implementation, Service Delivery, Product, Technology, HR, and other functions.
 * Communicate team performance, capacity, risks, employee-development needs, and resource requirements to Customer Success leadership.
 * Work effectively across geographic locations and time zones to support a global organization and client base.
 * Lead the team through organizational, process, and business changes and reinforce effective change adoption.

Additional Position Information: 

 * Remote India Opportunity 
 * Core Hours: 6 pm – 3 am (IST) or 5 pm – 2 am (IST)
 * Core Days Worked: Monday - Friday

 Desired Attributes: 

 * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 * 8+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, or a related client-facing function.
 * Minimum 3 years of direct people-management experience strongly preferred, ideally managing customer-facing or client-support professionals.
 * Demonstrated experience coaching employees, managing performance, developing talent, and building effective teams.
 * Experience managing a team of similar size and scope preferred.
 * Experience within B2B SaaS, education technology, assessment, or another global client-focused organization preferred.
 * Strong client orientation and demonstrated ability to effectively manage escalations and resolve complex issues.
 * Strong verbal and written English communication skills and the ability to work effectively with global colleagues and clients.
 * Strong organizational, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
 * Demonstrated ability to use data and performance metrics to manage a team and make informed decisions.
 * Ability to operate effectively within a global, cross-functional, and matrixed organization.

Measures of Success
 
 Success in this position will be measured primarily through the performance and effectiveness of the team, including: 

 * Achievement of team performance and service expectations.
 * Quality and consistency of client support.
 * Employee performance, engagement, development, and retention.
 * Effective coaching and development of Client Success Associates.
 * Timely and effective management of performance concerns and client escalations.
 * Appropriate workload distribution and team capacity management.
 * Development of internal talent and readiness for expanded responsibilities.
 * Strong partnership with Customer Success leadership and global stakeholders.

Our Company Values:

 * Integrity. Honest, open and ethical practices 
 * Service. Remarkable service and personal leadership 
 * Innovation. Anticipate, challenge, and create 
 * Excellence. Quality through relentless improvement 

Why Join Meazure Learning?

 * Impact: Play a key role in ensuring financial health for a global leader in education and professional testing.
 * Innovation: Work in a dynamic environment that embraces process improvement and technology.
 * Collaboration: Partner with colleagues across the U.S., Canada, UK, and India to support a truly global business.
 * Growth: Gain exposure to U.S. GAAP and international accounting practices, expanding your expertise.
 * Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a remote role with global reach. 


 The Benefits:

 * Company-Sponsored Health Insurance
 * Remote Work Opportunity
 * Competitive Pay 
 * Healthy Work Culture 
 * Career Growth Opportunities 
 * Learning and Development Opportunities 
 * Referral Award Program 
 * Company Provided IT Equipment 

Learn more at www.meazurelearning.com [http://www.meazurelearning.com/]

Meazure Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: Meazure Learning is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Meazure Learning will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. A bachelor's degree is required, along with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed organization.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
job_description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
OneSpan is building an internal ServiceNow capability to support Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT. We are seeking a ServiceNow Administrator who is passionate about platform excellence, user experience, process improvement, and operational support.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with business users, configuring platform capabilities, supporting day-to-day operations, and helping drive adoption of ServiceNow across the organization.
You will work closely with ServiceNow Developers, Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and global teams across North America, Europe, and India. This position combines platform administration, user support, reporting, and process improvement activities in a fast-paced environment.
This is primarily an administration and platform support role with an expected focus of approximately:
• 60% Platform Administration & Support
• 20% Configuration & Continuous Improvement
• 20% Stakeholder Collaboration, Reporting & Documentation
What You'll Do
Platform Administration & Support (Approximately 60%)
• Administer and maintain the ServiceNow platform and related modules.
• Manage users, groups, roles, permissions, and access requests.
• Support Customer Service Management (CSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), Service Catalog, Customer Portal, Knowledge Management, and ITSM processes.
• Investigate and resolve user issues, data discrepancies, platform questions, and configuration-related problems.
• Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
• Assist with system upgrades, patches, regression testing, and release activities.
• Maintain service catalogs, forms, workflows, notifications, and portal content.
• Support queue management, assignment groups, SLAs, workflows, and operational processes.
• Ensure system configurations follow established governance and platform standards.
• Partner with developers when issues require scripting, integrations, or custom development.
Configuration & Continuous Improvement (Approximately 20%)
• Configure forms, fields, views, notifications, dashboards, reports, catalog items, knowledge bases, and platform settings.
• Build and maintain Flow Designer automations and no-code/low-code solutions where appropriate.
• Support enhancement requests and platform optimization initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve user experience.
• Participate in testing and validation of platform changes.
• Assist with documentation of configurations and support procedures.
Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Support (Approximately 20%)
• Create and maintain ServiceNow reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
• Support business users with questions, training, and platform adoption.
• Document system processes, support procedures, configuration decisions, and operating standards.
• Assist Business Analysts in validating requirements and testing solutions.
• Participate in backlog reviews, enhancement planning, and support prioritization discussions.
• Help communicate platform updates and process changes to users.
Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of ServiceNow administration experience.
• Hands-on experience administering ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.
• Experience with:
o User Administration
o Roles & Security
o Service Catalog
o Knowledge Management
o Reports & Dashboards
o Flow Designer
o Forms, Views, and Configuration Management
• Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform navigation and administration.
• Experience supporting business users and troubleshooting platform issues.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
Preferred Qualifications
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
• Experience supporting CSM, ITSM, SPM/PPM, or Service Catalog implementations.

title: Inside Sales Representative
job_description:
Who Are We?

FDH Aero is a trusted global supply chain partner for aerospace and defense companies, providing end-to-end supply chain solutions for OEM and aftermarket customers.

With more than 55+ years of experience and operations in 14 countries, we bring expertise across Commercial, Defense, Space, Business Aviation and Cargo through our specialized business divisions, Electronics, Hardware, Commercial Aftermarket, and Defense Aftermarket.

For more information, please visit the FDH Aero website [https://fdhaeroprod.wpengine.com/].   

 

Why Work Here?

Fast-paced & Impactful Work – Every decision helps keep aircraft flying and missions moving

Driven Team & Culture – Supportive, driven colleagues who support you every step of the way

High-Growth Opportunities – We invest in your success with training and development

Competitive Benefits Package – Includes medical, dental, vision insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) 401k matching, wellness activities and more

At FDH Aero, we understand that the strength of our brand comes from our people, and our culture empowers every team member to contribute and grow.  As a global team, our culture is rooted in five (5) core values that begin with the words “We are” and include: service-first, respectful, amplifiers, open-minded and accountable.  

 

We Are Looking For

The Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and achieving sales targets within their assigned geography or territory. This role involves owning the entire sales process, from building and managing customer relationships to identifying needs, preparing quotes, negotiating deals, and fulfilling orders. The Account Manager works closely with internal teams to resolve administrative sales tasks, maintain accurate CRM records, and ensure seamless order management. They monitor account profitability, proactively address changes in product costs, and regularly update forecasts to align with division strategies. Collaborating with Sales Development Representatives, Business Development Managers, and Sales Managers, the Account Manager ensures effective performance against key KPIs while maintaining strong client relationships and delivering tailored solutions to meet customer needs.

 

What You’ll Do 

As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for:  

 * Owning the end-to-end sales process within assigned accounts in geography / territory. Driving revenue and sales growth at assigned accounts through building customer relationships and identifying needs
 * Managing accounts by qualifying / understanding account needs, recommending FDH solutions that meet their needs, preparing and sharing quotes, negotiating / closing opportunities, troubleshooting, and fulfilling orders
 * Achieving the annual sales quota for assigned accounts
 * Qualifying sales leads routed from Sales Development Rep and driving leads to closed deals
 * Facilitating administrative sales tasks through review of quotation orders and working with sales support to resolve order acceptance issues, share any information required by order entry / management teams, etc.
 * Maintaining accurate records in CRM systems pertaining to sales activities, customer interactions, and pipeline status
 * Assessing customer information to anticipate changes that could affect sales revenues and budget plans; updating rolling forecast monthly and reporting on variances
 * Monitoring and maintaining profitability with assigned accounts consistent with overall division strategy. Proactively managing changing landscape of product costs
 * Coordinating closely with sales manager to ensure performance against key KPIs and metrics within territory, division, and segment 
 * Communicating the outcome of negotiations and ensure that contract copies are appropriately documented, approved and distributed
 * Working closely with BDMs on assigned accounts to obtain competitive pricing, cost, and other information required to develop the selling strategy and obtain approval for the proposal
 * Working internally with supporting teams, such as LTA management

 

What You Bring

 * A diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field
 * 2+ years of experience in inside sales, experience in the Electronics industry preferred
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
 * Experience with ERP systems preferred Inside sales Account management Revenue growth Sales forecasting CRM management Negotiation Order management Microsoft Excel ERP systems Lead qualification Business development Supply chain management Candidates must have a diploma or bachelor's degree in Business or a related field. A minimum of 2 years of experience in inside sales is required, with preference given to those with experience in the electronics industry.

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused SAP MDG Solution Architect with 15+ years of SAP experience, including extensive expertise in SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) across both functional and technical domains. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving MDG strategy, architecting enterprise-scale master data solutions, engaging directly with customers, leading delivery teams, and ensuring successful implementation of SAP MDG programs.
This role requires a strong blend of solution architecture, consulting, stakeholder management, team leadership, and hands-on SAP MDG expertise covering Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, Data Quality Management, and Integration frameworks.

Business Partner
Customer

Material
Finance

Present architecture solutions, estimations, risks, and technical recommendations.

SAP MDG Central Governance
SAP MDG Consolidation

Data Replication Framework (DRF)
Workflow and Change Request Processes

Collaborate with business stakeholders to establish data stewardship and governance processes.

Data Models

Workflow Configuration

Enhancements and Custom Developments

Design and govern integrations between SAP MDG and enterprise applications using:

SOA Services
APIs
IDocs
Web Services
SAP PI/PO
SAP CPI/BTP Integration Suite
OData Services


Ensure seamless master data synchronization across SAP and non-SAP systems.
Define integration patterns, monitoring strategies, and data replication mechanisms.

Lead and mentor a team of approximately 15 SAP MDG consultants, including functional, technical, integration, and data migration resources.
Manage project planning, task allocation, quality reviews, and team development.
Provide architectural governance and technical oversight throughout project lifecycles.
Conduct solution reviews, code reviews, and design validations.




Delivery & Governance

Ensure successful delivery of SAP MDG implementations, upgrades, and transformation programs.
Identify project risks and provide mitigation strategies.
Establish and enforce architecture standards, best practices, and governance processes.
Support Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.

Master Data Lifecycle Management
Data Governance Frameworks

Experience managing and mentoring teams of 10-15+ consultants.

title: Manager, Circ & IDS Support
job_description:
Who We Are 
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. 
We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. 
While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. 
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity 
What’s In It For U 
Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative 
Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. 
Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. 
More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. 
Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. 
Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. 
Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. 
Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. 
Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. 
Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. 
Insurity’s Next Manager
Insurity is looking for a people focused Manager to lead a high-performing team. This role is responsible for developing team members, delivering departmental goals, supporting strong customer and stakeholder relationships, and helping the team operate effectively in a changing environment. The ideal candidate combines sound judgment, strong communication, hands-on knowledge of the function, and a genuine commitment to coaching and developing people.
What Our Manager Will Do 
Lead, coach, and mentor a high-performing, highly engaged team of individual contributors supporting bureau content for the base system & customers
Interview, hire, onboard, and retain exceptional talent while building a collaborative and accountable team culture.
Provide input to departmental goals and help ensure those goals are met.
Lead team members through Insurity’s performance management and development process.
Communicate effectively and regularly with team members, customers, and other stakeholders.
Manage financial responsibilities and activities for large projects
Effectively manage release planning including capacity for resources
Develop and maintain trusted customer relationships and effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders.
Drive utilization across the team and communicate financial results, goal progress, and KPI's to direct reports.
Perform hands-on individual-contributor work as needed to support the team and business objectives.
Who We’re Looking For 
Recommended: 5 years of experience managing people
Recommended: Bachelor’s degree in a related field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
Experience leading, managing, coaching, and developing a team of individual contributors
Experience in the U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance industry, with the ability to apply that knowledge in a support and operational leadership environment.
Ability to work U.S. Based hours (full-time ET Time Zone preferred)
Highly proficient analytical and critical-thinking skills, written and oral English communication, time management, prioritization, and organization
Strong ability to manage multiple priorities
Self-starter mindset, willingness to learn, attention to detail, active listening skills, and ability to collaborate while working autonomously.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information, ability to negotiate toward effective outcomes, and readiness to accept challenging assignments.
Ability to apply hands-on experience as an individual contributor and break down complex issues into simple, clear terms.
Willingness to complete Insurity’s Leadership Development Program and Insurity Manager Training within 12 months.
Ability to travel approximately 10–30% as needed.
Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

Proficiency in the U.S. Property & Casualty insurance industry and strong analytical and communication skills are essential.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
job_description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
OneSpan is establishing its first internal ServiceNow development capability in India as part of a growing global Business Systems organization. This is an opportunity to become one of the foundational members of a new team and play a key role in the future direction of our ServiceNow platform supporting Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT.
Unlike many enterprise development roles, this position requires a highly independent and self-motivated individual who can work effectively with limited day-to-day oversight. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, a Business Analyst in Canada, and a shared Business Analyst in India while partnering with teams across North America, Europe, and India.
This is a hands-on role with an expected focus of approximately 70% ServiceNow development and support, 20% solution design and platform architecture, and 10% requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration. The ideal candidate is comfortable working from enhancement requests, support tickets, project initiatives, and high-level business requirements that may not always be fully documented. You will be expected to evaluate needs, recommend scalable solutions, develop and test those solutions, maintain technical documentation, and support production issues in a highly customized ServiceNow environment.
What You'll Do
ServiceNow Development & Platform Support
(Approximately 70%)
• Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and support scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
• Build and maintain Flow Designer automations, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, Catalog Items, Notifications, and custom applications.
• Deliver enhancements supporting Customer Service Management (CSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), ITSM, Service Catalog, Customer Portal, and related business processes.
• Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems, particularly Salesforce and Jira.
• Build integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, and other appropriate integration technologies.
• Troubleshoot production issues, defects, integration failures, access requests, and platform incidents.
• Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions that improve platform stability and maintainability.
• Support platform upgrades, patching, release activities, and regression testing.
• Balance enhancement work, project delivery, support requests, operational tickets, and platform improvement initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to streamline business processes through automation, workflow optimization, and AI-driven capabilities.
• Communicate clear design, plans and status of work with ServiceNow team and Business Stakeholders via our Jira ticketing system.
Solution Design & Platform Architecture (Approximately 20%)
• Translate business requests and functional requirements into scalable, maintainable, and supportable technical solutions.
• Evaluate solution options and determine when to leverage out-of-the-box functionality versus custom development.
• Design platform enhancements that consider security, performance, scalability, data integrity, and long-term supportability.
• Assess impacts of proposed changes across ServiceNow modules, integrations, portals, users, and downstream systems.
• Create and maintain technical designs, integration documentation, architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and support documentation.
• Review existing customizations and recommend opportunities to reduce technical debt and align with ServiceNow best practices.
• Contribute to development standards, governance processes, code review practices, and release management activities.
• Provide technical leadership and guidance on complex platform enhancements and projects.
Requirements Analysis & Stakeholder Partnership (Approximately 10%)
• Work directly with business users, process owners, and Business Analysts to understand business needs and desired outcomes.
• Help refine requirements and identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and technical considerations. Challenge assumptions when appropriate and recommend simpler or more sustainable approaches.
• Participate in solution workshops, project discussions, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing activities.
• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders across global teams.
• Provide updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and technical recommendations.
Required Qualifications
• 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
• Strong experience with:
o Customer Service Management (CSM)
o Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM)
o ITSM
o Service Catalog
o Flow Designer
o JavaScript
o Business Rules
o Client Scripts
o Script Includes
o IntegrationHub
• Experience designing and implementing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, Jira, and other enterprise applications.
• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, web services, and system integrations.
• Experience troubleshooting and supporting highly customized ServiceNow environments.
• Experience creating technical design documents, architecture documentation, and support materials.
• Experience performing testing and validation activities without reliance on a dedicated QA team.
• Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and drive work forward with limited supervision.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting Customer Support and Professional Services organizations.
• Experience with ServiceNow Customer Portals, Service Portal, or Employee Center.
• Knowledge of CMDB and CSDM concepts.
• Experience working alongside or transitioning responsibilities from ServiceNow consulting partners.
• Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other developers.
• Experience supporting global organizations and distributed teams.
• Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies.
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
Bonus points
• Experience with ServiceNow AI, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Agents, or Generative AI capabilities.
• Experience implementing AI-enabled customer support or professional services workflows.
• Experience designing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and user experience.
• Experience operating in both development and technical business analyst capacities.
• Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives in enterprise environments.
• ServiceNow Certified implementation specialist – customer service management (CIS – CSM)
Working Model
• Must maintain regular overlap with North American business hours, including availability through approximately 11 AM Eastern Time.
• Collaborate closely with teams across North America, Europe, and India.
• Participate in support, enhancement, operational, and project-based initiatives.
• Work in a fast-paced environment where initiative, ownership, and accountability are highly valued.

You must be a self-motivated professional capable of working independently and managing complex technical requirements in a global environment.

title: Premium Support Specialist
job_description:
Company Description
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
#LI-Hybrid 
Job Description
We are looking for a skilled Technical Support Specialist to join the Nexthink customer support team and contribute to improving our customers' Digital Employee Experience. The TPS specialist will handle the technical support requests around the Nexthink Products, working closely with the Support Account Managers and Engineering teams.

Job Responsibilities:
Perform Level 1 and Level 2 support for the product-related tickets raised by the premium customers in scope.
Ensure timely resolution of the support tickets.
Reproduce the problems, perform troubleshooting, log analysis, and share actionable insights.
Participate/coordinate escalations and organize stakeholder meetings to fast-track solutions/hotfixes.
Service recovery by engaging SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) and/or other Engineering teams if needed.
Create Jira tickets with the different engineering teams with continuous follow-up.
Contribute, update, maintain and enhance the knowledge base.
Continually assess the customer deployment to ensure optimum performance and availability.
Build and maintain strong relationships with the Support Account Managers/Customers
Advocate for the customers to ensure their issues are addressed promptly
Qualifications
Minimum 5 years of experience in technical customer support.
Strong orientation towards customer service.
Proven problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn in a high-paced environment.
Autonomous mindset with time-management and organization skills.
Knowledge of Windows and Mac OS with basic knowledge of Linux.
A good understanding of SQL is preferred.
SaaS based applications technical and troubleshooting knowledge is preferred.
A good understanding of cloud technologies such as Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services), Microservices, and Kubernetes is a plus.
Knowledge of monitoring/observability systems (e.g. new relic, PagerDuty, Datadog) is a plus
Additional Information
We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

title: Product Manager, Geo, Google Maps, UGC Contributor Success
job_description:
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 * 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 * 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic
   marketing, business operations, consulting).
 * 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical
   presentations to executive leadership.
 * 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch
   (e.g., ideation to execution, 0 to 1, etc.).
 * Experience in AI/ML product management.
 * Experience with data analysis.


ABOUT THE JOB:

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need
Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products
that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception
to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down
complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing
products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product
Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers,
marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to
the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the
execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging,
promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

User-Generated Content (UGC) covers a wide range of products that enable Google
Maps (Geo) users to share their real-world experiences and facts of the world
with others in the form of reviews/ratings, photos or videos, asking and
answering questions about a place, place attributes, etc.

As the Product Manager, you will partner closely with the engineering and
analyst teams to leverage Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML)
models, user and place understanding, and platform capabilities to publish
high-quality content on addresses, location, landmarks, gates from contributors
across surfaces and Generative AI (GenAI) experiences.The Geo team is focused on
building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users,
through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more.
Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the
world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms
to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of
mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful
and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real
world.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 * Define the product idea, roadmaps, and success metrics for destinations and
   arrivals workstream, using data analysis and evaluations to inform both
   high-level strategy and day-to-day decisions.
 * Provide cross-functional leadership to a virtual team spanning engineering,
   operations, analytics, User Experience (UX), policy, legal, Public Relation
   (PR), privacy, and compliance across multiple product areas (e.g., Geo, Core,
   Trust and Safety, Commerce).
 * Rally stakeholders behind a common idea, backed by articulate and confident
   communication.
 * Collaborate effectively with machine learning, platform, and UGC experiences
   teams to build scalable solutions.
    Product Management Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Data Analysis Strategic Marketing Business Operations Technical Presentations Product Launch Cross-functional Leadership User Experience Generative AI Roadmap Definition Stakeholder Management Product Strategy Platform Capabilities Requires a bachelor's degree and at least 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. Preferred qualifications include experience in AI/ML product management, data analysis, and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Play Games
job_description:
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming
   languages (e.g., C, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript).
 * 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
 * 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related
   technical field.
 * 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
 * Strong interest with gaming in mobile gaming.
 * Hands-on technical leader, comfortable with both technical/architectural
   detail and people management.
 * Technical experience within the Play/Android ecosystem.


ABOUT THE JOB:

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just
Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to
take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a
team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers
are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your
project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams
work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial
intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale
system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design;
the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our
exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you
guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple
teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of
large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by
the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and
Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our
backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content
partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or
song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop.
The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and
partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 * Provide technical, product and strategic leadership for a team building
   user-facing gaming products.
 * Work on team development, coaching, execution and overarching strategy.
 * Participate in the full life-cycle of new modules/features. Shape product
   strategy, understand product requirements, contribute to system design, coach
   Software Engineers (SWEs) to implement and land these features.
 * Represent your team to other teams at Google, finding collaborative ways to
   achieve shared goals. Software Development People Management Technical Leadership C C++ Java JavaScript TypeScript Android Ecosystem Product Strategy System Design Gaming Mobile Gaming Cloud Computing Team Coaching Project Management Requires a bachelor's degree, 8 years of software development experience, and 5 years of experience in both people management and technical leadership. Preferred qualifications include a master's degree or PhD and experience within the Android ecosystem.

title: Senior Director Strategic Sourcing
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 


Job Summary
The Senior Director, Sourcing & Procurement – India will lead the Sourcing & Procurement organization based in India and will be accountable for building a high-performing, scalable, and strategically integrated capability across sourcing, procurement operations, procure to pay, data and analytics, and procurement systems. This leader will ensure that the India organization delivers measurable business value while providing reliable global support, strong operational controls, and an excellent stakeholder experience.
This role will serve as a senior strategic partner to Procurement leadership, Finance, Accounts Payable, Legal, Technology, Internal Audit, business leaders, and Category Managers. The successful candidate will combine executive leadership with strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, supplier management, procurement operations, source-to-pay processes, data and analytics, systems enablement, compliance, and continuous improvement.
The leader will be expected to modernize the India organization from a primarily execution-focused delivery model into a proactive center of excellence that uses data to identify opportunities and risks, improves cycle time and quality, automates manual work, strengthens controls, develops talent, and enables Category Managers and business stakeholders to capture sustainable value.
Key Responsibilities
India Organization Leadership and Operating Model
• Lead the full Sourcing & Procurement organization in India, including sourcing, Procurement Operations and P2P, and Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems.
• Translate global Procurement strategy into an India delivery roadmap with clear priorities, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.
• Set a high bar for accuracy, responsiveness, risk management, business partnership, continuous improvement, and measurable value creation.
• Build a strong leadership team, develop succession plans, attract and retain high-performing talent, and create career paths that increase the strategic capability of the India organization.
• Create an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable culture that supports global stakeholders across regions and time zones.
Strategic Sourcing, Category Execution, and Supplier Value
• Provide leadership and direction to the sourcing organization and ensure sourcing strategies are aligned with business priorities, category strategies, enterprise leverage, risk requirements, and value targets.
• Oversee the execution of complex and high-value sourcing initiatives, negotiations, renewals, supplier selections, and commercial agreements across relevant categories.
• Ensure sourcing teams use disciplined market intelligence, supplier research, competitive bidding, benchmarking, negotiation planning, and fact-based recommendations.
• Strengthen supplier relationship management, supplier performance, business reviews, issue resolution, and proactive management of supplier risk and dependency.
• Promote strategic alignment between global sourcing activities and local or regional business requirements, including the needs of international legal entities.
• Partner with Category Managers and business leaders to identify demand-management, specification, consolidation, supplier rationalization, and other value opportunities.
• Ensure sourcing outcomes are implemented effectively and that negotiated value is reflected in contracts, purchase orders, invoices, budgets, and business results.
Procurement Operations, Procure to Pay, and Service Delivery
• Provide executive oversight of the Procurement Operations and P2P organization responsible for purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, invoice approvals, PO changes, supplier support, and related activities.
• Establish operational performance standards and dashboards for intake-to-PR and PR-to-PO cycle time, PO accuracy, invoice processing and approval cycle time, aging, exception rates, throughput, workload, and service-level performance.
• Ensure the P2P organization delivers accurate and timely execution, proactively identifies funding and approval risks, and provides effective support to business stakeholders and Accounts Payable.
• Drive the standardization and continuous improvement of P2P processes, work queues, handoffs, controls, escalation paths, year-end PO cleanup, and open commitment management.
• Partner with Accounts Payable and Finance to improve invoice matching, discrepancy resolution, payment timeliness, supplier experience, and financial controls.
• Use capacity, workload, aging, and productivity data to improve work assignment, staffing decisions, service delivery, and scalability across the India organization.
• Set the direction for automation and shared-service improvements that reduce manual effort while preserving accuracy, control, and a high-quality stakeholder experience.
Data, Analytics, Procurement Systems, and Digital Enablement
• Lead the development of a trusted Procurement data and analytics capability that enables leadership, Category Managers, Finance, and business stakeholders to make informed decisions.
• Oversee executive reporting packages, Procurement KPI definitions, dashboards, data processes, data quality, reporting governance, and actionable insights across sourcing and procurement operations.
• Ensure data from workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, Finance, supplier, contract, and other relevant systems is connected, reconciled, governed, and available for consumption.
• Own the Procurement Operations systems roadmap and ensure systems support intake, sourcing, contracting, supplier management, purchase orders, invoices, savings tracking, compliance, and reporting.
• Use automation, analytics, and digital tools to improve visibility, reduce manual work, accelerate decision-making, and increase the scalability of the Procurement operating model.
• Ensure data and systems are designed and managed with appropriate security, access, documentation, controls, and auditability.
Savings, Value Governance, and Financial Partnership
• Establish clear accountability for Procurement value creation and ensure sourcing, operations, data, and systems teams support measurable business outcomes.
• Oversee a standardized savings governance process that defines how P&L savings, contractual savings, cost avoidance, demand management, and other value measures are calculated, documented, validated, tracked, and reported.
• Ensure sourcing outcomes are translated into financial and operational results and that value leakage is identified and addressed across the source-to-pay lifecycle.
• Use data and performance insights to direct resources toward the highest-value opportunities and identify areas requiring corrective action.
Process Transformation, Compliance, and Governance
• Establish a continuous improvement agenda that uses process mapping, root-cause analysis, stakeholder feedback, performance data, and automation to improve efficiency, quality, control, and user experience.
• Ensure sourcing, contracting, supplier onboarding, purchasing, and invoice processes operate within approved policies, delegation of authority, approval requirements, and applicable control frameworks.
• Promote proactive risk management across suppliers, markets, contracts, payments, data, systems, and operational dependencies.
• Ensure standard operating procedures, role definitions, training, documentation, and change-management practices are maintained as processes and systems evolve.
Executive Partnership and Global Stakeholder Management
• Serve as a senior representative of Sourcing & Procurement in India and build strong relationships with global Procurement leadership and enterprise functions.
• Provide concise, fact-based updates on performance, savings, risks, capacity, priorities, transformation progress, and resource needs.
• Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around decisions when priorities, ownership, or requirements cross organizational boundaries.
• Create transparency into the India organization's work, capabilities, service levels, and business impact.
• Promote consistent global standards while ensuring solutions are practical for the operating realities of international legal entities and distributed teams.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
• 12+ years of progressive experience in Sourcing, Procurement, Procurement Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related discipline, including significant leadership experience.
• Demonstrated experience leading multiple Procurement disciplines, including strategic sourcing, procure to pay or procurement operations, and procurement data, analytics, or systems.
• Experience leading large, complex, or geographically distributed teams and managing through direct and indirect leadership structures.
• Strong understanding of strategic sourcing, category management, supplier management, contracting, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoice processes, and source-to-pay controls.
• Strong executive presence, communication, influence, negotiation, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to use data and business insights to set priorities, manage performance, allocate resources, and identify opportunities and risks.
• Experience working in a global organization and leading teams that support stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience leading a Procurement Center of Excellence, shared-service organization, global delivery center, or India-based Procurement organization.
• Experience in a large, complex, or technology-enabled company with significant indirect or addressable spend.
• Experience with procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable automation, contract lifecycle management, supplier management, or business intelligence platforms.
• Experience leading automation, digital procurement, data integration, KPI governance, or analytics-enabled operating model improvements.
• Experience managing international sourcing, cross-border procurement, regional legal entities, multiple currencies, or local market requirements.

title: Sr Mgr. Strategic Sourcing- Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 

Job Summary
The Senior Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems will lead the team responsible for procurement data, reporting, systems enablement, process improvement, and special projects across the Sourcing & Procurement organization. This role will ensure that Procurement leadership and Category Managers have reliable data, effective tools, actionable insights, and disciplined processes to manage performance, improve operations, and make informed commercial decisions. 
The Senior manager will lead a team that supports procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, reporting, KPI management, systems improvements, and cross-functional initiatives. The role will partner closely with Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and other business functions to improve visibility and execution across the procurement lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine people leadership, procurement operations knowledge, analytical capability, systems thinking, and strong project management skills. 
A significant responsibility of this role will be to establish and operate a reliable savings governance process. Working with Category Managers and Finance, the manager will define how Procurement savings are calculated, documented, validated, approved, tracked, and reported. The process will distinguish between P&L savings and contractual savings or cost avoidance and will provide leadership with a clear view of expected, validated, realized, and at-risk value.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Operating Model
• Lead, coach, and develop the Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems team, including the Senior Systems Analyst and Senior Data & Analytics Analyst.
• Set priorities, establish clear ownership, manage capacity, and ensure work is delivered accurately and on time across reporting, systems, analytics, and special projects.
• Create a service-oriented operating model with defined intake, prioritization, delivery, communication, quality, and escalation practices.
• Build strong relationships with Procurement leadership, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand needs and deliver practical solutions.
• Develop the team's capabilities in procurement operations, data analysis, systems management, project delivery, process improvement, and stakeholder communication.

Procurement Systems and Technology Enablement
• Ensure procurement systems support the organization's category management model, intake processes, sourcing activities, contract and renewal visibility, savings tracking, and operational reporting needs.
• Partner with system owners and Technology to define requirements, evaluate solutions, manage testing and UAT, and implement changes with appropriate controls and adoption support.
• Establish system governance practices that promote data quality, clear ownership, consistent configuration, controlled changes, and reliable integrations.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, digitize, and automate manual procurement activities and prioritize improvements based on value, feasibility, risk, and user impact.

Data, Analytics, and Executive Reporting
• Oversee the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Procurement dashboards, scorecards, KPI definitions, and executive reporting packages.
• Ensure leadership and Category Managers have timely, accurate, and actionable insight into spend, sourcing activity, savings, cycle time, adoption, workload, risk, supplier performance, and other measures of Procurement performance.
• Establish data processes and governance that enable consistent collection, validation, reconciliation, and consumption of procurement data across systems and functions.
• Translate analysis into clear recommendations that support prioritization, resource allocation, category strategy, process improvement, and leadership decision-making.
• Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and other functions to obtain, reconcile, and improve access to relevant data sources.

Savings Governance and Value Tracking
• Design and implement a standardized process for calculating, documenting, tracking, validating, and reporting Procurement savings and cost avoidance.
• Partner with Category Managers to review savings methodologies, assumptions, baselines, timing, addressable spend, and supporting documentation for sourcing and procurement initiatives.
• Partner with Finance to distinguish and reconcile P&L savings from contractual savings, cost avoidance, and other forms of value creation and to establish an appropriate validation and sign-off process.
• Maintain a centralized savings tracker and reporting process that shows pipeline, estimated value, validated value, realized value, timing, risks, and variances against target.
• Provide regular savings and value reporting to Procurement leadership and support reviews with Finance and other senior stakeholders.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks in savings reporting and drive corrective action to improve credibility, transparency, and auditability.

Special Projects, Compliance, and Process Improvement
• Lead and support special projects across Procurement Operations, including initiatives related to compliance, Accounts Payable, procurement controls, policy implementation, process redesign, system changes, and operational transformation.
• Develop project charters, plans, milestones, risks, decisions, communications, and success measures for cross-functional initiatives.
• Partner with Accounts Payable on invoice, vendor, payment, and procure-to-pay projects that improve accuracy, timeliness, controls, and the stakeholder experience.
• Support compliance monitoring and reporting, including identifying process deviations, control gaps, unauthorized activity, missing approvals, and other risks requiring management attention.
• Use root-cause analysis, process mapping, stakeholder feedback, and performance data to improve Procurement processes and reduce cycle time, rework, and manual effort.
• Ensure changes are documented, communicated, adopted, and measured after implementation.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• Experience in Procurement, Procurement Operations, Sourcing, Finance, Business Intelligence, Procurement Systems, or a related function, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
• Experience managing, mentoring, or leading analysts or operations professionals.
• Demonstrated experience developing procurement reporting, KPI frameworks, dashboards, data processes, or operational performance management routines.
• Experience working with Finance to calculate, validate, reconcile, and report savings, cost avoidance, or other business value metrics.

title: Cloud Engineer III- Eng
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 

Role Purpose

The Cloud Patching and Backup team is seeking a Software Engineer III to strengthen Tanium-based Linux patching, vulnerability remediation, and automation across UKG cloud and data-center environments. The role combines hands-on Linux engineering with software-focused automation and cross-team operational ownership.

About the Team

The Cloud Patching and Backup team provides management services for UKG cloud and on-premise environments, supporting product maintenance, security, availability, and resilience through operating-system patching, Tanium-based endpoint management, systems automation, observability, backup integration, and coordinated production changes.

Responsibilities

The engineer will serve as a Linux subject matter expert for Cloud Engineering and use Tanium to plan, target, deploy, monitor, and validate patching across development, test, disaster-recovery, non-production, and production environments. Responsibilities include maintaining Tanium packages, actions, deployments, schedules, targeting logic, and compliance reporting; troubleshooting patch applicability, installation failures, pending reboots, configuration drift, and post-patch service issues; and improving deployment reliability through Python tooling and DevOps practices such as Git, code review, CI/CD, testing, logging, and documentation. The role will coordinate patch plans and emergency vulnerability remediation with application, database, security, SRE, and regional operations teams while supporting observability, formal change controls, maintenance windows, and an on-call rotation.

Scope and Level Expectations

Independently lead complex Tanium-based Linux patching initiatives from problem definition through implementation, validation, and operational handoff.
Coordinate work across environments, regions, product pillars, and partner teams while maintaining production safety and clear communication.
Identify recurring operational problems, turn them into automation or reliability improvements, and mentor engineers and operations partners.

Core Qualifications

Five or more years of experience in Linux systems engineering, administration, software engineering, or a related field.
Strong enterprise Linux experience, including system upgrades, package management, services, filesystems, storage, networking, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience using Tanium or a comparable enterprise platform to target, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and report on operating-system patches across large server fleets.
Strong Python skills for operational tooling, automation, integrations, data processing, and maintainable code, with experience using Git, CI/CD, and infrastructure or configuration as code.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong written and verbal communication skills are also required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or comparable DevOps automation tools.
Experience with GCP, AWS, or Azure; hybrid cloud operations; and large, geographically distributed server fleets.
Experience with vulnerability remediation, CVE prioritization, security scanning, observability tools, or enterprise backup platforms such as Veeam or Commvault.

Working Relationships

This role works closely with Cloud Infrastructure, security and vulnerability teams, application and database engineering, SRE, observability, backup, change management, and regional operations. Success depends on translating Linux engineering decisions into safe production execution, measurable reliability improvements, and clear operational handoffs.
