title: Sr IT Software Engineer (Service Now Developer)
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 
Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior ServiceNow Developer with at least seven years of experience designing, developing, configuring, and supporting ServiceNow solutions. The ideal candidate has strong experience across ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB, with additional experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

The candidate will work with architects, platform owners, process teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable solutions aligned with platform standards and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, configure, and support ServiceNow applications and platform capabilities.
Build and enhance ITSM workflows, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, and Service Catalog.
Develop ITOM capabilities such as Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and integrations with monitoring tools.
Maintain CMDB data quality, including CI identification and reconciliation, relationships, normalization, and health reporting.
Configure and enhance TPRM capabilities, including vendor onboarding, risk assessments, questionnaires, issues, workflows, and reporting.
Develop integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, spokes, MID Servers, and other appropriate integration patterns.
Create and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer flows, Catalog Items, and notifications.
Apply platform security controls, including ACLs, roles, groups, and data access rules.
Support deployments through update sets or application repositories, and follow development, testing, and release management practices.
Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
Participate in requirements discussions, solution design, code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
Follow secure development practices and support compliance needs in regulated environments, including FedRAMP-aligned ServiceNow environments.
Collaborate with platform and security teams to maintain separation of duties, access controls, auditability, and change traceability.
Required Qualifications
7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development and administration experience.
Strong development experience with JavaScript and the ServiceNow scripting framework.
Practical experience delivering solutions across ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB.
Experience configuring and supporting TPRM workflows and risk management processes.
Experience with Discovery, MID Server configuration, CI identification and reconciliation, and CMDB relationships.
Experience building and consuming REST or SOAP integrations.
Proficiency with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, ACLs, and Service Catalog.
Understanding of ServiceNow upgrade, testing, deployment, and release management practices.
Ability to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
Strong communication, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or relevant CIS certifications.
Experience with ServiceNow TPRM, Integrated Risk Management (IRM), or Vendor Risk Management implementations.
Experience with Service Mapping, Event Management, Service Graph Connectors, or CMDB Workspace.
Familiarity with Automated Test Framework (ATF), Performance Analytics, source control, and automated deployment practices.
Experience working in Agile delivery teams and supporting enterprise-scale ServiceNow implementations.


Company Overview: 
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. 
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 
Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process 
For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com ServiceNow ITSM ITOM CMDB JavaScript TPRM REST APIs SOAP APIs Flow Designer Discovery Service Mapping IntegrationHub MID Servers Script Includes Business Rules Client Scripts The role requires at least seven years of hands-on ServiceNow development and administration experience with strong proficiency in JavaScript. Candidates must have practical experience across ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB, along with excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

title: SDE 2 - Backend
job_description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:


We are looking for an experienced Backend developer to join our technology team.
As a Backend developer, you’ll work closely with our Design, Product, Data
Science and Analytics team to develop microservices which focus on the financial
needs of millennials in India. If you have excellent programming skills and a
passion for developing applications or improving existing ones, we would like to
meet you.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 * Design and develop microservices that can work in a large-scale multi-tenant
   environment.

 * Explore design implications and work towards an appropriate balance between
   functionality, performance, and maintainability.

 * Work with a cross-disciplined team of Design, Product, Data Science, and
   Analytics teams.

 * Deploy and maintain the application in a secure AWS environment. Take
   ownership from the ideation phase to deployment and maintenance.

 * Actively participate in the hiring process to bring world-class programmers
   to the team.


WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

 * 3+ years of experience in server-side development.

 * Strong programming skills. Hands-on experience in API development and
   frameworks such as Express, Loopback, Hapi.

 * Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases.

 * Experience in test-driven development (Unit test and API test).

 * Understanding of basic cloud computing concepts and experience in using any
   of the major cloud service providers(AWS/GCP/Azure).

 * Ability to build and deploy the application in a containerized environment.

 * Understanding of application logging and monitoring systems like Prometheus
   or Kibana.

 * B.E/B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/M.S. from a reputed university with a good academic
   record.

 * Curiosity to explore cutting-edge technologies and bake them into the
   products.

 * Zeal and drive to take end-to-end ownership.


LIFE AT SLICE: 

Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:  

 * Competitive salaries. Period.  

 * An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their
   dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.  

 * Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep
   schedule.  

 * Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment
   in your life.     

 * A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year.
   Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.   

 * Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.  

 * Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An
   environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your
   friends”. 

We believe in equality. Period. 



At slice, we are committed to building a diverse and talented workforce. We
never discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, colour, national origin,
gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran
status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic
protected by the applicable law. 



We consider all qualified job-seekers with criminal histories in a manner 
consistent with the applicable law. Additionally, we are committed to providing
reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with physical or mental
disabilities in order to participate in the job application or interview
process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits
and privileges of employment. 



Come join our crew!

slice

title: Engagement Principal, Chanakya
job_description:
ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is
developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research,
models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI
genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public
institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam
partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED,
IDFC, and LIC.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Engagement Principal is a senior client-facing role in the Chanakya vertical.
You own pipeline development, account strategy, and long-term engagement
management across defence and strategic sector clients. This is not a
quota-chasing sales role — it is a builder role for someone who understands the
defence procurement landscape, can engage at the command and technical
leadership level, and can convert complex AI capability into funded, deployable
programmes.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

•       Own GTM strategy and pipeline for this vertical: from prospecting
through programme initiation.

•       Build and maintain relationships at the decision-making level:
Acquisition directorates, CTO offices, field and HQ command, and PSU leadership.

•       Translate Sarvam’s technical capability into proposals and narratives
that resonate across technical and command-level stakeholders.

•       Lead RFI/RFP responses, PoC scoping, and commercial negotiation — with
full technical fluency.

•       Collaborate with Strategic Deployment Engineers and the product team to
ensure client expectations are grounded in what we can actually deliver.

•       Manage account health, renewal strategy, and expansion pipeline for
active accounts.

•       Surface emerging requirements, policy shifts, and competitor moves that
should shape our roadmap.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

•       7–12 years of total experience, with at least 4 years in strategic
sector GTM, defence procurement consulting, or enterprise sales in a technical
domain.

•       Track record of closing and managing multi-crore engagements in
disciplined or complex environments: defence, critical infrastructure, or
complex enterprise clients.

•       Functional understanding of defence procurement frameworks: DRDO, DPP,
emergency procurement, Make-I/Make-II.

•       Strong executive presence: comfortable in flag-level meetings and senior
CTO offices, and equally comfortable with working-level technical teams.

•       Familiarity with GenAI/ML capability sufficient to hold a credible
conversation about what Sarvam’s stack can and cannot do.

•       Active network in the Indian defence ecosystem (Army, Navy, IAF, DRDO,
DPP offices, PSUs, DSSC) is an advantage.

 


BONUS POINTS

•       You’ve built a pipeline in a domain where trust takes years — and moved
it faster than expected.

•       You’ve held a deal together through difficult technical delivery without
damaging the client relationship.

•       You are well-networked in the defence and strategic sector ecosystem.

•       Experience owning complex, ambiguous mandates at a consulting firm, with
accountability for outcomes.

 

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not
people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you
and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

 


WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for
India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real
population-scale impact.

•       Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders
who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.

•       High ownership and high impact, from day one.

•       Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way
we think about problems.

•       You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns,
works, and communicates.

 

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the
place to be. A deep understanding of defence frameworks and the ability to engage with senior command and technical leadership is essential.

Role: Intern - Banking Operations ( 3 Months Internship)

 * Act as the primary point of contact (POC) for the Banking Operations team for

   product optimization. You will need to communicate requirements, track

 * Occasionally screen websites when required, which could be for verifying

 * Own & execute end to end cost queries internally, cross-functionally & with

 * Fresher - Available for 3 months internship with Banking Operations team

 * Strong communication skills, oral & written.

 * Proven experience on google sheets or excel knowledge.

 * Strong inter/intrapersonal skills and an ability to build rapport with our
   banking partners. title: Software Development Manager
job_description:
Responsibilities:

 * Architect & Develop: Design and implement highly scalable, low-latency
   backend services and APIs in Java. Lead rigorous code reviews, enforcing
   SOLID principles, clean code heuristics, and secure coding practices.

 * System Design & Streaming: Build robust microservices, RESTful/gRPC APIs, and
   event-driven architectures utilizing distributed streaming platforms (e.g.,
   Apache Kafka, Kinesis) for real-time payment processing and data pipelines.

 * Engineering Excellence: Champion technical standards across the engineering
   team by conducting Architecture Design Reviews (ADRs), establishing best
   practices, and driving consistent agile delivery.

 * Distributed Architecture: Navigate complex architectural tradeoffs in a
   large-scale distributed environment. Implement advanced synchronous and
   asynchronous communication patterns, circuit breakers, load balancing, and
   distributed tracing.

 * Performance Optimization: Optimize API performance and database queries for
   massive throughput. Ensure high code coverage and reliability through
   TDD/BDD, extensive integration testing, and performance profiling.

 * DevOps & CI/CD: Orchestrate CI/CD pipelines leveraging containerization
   (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure seamless,
   zero-downtime automated deployments.

 * Technical Leadership: Partner with engineering leadership and Staff/Principal
   engineers to resolve complex concurrency issues, JVM-level bottlenecks, and
   distributed system anomalies.

Requirements:

 * 8+ years of deep, hands-on backend software engineering experience, primarily
   in the Java ecosystem (Java 11+, JVM internals, Garbage Collection tuning,
   memory management).

 * 2+ years of experience as a Technical Lead, actively mentoring engineers,
   unblocking teams, and driving technical roadmaps.

 * Proficiency with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, and ORM
   frameworks (Hibernate/JPA).

 * Strong production experience with cloud-native architectures on AWS (EC2,
   EKS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS, ElastiCache) and a solid understanding of cloud
   networking and security.
   
   Deep expertise in RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including query execution plans,
   indexing strategies, locking mechanisms, and ACID transaction isolation
   levels. Solid experience with NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).

 * High-Scale Concepts: Strong understanding of distributed caching
   (Redis/Memcached), rate limiting, building idempotent APIs, and managing
   state in distributed environments.

 * Product Thinking: Uncover the why,challenge assumptions and turn ambiguity
   into simple, high-impact solutions that translate intent into action.

 * Innovation: Challenge the status quo, simplify complexity, embrace new
   technologies, and turn curiosity → experiment → insight → solution into
   elegant, reliable, scalable systems that create lasting value.

 * AI Engineering: Build practical expertise in AI, LLMs, agents, automation,
   and emerging technologies to transform engineering workflows with
   context-aware, evidence-based, reliable, validated, and safely controlled AI
   solutions.

Your Opportunity:

 * Massive Scale: Architect and evolve core payment routing and processing
   engines capable of flawlessly handling $80B+ in annual transaction volume
   with strict P99 latency requirements.

 * High Throughput: Engineer resilient, highly available solutions to support a
   rapidly growing base of 800,000+ merchants, seamlessly processing tens of
   millions of requests daily.

 * Technical Impact: Drive organizational technology evolution on multiple
   fronts—introducing advanced observability paradigms (e.g., Prometheus,
   Grafana, ELK), optimizing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring platform
   reliability.

 * Innovation: Lead the charge on technical innovations, exploring new
   frameworks and architectural patterns to keep our core payment systems ahead
   of industry standards.
   
   .

title: Senior Director, Operational Excellence & Quality Improvement - Bangalore / Mumbai
job_description:
Company Description
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
Job Description
Position summary
The Senior Director, Operational Excellence & Quality Improvement leads the strategic enhancement of Gracenote’s end-to-end global operating model. This executive establishes robust governance, metrics, quality systems, and cross-functional alignment to drive customer trust, data accuracy, scalability, operational efficiency, and resilience.
Translating growth, automation, and content-modernization strategies into high-impact operating plans, this role leads cross-functional teams across Content, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Commercial, and Strategy to champion data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
Key responsibilities
Define and execute the global operational excellence and quality strategy across Gracenote.
Establish high-impact performance governance, risk management, QA protocols, and continuous improvement frameworks.
Align business goals with initiative portfolios, resource planning, and clear performance outcomes.
Proactively mitigate operational, technology, and transformation risks before they impact customers.
Own the end-to-end quality framework, including SOPs, audits, monitoring, alerts, and process QA.
Lead incident management, root-cause analysis (RCA), and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) tracking.
Eliminate customer-impacting defects, rework, and process variation at the root cause level.
Build executive dashboards to track quality trends, SLA compliance, defect severity, and remediation progress.
Partner with Product & Engineering on release readiness, UAT, change control, and post-release reviews.
Drive data-driven transformation projects leveraging automation, process discovery, and change management.
Advance human-in-the-loop (HITL) automation to scale operations, improve speed, and ensure precision.
Coach, develop, and inspire high-performing global teams, embedding continuous learning and inclusion.
Measures of success
Measurable reduction in customer defects, quality escapes, recurring incidents, and unnecessary rework.
Increased RCA completion velocity, CAPA effectiveness, SLA compliance, and risk resolution rates.
Enhanced throughput, cycle times, capacity management, productivity, and automation adoption.
Higher customer satisfaction, operational resilience, operational transparency, and organizational capabilities.
Qualifications
12+ years of progressive experience in operations, quality, process excellence, transformation, content/data operations, product operations, or a related field, including significant leadership experience.
Experience leading through multiple managers and/or senior functional leaders in a complex, global organization.
Demonstrated success building operational excellence, quality-management, continuous-improvement, or business-performance systems.
Strong knowledge of QA, process governance, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, risk management, change management, KPIs, and executive reporting.
Track record leading technology-enabled transformation, automation, process redesign, or platform modernization.
Exceptional communication, influence, facilitation, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree or relevant certification preferred.
Media, entertainment, metadata, data services, digital products, or complex content/technology experience preferred.
Leadership profile
A systems thinker and pragmatic operator who moves comfortably between strategy and execution; creates clarity without waiting for certainty; balances quality, speed, efficiency, cost, and customer outcomes; and leaves teams stronger than they found them.
Additional Information
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels. Operational Excellence Quality Improvement Strategic Planning Governance Risk Management Process Optimization Change Management Root-cause Analysis Data-driven Decision Making Automation Stakeholder Management Leadership Performance Metrics Incident Management Cross-functional Collaboration Candidates must have 12+ years of progressive experience in operations, quality, or process excellence within a complex global organization. A bachelor's degree is required, with a preference for advanced degrees and experience in media, metadata, or data services.

title: Sr Strategic Sourcing Analyst- International Sourcing Analyst
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 

Job Summary
The International Sourcing Analyst II is a key member of the Sourcing & Procurement organization and serves as the dedicated sourcing partner for international legal entities. Working closely with the Director of Sourcing – Global, this role will lead sourcing and procurement projects across categories, from initial intake and requirements definition through market analysis, sourcing, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and supplier follow-up.
This is an individual-contributor role with end-to-end ownership of assigned projects. The International Sourcing Analyst II will independently manage a portfolio of international sourcing initiatives, establish project plans and timelines, coordinate stakeholders and suppliers, develop recommendations, and remain accountable for delivering measurable business value.
The successful candidate will combine strong sourcing fundamentals, commercial judgment, analytical capability, and knowledge of international business practices. The role will work with stakeholders across countries, functions, and time zones and will help ensure that international procurement activity is consistent with Sourcing & Procurement policies while also reflecting local business, legal, financial, and operational requirements.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Sourcing Project Ownership
• Lead assigned sourcing and procurement projects for international legal entities from intake through completion, including project planning, stakeholder alignment, sourcing execution, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and closeout.
• Serve as the primary Sourcing & Procurement point of contact for assigned projects and maintain clear accountability for scope, milestones, deliverables, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
• Develop project plans, sourcing strategies, timelines, stakeholder maps, evaluation criteria, communication plans, and decision materials appropriate to the complexity and value of each initiative.
• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong organization, timely follow-up, accurate documentation, and consistent communication with stakeholders and suppliers.
• Escalate risks, delays, scope changes, and unresolved decisions to the Director of Sourcing – Global with clear recommendations and proposed actions.
International Stakeholder and Business Partnership
• Build effective working relationships across countries and time zones and adapt communication, project management, and sourcing approaches to local business needs.
• Help international stakeholders navigate Sourcing & Procurement requirements, approval processes, supplier onboarding, contracting, and applicable policies.
• Clarify business requirements, challenge specifications when appropriate, identify opportunities to consolidate demand, and promote enterprise value while respecting local requirements.
• Provide regular project updates, recommendations, and status reporting to the Director of Sourcing – Global and relevant business leadership.
Strategic Sourcing and Negotiations
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned categories and projects, including Requests for Information, Requests for Proposal, Requests for Quote, competitive bidding, benchmarking, and direct negotiations.
• Conduct market, supplier, and commercial research to understand supplier capabilities, competitive dynamics, pricing drivers, market conditions, and potential sourcing opportunities.
• Develop sourcing documentation, supplier communications, evaluation criteria, bid analyses, negotiation plans, and recommendation materials.
• Analyze supplier proposals, pricing structures, payment terms, service levels, contract terms, and other commercial considerations to develop clear comparisons and recommendations.
• Lead or actively participate in supplier negotiations, using data, benchmarking, scenario analysis, and commercial judgment to improve value and manage risk.
• Coordinate supplier presentations, clarification meetings, reference checks, due diligence, and other activities needed to support an informed award decision.
Contracting, Implementation, and Supplier Management
• Partner with Legal, TPRM, Finance, business stakeholders, and suppliers to move sourcing recommendations through contracting and approval to execution.
• Review Statements of Work, order forms, proposals, pricing schedules, and other commercial documents for alignment with negotiated terms, business requirements, and approved sourcing outcomes.
• Coordinate implementation activities, including purchase order requirements, supplier onboarding, transition planning, communications, and handoff to the appropriate business owner.
• Support supplier performance management by establishing expectations, tracking issues, coordinating business reviews, and escalating performance concerns when appropriate.
• Maintain accurate sourcing, contract, supplier, project, and savings information in applicable procurement systems and tracking tools.
• Support renewals and extensions for assigned international suppliers by assessing business needs, historical spend, performance, market alternatives, and commercial opportunities.
Savings, Value Creation, and Reporting
• Identify and pursue cost savings, cost avoidance, demand management, process improvements, risk reduction, and other sources of value across assigned international projects.
• Document sourcing assumptions, baselines, negotiated outcomes, implementation timing, and supporting evidence for each project.
Governance, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
• Ensure assigned projects follow Sourcing & Procurement policies, approval requirements, sourcing practices, contracting standards, and applicable controls.
• Identify and communicate potential compliance, supplier, commercial, legal, tax, currency, payment, or operational risks associated with international sourcing projects.
• Maintain complete and audit-ready project documentation, including requirements, sourcing events, evaluations, approvals, negotiations, recommendations, contracts, and savings support.
• Identify opportunities to improve international sourcing processes, templates, tools, stakeholder experience, and consistency across legal entities.
• Share lessons learned, market intelligence, supplier insights, and effective practices with the Director of Sourcing – Global and the broader Sourcing & Procurement organization.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, International Business, or a related field.
• 3–5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, purchasing, supply chain, commercial analysis, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience independently leading sourcing or procurement projects from requirements definition through negotiation, contracting, and implementation.
• Experience managing sourcing events such as RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, competitive bids, or structured negotiations.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret spend, pricing, supplier, and commercial data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Strong negotiation, project management, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and suppliers across functions, countries, and organizational levels.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining accurate documentation and timely delivery.
• Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take ownership of outcomes, and escalate issues appropriately.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and other business productivity and procurement tools.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working directly with international legal entities, regional business units, or stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.
• Experience leading sourcing projects across corporate services, professional services, facilities, travel, marketing, human resources, finance, or other non-technology categories.
• Experience with international contracting, cross-border sourcing, multiple currencies, local market requirements, tax considerations, payment terms, or supplier due diligence.
• Experience with contract lifecycle management, sourcing, spend analytics, supplier management, or procurement workflow platforms.
• Experience partnering with Finance to calculate and validate P&L savings, contractual savings, cost avoidance, or other value measures.
• Experience supporting supplier performance management, business reviews, or post-award governance.

Company Overview: 
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. 
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 
Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process 
For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com Strategic sourcing Procurement Project management Negotiation Contracting Market analysis Stakeholder management Data analysis Financial analysis Supply chain management International business Supplier management Microsoft Excel Microsoft PowerPoint Microsoft Teams Risk management Candidates must possess a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 3–5 years of experience in strategic sourcing or procurement. Strong analytical, negotiation, and project management skills are required, along with the ability to work effectively across different countries and time zones.

General Summary:
The Senior Software Test Engineer I is responsible for creating and maintaining automated tests from manual test scripts and test cases. This role works in partnership with the Engineering teams to provide support on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, and potential problems
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Provides support to the Quality Engineering teams, with a high attention to detail in a disciplined agile
environment

practices

Plans test schedules and/or strategies in accordance with project scope and delivery dates
Reviews software documentation to ensure technical accuracy, compliance, and completeness and to mitigate risks
Provides feedback and recommendations on software usability and functionality
Identifies program deviance from standards and suggests modifications to ensure compliance
Develops and specifies standards, methods, or procedures to determine product quality or release readiness
Conducts historical analyses of test results
Collaborates with colleagues to evaluate or diagnose problems and recommend possible solutions
Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities Required:
Ability to work independently on projects and processes with general supervision
Practical knowledge of applicable work area
Ability to situationally adapt and understand new technology/processes as per business requirement
Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies
Familiarity with object-oriented programming language
Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Knowledge of builds and deployments
Ability to update base level classes without causing issues
Strong problem-solving skills
Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to meet reasonable deadlines
Strong team player with the ability to build positive and collaborative relationships
Knowledge of programming concepts and ability to read complex manual test c ases and implement new
actions, fragments, and scripts

Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent business experience
3+ years of relevant experience

Onsite/Hybrid/Remote depending on location

title: Lead Strategic Sourcing Analyst- Data and Analytics
job_description:
Why UKG: 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. 
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. 


Job Summary
The Senior Data and Analytics Analyst will own reporting, data, and analytical support for the Sourcing & Procurement organization. Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will connect data from procurement workflow, spend analytics, ERP, Finance, Accounts Payable, and other relevant sources to provide reliable reporting and actionable insights for Procurement leadership and Category Managers.
The role will design and maintain dashboards, executive reporting packages, KPI definitions, data processes, and analytical models that help the organization manage performance and make better decisions. The successful candidate will combine strong technical skills in Excel, Power BI, and SQL with an understanding of procurement and the ability to explain complex data clearly to business and executive audiences.
Key Responsibilities
Procurement Reporting and Executive Insights
• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve executive reporting packages used by the VP of Sourcing and Procurement and Procurement leadership to review organizational performance.
• Design dashboards and scorecards that provide visibility into spend, sourcing pipeline, savings, cost avoidance, cycle time, adoption, supplier activity, workload, risk, and other Procurement KPIs.
• Deliver recurring and ad hoc analysis for leadership, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, and other stakeholders, translating data into clear insights and recommended actions.
• Develop reporting views that support category strategy, supplier prioritization, renewal planning, resource allocation, compliance monitoring, and operational improvement.
• Ensure reports are accurate, timely, easy to interpret, and appropriately tailored to the audience and decision being supported.
KPI Definition and Performance Management
• Partner with Procurement leaders and process owners to define meaningful KPIs, business rules, calculation methods, targets, owners, reporting frequency, and data sources.
• Establish and maintain a centralized KPI catalog and reporting documentation so measures are consistently understood and applied across Sourcing & Procurement.
• Track performance trends, variances, bottlenecks, and emerging risks and proactively highlight issues that require leadership attention.
• Support the development of service-level and operational reporting for intake, sourcing, contracting, purchase orders, invoices, supplier onboarding, savings, and other procurement activities.
• Help stakeholders move from descriptive reporting to actionable analytics by identifying root causes, opportunities, and recommended next steps.
Data Integration, Quality, and Governance
• Connect and reconcile data from procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, Finance, contract, supplier, and other relevant systems.
• Use SQL, Power BI, Excel, Power Query, and related tools to extract, transform, model, validate, and present data for reliable consumption.
• Partner with system owners and other functions to improve access to source data, resolve data quality issues, document field definitions, and close reporting gaps.
• Establish repeatable data refresh, validation, reconciliation, and exception-management processes that reduce manual reporting effort and improve confidence in results.
• Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, business rules, calculations, assumptions, refresh schedules, and report ownership.
• Support appropriate access, confidentiality, controls, and governance for Procurement and financial data.
Savings and Value Analytics
• Support the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems in implementing a centralized process to calculate, track, validate, and report Procurement savings and cost avoidance.
• Build reporting that distinguishes P&L savings, contractual savings, cost avoidance, pipeline value, validated value, realized value, and at-risk value.
• Partner with Category Managers and Finance to reconcile savings data, validate assumptions and timing, and identify variances between Procurement estimates and Finance-approved results.
• Provide dashboards and analysis that show savings performance by category, supplier, initiative, owner, fiscal period, and status.
• Improve the transparency, consistency, auditability, and usability of Procurement value reporting.
Self-Service Analytics and Stakeholder Enablement
• Create intuitive dashboards, templates, and data products that allow Category Managers and Procurement leaders to answer common questions without relying on manual analysis for every request.
• Train and support stakeholders in interpreting dashboards, using reports, understanding KPI definitions, and applying insights to business decisions.
• Gather feedback from users and use it to improve report design, usability, performance, and relevance.
• Promote consistent use of approved data sources and reporting definitions across the Procurement organization.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
• 4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, procurement analytics, finance analytics, operations analytics, or a related role.
• Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining dashboards, executive reporting packages, KPI frameworks, and analytical models.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and SQL, including data extraction, transformation, modeling, analysis, and visualization.
• Experience connecting and reconciling multiple data sources and translating complex data into clear, actionable business insights.
• Experience defining metrics, documenting business rules, implementing repeatable data processes, and improving data quality and reporting reliability.
• Strong understanding of data validation, quality controls, data governance, and reporting lifecycle management.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to Procurement leaders, Category Managers, Finance, and other stakeholders.
• Strong attention to detail, ownership, prioritization, and ability to manage recurring reporting responsibilities while responding to ad hoc needs.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting a Sourcing & Procurement organization, including spend analytics, sourcing pipeline, contract or renewal reporting, supplier analytics, P2P, or savings reporting.
• Experience with procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, contract lifecycle, supplier management, or data warehouse tools.
• Experience with Power Query, cloud data platforms, or automated report refreshes.
• Experience partnering with Finance to calculate, validate, reconcile, and report P&L savings, contractual savings, cost avoidance, or other value metrics.
• Experience working in a global organization and supporting stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
• Power BI, SQL, Tableau, CIPS, APICS, or other relevant certification or training.

Company Overview: 
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. 
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 
Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process 
For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com Data Analytics SQL Power BI Excel Procurement Analytics Reporting Data Modeling KPI Definition Financial Analysis Data Governance Business Intelligence Data Visualization Stakeholder Management Process Improvement Spend Analytics Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least 4 years of experience in data or business analytics. Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel is required, along with strong communication skills and experience in data modeling and reporting.

Job Summary
The Procurement Operations Manager – Procure to Pay will lead a team of P2P specialists responsible for the timely and accurate creation and management of purchase orders and the reconciliation and approval of invoices. This role is central to ensuring that the business has the purchasing coverage, data quality, and operational support needed to pay suppliers accurately and on time.
The manager will run a data-driven operating model that monitors intake-to-purchase requisition and purchase order cycle times, invoice processing and approval cycle times, workload, aging, exception trends, and service-level performance. The role will use these insights to allocate work effectively, identify risks before they become payment issues, and guide business stakeholders on actions needed to maintain sufficient funds on purchase orders for expected spend.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this role will help transform P2P operations by standardizing processes, reducing manual touchpoints, improving controls, and identifying opportunities to automate repeatable work. The successful candidate will combine strong operational discipline and attention to detail with the ability to use data, influence stakeholders, and continuously improve the employee and supplier experience.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Daily Operations
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of P2P specialists responsible for purchase order creation, purchase order maintenance, invoice reconciliation, and invoice approval support.
• Establish clear work queues, service expectations, quality standards, escalation paths, and coverage plans to ensure consistent support across business areas and time zones.
• Use workload, aging, complexity, and capacity data to assign work to the appropriate team members and rebalance priorities as business needs change.
• Monitor daily execution and remove operational blockers so purchase orders and invoices are processed accurately and within agreed timelines.
• Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and high-quality service to internal stakeholders and suppliers.

Purchase Order and Requisition Operations
• Oversee the end-to-end PR-to-PO process, including requisition review, purchase order creation, validation of required information, and timely communication with requesters and approvers.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and reflect approved commercial terms, supplier information, quantities, pricing, dates, accounting details, and available funding.
• Manage purchase order changes, amendments, closures, cancellations, and other maintenance activities while preserving data integrity and appropriate approvals.
• Lead year-end purchase order cleanup activities, including identifying obsolete or expired purchase orders, coordinating required actions, and improving readiness for the new fiscal year.
• Partner with budget owners, Finance, Category Managers, and business stakeholders to proactively identify purchase orders that may not have sufficient funds to cover expected spend and coordinate timely corrective action.
• Establish proactive monitoring and reporting that alerts the business to funding risks before invoices are received or payments are delayed.

Invoice Reconciliation and Approval Support
• Oversee invoice reconciliation and approval support, including researching discrepancies, and coordinating resolution with requesters, Accounts Payable, and other partners.
• Ensure invoices are routed to the correct approvers and approved within required timelines, with appropriate follow-up on aging or stalled items.
• Identify recurring invoice exceptions, root causes, and process gaps and recommend corrective actions that improve first-time match rates and reduce rework.
• Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve blocked invoices, supplier inquiries, payment risks, and other issues that could result in late payment, duplicate payment, or inaccurate accounting.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation to support auditability, policy compliance, and reliable reporting.

Metrics, Reporting, and Controls
• Define, produce, and maintain operational dashboards and reports covering intake-to-PR and PR-to-PO cycle time, PO creation accuracy, PO change volumes, invoice processing and approval cycle time, aging, exception rates, workload, throughput, and service-level performance.
• Translate data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for Procurement leadership, Category Managers, Accounts Payable, and business stakeholders.
• Use trend analysis to anticipate capacity constraints, recurring bottlenecks, funding risks, approval delays, and other issues that may affect business operations or supplier payments.
• Establish quality checks and operating controls that minimize data errors, duplicate work, unauthorized changes, missed approvals, and processing delays.
• Support the development of consistent definitions, data standards, and reporting practices across P2P operations.

Process Improvement and Automation
• Document and standardize P2P procedures, work instructions, handoffs, and escalation paths to ensure repeatable and scalable execution.
• Identify manual, repetitive, and error-prone activities and evaluate opportunities to simplify, digitize, or automate them.
• Partner with Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, Technology, and system owners to define requirements, test solutions, and implement process improvements.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives that reduce cycle time, improve accuracy, increase visibility, and enhance the stakeholder experience while maintaining appropriate controls.
• Measure the impact of implemented improvements and use results to prioritize the next set of operational enhancements.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
• 3–5 years of experience in Sourcing and Procurement, Accounts Payable, Procure to Pay, purchasing operations, or a related function.
• Hands-on experience with the PR-to-PO process, purchase order creation and maintenance, invoice reconciliation, and invoice approval workflows.
• Experience leading, supervising, or coordinating the work of an operations or P2P team, including workload allocation and performance management.
• Strong analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to build, interpret, and act on operational metrics and trends.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and analysis of large data sets; experience with dashboards or business intelligence tools is a plus.
• Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to maintain accuracy while managing high transaction volumes and competing priorities.
• Strong organizational, follow-through, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, business stakeholders, and suppliers across regions and time zones.
• Ability to identify process weaknesses, operationalize solutions, and manage work to defined timelines and service expectations.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working in a global organization with shared-service, offshore, or geographically distributed P2P operations.
• Experience with ERP, procurement, accounts payable, invoice automation, workflow, or supplier management systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms is preferred.
• Experience developing operational dashboards, queue-management reports, service-level reporting, or capacity and workload models.
• Experience leading year-end purchase order cleanup, open commitment reviews, budget or funds-availability monitoring, or similar financial control activities.
• Experience identifying and implementing automation or workflow improvements in P2P, procurement, or Accounts Payable operations.
• Knowledge of three-way matching, invoice exceptions, purchase order controls, approval workflows, and procure-to-pay policies.

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. Job Summary
The Senior Systems Analyst, Procurement Operations will help the Sourcing & Procurement organization maximize the value of its workflow, reporting, and procurement technology. Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will manage the intake, analysis, coordination, and delivery of system and process enhancements that improve procurement execution, visibility, compliance, and stakeholder experience.
The Senior Systems Analyst will serve as a connector between Procurement Operations, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders. The role will translate business needs into structured requirements, workflows, system changes, reports, automations, and operating procedures. Success requires strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, change leadership, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or fast-moving initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio, Intake, and Initiative Management
• Orchestrate the intake process for new Procurement Operations requests, system enhancements, reporting needs, process issues, and special projects.
• Maintain a structured portfolio of active and planned initiatives, including priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, and expected outcomes.
• Develop practical workflows and governance routines that improve transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and timely delivery of procurement initiatives.
• Prepare status updates, decision materials, action logs, and executive-ready communications for Procurement leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Facilitate recurring working sessions and follow up on decisions and actions to keep initiatives moving to completion.
Systems Analysis and Process Design
• Gather and document business requirements for procurement workflow, ERP, spend analytics, reporting, supplier, Accounts Payable, and related systems.
• Map current and future-state processes, identify pain points and control gaps, and recommend practical improvements to reduce cycle time, rework, and manual effort.
• Translate requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, process diagrams, and configuration or development requests.
• Partner with system owners and Technology to evaluate options, clarify feasibility, manage dependencies, and support prioritization decisions.
• Help ensure system design supports Procurement policies, approval requirements, category management, data quality, auditability, and the needs of global stakeholders.
Testing, Implementation, and Adoption
• Coordinate testing and UAT for system enhancements, workflow changes, integrations, reports, and automations.
• Develop test scenarios, expected results, defect logs, resolution tracking, and go-live readiness assessments.
• Support implementation planning, stakeholder communications, training materials, standard operating procedures, and post-implementation adoption.
• Monitor results after implementation and confirm that changes achieve expected outcomes without introducing new operational or control issues.
• Maintain accurate documentation of system functionality, business rules, process ownership, and change history.
Automation and Operational Improvement
• Identify repeatable, manual, and error-prone activities that can be simplified or automated through workflow, integrations, reporting, or low-code solutions.
• Partner with Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, Finance, and Technology to design and implement practical automations that improve accuracy and timeliness.
• Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify root causes of delays, duplicate work, missing information, approval bottlenecks, and compliance risk.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and help measure the impact of changes on cycle time, quality, adoption, workload, and stakeholder experience.
Stakeholder Partnership and Change Management
• Build trusted relationships with Category Managers, Procurement Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders.
• Explain system and process changes clearly, tailor communications to the audience, and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities.
• Raise risks and dependencies early, facilitate resolution across teams, and maintain momentum when priorities or requirements change.
• Support the rollout of workflow tools, reporting processes, procurement controls, and other initiatives that improve how the organization operates.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Process Improvement, or a related field.
• 4+ years of experience in Procurement Operations, Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Project Management, Change Management, Process Improvement, or a related role.
• Experience implementing or improving workflow tools, procurement systems, ERP processes, reporting solutions, or software used across multiple teams.
• Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes, coordinating testing and UAT, managing defects, and supporting implementation and adoption.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to structure workflows, manage multiple priorities, and deliver work to defined timelines.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively across functions and influence decisions without direct authority.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data manipulation, and analysis of operational data.
• Ability to navigate ambiguity, learn new systems quickly, and convert business problems into practical process or technology solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, invoice automation, supplier management, or contract lifecycle systems.
• Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SQL, APIs, or other automation and data tools.
• Experience supporting procurement compliance, SOX controls, audit remediation, Accounts Payable initiatives, or policy implementations.
• Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed stakeholders and shared-service operations.
• Lean Six Sigma, PMP, CIPS, APICS, business analysis, or other relevant certification.

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. 
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 
Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process 
For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com Procurement Operations Systems Analysis Business Analysis Project Management Change Management Process Improvement Data Analysis ERP Systems Workflow Design Stakeholder Management Microsoft Excel Requirements Gathering User Acceptance Testing Automation Strategic Sourcing Reporting Candidates must have a bachelor's degree and at least 4 years of experience in procurement operations, systems analysis, or process improvement. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP systems, workflow tools, and requirements documentation are essential for this role.

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
	
Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour. 
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 
Position Overview:
	
The Operations Executive / Senior Operations Executive – eCommerce Operations is responsible for managing the day-to-day operational execution of the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the surface network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations for the eCommerce product, ensuring shipment visibility, network connectivity, service quality and adherence to committed timelines.
Reporting to the Hub Manager, the incumbent works closely with Linehaul Operations, Network Operations, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient hub processing, timely dispatches and effective resolution of operational exceptions. The role plays a critical part in maintaining service reliability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction for the eCommerce product across the surface logistics network.
Job Purpose:
	
To manage end-to-end hub operations for the eCommerce product by ensuring timely processing, consolidation and movement of shipments across the surface network, while maintaining operational accuracy, service quality, network connectivity and compliance with organisational standards.
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
	
eCommerce Product Operations
Manage day-to-day operational activities for the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub.
Ensure timely receipt, segregation, processing, consolidation and dispatch of eCommerce shipments.
Monitor shipment flow across inbound, outbound and transit operations to achieve network timelines.
Ensure adherence to operational workflows, product handling standards and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Support achievement of product-specific service quality and operational performance targets.
Surface Network Coordination
Coordinate movement of eCommerce shipments through scheduled surface linehaul and feeder network operations.
Ensure timely loading, dispatch and connectivity of shipments to destination hubs and service centres.
Monitor adherence to network cut-off timings and dispatch schedules.
Coordinate with Network Operations and Linehaul teams to minimise delays and optimise shipment movement.
Ensure accurate shipment visibility through timely scanning and system updates.
Shipment Processing & Exception Management
Monitor scanning, sorting, bagging and dispatch activities to ensure operational accuracy.
Proactively identify and resolve shipment exceptions including delays, misroutes, scanning discrepancies and stock lying at hub (SLAH).
Coordinate with originating and destination locations to ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.
Ensure prompt communication of network disruptions and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders.
Drive timely resolution of service issues impacting product performance.
Operational Coordination & Service Performance
Coordinate daily with Hub Operations, Linehaul, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless operational execution.
Monitor daily shipment volumes and support manpower planning based on operational requirements.
Track product-specific operational performance and recommend corrective actions to improve service reliability.
Support implementation of process improvements and operational best practices across the hub.
Prepare operational updates and escalate critical service issues to the Hub Manager in a timely manner.
Service Quality & Operational Excellence
Monitor operational performance against defined service level agreements (SLAs) and eCommerce product commitments.
Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions to minimise service failures and improve shipment visibility.
Monitor shipment ageing, pending loads and stock lying at hub (SLAH), ensuring timely corrective actions.
Drive adherence to scanning compliance, shipment accuracy and operational quality standards.
Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance service reliability and operational productivity.
Resource Planning & Hub Coordination
Coordinate with the Hub Manager to ensure adequate manpower, equipment and operational resources are available to support daily volumes.
Support daily operational planning based on shipment forecasts, network priorities and hub capacity.
Coordinate with transport partners and linehaul teams to ensure timely vehicle placement and dispatch readiness.
Ensure optimum utilisation of operational resources to achieve productivity and cost efficiency.
Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and volume surges.
Compliance & Operational Governance
Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs and statutory requirements applicable to hub operations.
Promote safe handling of shipments and adherence to security protocols across all operational activities.
Support internal audits, quality reviews and compliance assessments, ensuring timely closure of observations.
Maintain operational records, documentation and system updates in accordance with organisational requirements.
Escalate operational risks, compliance gaps and service issues to the Hub Manager on a timely basis.
Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Generate and maintain daily operational MIS and product performance reports.
Monitor key operational metrics and analyse trends to identify opportunities for process improvement.
Support implementation of automation initiatives and standardised operational practices across the hub.
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving network efficiency and customer experience.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability and continuous improvement within the product operations team.
Qualifications & Experience:
	
Education:
Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
Certification or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Operations Management will be an added advantage.
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, eCommerce logistics or hub operations.
Experience in managing hub operations, shipment processing or mid-mile logistics within a high-volume environment.
Exposure to surface linehaul operations, shipment tracking and operational performance management.
Experience in coordinating with multiple internal stakeholders to achieve network and service commitments.
Working knowledge of logistics management systems, operational dashboards and Microsoft Office applications.
Skills & Capabilities:
	
Technical Skills:
eCommerce Hub Operations Management
Surface Network & Linehaul Coordination
Shipment Processing & Transit Operations
Scanning, Bagging & Dispatch Management
Service Level Agreement (SLA) Management
Operational MIS & Performance Reporting
Exception Management & Service Recovery
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance
Microsoft Office & Logistics Management Systems
Key Competencies:
Customer Focus
Planning & Organising
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
Attention to Detail
Decision Making
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Accountability & Ownership
Adaptability & Resilience
Communication Skills
Continuous Improvement Mindset
Key Performance Indicators:
	
KRAs
	
KPIs
	
Service Performance
	
Timely processing and dispatch of eCommerce shipments; Network cut-off adherence; Shipment connectivity
	
Shipment Quality
	
Scan compliance; Shipment processing accuracy; Reduction in misroutes, misconnections and operational errors
	
Operational Efficiency
	
SLAH reduction; Shipment ageing; Hub productivity; Turnaround time (TAT) adherence
	
Network Coordination
	
Linehaul schedule adherence; Vehicle dispatch readiness; Timely communication of operational exceptions
	
Customer Experience
	
Timely closure of product exceptions; Service recovery within TAT; Product SLA adherence
	
Compliance & Governance
	
SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety and security compliance
	
Operational Reporting
	
Accuracy and timeliness of MIS; Data integrity; Performance reporting
	
Continuous Improvement
	
Process improvement initiatives implemented; Productivity improvements; Operational efficiency gains
	
Why join DHL Blue Dart?
	
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:
Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.
Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.
The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.
This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.
