Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour. 
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 
Position Overview:
The Operations Executive / Senior Operations Executive – eCommerce Operations is responsible for managing the day-to-day operational execution of the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the surface network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations for the eCommerce product, ensuring shipment visibility, network connectivity, service quality and adherence to committed timelines.
Reporting to the Hub Manager, the incumbent works closely with Linehaul Operations, Network Operations, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient hub processing, timely dispatches and effective resolution of operational exceptions. The role plays a critical part in maintaining service reliability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction for the eCommerce product across the surface logistics network.
Job Purpose:
To manage end-to-end hub operations for the eCommerce product by ensuring timely processing, consolidation and movement of shipments across the surface network, while maintaining operational accuracy, service quality, network connectivity and compliance with organisational standards.
Key Roles & Responsibilities:

eCommerce Product Operations
Manage day-to-day operational activities for the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub. 
Ensure timely receipt, segregation, processing, consolidation and dispatch of eCommerce shipments. 
Monitor shipment flow across inbound, outbound and transit operations to achieve network timelines. 
Ensure adherence to operational workflows, product handling standards and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). 
Support achievement of product-specific service quality and operational performance targets. 
Surface Network Coordination
Coordinate movement of eCommerce shipments through scheduled surface linehaul and feeder network operations. 
Ensure timely loading, dispatch and connectivity of shipments to destination hubs and service centres. 
Monitor adherence to network cut-off timings and dispatch schedules. 
Coordinate with Network Operations and Linehaul teams to minimise delays and optimise shipment movement. 
Ensure accurate shipment visibility through timely scanning and system updates. 
Shipment Processing & Exception Management
Monitor scanning, sorting, bagging and dispatch activities to ensure operational accuracy. 
Proactively identify and resolve shipment exceptions including delays, misroutes, scanning discrepancies and stock lying at hub (SLAH). 
Coordinate with originating and destination locations to ensure timely closure of operational exceptions. 
Ensure prompt communication of network disruptions and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders. 
Drive timely resolution of service issues impacting product performance. 
Operational Coordination & Service Performance
Coordinate daily with Hub Operations, Linehaul, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless operational execution. 
Monitor daily shipment volumes and support manpower planning based on operational requirements. 
Track product-specific operational performance and recommend corrective actions to improve service reliability. 
Support implementation of process improvements and operational best practices across the hub. 
Prepare operational updates and escalate critical service issues to the Hub Manager in a timely manner. 
Service Quality & Operational Excellence
Monitor operational performance against defined service level agreements (SLAs) and eCommerce product commitments. 
Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions to minimise service failures and improve shipment visibility. 
Monitor shipment ageing, pending loads and stock lying at hub (SLAH), ensuring timely corrective actions. 
Drive adherence to scanning compliance, shipment accuracy and operational quality standards. 
Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance service reliability and operational productivity.
Resource Planning & Hub Coordination
Coordinate with the Hub Manager to ensure adequate manpower, equipment and operational resources are available to support daily volumes. 
Support daily operational planning based on shipment forecasts, network priorities and hub capacity. 
Coordinate with transport partners and linehaul teams to ensure timely vehicle placement and dispatch readiness. 
Ensure optimum utilisation of operational resources to achieve productivity and cost efficiency. 
Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and volume surges. 
Compliance & Operational Governance
Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs and statutory requirements applicable to hub operations. 
Promote safe handling of shipments and adherence to security protocols across all operational activities. 
Support internal audits, quality reviews and compliance assessments, ensuring timely closure of observations. 
Maintain operational records, documentation and system updates in accordance with organisational requirements. 
Escalate operational risks, compliance gaps and service issues to the Hub Manager on a timely basis. 
Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Generate and maintain daily operational MIS and product performance reports. 
Monitor key operational metrics and analyse trends to identify opportunities for process improvement. 
Support implementation of automation initiatives and standardised operational practices across the hub. 
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving network efficiency and customer experience. 
Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability and continuous improvement within the product operations team. 
Qualifications & Experience:

Education: 
Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. 
Certification or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Operations Management will be an added advantage. 
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, eCommerce logistics or hub operations. 
Experience in managing hub operations, shipment processing or mid-mile logistics within a high-volume environment. 
Exposure to surface linehaul operations, shipment tracking and operational performance management. 
Experience in coordinating with multiple internal stakeholders to achieve network and service commitments. 
Working knowledge of logistics management systems, operational dashboards and Microsoft Office applications. 
Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:
eCommerce Hub Operations Management 
Surface Network & Linehaul Coordination 
Shipment Processing & Transit Operations 
Scanning, Bagging & Dispatch Management 
Service Level Agreement (SLA) Management 
Operational MIS & Performance Reporting 
Exception Management & Service Recovery 
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence 
Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance 
Microsoft Office & Logistics Management Systems

Customer Focus 
Planning & Organising 
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills 
Attention to Detail 
Decision Making

Accountability & Ownership

Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.

title: Manager Of Team (Mobile Solutions)
job_description:
Your IT Future, Delivered.
Manager Of Team (Mobile Solutions)
With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. Our offices in Cyberjaya, Prague, and Chennai have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
Digitalization. Simply delivered.

In our Mobile Solutions subdomain, we design and improve apps such as the Post & DHL app, the main app for Deutsche Post in Germany with millions of users or for our parcel locker network, thus helping millions of people to make everyday life easier. We rely on DevOps and work closely with our colleagues at the business side. Our way of working is characterized by agile methods, in which we are open to new technologies and best practices. We attach great importance to continuous training.
We are looking for a Team Manager to join our growing team in India; the role combines technical and disciplinary leadership and project management. Become part of our team.

Grow together

What you can do with us:
· You will take over the disciplinary leadership of the team members in India.
· You plan and promote personnel development in order to meet current and future requirements.
· You ensure agile processes and methods in the projects (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Servant Leadership, Management 3.0).
· You will coach and advise team members for their role as agile DevOps leaders
· You will support the development and expansion of the team and processes within the framework of global sourcing.
· You will be responsible for planning, monitoring and managing projects with internal and external employees in an international environment.
· You will work on cross-departmental and cross-divisional tasks.

Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:
What you should bring with you:

· Completed studies with a technical focus (computer science, business informatics) or corresponding well-founded and many years of professional exp.
· Agile Mindset
· Comprehensive business knowledge and entrepreneurial thinking
· Strong leadership skills, especially result- and team-oriented leadership
· High level of social competence and communication skills with employees, customers and service providers
· Sound judgment and decision-making skills, especially in escalation or emergency situations
· Knowledge of Servant Leadership and Management 3.0
· Good general IT skills as well as good knowledge of the market and overview of new and innovative technologies
· We work in international teams and with business partners in Germany. You are therefore fluent in German and fluent in English.
An array of benefits for you:
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications. Team leadership Agile methodologies Scrum Kanban SAFe Servant leadership Management 3.0 Project management DevOps Personnel development Communication skills Decision-making German language English language Technical leadership Candidates must have a technical degree or extensive professional experience along with strong leadership and agile mindset. Proficiency in both English and German is required to work effectively with international teams and business partners.

title: HR Specialist
job_description:
Reports Directly to: Human Resources Assistant Manager
Position Overview:
Human Resources Specialist undertakes a variety of HR administrative duties in a designated HR area (policy administration, compensation & benefits, performance management, etc.). This position has a broad knowledge of Human Resources as well as general administrative responsibilities. The Site Human Resources Specialist will be able to work autonomously and efficiently to ensure the end-to-end running of HR projects in their specific area. 
Primary Responsibilities:
Processing payroll: This involves calculating employees' pay based on days worked, deductions, taxes and relevant benefits.
Maintaining payroll records: maintains accurate records of all payroll transactions, including employee earnings, taxes and deductions.
Tax compliance: calculates and ensure the on-time payment of all payroll-related taxes.
Benefits administration: accounts for employee benefits, such as health insurance and retirement plans.
Monitoring compliance: ensures the organisation complies with all applicable laws and regulations related to payroll, taxes and benefits.
Responding to employee enquiries: serves as the first point of contact for employees with questions or concerns about their salary, benefits or taxes.
Generating reports: generate reports related to payroll expenses, taxes and other payroll-related data to help the organisation make informed decisions. 
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Experience: 2+ years of experience in HR or related administrative roles.
Technical Skills: Proficient in HRIS and payroll systems; strong knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, interpersonal skills, and a strong sense of integrity.
Other Qualifications: Ability to work independently and as part of a team; strong time management skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Benefits:
Gain valuable hands-on experience in talent acquisition and recruitment.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced HR professionals.
Opportunity to build a professional network within the company.
Flexible working hours.
Potential for future employment opportunities based on performance. Payroll processing Tax compliance Benefits administration HRIS Payroll systems Microsoft Office Problem-solving Interpersonal skills Integrity Time management Performance management Policy administration Candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field and have at least two years of experience in HR or administrative roles. Proficiency in HRIS, payroll systems, and Microsoft Office is required, along with strong problem-solving and time management skills.

job_description:

Tasks

Manage end-to-end recruitment activities including sourcing, resume screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.
Coordinate offer rollouts, pre-joining formalities and onboarding activities.
Maintain employee records, HRIS updates, attendance and leave records.
Support employee lifecycle activities including confirmations, transfers, promotions and other HR transactions.
Provide monthly payroll inputs and coordinate with relevant teams.
Handle employee queries related to HR policies, processes and benefits.
Support employee engagement activities, feedback initiatives and recognition programs.
Assist with performance management, appraisal cycles and learning initiatives.
Prepare and maintain HR documentation including offer, confirmation, increment, promotion, experience and relieving letters.

1–2 years of experience in HR Operations / HR Generalist roles.
Hands-on experience with recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Exposure to HRIS and ATS platforms.
Good working knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Understanding of HR policies and statutory requirements.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Recruitment Onboarding HR Operations Employee Engagement HRIS ATS Payroll Performance Management Documentation Employee Relations MS Word Excel PowerPoint Time-management Communication Interpersonal skills Candidates must have a bachelor's degree, with an MBA in HR considered an advantage, and 1–2 years of experience in HR operations or generalist roles. Proficiency in HRIS, ATS, and MS Office tools is required, along with strong communication and organizational skills.

title: Services Sales Manager
job_description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what’s the role all about?
We are looking for an experienced and results-oriented Services Sales Manager, Actimize to drive Professional Services revenue across an assigned territory and portfolio of existing clients. In this role, you will own the end-to-end services sales lifecycle, from pipeline generation and opportunity qualification through proposal development, contract negotiation, Statement of Work (SOW) closure, and successful handover to delivery teams.
You will partner closely with License Sales, Pre-Sales, and Professional Services Delivery teams to position Professional Services as a strategic component of the overall solution. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong financial services domain expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across global financial institutions.
For the initial year, the annual individual booking target is expected to be in the range of USD 6M – 10M, subject to annual revision based on organizational objectives.
How will you make an impact?
You will be responsible for driving Professional Services growth and customer success by:
Owning the end-to-end services sales cycle from lead generation through opportunity closure.
Defining and executing territory and account plans to achieve services revenue targets.
Generating new Professional Services pipeline, including standalone services opportunities.
Developing compelling value propositions based on customer business needs.
Building and maintaining strong relationships with executive stakeholders and decision makers.
Managing services sales opportunities across assigned accounts.
Working closely with Product Sales and Pre-Sales teams to provide services responses for RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs.
Supporting and contributing to the Professional Services RFP response library.
Collaborating with Sales Managers and Pre-Sales teams to understand solution scope and position services effectively.
Partnering with Professional Services Delivery teams to ensure alignment and readiness for project execution.
Demonstrating ownership and accountability throughout the services engagement lifecycle.
Developing project effort estimates using company-approved estimation tools.
Preparing customer-facing proposals using approved templates.
Creating Statements of Work (SOWs) aligned to customer requirements and business objectives.
Negotiating commercial and contractual terms to successfully close Professional Services engagements.
Supporting the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of Professional Services sales materials and templates.
Ensuring seamless transition of opportunities from sales to delivery teams.
Have you got what it takes?
Experience in Financial Services including Banking, Brokerage, Capital Markets, or Insurance industries.
Knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Fraud Prevention, Transaction Monitoring, and/or Trade Surveillance.
Proven experience selling Professional Services or Consulting Services within a software vendor, consulting, or technology organization.
Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding services sales targets.
Strong understanding of enterprise software and solution sales cycles.
Experience managing complex customer engagements and multi-stakeholder sales processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong negotiation, influencing, and presentation abilities.
Ability to articulate the value of Professional Services as part of a broader solution sale.
Strong business and financial acumen with experience developing business cases and commercial proposals.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Customer-focused mindset with excellent relationship management capabilities.
Ability to travel up to 20% as required.
You will have an advantage if you also have:
Experience selling to executive and C-level stakeholders within Financial Services organizations.
NICE Actimize product knowledge and industry experience.
Experience working with AML, Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
Prior experience supporting enterprise-level digital transformation initiatives.
Experience creating effort estimates, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
Knowledge of Professional Services delivery methodologies.
Experience working in a matrixed global organization.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing competing priorities.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Collaborative and team-oriented working style.
What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
Reporting Into: Senior Director, Professional Services, Actimize
Role Type: Individual Contributor
Function: Professional Services Sales
About NiCE 
NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 
Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. 
NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law. Sales management Professional services sales Financial services domain expertise Pipeline generation Contract negotiation Statement of work (SOW) development Consultative sales Relationship management Strategic planning Proposal development Anti-money laundering (AML) Fraud prevention Trade surveillance Enterprise software sales Stakeholder management Business acumen Candidates must have proven experience in selling professional services within the financial services industry, specifically in areas like AML, fraud, or compliance. Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills are essential for managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.

job_description:
3Shape is offering a unique opportunity to take on the role of Territory Manager, India. This individual will be responsible for the total revenue across the 3Shape product portfolio in a few states. The position will report to Country Manager, India, and will be based in Chennai/Bangalore/Ahmedabad/Delhi
The Territory Manager will be responsible in the direct management and development of 3Shape’s business and partnerships in dental labs and clinics. This is a role for an independent, dynamic, and self-driven sales manager, ideally with experience from dental/medical device industries. In this role, you will take ownership and develop the 3Shape brand in India and be a key part fueling the growth of dental technology products.
Skills Required:
Sales Acumen: Proven ability to identify customer needs and close deals effectively.
Technical Proficiency: Understanding of dental technology products, procedures and services.
Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Negotiation Skills: Ability to negotiate terms and pricing while maintaining client relationships.
Problem-Solving: Capable of analyzing client requirements and providing innovative solutions.
Time Management: Strong organizational skills for managing multiple accounts and tasks.
CRM Proficiency: Experience in using CRM software to track sales activities and customer information.
Team and External Reseller Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners
Use of MS Office
Ideal Candidate:
Minimum 4 years’ experience working with business development and sales
Minimum a bachelor’s degree in Business/Marketing
Industry experience and/or knowledge of Medical Devices / Dental is desirable
Experience in working on the field in the chosen location
Understanding and have experience of working at an international company with strong corporate values and guidelines
Furthermore, we expect the candidate to be:
Trustworthy with a strong personal accountability to do business ‘the 3Shape way’ with reference to the mission, vision and values of the company
Ability to develop business-oriented results with appropriate level of detail and keep the right people informed
Be proactive and able to get things done in a timely manner
Analytical and think in ways of strategy, structure and execution
A business and sales developer – not an administrator
Willing to travel
Strong communicator and relationship builder
Always ready for change & thrive in a high paced environment with challenges with an ‘can-do’ attitude
We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.
About us
3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn. Sales Acumen Technical Proficiency Communication Skills Negotiation Skills Problem-Solving Time Management CRM Proficiency Business Development Relationship Building Strategic Thinking Analytical Skills MS Office Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years of experience in business development and sales, preferably within the medical device or dental industry. A bachelor's degree in Business or Marketing is required, along with the ability to travel and work effectively in the field.

title: F&B Service Expert
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy
until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is
memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service
Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure
that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the
kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies,
the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

 

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to
success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures,
upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and
communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and
moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping,
uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify
information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push,
pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without
assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees,
including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well
(and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service
Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

 

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


Fairfield by Marriott guarantees a beautifully simple stay wherever you travel,
with over 1,000 locations worldwide. Our Marriott family farm heritage inspires
a calming, reliable experience characterized by warm hospitality, all at a great
value. As a member of our team, you’ll deliver on the Fairfield Guarantee — our
commitment that every guest leaves the hotel satisfied. At Fairfield, we invite
you to explore career opportunities that hold our hotels and the service we
provide to the highest standard. In joining Fairfield by Marriott, you join a
portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best
work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global  team, and become the best
version of you. Customer service Food and beverage service Table setting Communication Teamwork Quality standards Safety compliance Menu management Physical stamina Attention to detail Candidates must have a high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent and less than one year of related work experience. The role requires the physical ability to stand, walk, and lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds with assistance.

title: Senior Lead, Energy Strategic Negotiator
job_description:
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
   
 * 10 years of experience leading negotiations or business development.
   



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 * Experience leading regulatory, public affairs or policy development programs
   in the energy industry.
 * Experience leading negotiations and business development.
 * Experience managing relationships and leading critical negotiations for
   infrastructure projects.
 * Experience in power procurement and infrastructure project commercial.
 * Track record of managing and executing commercial transactions (e.g., energy
   supply agreements and power purchasing agreement).


ABOUT THE JOB:

Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's
products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works
behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything
from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator,
you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry
savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure
growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating agreements,
managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting agreement
recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the
potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every
part of the business.

Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's
products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works
behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future everything from
underwater cables to physical data center space.

As a Strategic Negotiator, you will combine your deep experience in the policy
and regulatory landscale and energy markets to support Google's infrastructure
growth. You'll work with market development teams to manage regulatory and
government stakeholders, as well as commercial teams on negotiating agreements
managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting agreement
recommendations to our leadership. You will combine your policy and regulatory
experience, financial acumen, industry experience and persuasion skills to
analyze and communicate trends, and evaluate supply, investment opportunities,
and agreement structures, whilst ensuring government and regulatory pathways
remain clear to support these opportunities.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its
business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage
Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably.
Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as
their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business
problems.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 * Lead energy regulatory interventions and policy advocacy initiatives in India
   to secure power and energy for Google data centers and mitigate operational
   risks.
 * Lead energy impact initiatives that support Google's ongoing investments and
   benefit local and regional stakeholders.
 * Support and manage power and clean energy procurement initiatives in India to
   secure reliable, cost-effective power and carbon free energy for Google's
   data centers and operations.
 * Originate, support and contribute to transaction negotiations and commercial
   structuring for data center energy agreements, including supply agreements,
   interconnection agreements, power purchases agreements etc.
 * Develop and manage strategic relationships with governments, regulators,
   utilities, energy developers and grid operators to influence market
   acceleration and advance business priorities related to energy in India. Negotiation Business Development Energy Regulatory Affairs Policy Advocacy Power Procurement Infrastructure Project Management Commercial Structuring Financial Acumen Stakeholder Management Energy Markets Transaction Execution Data Center Infrastructure Strategic Planning Market Development Regulatory Compliance Candidates must have a bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of experience in negotiations or business development. Preferred qualifications include expertise in energy industry policy, regulatory affairs, and infrastructure project management.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst-Systems
job_description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
What’s in it for you?
Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity
Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
Impact In This Role
As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will assist with financial planning and budgeting, analyze financial statements and be responsible for the support and maintenance of our FP&A and Accounting systems, build and validate multiple reports for the Finance teams, make sure various integrations are supported and maintained, and keep up-to-date knowledge of system needs for customization and integration. The ideal candidate is passionate about Fictiv, has strong financial knowledge and analytical skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This position will have the opportunity to interact with multiple finance and technical teams across Fictiv, providing a broad exposure to the business. This is a senior role: we're looking for someone who can shape how Finance and Business Applications work together, not just operate within the systems and processes already in place.
You will report to the Manager FP&A.
What You’ll Be Doing
Be responsible for the support, planning, analysis, and delivery of our key financial tools, as well as running and maintaining their integration with other Fictiv’s systems.
Liaise with multiple stakeholders across the organization to ensure that the planning tools are up and running and to ensure minimal downtime.
Assist with the recurring forecasting, budgeting, and month-end close.
Automate data retrieval tasks via reports & dashboards.
Lead or participate in the development and implementation of new systems and new reports and administer those reports going forward.
Maintain an in-depth understanding of existing business application architecture, including integrations and data structures.
Assess and standardize financial processes across all global regions and entities, accounting for local requirements, and ensure they are supported consistently in NetSuite and the planning tools
Identify the data needs for Financial tasks and communicate with Data teams and other business partners to close the gaps.
Troubleshoot problems that Finance’s teams encounter with Fictiv’s tools and systems, including but not limited to the planning tools, NetSuite ERP, Salesforce, and Sigma.
Interface with external software vendors for product issues, troubleshooting and resolution; initiating Service Requests (SR's) as necessary with other 3rd Party Vendors.
Liaise and act as representative for Fictiv FP&A to other systems teams within the organization.
Identify, evaluate, and recommend other key technologies required to support and improve the business process centered around existing systems.
Desired Traits
This is a senior-level role. Candidates must have a demonstrated track record of driving change in cross-functional financial systems and processes — not simply executing within existing workflows and constraints, or finding workarounds within them. This means having personally identified a broken financial process, built the business case for a fix grounded in financial impact, pushed back where needed, and seen it through to a resolution with a systems or technology team. Candidates who can only operate within existing systems and processes are not a fit for this role.
8+ years in a similar role, with a proven record of operating at a senior level — preferred at a technology or manufacturing related business.
A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field is required. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
Required experience with implementation and management of financial planning systems such as Hyperion/ NSPB or Anaplan.
Experience with NetSuite and/or Oracle ERP systems (required); experience with Salesforce, Odoo, Sigma (desirable).
Ability to translate financial and business processes into ERP system design — understanding not just what the finance process should be, but how to map it to the actual system setup.
Understanding of manufacturing and supply chain operations and inter-company dynamics, with the ability to map that to financial processes — grasping the operational realities specific to the business well enough to design the right financial process.
Has served as a system owner or administrator for an ERP or FP&A platform — not just a power user or requester of changes — with experience leading a system implementation or major upgrade end-to-end, from requirements through go-live.
Track record of partnering directly with IT/Business Applications leadership to shape system design decisions, and comfortable presenting recommendations and trade-offs to senior finance and business leaders — including pushing back on requests that don't hold up.
Skills in tools for efficiently querying large databases.
Expertise with MS Office suite and G. suite.
Understanding of Financial Statements and Finance and Accounting principles.
Extremely organized with the ability to work on and manage multiple projects within tight timelines.
Strong attention to details.
Strong interpersonal skills, written and verbal communication, and facilitation skills.
Self-motivated, proactive, willing to learn, strong sense of accountability, and a proven track record of delivering results.
Must work well under pressure, be sensitive to deadlines, be able to interact in a team environment, be able to adapt quickly to change, and possess excellent analytical, problem solving and customer service skills.
Must be able to troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate solutions for system issues to the stakeholders.
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. 
Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. 
Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates
We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans. Financial Planning Budgeting Financial Analysis NetSuite Oracle ERP Hyperion NSPB Anaplan Salesforce Sigma Data Analytics System Administration Process Improvement Financial Reporting Accounting Principles Project Management Candidates must have at least 8 years of experience in a senior financial systems role, with a proven track record of driving process changes and system implementations. A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Data Analytics is required, along with expertise in ERP systems like NetSuite and financial planning tools.

title: Manager Revenue Operations
job_description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
Key Responsibilities 
1. GTM Database Expansion 
Own the strategy and execution for expanding Netradyne's GTM account and contact database. 
Identify and source new target accounts based on ICP, industry, company size, geography, fleet size, technology adoption, and other business criteria. 
Build and maintain comprehensive account and contact coverage across Netradyne's target markets. 
Identify whitespace within the existing database and develop programs to systematically close coverage gaps. 
Source decision-makers, influencers, and relevant buying committee contacts within target accounts. 
Develop scalable processes for continuously adding new accounts and contacts to Salesforce. 
Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to understand market coverage requirements and translate them into database expansion initiatives. 
Monitor database growth and establish measurable targets for account and contact coverage. 
2. Data Enrichment & Intelligence 
Own the enrichment strategy across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, and other relevant GTM data. 
Leverage Clay, ZoomInfo, PrimeRole, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other data providers to source and enrich GTM data. 
Build multi-source enrichment strategies to maximize data coverage and accuracy. 
Evaluate the strengths and limitations of different data providers and determine the appropriate source for specific data requirements. 
Develop workflows to enrich firmographic, demographic, organizational, contact, technology, and other relevant data points. 
Establish validation frameworks to ensure sourced data meets defined quality standards. 
Continuously identify new data sources and technologies that can improve coverage and reduce data gaps. 
Modern GTM data platforms increasingly support multi-provider enrichment and AI-driven research, making the ability to orchestrate multiple sources an important part of this role. 
3. Salesforce Data Management 
Own the overall health and quality of GTM data within Salesforce. 
Establish and enforce standards for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness. 
Manage data quality initiatives across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, and Opportunities. 
Drive deduplication, normalization, account hierarchy, ownership, and data remediation initiatives. 
Identify data debt and establish structured programs to address it. 
Build Salesforce reports and dashboards to monitor database health, coverage, and quality. 
Partner with Salesforce and RevOps stakeholders to improve CRM processes and data governance. 
Ensure that database expansion initiatives are integrated into Salesforce through scalable and controlled processes. 
4. GTM Data Technology & AI 
Own the effective utilization of GTM data and intelligence platforms including Clay, ZoomInfo, PrimeRole, Salesforce, and other emerging technologies. 
Design and optimize data sourcing and enrichment workflows. 
Leverage AI and agentic workflows for account research, contact discovery, enrichment, validation, and data classification. 
Identify manual processes that can be automated and drive automation initiatives. 
Evaluate new GTM technology and data providers based on coverage, accuracy, scalability, usability, and business impact. 
Continuously optimize the GTM data stack to improve the quality and breadth of available data. 
5. People Management & Team Leadership 
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of GTM Operations / Data Operations professionals. 
Set team goals, priorities, productivity targets, SLAs, and quality standards. 
Allocate work across account sourcing, contact sourcing, enrichment, validation, and data quality activities. 
Monitor team performance through defined productivity and quality metrics. 
Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and development conversations. 
Identify capability gaps and create training and upskilling plans. 
Build a culture of ownership, accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
Review team output regularly and implement corrective actions where required. 
Support hiring, onboarding, and development of GTM Operations talent. 
6. Data Quality & Governance 
Establish a structured GTM Data Quality framework covering completeness, accuracy, freshness, duplication, and coverage. 
Define and monitor data quality KPIs across the GTM database. 
Conduct recurring database audits and proactively identify data quality issues. 
Establish processes to prevent data quality issues rather than relying only on reactive cleanup. 
Partner with Sales and Marketing to establish data requirements and governance standards. 
Track data quality trends and provide recommendations to GTM leadership. 
7. Reporting & Analytics 
Build and maintain dashboards to monitor: 
Account database growth 
Contact database growth 
Account coverage 
Contact coverage 
Data completeness 
Data accuracy 
Enrichment coverage 
New account sourcing 
Data provider performance 
Team productivity 
Data quality trends 
Provide regular reporting and insights to GTM and Revenue Operations leadership. 
Use data to identify coverage gaps, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement. 
Translate operational data into clear business recommendations. 
8. Cross-Functional Partnership 
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, and other GTM stakeholders. 
Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions. 
Support Sales leadership with account and contact coverage initiatives. 
Work with Marketing on campaign audiences, target account lists, and contact coverage. 
Act as the primary point of contact for GTM data-related initiatives. 
Drive adoption of data standards and best practices across GTM teams. 
Mandatory Skills & Experience 
8–12 years of total professional experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Data Operations, Business Operations, or a related data-focused function. 
1–2 years of people management / team leadership experience. 
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce, particularly CRM data management, reporting, list views, data quality, and database management. 
Strong experience with GTM data and enrichment platforms such as Clay, ZoomInfo, PrimeRole, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools. 
Demonstrated experience in account and contact sourcing, database expansion, enrichment, validation, and data quality management. 
Advanced Excel skills including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Pivot Tables, data cleaning, Power Query, and complex formulas. 
Strong understanding of CRM data governance, deduplication, normalization, and data hygiene. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

title: Supervisor-Housekeeping
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper
to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status,
determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of
departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily
activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping,
Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with
discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate
changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required
paperwork.

 

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling,
disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and
safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems,
safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and
certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and
professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect
company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company
standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with
disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using
clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working
relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of
other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move,
lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without
assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull
a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and
uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending,
twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended
period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of
varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale
systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g.,
small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.

Experience: 9+ yrs
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for an exceptionally strong Senior Systems Architect with deep expertise in high-performance application architecture, cross-platform engineering, real-time data processing, and graphics rendering. The ideal candidate will have experience building latency-sensitive applications where performance, responsiveness, and reliability are critical, preferably within the gaming industry or other performance-intensive domains such as financial trading, real-time analytics, or interactive applications.
This role requires a combination of systems-level thinking, advanced programming skills, and a strong understanding of modern web and mobile rendering technologies. You will architect shared, high-performance client-side systems across web, native mobile, and cross-platform frameworks, ensuring consistent functionality and exceptional responsiveness across platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Architect a unified cross-platform client-side system that shares core business logic, order-book management, and binary data parsers across web, native mobile, Flutter, and React Native.
Design high-performance data ingestion pipelines for WebSocket streams using binary protocols such as Protocol Buffers, FlatBuffers, and Simple Binary Encoding (SBE).
Implement zero-copy data processing techniques to minimise memory allocations, data copying, and processing latency.
Move intensive parsing and data-processing operations off the main UI thread using Web Workers, native background threads, and Dart Isolates.
Design hardware-accelerated charting, graphics, and order-book rendering systems using Canvas, WebGL/WebGPU, Flutter Impeller/Skia, and native graphics APIs such as Metal and Vulkan.
Optimise rendering pipelines to achieve consistent, low-latency performance, targeting 120 FPS where supported by the platform and hardware.
Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, including garbage-collection pauses, UI thread blocking, excessive memory allocation, and dropped frames.
Apply memory pooling, lock-free data structures, concurrency patterns, and efficient resource management techniques.
Establish performance benchmarks, profiling practices, and automated testing to validate responsiveness, stability, and scalability across devices.
Lead architecture reviews, define engineering standards, and guide teams in implementing maintainable, high-performance systems.
Collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to translate demanding functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and optimisation techniques across web, mobile, graphics, and systems programming.
What Makes You a Great Fit
9+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing high-performance applications or complex client-side systems.
Experience in the gaming industry is strongly preferred, particularly in real-time rendering, graphics optimisation, game engines, or performance-critical applications.
Strong understanding of cross-platform architecture spanning web, native iOS/Android, and frameworks such as Flutter or React Native.
Hands-on experience with WebAssembly, Web Workers, JavaScript/TypeScript, Dart, or native mobile development.
Strong knowledge of streaming architectures, WebSockets, binary protocols, and efficient data-processing pipelines.
Experience with zero-copy processing, memory pooling, concurrency, multithreading, and lock-free programming techniques.
Practical experience with graphics rendering technologies such as WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, Skia, Impeller, Metal, or Vulkan.
Proven ability to profile and optimise CPU, memory, rendering, and network performance in latency-sensitive applications.
Strong understanding of garbage collection, memory allocation, thread scheduling, and platform-specific performance constraints.
Experience building responsive, real-time interfaces that handle high-frequency data updates without compromising usability.
Excellent architectural judgement, debugging skills, and the ability to solve complex systems-level engineering problems.
Strong communication and technical leadership skills, with the ability to guide engineering teams and drive architectural decisions.
A strong focus on performance measurement, engineering precision, reliability, and continuous optimisation. Systems Architecture High-performance Computing Cross-platform Engineering Real-time Data Processing Graphics Rendering WebAssembly TypeScript Dart Flutter React Native WebGL WebGPU Metal Vulkan Concurrency Memory Management Requires 9+ years of experience in high-performance application architecture, with deep expertise in graphics rendering and cross-platform development. Candidates must possess strong skills in systems-level programming, memory management, and performance optimization for latency-sensitive applications.

title: Apprentice - Enterprise Technology Services
job_description:
Innovation is at the heart of everything we do. Every single day, our
technologists enable our customers around the globe to achieve their goals. They
design and deliver American Express infrastructure and applications across all
markets and business units. To meet these demands, we’re looking for problem
solvers who can get results through precise analysis and programming
methodologies, individuals with a strong intellectual curiosity and a passion
for innovation, and teammates who can convert their ideas into execution.

Join our 12-month paid apprenticeship program where you will have opportunities
for development, networking and engaging with our executives. An apprenticeship
at American Express will give you the chance to influence and strengthen the
core businesses across the organization.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Join the team and make an impact right away:

 * Write code with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript,
   .NET, Python)
 * Function as a core member of an agile team working on API specs, conducting
   code reviews and testing in ongoing sprints, or doing proof of
   concepts/automation tools
 * Design and develop new customer-facing applications on multiple channels like
   native iOS, Android, web, social integration and Java services/APIs
 * Design and implement web-enabled systems for data collection

 

We have the know-how, technology, and global reach to make nearly any idea a
reality. All that’s missing is you! Do you have?

 * Passion for technology and strong desire to learn
 * Curious mind to explore new possibilities and act on them
 * Never-settle attitude and continuously looking for improvements
 * Customer-focus to think differently and deliver value to customers
 * Data-driven nature to drive decisions and results based on data

 

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 * The candidate must have completed graduation under Bachelor’s or Master’s
   degree program in Computer Science and Information Technology Engineering or
   other technical discipline

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions
without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other
status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful
completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and
regulations.

 *  Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending
   on role and business need
 *   Career development and training opportunities


At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of
innovation, shared values 
[https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/company/who-we-are/]and Leadership
Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and
colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class
customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to
uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive
support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills,
develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter,
your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of
American Express. Java JavaScript .NET Python API development Agile methodology Code reviews Testing Automation tools iOS development Android development Web development Data collection systems Problem solving Programming Candidates must have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Applicants should possess a strong passion for technology, a curious mind, and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.

title: IN_Bosch Rexroth India_Design Engineer_ Bangalore
job_description:
Company Description
Unlock Your Potential: A Rewarding Career with Bosch Rexroth India
Bosch Group is more than 139 years old organization, head quartered in Germany, active across diverse sectors including Automotive, Industrial, Consumer Goods, and Energy & Building Technology.
Bosch in India is operating since 1951 through its 11 legal entities with 17 manufacturing sites and 7 development centers, including its largest development center outside Germany, with 39,000+ associates and net revenue of 373,457 mINR (FY 2024-25).
Bosch Rexroth is one of the subsidiaries of Bosch Group and is a leading expert in drive and control technologies. Under the brand name of Rexroth (more than 231 years old Brand), employing 40000+ employees across Globe. The company provides cutting-edge automation solutions, software, and services that enable businesses to operate more efficiently while accelerating digital transformation and sustainability.
Bosch Rexroth India is a 100% subsidiary of Bosch Rexorth AG with INR 2200+ Crores turnover (FY 2024-25) and 2000 employees.
Bosch Rexroth India supplies tailored drive and control solutions across three key sectors: Mobile Applications, Industrial Applications, and Factory Automation:
Industrial & Mobile Hydraulics: Market-leading pumps, valves, cylinders, and power units.
Electric Drives & Controls: Next-gen ctrlX AUTOMATION open ecosystem and IoT gateways for smart factories.
Linear Motion & Assembly: Modular conveyor systems (Vario Flow plus), screw drives, and ergonomic workstations.
Mobile Robotics & Tightening: Automated guided vehicles (ACTIVE Shuttle) and precision cordless tools (NEXO) for automotive and heavy manufacturing.
We are deeply committed to employee development, well-being and fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment where you can work on advanced technologies and make a meaningful impact. If you're a promising and dynamic professional, we invite you to explore a long-term and rewarding career with us.
Additional information can be accessed at Company & Jobs and Career
Job Description
CAD support for the creation and modification of drawings for radial piston motors and their individual components using CREO & AutoCAD.
Manage drawing and document revisions through the PDM system
Creation of 3D models of new and existing products using CREO
Create or Modify technical documents using Microsoft Word & Adobe Reader
DFMEA updates using APIS IQ-RM
Handle customer and sales requests related to Radial piston motor products.
Process and coordinate Engineering Change Requests (ECR) and Engineering Change Notifications (ECN).
Support product customization, variant management, and application-specific configurations.
Support prototype development, product validation, and series release activities.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Sales, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and Quality.
Maintain and continuously improve engineering software tools, configurators, and digital engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with engineering standards, quality requirements, and documentation processes.
Support process optimization, automation initiatives, and engineering excellence programs.
Create and maintain motor and component master data, material masters, and BOMs in SAP.
Qualifications
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 2- 5 years of experience
Additional Information
Preferred experience of product engineering in radial piston motors 
Hydraulics background 
Good Engineering knowledge in radial piston units 
Hands on experience in Creo and PDM

Legal Entity: Bosch Rexroth (India) Private Limited Creo AutoCAD PDM SAP Hydraulics Radial piston motors Technical documentation DFMEA APIS IQ-RM Engineering change management 3D modeling Product validation BOM management Mechanical engineering Variant management Candidates must hold a B.E. or B.Tech degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2 to 5 years of relevant experience. Proficiency in Creo, PDM systems, and a strong background in hydraulics and radial piston units are required.

title: Product Officer
job_description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
We connect. We inspire.
Role Purpose
This role manages the day-to-day operational delivery of online and blended learning and assessment products, ensuring efficient processes, effective user support and high-quality service delivery. You will coordinate operational activities that support learners, administrators and stakeholders across multiple locations, helping to ensure digital learning platforms and services operate smoothly and consistently.
Working within English & Exams (E&E), you will provide operational support for learning management systems, learner administration, reporting and issue resolution. The role combines customer support, systems administration, data analysis and operational coordination to enhance the user experience, support business objectives and maintain the effective delivery of digital learning and assessment services.
Role Accountabilities
You will implement and manage standard operational processes and systems that support the delivery of online and blended learning and assessment services. This includes coordinating resources and activities, managing learner records and system settings, supporting learning management system operations, maintaining operational documentation, and ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery of services. You will monitor operational performance, provide feedback on issues and opportunities for improvement, identify recurring user issues and product enhancement opportunities, and support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and service quality.
You will act as a key point of contact for operational and user support queries, resolving issues independently where possible and coordinating with specialist teams when escalation is required. when escalation is required. You will analyse user feedback, defects and support trends, and provide insight to support prioritisation, product improvements and continuous enhancement of the user experience. The role is responsible for analysing operational data, producing reports and insights, maintaining knowledge resources, supporting local administrators and stakeholders, and ensuring that digital learning systems and processes are used effectively across the organisation. You will also manage competing priorities and contribute to the successful delivery of operational objectives within a fast-paced, global environment.
Qualifications
Essential: Degree in Instructional Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Desirable:
ITIL certification.
MCSA BI Reporting or other data management qualification.
Requirements
Essential: 
Experience managing support requests using shared inboxes, CRM tools, Microsoft 365 applications or similar systems.
Experience working with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones.
Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI or other reporting and data analysis tools.
Experience supporting digital learning, assessment products or e-learning platforms.
Experience administering learning management systems and learner records.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with large datasets and producing operational reports.
Strong organisational and customer service skills.
Ability to work independently and manage changing priorities.
Written and verbal proficiency in English is required, as British Council systems and global processes operate in English.
Desirable:
Knowledge of English & Exams online products and services across teaching, B2C and B2G contexts.
Experience using screencasting tools and maintaining user guidance materials.
Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS.
Experience working with Thinking Cap and/or eXact LCMS.
Experience supporting digital learning implementations in international environments.
Important Information
Contract type: Indefinite Contract 
Pay band: 6/G
Starting Salary: UK - £25,520 per annum, plus a London Market Allowance of £3,300 per annum for employees based in London. Poland - 7,400 PLN per month. Salary will be determined based on relevant skills and experience.
Working Model: Hybrid
Location: UK, Poland
Proof of Identity requirements & right to work in the country: Applicants must have the legal right to work in the stated location. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not provided. 
Closing Date: Sunday 25th October 2026 at 23:59 UK time (Monday 26th October at 00:59 Poland time)
A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement
We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. title: Director, Design
job_description:

Experience: 10+ yrs
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for an experienced Director of Design – Architecture to lead and scale architectural design capabilities, technical documentation, and multidisciplinary design delivery within a global construction and design environment.
The ideal candidate will combine deep architectural expertise with strong operational leadership and experience managing large-scale design teams. This role focuses on building a technically proficient architecture and engineering organisation capable of delivering high-quality design development, construction documentation, coordinated drawings, specifications, and constructability-driven solutions aligned with US construction standards.
The successful candidate will play a strategic role in transforming architectural production into a comprehensive design capability, establishing technical excellence, standardised workflows, and scalable delivery practices across global teams.
Key Responsibilities
Lead architectural design, technical documentation, detailing, and constructability practices across the India-based design organisation.
Establish and govern US-aligned architectural documentation standards, drawing-set structures, detailing protocols, specifications, and QA/QC processes.
Oversee architectural drawing packages across design development and construction documentation phases.
Ensure architectural deliverables accurately reflect design intent, constructability requirements, building systems, and interdisciplinary coordination.
Direct daily architectural production and ensure deliverables meet project schedules, quality expectations, and budget requirements.
Standardise design workflows to improve coordination with US-based design teams, increase predictability, and reduce rework.
Implement structured quality-control checkpoints and performance metrics covering accuracy, timeliness, productivity, and first-pass quality.
Use ERP and project-performance systems to monitor team output, resource utilisation, operational efficiency, and profitability.
Evaluate and implement digital design tools, documentation automation, and AI-assisted design workflows.
Collaborate with Design Technology, Digital Delivery, and AI teams to improve model-based documentation and integrated design processes.
Ensure alignment with Revit standards, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and related digital design platforms.
Recruit, mentor, and develop architectural and engineering professionals while building strong technical leadership within the organisation.
Establish training frameworks, competency benchmarks, career progression models, and technical development programmes.
Build and scale a high-performing architecture and engineering team, with a long-term growth objective of 100+ professionals.
Act as the primary India-based architectural counterpart to US design leadership, ensuring effective communication and continuity across time zones.
Partner with project executives, architects, engineers, and other stakeholders to resolve technical challenges and maintain delivery standards.
Drive continuous improvement in design quality, operational efficiency, team performance, and commercial outcomes.
What Makes You a Great Fit
10+ years of experience in architecture, with strong expertise in technical documentation, architectural detailing, and complex project delivery.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture.
Proven experience leading large architectural or engineering production teams, preferably with 50+ professionals.
Strong knowledge of US construction documentation standards, detailing practices, and coordinated drawing production.
Deep understanding of building systems, constructability, construction sequencing, and multidisciplinary design coordination.
Advanced proficiency in Revit and architectural documentation workflows.
Experience building or scaling design teams, including recruitment, technical training, performance management, and capability development.
Strong operational and commercial discipline, with experience managing productivity, project schedules, budgets, and delivery quality.
Experience using ERP or project-management systems to improve operational efficiency, profitability, and performance visibility.
Familiarity with model-based documentation, structured data integration, digital design environments, and design automation.
Experience collaborating with international design teams and managing distributed delivery across multiple time zones.
Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical and operational challenges.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong cross-functional relationships.
Entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with the ability to establish processes, manage ambiguity, and drive organisational growth.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to standardised workflows, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Architectural Design Technical Documentation Construction Standards Revit Autodesk Construction Cloud Team Leadership Project Management Constructability Quality Control Workflow Standardization Strategic Planning Mentoring Resource Utilization Digital Design Interdisciplinary Coordination Requires 10+ years of experience in architecture with deep expertise in technical documentation, detailing, and complex project delivery. Candidates must hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture and possess advanced proficiency in Revit and US construction standards.
