title: Senior Analyst
job_description:
This role will help ensure Cash equivalent and Marketable securities balances
were reported correctly in FN and 10K/10Q filing there on. The ideal candidate
should have strong knowledge of accounting, a good understanding of investment
portfolios, and hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience to support Ford’s reporting and
accounting activities.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities

 * Support quarterly and annual FN preparation of Auto Marketable securities in
   line with corporate reporting timelines.
 * Prepare and report Cash equivalent and Marketable securities schedules as per
   the format recommended for 10K/10Q filing.
 * Perform month end balance checks and perform adjustment entries wherever
   applicable.
 * Work closely with trading team, treasury operations and state street contacts
   (external parties) in case of any discrepancies in the numbers reported.
 * Manage general ledger activities, including journals, reconciliations, and
   month-end/quarter-end close tasks.
 * Use SAP S/4HANA, Group reporting to download reports for all Auto BUs
   together and work on the fluctuation explanation QoQ and YoY.
 * Handle internal and external audits for any queries related to Marketable
   securities schedules and reports.
 * Support process design, testing, automation, and system improvements in
   S/4HANA.
 * Ensure compliance with SOX, Ford accounting policies, and reporting
   requirements.
 * Prepare and present variance analysis, and management reporting packs.
 * Coordinate with External Reporting, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit on
   reporting matters.
 * Support accounting research and documentation for new transactions or
   organizational changes.
 * Identify opportunities to improve and standardize consolidation and reporting
   processes.


QUALIFICATIONS

 * Professional accounting qualification required, such as CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA,
   or equivalent.
 * Minimum 3 years of experience in corporate accounting, financial reporting.
 * Experience in investment accounting and cash accounting is an added
   advantage.
 * Hands-on experience with management reporting, foot note preparation and
   variance explanation.
 * Strong knowledge of general accounting, month-end close, reconciliations
 * Practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including Group Reporting, General Ledger,
   and financial reporting.
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills with
   ability to meet deadlines.
 * Good communication skills and ability to work independently with finance
   teams and senior management (Controller and CFO).
 * Experience with internal controls and SOX compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

 * Experience with financial reporting tools such as SAP Group Reporting or
   Hyperion.
 * Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Alteryx. Accounting Financial Reporting SAP S/4HANA Investment Accounting Cash Accounting General Ledger Reconciliations Month-end Close Variance Analysis SOX Compliance Internal Audit Group Reporting Financial Analysis Problem-solving Communication Skills Candidates must hold a professional accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or CMA and possess at least 3 years of experience in corporate accounting. Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA and a strong understanding of financial reporting and internal controls are required.

title: Security Officer
job_description:
At Holiday Inn Gurugram Sector 90, an IHG Hotel, the safety and security of our
guests, colleagues, and property are our top priorities. We are seeking a
vigilant, responsible, and service-oriented Security Officer who will help
maintain a safe and secure environment while delivering warm, professional, and
welcoming hospitality.

In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring hotel premises,
implementing security procedures, responding to incidents, and ensuring
compliance with hotel safety standards and operational policies.  

 

What You'll Do

 * Monitor hotel premises, including guest areas, back-of-house areas,
   entrances, exits, and other designated locations, to ensure the safety and
   security of guests, colleagues, and property.
 * Conduct regular security patrols and maintain vigilance throughout the
   assigned shift.
 * Monitor CCTV systems, access control points, and surveillance equipment to
   identify and report suspicious activities.
 * Verify the movement of colleagues, visitors, contractors, and vehicles in
   accordance with hotel security procedures.
 * Respond promptly and professionally to security incidents, emergencies, and
   guest or colleague concerns.
 * Assist in implementing emergency response procedures, fire safety protocols,
   evacuation drills, and other life-safety measures.
 * Maintain accurate records of incidents, visitor entries, security checks, and
   shift handovers.
 * Support the enforcement of hotel policies and ensure compliance with
   established security procedures.
 * Coordinate with the Front Office, Engineering, Human Resources, and other
   departments on security-related matters.
 * Handle guest information and security-sensitive matters with discretion and
   confidentiality.
 * Assist in investigations, prepare incident reports, and escalate concerns to
   the Security Supervisor or Security Manager as required.
 * Deliver courteous and professional service while maintaining a strong
   security presence throughout the hotel.

 

What We're Looking For

 * A minimum qualification of 10+2 or equivalent; additional security or
   safety-related training will be an advantage.
 * Previous experience in hotel security, hospitality, or a similar security
   role is preferred.
 * Knowledge of security procedures, access control, CCTV monitoring, emergency
   response, and basic fire safety practices.
 * Good observation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
 * The ability to remain calm, alert, and professional while handling
   challenging situations.
 * A strong sense of responsibility, integrity, discipline, and confidentiality.
 * Physical fitness and the flexibility to work rotational shifts, including
   weekends and public holidays.
 * A guest-focused attitude with the ability to balance effective security
   practices with warm and courteous hospitality.

 

Why Join IHG?

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe in creating an environment where colleagues
feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow. As part of our team, you will
contribute to a culture of safety, trust, and True Hospitality while developing
your skills within a globally recognized hospitality brand.

Join us at Holiday Inn and help create a safe, secure, and welcoming experience
for every guest and colleague. Security monitoring CCTV operation Access control Emergency response Fire safety Incident reporting Surveillance Communication Interpersonal skills Hospitality Patrolling Conflict resolution Candidates must have a minimum qualification of 10+2 and possess knowledge of security procedures, CCTV monitoring, and emergency response. Strong communication skills, physical fitness, and the ability to work rotational shifts are required.

title: Senior Support Engineer
job_description:
At Meazure Learning, we empower universities and credential organizations around the world by providing secure, reliable online proctoring and testing solutions. Our mission is to create seamless, high-quality experiences for test takers, ensuring fairness and integrity in remote assessments.

As Meazure Learning continues to expand its commitment to exceptional customer experience, we are building a Customer Support Engineering team in India. This team will serve as a key technical partner to our customers and internal stakeholders, taking ownership of complex technical issues that require deeper investigation and cross-functional collaboration.

This is a remote position based in India, supporting core business hours from 1 PM – 10 PM; 4 PM – 1 AM IST, Monday through Friday, with flexibility depending on business needs. You will collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across different time zones, contributing to the resolution of complex customer-impacting issues and continuous improvement of our products and support processes.

Join Us and You’ll:

 * Be part of an innovative and fast-growing global technology team focused on automation and quality engineering.
 * Work on cutting-edge test automation frameworks and cloud-based solutions to improve software quality.
 * Collaborate with talented professionals across development, product management, and engineering teams to deliver world-class software.
 * Make a real impact by helping ensure the integrity and reliability of online assessments worldwide.
 * Grow your career in an organization that values learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do:

 * Technical Support:
   * Provide prompt, accurate, and empathetic technical support to Meazure Learning customers via various channels (e.g., email, chat, phone).
   * Diagnose and troubleshoot basic to intermediate technical issues related to our software applications, web platforms, and associated services.
   * Guide users through step-by-step solutions, provide clear instructions, and explain technical concepts in an easy-to-understand manner.
   * Assist with account inquiries, login issues, password resets, and basic product navigation.
 * Issue Resolution & Escalation:
   * Accurately document all customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in our ticketing system.
   * Identify when an issue requires escalation to Engineering or other internal teams, providing thorough documentation for seamless handover.
 * Knowledge Base Contribution:
   * Utilize our knowledge base and internal resources to efficiently resolve customer issues.
   * Contribute to the continuous improvement of our knowledge base by suggesting new articles, updating existing content, and identifying common customer pain points.
 * Customer Advocacy:
   * Act as a customer advocate, ensuring their feedback and concerns are heard and relayed to relevant internal teams for product and service improvement.
   * Maintain a positive, professional, and patient demeanor in all customer interactions.
 * Continuous Learning:
   * Actively participate in training sessions to stay up to date on Meazure Learning products, features, and support best practices.
   * Continuously improve technical skills and product knowledge to better serve our customers.

What We’re Looking For:

 * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 * 7–10 years of experience in technical customer support, application support, production support, customer engineering, or a similar technical support role, preferably supporting SaaS or web-based applications.
 * Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex customer issues, identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and systematically narrow down the root cause.
 * Good understanding of web applications, application architecture, HTTP/HTTPS, networking fundamentals, and common browser/client-side troubleshooting techniques.
 * Good understanding of relational databases and SQL, including the ability to write queries, perform joins and filtering, investigate data inconsistencies, and use database information as part of technical troubleshooting.
 * Good understanding of REST APIs and API troubleshooting, including HTTP methods and status codes, request/response payloads, headers, authentication/authorization, and JSON. Experience using tools such as Postman or equivalent is preferred.
 * Experience using monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, AppSignal, or similar platforms to investigate application and service issues.
 * Ability to analyze logs, API responses, database records, monitoring data, and application behavior to determine the likely failure point and distinguish between client-side, application, data, integration, and infrastructure-related issues.
 * Demonstrated ability to own technical issues end-to-end, including investigation, troubleshooting, customer communication, resolution, and escalation when required.
 * Experience working with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to resolve complex customer-impacting issues.
 * Ability to provide high-quality technical escalations with relevant evidence, troubleshooting performed, findings, reproduction steps, and business/customer impact.
 * Understanding of incident management, root-cause analysis, and post-incident documentation is preferred.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 * Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and structured problem-solving skills.
 * Experience with ticketing and case-management platforms such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or similar tools.
 * Ability to prioritize multiple issues based on customer impact, severity, urgency, and business requirements.
 * Experience supporting customers or internal stakeholders across different time zones and working effectively with globally distributed teams.
 * Experience creating or improving technical documentation, knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and support runbooks.
 * Demonstrated ability and willingness to mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical escalation point within the team.
 * Experience in EdTech, assessment technology, SaaS, or other technically complex software environments is preferred.

The Benefits: 

 * Competitive Salary
 * Exceptional Benefits
 * Professional development
 * Remote and hybrid first organization
 * Great working environment with a team of exceptional people




Learn more at www.meazurelearning.com [http://www.meazurelearning.com]

title: Senior Quality Assurance
job_description:
The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will lead a team of Quality Analysts assigned to a project and will be responsible for coordinating all testing efforts. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will create and execute test plans and test cases to ensure adherence with specified requirements. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing using a combination of manual testing and automated tools to validate end to end system performance. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst supports external clients through their testing cycles by providing detailed release notes with every delivery, triaging issues reported, and engaging clients to review system discrepancies as needed. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will provide training to client counterparts on Hexure’s systems and testing practices.
Responsibilities:
Review requirement documentation to ensure understanding of the scope of the project and what needs to be tested.
Create and maintain test plans and test cases designed to offer adequate test coverage and minimize escaped defects.
Create and maintain Quality Assurance matrices of test coverage, slippage ratios, and other pertinent quality metrics.
Follow established quality control processes, test execution methods and standards to identify, analyze, and document issues, bugs, defects, and other problems.
Complete full regression testing and analyze test results.
Manage code and data migrations across multiple testing and production environments.
Perform a thorough shakeout testing after builds/installs are complete.
Monitor defect tracking system daily and collaborate with the development team to ensure that any defects are fixed in a timely fashion.
Actively participate in team meetings such as stand-up meetings and sprint retrospectives and provide testing status reporting on a regular basis.
Provide mentorship and ongoing support to other Quality Assurance resources.
Develop and document training materials and job aids aimed at fostering more efficient and consistent practices across implementations.
Evaluate existing practices, identify, and implement process improvement initiatives.
Take ownership of all functional areas and features on assigned client implementations.
Reinforce the use of best practices on the team and motivate the team to be more productive.
Assist with recruitment and onboarding of new hires.
Lead team of 2-3 Quality Assurance resources and coordinate all testing activities on assigned projects.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Katalon, Playwright, or Selenium (Java), ensuring reliable and scalable test coverage.
Utilize Git branching strategies and CI/CD concepts to integrate automated test execution into build and deployment pipelines, supporting continuous quality validation.
Leverage AI-powered testing tools and automation frameworks to improve test design, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency while reducing maintenance effort.
Leverage AI-powered tools to support manual testing activities, including test case generation, exploratory testing, requirement analysis, test data creation, and defect investigation to improve test effectiveness and productivity.
Qualifications:
Expert understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle.
5+ years’ experience testing Software applications and or technology background
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Life Insurance and Annuities proficiency preferred.
We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 
For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc

title: Duty Manager
job_description:
Job Description
We are seeking a dynamic and organized Duty Manager to join our team in Kochi, India. As a Duty Manager, you will be the backbone of our operations, ensuring seamless service delivery, maintaining the highest standards of safety and security, and representing management with professionalism and empathy. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead during your shift, make decisive decisions, and create exceptional experiences for our guests while supporting your team with collaborative leadership and transparent communication.
Oversee all hotel operations during assigned shifts, conducting regular property tours to ensure compliance with organizational standards and identify any maintenance or service issues
Serve as the primary point of contact for guest concerns and complaints, addressing issues promptly with diplomacy and finding effective solutions that prioritize guest satisfaction
Ensure the safety and security of all guests, staff members, and property assets by monitoring security protocols, responding to incidents, and implementing emergency procedures as needed
Supervise and coordinate front office operations, including check-ins, check-outs, and guest communications, while maintaining brand standards and hospitality excellence
Anticipate guest needs and personalize interactions to enhance satisfaction and foster loyalty throughout their stay
Maintain detailed and accurate duty reports, documenting all incidents, guest feedback, and operational observations, and ensure timely distribution to relevant departments
Manage VIP arrivals and departures with meticulous attention to detail, coordinating with various departments to deliver customized service experiences
Monitor and promote hotel amenities, services, and dining outlets to guests, actively contributing to revenue generation and guest engagement
Respond to guest feedback and online reviews within 24 hours, demonstrating commitment to continuous improvement and guest relations
Collaborate with all departments to ensure consistent service quality, resolve interdepartmental issues, and support team members in delivering excellence
Implement and enforce health, safety, security, and quality control procedures across all areas of the property
Participate in staff training initiatives, guest experience meetings, and quality improvement projects to drive organizational excellence
Manage stress effectively while maintaining composure and making sound decisions during high-pressure situations
Qualifications
**Required Skills and Competencies:**
Fluency in English; additional language proficiency is highly valued
Exceptional organizational and time management abilities
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with active listening capabilities
Leadership and team management experience
Customer service orientation with a genuine commitment to guest satisfaction
Ability to remain calm and make decisive decisions under pressure
Proficiency in conflict resolution and diplomatic communication
Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and reporting
Adaptability and flexibility in a dynamic work environment
Proactive and anticipatory mindset
Professional presentation and demeanor
**Required Experience:**
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in hospitality operations or front office management
Proven experience in a supervisory or management role
Experience handling VIP guests and managing guest relations
Familiarity with property management systems (PMS) such as OPERA or similar platforms
Background in duty management, shift supervision, or night audit operations
Experience in luxury or upscale hospitality establishments is preferred
**Preferred Qualifications:**
Hospitality management certification or relevant training
Knowledge of health, safety, and security regulations
Experience with incident reporting and crisis management
Familiarity with budget management and cost control
Background in quality assurance and guest satisfaction programs
Experience with loyalty programs and guest profiling systems
**Essential Attributes:**
Resilience and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
Inclusive and supportive approach to team collaboration
Transparent and ethical decision-making practices
Empathetic understanding of guest and staff needs
Goal-oriented mindset with commitment to operational excellence
Efficient work habits and strong organizational capabilities

Job-Category: Rooms
Job Type: Permanent
Job Schedule: Full-Time Hospitality operations Front office management Guest relations Leadership Conflict resolution Problem-solving Time management Communication Incident reporting Crisis management Safety and security protocols Property management systems Team management Customer service Operational excellence Decision making Candidates must have 2-3 years of experience in hospitality or front office management with strong leadership and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in property management systems and a commitment to guest satisfaction are essential for this role.

title: GIS Service Engineer
job_description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (GIS Service Engineer)

As a GIS Service Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliable operation and performance of high-voltage Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems across customer sites. You will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of GIS equipment up to 420kV, supporting customers through the entire lifecycle of their assets.

In this role, you will work closely with customers, project teams, engineering, quality, and field service professionals to deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality service execution. You will leverage your technical expertise in high-voltage equipment, diagnostic testing, and site execution practices to resolve complex technical challenges, improve equipment reliability, and ensure customer satisfaction. We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused service professional who can combine hands-on field experience, problem-solving capability, and operational excellence to support Siemens Energy's service business growth.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Execute installation, commissioning, maintenance, and retrofit activities for Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems up to 420kV while ensuring adherence to quality and safety standards.

• Carry out preventive maintenance and routine servicing activities to maximize equipment reliability, improve operational performance, and minimize unplanned outages.

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair GIS equipment, including replacement of defective components, fault rectification, and post-maintenance testing.

• Perform on-site testing and diagnostics using specialized equipment such as CRM kits, CB timing kits, DCRM test kits, SF6 gas analyzers, HV PD test kits, CPC 100, and CT analyzers.

• Analyze technical issues and provide effective solutions to customers while ensuring minimum downtime and sustainable equipment performance.

• Support customers during planned shutdowns, emergency breakdowns, and critical operational situations with timely technical assistance.

• Ensure accurate documentation of service activities, maintenance records, testing reports, modifications, upgrades, and site observations.

• Conduct site audits and technical assessments to identify improvement opportunities, enhance service quality, and reduce non-conformities.

• Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, engineering teams, and service stakeholders to ensure efficient project execution and customer satisfaction.

• Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy safety standards, IEC requirements, environmental regulations, and site-specific procedures while maintaining a zero-incident culture.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, technical excellence, and customer experience.

• Support business growth by building strong customer relationships, identifying service opportunities, and contributing to the overall success of the service organization.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Electrical Engineering.

• Minimum 4-5 years of hands-on experience in installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of GIS or high-voltage switchgear systems.

• Strong technical understanding of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), high-voltage electrical equipment, protection systems, and substation applications.

• Hands-on experience using advanced testing and diagnostic equipment such as CRM kits, CB timing kits, DCRM test kits, SF6 gas analyzers, HV PD test kits, CPC 100, CT analyzers, and related tools.

• Ability to interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose faults and implement effective corrective actions under challenging field conditions.

• Good understanding of electrical safety practices, IEC standards, maintenance procedures, and quality requirements related to high-voltage equipment.

• Strong communication and customer management skills with the ability to explain technical issues and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional and multicultural teams.

• Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple activities in dynamic project environments.

• Willingness to travel extensively (up to 80%) for domestic and international assignments, including emergency service support and customer shutdown activities.

• Passion for technical excellence, customer service, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL)

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure-play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain throughout their energy transition journey. Our portfolio includes low to zero-emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.

• Comprehensive Medical Insurance coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Meal Card facility as per company policy and applicable tax regulations.

title: Gas Turbine Service Engineer for Fleet Intelligence & Reporting
job_description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Service Engineering supports the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the installed power-generation fleet. In this role, you will connect data from different systems and turn it into transparent, consistent and user-oriented information products for technical experts and business stakeholders. 

You will analyze operating and engineering data, establish reporting structures, develop plant- and fleet-specific dashboards and improve the underlying data flows. The position combines technical understanding, data analytics, digital solution development and close collaboration with Engineering, Field Service, project teams, process owners and IT. 

How You'll Make an Impact

 *
 * Integrate information from multiple data sources: Collect, combine and structure data from operating-data systems, Product Change Management, engineering databases, and other relevant sources. 
 *  Analyze fleet and operating data: Evaluate standard operating parameters and additional sensors defined by technical experts. Identify trends, deviations and unusual developments and make the results transparent and traceable. 
 *  Develop and maintain dashboards: Build clear, user-focused dashboards for plants, fleets and specialist functions. Depending on the use case, these may include operating-data trends, Engineering recommendations, PCM information, action status and milestones. 
 * Assure data quality and consistency: Perform systematic checks for completeness and consistency. Identify gaps, duplicates and contradictions and coordinate clarification with the responsible data owners and functions. 
 *  Improve data models and reporting standards: Define common data structures, terminology, templates, KPIs and quality checks to create scalable solutions.
 * Automate recurring data and reporting activities: Identify manual steps and develop practical solutions using automation tools.
 * Translate requirements into digital solutions: Work with technical experts and stakeholders to convert their needs into maintainable dashboards, data models or workflows. 
 *
 *

What You Bring

 *
 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, data analytics, or comparable technical qualification. 
 * Professional experience in data analysis, reporting, technical information management, power generation, Service Engineering or a comparable environment is an advantage. 
 * Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand relationships between technical systems, operational behavior and engineering information. 
 * Hands-on experience with tools for data preparation, data modeling, visualization and the development of intuitive reports and dashboards (e.g. SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Python, ETL tools, etc.).
 * A careful and reliable approach to data quality, data security, documentation, deadlines and the maintenance of digital solutions. 
 * Very good written and spoken English.
 * Confidence working in international and cross-functional teams and the ability to translate specialist requirements into practical digital solutions. 
 *   A high level of ownership, curiosity and initiative, combined with a pragmatic approach to improving data flows, processes and reporting solutions. 
 *
 *

title: Front Office Manager
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and
supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff,
Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with
managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in
and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the
financial performance of the department.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front
desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant
Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work
experience required.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the
expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your
work.

• Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts,
or otherwise negotiating with others.

• Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and
financial objectives are met.

• Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to
create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes
performance, and produces desired results.

• Understands the impact of department’s operations on the overall property
financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.

 

Supporting Management of Front Desk Team

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and
encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making;
demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team
members.

• Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees'
absence.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and
ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or
Assistant Front Office Manager.

 

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service 

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and
retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand
guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

title: Deputy Vice President - Activation, Retention, Cross Border spends & CLIP
job_description:
About Us

SBI Card is a leading pure-play credit card issuer in India, offering a wide
range of credit cards to cater to diverse customer needs. We are constantly
innovating to meet the evolving financial needs of our customers, empowering
them with digital currency for seamless payment experience and indulge in
rewarding benefits. At SBI Card, the motto 'Make Life Simple' inspires every
initiative, ensuring that customer convenience is at the forefront of all that
we do. We are committed to building an environment where people can thrive and
create a better future for everyone.

SBI Card is proud to be an equal opportunity & inclusive employer and welcome
employees without any discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, gender,
religion, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital
status, caste etc. SBI Card is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse
workplace where all employees are treated equally with dignity and respect which
makes it a promising place to work.

Join us to shape the future of digital payment in India and unlock your full
potential.

What’s in it for YOU

 1. SBI Card truly lives by the work-life balance philosophy. We offer a robust
    wellness and wellbeing program to support mental and physical health of our
    employees
 2. Admirable work deserves to be rewarded. We have a well curated bouquet of
    rewards and recognition program for the employees
 3. Dynamic, Inclusive and Diverse team culture 
 4. Gender Neutral Policy
 5. Inclusive Health Benefits for all - Medical Insurance, Personal Accidental,
    Group Term Life Insurance and Annual Health Checkup, Dental and OPD benefits
 6. Commitment to the overall development of an employee through comprehensive
    learning & development framework

Role Purpose 

Responsible for planning and executing the following components of portfolio
management, namely Onboarding, Early Activation, Retention, Authorization, Cross
border spends

Role Accountability 

 1.  Plan & implement onboarding & retention strategy, ensuring that requisite
     SLAs are met by Customer Service and outbound calling teams
 2.  Launch early activation programs to increase first swipe on the card
     (Separate action plan for early activation for Shikhar accounts)
 3.  Monitor New sourcing inflow to identify potential issues/aberrations and
     flag them for appropriate remedial action
 4.  Determine the pool of customers to reach out for win back calling and
     ensure re-carding in a time bound manner
 5.  Develop and implement strategies for improving claw back of authorization
     decline spends
 6.  Plan and execute cross border spends increase campaigns 
 7.  Plan and implement credit line increase programs across calling and self
     service channels
 8.  Lead implementation of authorization rate improvement initiatives, such as
     RBI switch relates usage guidelines and other such initiatives
 9.  Work with IT to implement all strategies and regulatory changes within
     assigned area in the system
 10. Ensure process documentation and compliance adherence

Measures of Success 

 1.  Voluntary Attrition nos as per plan
 2.  Early activation rates & spend / account as per plan
 3.  Onboarding numbers as per plan
 4.  Cross border Active rate
 5.  Cross Border spends
 6.  Cross Border Auth rate improvement %
 7.  Customer Winback %
 8.  Spends Claw back %
 9.  Number of Credit Line Increase (CHS #)
 10. Process adherence as per MOU

Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications

 1. Spends Category Understanding
 2. Good knowledge on Consumer and Competition behavior and Credit Card Market
    Dynamics
 3. Prior knowledge of alliances and partnerships
 4. Prior knowledge of retention and activation preferred

Competencies critical to the role

 1. Planning & Organizing
 2. Analytical Ability
 3. Negotiation & Influencing
 4. Innovation & Problem Solving
 5. Teamwork & Collaboration

Qualification 

MBA /PGDBM in Marketing or any other relevant discipline

Preferred Industry

Payment Card Industry, Telecom, Retail Portfolio management Onboarding Retention strategy Early activation Cross border spends Authorization rate improvement Credit line increase Data analysis Planning and organizing Negotiation Influencing Problem solving Teamwork Collaboration Consumer behavior Market dynamics Candidates must possess an MBA or PGDBM in Marketing or a relevant discipline. The role requires 11-14 years of overall experience with 7-9 years specifically in team handling or domain-related functions within the payment card, telecom, or retail industries.

title: Marketing Coordinator
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques
that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott.
Recognize opportunities to up-sell the customer and sell enhancements to create
a better Marriott experience or event. Encourage guests or callers to purchase
or schedule preview package sales/tours. Explain details and requirements
related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Verify that
individuals meet eligibility requirements for preview package sales/tours prior
to scheduling a tour for a Marriott vacation club property. Determine and give
complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage (e.g., rewards points,
show tickets). Answer guest questions about property facilities/services.
Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.

 

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal
appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary
information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests
according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs;
thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and
professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and
completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain
positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals;
listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with
quality assurance expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and
place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance;
stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job
duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Education: High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience. 

License or Certification: None

title: Application Engineer
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Python Developer — AWS Cloud

 

 

Role: Python Developer with AWS Cloud Experience

Experience: 8–10 years

 

We are looking for an experienced Python Developer who can build scalable
backend services, APIs, and cloud-based applications on AWS. The ideal candidate
should have strong Python programming skills, hands-on experience with web
frameworks, and working knowledge of AWS services used in modern application
development.

  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications and backend services.

•  Build and integrate REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or
Django REST Framework.

•  Work with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, ECR, S3, EventBridge, CloudWatch,
and Secrets Manager.

•  Write clean, reusable, and well-tested code following coding standards and
review practices.

•  Support performance tuning, troubleshooting, logging, and monitoring of
production applications.

•  Collaborate with architects, developers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver
reliable cloud solutions.

  REQUIRED SKILLS

 * Strong hands-on experience in Python programming.
 * Good understanding of object-oriented programming and basic design
   principles.
 * Experience with API development using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST
   Framework.
 * Working knowledge of asynchronous programming, threading, or multiprocessing.
 * Experience with AWS cloud services, especially Lambda, ECS, S3, CloudWatch,
   EventBridge, and Secrets Manager.
 * Familiarity with Pandas and NumPy is preferred for data processing use cases.
 * Knowledge of code quality tools such as pylint, mypy, pytest, and
   Git/Bitbucket.
 * Develop scalable backend applications and microservices using Python.
 * Build RESTful APIs and event-driven services for AI platforms.
 * Develop integrations with CRM, CCaaS, IVR, Knowledge Management, and
   enterprise systems.
 * Implement asynchronous processing, workflow orchestration, and automation
   services.
 * Ensure high-quality code through unit testing, code reviews, and CI/CD
   practices.

  Generative AI & Agentic AI

 * Design and implement LLM-powered solutions using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI,
   Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or similar models.
 * Develop RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architecture and enterprise
   knowledge assistants.
 * Integrate vector databases and semantic search capabilities.
 * Build AI agents capable of tool usage, workflow execution, and
   decision-making.
 * Optimize prompts, grounding strategies, and response quality.

 

  NICE TO HAVE

•  Exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, or GenAI-based application
development.

•  Experience with API gateways such as Apigee.

•  Experience working with containerized applications using ECS and ECR.

  HR SCREENING CHECKLIST

•  8–10 years of overall software development experience.

•  Strong Python backend development experience.

•  Hands-on experience with at least one Python web framework such as FastAPI,
Flask, or Django REST Framework.

•  Practical AWS experience, preferably with Lambda, ECS, S3, CloudWatch, and
Secrets Manager.

•  Good communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

title: Executive Sous Chef
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while assisting in
leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually
improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the financial
performance in all areas of responsibility. Assists in supervising all kitchen
areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for
guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation
and food standards are achieved. Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all
food preparation areas (e.g., banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge
and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (e.g., dish room and purchasing)
as applicable.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and
beverage, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and
Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary,
food and beverage, or related professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Assisting in Leading Kitchen Operations for Property

• Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.

• Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees'
absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance
standards and monitoring performance.

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and
encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making;
demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team
members.

• Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and
financial objectives are met.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and
ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews
employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or
concerns.

• Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food
preparation.

• Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.

 

Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities

• Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and
receiving areas.

• Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes,
ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and
procedures related to safety.

• Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies,
uniforms and equipment.

• Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.

• Knows and implements the brand's safety standards.

 

Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met

• Provides direction for menu development.

• Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards
are met.

• Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.

• Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.

• Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.

• Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.

• Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation
certifications.

• Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.

• Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for
special guests or functions.

 

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer
satisfaction and retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand
guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the
expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer
service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service
levels.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Establishes
guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. Ensures
employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify
areas of improvement.

 

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or
otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent
plate presentations.

• Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.

• Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding
food knowledge and menu composition.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals
and or managers.

• Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of
responsibility.

• Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to
Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer
Review Process.

 

Additional Responsibilities 

• Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers,
and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and
solve problems.

employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any

can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and
become the best version of you.

JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of

belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. title: Assistant Revenue Manager
job_description:
At Holiday Inn Gurugram Sector 90, an IHG Hotel, we are committed to delivering
True Hospitality while driving business performance and maximizing revenue
opportunities. We are looking for a commercially driven and analytical Assistant
Revenue Manager to support our revenue strategy, optimize room revenue, and
enhance the hotel’s overall financial performance.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Revenue Manager, Sales, and
Reservations teams to analyze market trends, manage room inventory, and
implement effective pricing strategies to maximize revenue and profitability.

What You'll Do

 * Assist in developing and implementing revenue management strategies to
   maximize room revenue, occupancy, and RevPAR.
 * Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, demand patterns, and booking pace
   to identify revenue opportunities.
 * Analyze historical data, current business trends, and future demand to
   support accurate forecasting and budgeting.
 * Manage room rates, inventory, restrictions, and distribution channels in line
   with the hotel’s revenue strategy.
 * Monitor key performance indicators, including ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and
   market share.
 * Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly revenue reports and provide actionable
   insights to support business decisions.
 * Collaborate with Sales, Reservations, Front Office, and Marketing teams to
   optimize business mix and achieve revenue targets.
 * Support the management of online travel agencies (OTAs), brand.com, and other
   distribution channels to ensure rate parity and maximize online revenue.
 * Assist in conducting regular competitor analysis and preparing reports on
   market performance.
 * Ensure compliance with IHG revenue management standards, systems, and
   commercial policies.

 

What We are Looking For

 * A bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a
   related field.
 * Previous experience in revenue management, reservations, or hotel commercial
   operations, preferably in a Five Star Hotel brand.
 * Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills with excellent
   attention to detail.
 * Knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, forecasting, pricing
   strategies, and distribution channels.
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hotel property management systems;
   experience with revenue management systems is an advantage.
 * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to
   collaborate effectively across departments.
 * A proactive, commercially focused mindset with the ability to identify
   opportunities and recommend data-driven solutions.

 

Why Joining IHG?

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, you’ll be part of a global hospitality family that
values individuality, encourages growth, and empowers colleagues to make a
meaningful difference. Join us to grow your career, contribute to commercial
success, and help create exceptional experiences for our guests.

Join us and be part of a team where True Hospitality begins with you. Revenue management Analytical skills Forecasting Pricing strategies Microsoft Excel Property management systems Market analysis Inventory management Data analysis Communication skills Problem-solving Strategic planning Commercial awareness Reporting Collaboration Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Previous experience in revenue management or hotel commercial operations, preferably within a five-star brand, is required.

Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

How you'll make an impact

· Apply skills in order to provide and present financial monitoring reports that measure client financial status, track expenses by product line, renewal projections, funding levels and rates, etc. Be able to speak with FBC management about abnormal conditions that arise from the evaluation of these reports
· Maintain proficiency and understanding of various proprietary Models and Tools to calculate financial results.
· Analyze data from carriers on complex clients and provide recommendations to Client Servicing teams
· Preparing and analyzing on various client deliverables, as defined by the scope of services of the FMR team
· Demonstrates understanding of whether or not analysis “makes sense”; can think beyond the numbers on the page
· Conduct any activity for special assignments as assigned by management
· Demonstrate competence with collection of required data and materials needed for the successful completion of various projects
· Proficient and compliant with internal systems
· Strong oral and written communications and presentations
	
Secondary Responsibilities 
· Ability to communicate effectively in fast pace work environment 
· Effectively navigate through conflict
· Excellent communication skills (both orally and in writing)
· Initiative to continue growing personally and professionally as our industry changes and business need changes
· Must be able to persuade others to provide items needed to complete this job within pre-established timeframes
· Must demonstrate ability to work professionally as a team member in a group with diverse backgrounds
· Must have initiative and be properly assertive in presenting new ideas
	
	

About you

Qualifications
· Candidate with Maths or Stats background
· Good knowledge of Applied Statistics (Intermediate Level)
· Good knowledge of MS Excel & VBA
· Excellent analytical skills
· Good communication skills
· Bachelor’s graduates only.

Additional Information

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.
Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being 
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning

title: Marketing Intern (Cross-Border) - 6 months Internship

Role: Marketing Intern (Cross Border) – 6 Months Internship

Location: Bangalore - Eco-world



About the role

Cashfree helps businesses collect payments online. Our Cross-Border team works
on payments that move between India and the rest of the world, in both
directions:

 * Global companies coming into India. We help foreign brands and payment
   companies accept payments from Indian customers.

 * Indian businesses selling abroad. We help Indian brands get paid by customers
   in other countries.

As our marketing intern, you'll help us tell that story. You'll work on content,
social posts, and track how our campaigns perform. Everything you make goes
live, and you'll see the results.

What you'll do

Publish content people find on Google and in AI tools

 * Write web pages and FAQs that answer common questions from global companies
   entering India

 * Write simple explainers for a new payment option we're launching

 * Research what people search for in a new product area, and write content for
   it early

 * Track which pages show up in search and AI answers, and update the ones that
   don't

Create for social media

You'll help plan our social content, create the posts, and see how they perform.

 * Join planning sessions and pitch post ideas for each campaign

 * Create posts using AI tools for design and copy, from launch posts to custom
   visuals for brands we want to win

 * Work with the social media team to schedule and publish posts 

 * Track how each post performs and report on what's working

Manage campaign data and report results

Every campaign has a goal. You'll help us see whether we're hitting it.

 * Build target lists we want to reach

 * Keep track of campaign performance and maintain performance reports

 * Create reports for monthly and quarterly team reviews

Use AI to work faster

AI tools are part of the job every day, not an extra.

 * Use tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Canva AI to write, design and research
   faster

 * Create reusable prompts and templates the team can share

 * Check AI output carefully and fix it before it goes out

Who we're looking for

You must have

 * A portfolio: links to things you've written, designed or built. College
   projects and personal work count.

 * An eye for design, and some experience with Canva or Figma

 * Experience using AI tools in your own work, with examples you can show

Nice to have, not required

 * Interest in fintech, payments or tech companies

 * Experience running a social media page, newsletter or community

 * You've automated something (even small) with a tool 

What you get

 * Real work that goes live, not practice tasks

 * A seat in team planning meetings and reviews

 * A portfolio of live campaigns, with real results, to show future employers



This isn't your average intern role. You'll be a marketer, a strategist, a
storyteller for one of India's fastest moving identity/regtech products. If you
want to launch your career in B2B product marketing, building decks that close
deals, running campaigns that move pipelines, and shaping how India's digital
economy thinks about identity, let's talk. Content writing Social media management Data analysis Canva Figma AI tools Copywriting Digital marketing Fintech B2B marketing SEO Reporting Campaign management Research Candidates must provide a portfolio of written or designed work and demonstrate proficiency with AI tools and design software like Canva or Figma. While not required, experience in fintech or social media management is considered a plus.

title: Front Office Associate - AYS
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Answer, record, and process all guest requests, questions, or concerns via
telephone, email, chat, and mobile communication devices. Operate telephone
switchboard, process guest requests for wake-up calls, and connecting and
directing calls to the appropriate extension. Receive, record, and relay
messages accurately. Log all guest requests or issues into computer, contact
appropriate individual or department (e.g., Bellperson, Housekeeping), and
follow up with guest to ensure their request has been resolved to their
satisfaction. Provide information to guests about room features, property
amenities, and local areas of interest. May process room service orders, answer
questions on menu selection and record transactions in point-of-sale system.
Assist guests with accessing internet and guestroom entertainment.

 

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal
appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary
information; and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests
according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs,
assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine
appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and
answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive
working relationships with others, and support team to reach common goals.
Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually
verify information in a variety of formats; stand, sit, or walk for an extended
period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and
place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

Overview

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking to hire a Service Support Associate for the Insurance vertical. As part of this role, the Service Support Associate serves as the primary point of contact for the US branch, providing end-to-end support for policy renewals, including documentation management (Census, SBC, SPD, Carrier Proposals, etc.). You will collaborate with Client Managers to ensure timely completion of tasks for ~35 accounts. A solid understanding of US Health Insurance regulations and previous experience with carriers like Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and MetLife is preferred. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills are essential for managing multiple tasks and delivering high-quality support.

How you'll make an impact

Act as the primary point of contact for the branch (US onshore), providing comprehensive support.
Understand and implement US Health Insurance regulatory standards, guidelines, policies, and
procedures.
Ensure end-to-end support of the policy lifecycle services.
Assume the role of Client Associate (~35 accounts) at the branch.

Coordinate with internal operations teams to complete renewal activities on time.

Education: Degree- Bachelor's/ Master's

Graduate with 3-5 years of experience in the insurance domain.

title: Performance Marketing Lead- Sahi English
job_description:
About Lokal
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)

title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
job_description:
This role combines people leadership with technical ownership. The manager will
establish a reliable operating rhythm for the team, set priorities, coach and
develop engineers, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure that enterprise
platforms and services are secure, well-documented, measurable, and responsive
to business needs. 

The manager will oversee capabilities including Atlassian products, Jira Service
Management, Jira Assets, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, and related
enterprise integrations and data workflows. 

Key responsibilities 

People leadership and team management 

 * Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Solutions Engineers in India and across
   the broader team. 

 * Set clear goals, ownership, service expectations, and development plans for
   each team member. 

 * Establish team standards for communication, documentation, quality, delivery,
   and operational follow-through. 

 * Run regular one-on-ones, team meetings, planning sessions, and performance
   reviews. 

 * Build accountability for commitments while creating a collaborative and
   supportive team environment. 

 * Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain Enterprise Solutions talent. 

 * Coordinate knowledge transfer, coverage, succession planning, and
   cross-training so critical services do not depend on a single individual. 

Portfolio, prioritization, and stakeholder management 

 * Own the Enterprise Solutions team backlog and prioritize work across
   operational support, projects, platform improvements, automation, reporting,
   and strategic initiatives. 

 * Translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery plans, milestones,
   and measurable outcomes. 

 * Serve as the primary escalation point for Enterprise Solutions work and
   communicate status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to leadership. 

 * Establish and maintain an operating rhythm for intake, prioritization,
   delivery tracking, service reviews, and continuous improvement. 

 * Partner with Corporate Support, Product Engineering, Data & AI, Information
   Security, Finance, Human Resources, and business stakeholders. 

 * Ensure commitments are realistic, visible, and delivered with appropriate
   quality and documentation. 

Enterprise platform ownership 

 * Provide governance and technical direction for Atlassian products, Jira
   Service Management, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, Jira Assets,
   and related platforms. 

 * Ensure platforms are configured, administered, monitored, and improved as
   reliable enterprise services. 

 * Establish platform roadmaps, lifecycle plans, access controls, configuration
   standards, and service documentation. 

 * Oversee provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, vendor coordination,
   and platform changes. 

 * Ensure platform administration follows security, compliance,
   change-management, and data-protection requirements. 

AI adoption and enablement 

 * Lead the assessment, piloting, implementation, governance, and adoption of AI
   tools such as Glean, Claude, Cursor, and Fellow.ai. 

 * Identify and document business cases for AI integration and measure adoption,
   productivity, quality, and business outcomes. 

 * Establish practical standards, workflows, training, and compliance procedures
   for responsible AI use. 

 * Coach the team to use AI-assisted development and automation tools
   responsibly to improve delivery speed and quality. 

Enterprise data management and business intelligence 

 * Oversee the design, management, and optimization of Power BI dataflows,
   reports, dashboards, and supporting data processes. 

 * Ensure reporting requirements are translated into accurate, maintainable, and
   actionable business intelligence solutions. 

 * Establish standards for data integrity, security, accessibility,
   documentation, and report ownership. 

 * Coordinate the transition and modernization of reporting infrastructure,
   including potential migration toward Snowflake and partnership with the Data
   & AI team. 

Process automation and systems integration 

 * Direct automation of business processes within Jira Service Management and
   other enterprise platforms. 

 * Oversee integrations using Power Automate, APIs, Python, and other middleware
   or automation technologies. 

 * Identify opportunities to remove manual effort, improve control quality,
   reduce operational risk, and increase service responsiveness. 

 * Ensure automation is tested, documented, monitored, supportable, and governed
   through appropriate change controls. 

Asset management and service operations 

 * Oversee asset-management practices using Jira Assets, including hardware,
   software, application, service, and ownership records. 

 * Maintain accurate inventories and ensure alignment with compliance,
   lifecycle-management, and operational requirements. 

 * Define service measures, operational reports, escalation paths, and support
   procedures for Enterprise Solutions services. 

 * Ensure incidents, problems, requests, changes, and recurring operational work
   are managed consistently and used to drive improvement. 

 * Require clear root-cause analysis and corrective actions for material service
   issues or missed commitments. 

Documentation, training, and knowledge management 

 * Establish and maintain technical documentation, operating procedures,
   runbooks, service definitions, and ownership records. 

 * Ensure the team creates user-focused knowledge articles and delivers training
   for platform users and stakeholders. 

 * Build a searchable, current knowledge base that supports onboarding,
   self-service, continuity, and auditability. 

Qualifications 

 * 7+ years of experience in enterprise applications, business systems, IT
   operations, systems integration, business intelligence, or a related field. 

 * 2+ years of experience leading, managing, mentoring, or coordinating
   technical professionals. 

 * Proven hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Atlassian
   products, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Power BI, and AI tools such as
   Glean or Claude. 

 * Experience managing a team backlog, setting priorities, coordinating
   delivery, and communicating status to senior stakeholders. 

 * Competence in data modeling, ETL, reporting, and dashboard development,
   including Power BI and preferably Python or SQL. 

 * Demonstrated ability to automate and integrate systems and business processes
   using Power Automate, APIs, scripting, or middleware. 

 * Experience supporting asset-management solutions such as Jira Assets or
   comparable platforms. 

 * Strong understanding of access management, information security, data
   protection, change management, and operational controls. 

 * Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to
   work effectively with US-based and globally distributed teams. 

 * Demonstrated ability to create clear documentation, facilitate training, and
   establish repeatable operating practices. 

 * Strong judgment, problem-solving, prioritization, and conflict-resolution
   skills. 

Preferred skills and experience 

 * Experience administering or leading an Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira,
   Confluence, and Jira Service Management. 

 * Experience with Zendesk administration, reporting, workflows, or platform
   transitions. 

 * Experience with Glean, Claude, Cursor, Fellow.ai, or comparable enterprise AI
   platforms. 

 * Experience with Power BI dataflows, Power Automate, Python, SQL, REST APIs,
   or similar integration technologies. 

 * Experience leading platform migrations, service consolidations, or enterprise
   operating-model improvements. 

 * Experience in financial technology, wealth management, or another regulated
   industry. 

 * Familiarity with vendor management, licensing, service-level reporting, and
   technology portfolio planning. 

Success in the first 12 months 

 * A clear team structure, ownership model, backlog, and operating rhythm are in
   place. 

 * Each Enterprise Solutions Engineer has defined responsibilities, goals,
   development priorities, and backup coverage. 

 * Critical Atlassian, Power BI, Power Automate, Zendesk, Glean, and Jira Assets
   services have documented owners, procedures, and escalation paths. 

 * Reporting and service metrics are reliable, visible, and reviewed regularly. 

 * The team has reduced dependency on individual knowledge through
   documentation, cross-training, and repeatable processes. 

 * Priority automation and platform-improvement initiatives are delivered with
   measurable operational or business impact. 

 * Stakeholders experience predictable communication, clear prioritization, and
   improved responsiveness from Enterprise Solutions. 

Apply without meeting every requirement 

If you do not meet every requirement but believe you would thrive in this role,
we would still like to hear from you. We value people who connect with
InvestCloud’s mission, learn quickly, take ownership, and build trusted
partnerships across the organization. People leadership Atlassian products Jira Service Management Zendesk Power BI Power Automate AI adoption Data modeling ETL Python SQL Stakeholder management Process automation Asset management Technical documentation Change management Candidates must have at least 7 years of experience in enterprise applications or IT operations, including 2 years in a leadership capacity. Proficiency in Atlassian tools, Power BI, and automation technologies is required, along with strong communication skills for global stakeholder management.

title: Content Specialist(QC) - Telugu (Gyan Tv)
job_description:
Role - Content Specialist – QC
Work Location - Work From Office -Bangalore

About Lokal:

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened.
