title: Manager- Core Projects
job_description:
Company Description
Believe is a global artist development company. We empower local artists, labels and publishers to grow their audiences at each stage of their careers with expertise, respect, fairness and transparency. Operating in 50+ countries, with more than 2,000 employees, Believe offers a full range of services including audience development, publishing, marketing and distribution, with a tailor-made approach to fit any artist, label or publisher. 
Believe champions independence and innovation through a unique model that combines local expertise with a global tech platform, delivering exclusive solutions for artists to promote and monetize their music thanks to strategic partnerships with leading global digital service providers. 
With a leading portfolio of brands that includes Nuclear Blast, naïve, TuneCore, Groove Attack, Sentric, AllPoints and Byond, Believe artists generated more than 800 billion streams worldwide in 2024 across all genres, and were recognized with more than 70 leading industry awards. 
Believe is a simplified joint-stock company under French law. Learn more at www.believe.com Ready to #setthetone with Believe?
Job Description
Position Overview: 
● As part of the Group Finance Transformation department, the Core Projects Team Member will lead Finance process improvement and transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on process optimization, standardization and automation across transactional Finance activities. 
● The role involves coordinating cross-functional initiatives across Finance, IT, Operations and other departments, while collaborating with stakeholders across regions and Business Units. 
● The incumbent will report to the Head of Core Projects Finance based in India. 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 
1. Strategic Finance Process & Transformation Delivery : process optimization & automation expertise 
● Lead Finance transformation and process improvement initiatives with a focus on end-to-end transactional processes optimization (P2P, O2C, R2R), process standardization and operational efficiency.
● Drive Finance projects and continuous improvement initiatives in alignment with Finance priorities, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. 
● Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across regions and Business Units to support process improvements and change management. 
● Identify process inefficiencies, risks and automation opportunities, and contribute to scalable improvement initiatives. 
● Support the implementation and enhancement of Finance systems and workflows (e.g. procurement).
● Ensure data quality, process integrity and compliance throughout transformation and optimization initiatives. 
● Define project scope, objectives and success metrics in collaboration with Finance stakeholders 
2. Governance & Risk Management: 
● Ensure implementation and maintenance of governance frameworks and reporting standards.
● Monitor project performance, manage dependencies, and escalate risks or delays when needed. 
3. Stakeholder Engagement & Change Leadership: 
● Act as a key point of contact for project sponsors and executive stakeholders. 
● Drive alignment across business functions and geographies. 
● Participate with other Finance transformation initiative through internal communication and stakeholder engagement across projects.
4. Change & Communication Strategy: 
● Ensure effective change management practices are embedded into all core projects. 
● Collaborate with the Change Management team to support training, communication, and user adoption activities. 
● Champion a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. 
Must have: 
● Experience: 6 - 8 years in project or program management, ideally within a Finance Transformation or Consulting environment (Big 4). 
o Strong understanding of Finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R and FP&A) and finance systems (e.g. accounting, budgeting) 
o Six sigma certification & PMP certification is a plus 
o Strong experience in Finance process optimization, standardization and automation, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and drive scalable operational improvements. 
o Knowledge of process automation tools and AI-enabled solutions (e.g. Alteryx, N8N, AI tools) to support operational efficiency and process optimization. 
● Project Skills: 
o Strong experience in Finance process optimization, automation and standardization, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable improvements across transactional processes. 
o Proven experience driving process improvement and automation initiatives in complex Finance environments. 
o Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools (Agile, PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus. ● People Skill: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international and matrixed operational structures. 
● Mindset: Strategic thinker with strong operational execution; thrives in dynamic, fast-paced settings. ● Communication: Strong interpersonal and influencing skills; 
o Fluency in English 
Qualifications
CA / MBA in Finance / Masters degree (post graduate) in Finance 
Additional Information
Benefits @Believe: 
#Flexibility – Just punch in leaves, not in time and out time 
#Office perks – a game of foosball, table tennis to bat the afternoon lacklustre, free event pass for exclusive and limited shows, music subscription, etc 
#Wellbeing – Caring by EUTELMED, professionals are at your disposal for advice and support, in your own language and culture 
#Transperancy – engaged in secondary activity just disclose it to us 
#Sustainability – You can be a part of CSR program, represent yourself as a #shaper and contribute to a better future. 
Disclaimer: 
Believe strongly promotes equal treatment regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, age, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, physical abilities, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies.

title: Visual Merchandiser
job_description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
​
As a Visual Merchandiser, you’ll play a key role in creating an inspiring and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and driving commercial excellence. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to your success and that of the company.
You will:
Execute visual, commercial, and styling curation in line with store guidelines and calendars to enhance the customer experience and drive sales in your store.
Analyse sales performance, maintain stock levels, ensure garment care and identify and prioritize visual and commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management.
Use your trend and competitor insights to coach and develop the store team, equipping them to deliver a great customer experience.
Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.
Support Sales Market with store expansion projects.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​
Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.
​
WHO YOU ARE​
We are looking for people with…​
​Strong Visual merchandising and commercial experience in a dynamic environment, with a solution-oriented mindset.
Knowledge of how to manage, analyse and act on sales reports and the selling equation.
And people who are…​
Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience.
Motivated to create outstanding customer experiences while promoting and driving sales.
Creative, curious, and proactive.
Skilled communicators who can lead and inspire store teams to achieve collaborative results.
Flexible and action oriented.
​
WHO WE ARE​
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
​
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
​
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.
· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.
JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
​
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.
Additional Information
This is a full-time position for our stores in Mohali. The position reports to the Store Manager. Visual merchandising Commercial awareness Styling curation Sales analysis Stock management Garment care Trend analysis Competitor insights Team coaching Customer experience Communication Leadership Problem solving Flexibility Candidates must have strong visual merchandising and commercial experience in a dynamic retail environment. They should possess the ability to analyze sales reports and demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

title: EOE Process Governance Manager
job_description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity
The EOE Process Governance Manager is responsible for driving EOE process-based autonomy to enable ANO ways of working through process standardization, standard process metrics, improvements, audits, analysing deviations, and reporting KPIs. They are also responsible for identifying automation and AAA opportunities, implementing process improvements and best practices. EOE Process Governance Manager within SL Operate Service Management, reporting to the respective Line Manager within SL Operate Service Management is responsible to deliver value to the customer/stakeholder by increasing the process-based autonomy aligned to ANO wow, analysing monitoring Process KPI, engaging stakeholders & proposing automated process solutions, driving process improvements to bring value to overall operations & organization.

What you will do:
Identify automation opportunities to drive process-based autonomy aligned with ANO ways of working and ensure AAA teams get detailed feedback on the same.
Work with the BPMS team to identify opportunities to define service flows for process-based autonomy and implementation of AAA use cases for successful implementation.
Report on the current state of process-based autonomy and give feedback on existing automation effectiveness while suggesting ideas and actions to improve the same.
Develop standardized, reusable templates for common processes to accelerate automation and reduce manual intervention.
Define and drive standardization of the processes (including Change Management) including work instructions, process metrics and global best practices across the board for all operational processes.
Ensure standardisation through tracking the use of AAA capabilities to automate delivery tasks. Coordinating with the SDUs and MA MS teams for process governance as key component of overall MS governance.
Ensure contract-level process governance with key management stakeholders at agreed intervals and track improvement actions.MA support activities (KS activities with Operational staff of different MS contracts, Process related Governance and meetings with MSCLT and CU’s etc.).
Perform regular assessment of actual ways of working of operational teams and maintain notes of scenarios with timelines and stakeholder’s details & Perform and publish gap analysis on actual ways of working with respect to standard process framework, global best practices & policies and defined delivery solution.
Conduct quarterly/yearly process audits to ensure any major process deviation from EOE framework are reported and corrected through relevant forums.

You will bring:
8+ years of experience in managed services, with strong expertise in the MS delivery model, EOE framework, associated processes, best practices, audit frameworks, and operational metrics.
Well-versed in key managed services delivery challenges, AAA capabilities, process automation and optimization, along with a conceptual understanding of ANO.
Experience in managing senior stakeholders, leading process improvement initiatives, and tracking and reporting progress on those improvements.
BSc/BTech/BE or equivalent degree.
Managed Services hands-on experience within NOC/ MSCLT. Trained or certified on the process framework of ITIL and/or Etom.
Excellent knowledge of TMForum ANO framework and various ANO methodologies.
Ability to explain relevant Process frameworks.
Working knowledge of MSDP tool suite and Automation, AI/ML & Analytics, BPMS etc.
Six Sigma / Lean training and implementation experience.
Note- All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Procurement Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a Procurement Manager to own technology sourcing for IMC India. You will run the full cycle for IT hardware, software, network, data centre and technology services: from understanding what our engineers and traders need, to negotiating with vendors, to managing contracts and renewals.
You will work closely with Technology, Infrastructure, Information Security, Legal, Compliance and Finance in Mumbai, and with IMC's global procurement colleagues in other offices. You will also lead and develop a small team.
Key spend categories: servers, storage and low-latency network hardware; software licences and SaaS; data centre and colocation; telecom and leased lines; cloud services; end-user devices; IT services and support contracts; market data and connectivity. 
Your Core Responsibilities: 
Sourcing and negotiation
Identify new vendors and service providers in India and globally, building a strong supplier base for each IT category.
Run end-to-end sourcing for IT categories: requirements, RFI/RFQ/RFP, vendor evaluation, commercial negotiation and award.
Negotiate pricing, SLAs, support terms, warranties, delivery timelines and licensing models with OEMs, distributors and service providers.
Manage urgent hardware buys for trading infrastructure, balancing speed with cost and control.
Reduce single-vendor dependency by identifying and maintaining alternative suppliers for strategic and critical categories
Market intelligence and forward planning
Track IT market trends, pricing and supply conditions, such as rising memory, storage and GPU costs, component shortages, lead times and currency movements, and brief stakeholders on what they mean for IMC.
Build close relationships with IT and infrastructure teams to understand upcoming needs early, and with vendors and OEMs to get early sight of price changes, product roadmaps and end-of-life notices.
Use this insight to anticipate supply constraints and price rises and act ahead of them, for example by timing purchases, securing allocation or locking in pricing, and to spot savings opportunities.
Contracts and vendor management
Review and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, licence agreements and DPAs with Legal.
Keep a contract register and renewal calendar so no licence, support contract or circuit lapses unplanned.
Run vendor onboarding, due diligence and periodic performance reviews against SLAs and KPIs.
Manage relationships with strategic technology vendors and escalate issues when needed.
Risk, compliance and controls
Work with Information Security and Compliance on third-party risk assessments, especially for vendors with access to systems or data.
Work with Finance to handle tax aspects of purchases, including GST, TDS, import duties and documentation for imported hardware.
Keep procurement auditable: approvals, purchase orders, three-way match and documentation ready for internal and external audit.
Partner with IT on hardware asset lifecycle: procurement, tagging, refresh cycles and compliant disposal (e-waste).
Budget, reporting and team
Support annual IT budgeting and forecasting with Finance and Technology leads.
Report on spend, savings, contract status and vendor performance.
Improve procurement processes and tools, including the purchase-to-pay workflow.
Lead, coach and develop 1–2 procurement specialists.
Your Skills and Experience: 
8–12 years in procurement, with at least 5 years focused on IT or technology categories.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, supply chain or a related field. An MBA or a certification such as CIPS or CPSM is a plus.
Solid understanding of IT hardware, networking, software licensing models (perpetual, subscription, enterprise agreements) and cloud pricing.
Strong negotiation skills and a record of measurable savings and better contract terms.
Experience drafting and negotiating technology contracts and SLAs.
Working knowledge of Indian procurement requirements: GST, TDS, import and customs processes, and vendor compliance.
Experience in financial services, trading, or another regulated, technology-heavy environment is strongly preferred.
Comfort with ERP and procurement tools [e.g. Workday, Coupa, SAP Ariba] and strong Excel skills.
Clear communicator who can work with engineers, traders, legal and finance, and with global colleagues across time zones.
Experience managing or mentoring a small team.
Experience buying data centre or colocation services, low-latency network equipment or market data.
Exposure to third-party risk management frameworks and information security questionnaires.
Experience with software asset management (SAM) tools.
About Us
IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage. Procurement IT Sourcing Vendor Management Contract Negotiation IT Hardware Software Licensing Cloud Services Data Centre Management Financial Services Risk Management Compliance Budgeting Team Leadership ERP Tools Market Intelligence SLA Management Candidates must have 8–12 years of procurement experience with at least 5 years focused on IT or technology categories. A bachelor's degree is required, and proficiency in Indian procurement regulations, contract negotiation, and financial services environments is strongly preferred.

title: Manager, Commerce, India
job_description:
About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
Responsibilities of the role: 
Proven experience as an eCommerce manager or similar role, preferably in an online retail environment
Experience of having worked with FMCG brands would be an advantage.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas to non-technical stakeholders is a must.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. 
Good understanding of eCommerce platforms, technologies, and digital marketing strategies
In this role, your goals will be: 
In 3 months: 
Get an understanding of the client’s e-commerce business & understand stakeholder engagement.
Started to build relationships with the key decision makers and strategic partners.
Take a handover on complete client business – internalize brand playbooks, past e-commerce campaigns * efforts & any client specific framework trainings.
Support in development of category>brand specific Playbooks/SOPS/Calendars for the client on media commerce plans & opportunities at a platform level.
Develop a framework to track and share category insights & learnings basis past & current e-commerce activations and campaigns – also track competition activity & cascade to relevant stakeholders.
Have a broad POV on e-commerce business in India across various business models, understanding & value of “media” as a lever to drive incremental growth for the client on e-commerce.
Develop & share reporting formats and SLAs – streamline data requirements (internal & external).
Identify all relevant internal support teams and drive effective engagement. 
In six months, you would have: 
Work with e-commerce platform partners on campaign planning, deployment & track deliverables.
Work with the e-commerce team lead on all media commerce strategy & planning discussions.
Manage active communication & support on all client related e-commerce needs with central trading & e-commerce team.
Support on e-commerce focused workshops & trainings as required for internal & client teams.
100% certification on all e-commerce related platform trainings & certifications for self & team E.g.: AMS (Amazon), Google, FB etc. 
In 12 months, you would have: 
Work with E-commerce Team Lead to ensure 100% achievement of targets delivered to client.
Manage a daily/weekly/monthly tracking dashboard to track category>sub-category>brand level Metrics.
Support in development of e-commerce media AOPs in collaboration with mainline + digital teams. 
Job Responsibilities:
Serve as an SME for agency and client teams to help navigate the Commerce activation landscape and utilize Commerce capabilities to service solutions.
Work closely with agency teams to deliver best-in-class campaign execution that accomplish client’s business objectives.
Proactively identify opportunities for process improvements that can help teams work better together and with our clients.
Drive incorporation of cross-platform testing and optimization strategies.
Develop frameworks, case studies, trainings and other content to continuously raise the bar
Own relationships with select priority Commerce partners to ensure development & delivery of best-in-class biddable campaigns.
Stay up to date on changing marketplace dynamics surrounding ad products, technology, and measurement acoss search and programmatic partners.
Drive the adoption of Commerce for new business and existing accounts.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in commerce media execution. 
Experience managing a team of direct reports. 
Experience across the Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Proven track record of success in executing commerce campaigns that achieve business objectives.
Deep understanding of retail commercial elements such as profit margin, inventory levels, forecasting, and demand planning to inform media decisions.
Deep understanding of how different media channels work together and how ecommerce media fits within the wider ecosystem.
Experience with retail bid management platforms, such as Pacvue or Skai. 
Experience in campaign management and optimization across multiple retail platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Big Basket, Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, Myntra etc.).
Ability to collaborate and work effectively with internal teams and external partners. 
A self-starter attitude that thrives in a fast-paced environment. 
Excellent project-management skills; able to coordinate projects across multiple teams and functions. 
Detail-oriented with the ability to coordinate projects across multiple teams and functions.
Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to analyze data and develop insights that inform strategy and optimization.
Strong presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas to clients and internal stakeholders.
Life at WPP Media & Benefits 
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide. Strong analytical skills, proficiency in retail bid management platforms, and the ability to manage direct reports are essential for this position.

title: Executive Assistant
job_description:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
We are seeking a proactive and highly organised Executive Assistant to support the Executive Director, Advisory Division at AECOM India. The role will help drive the ED’s priorities, coordinate with internal teams and ensure effective planning, communication and follow-through.
Key Responsibilities
Support the Executive Director in planning, tracking and driving key priorities, team agenda and action items.
Coordinate with Advisory team and other internal functions to obtain updates, follow up and ensure timely closure of actions.
Manage the ED’s calendar, including meetings, travel, appointments and scheduling priorities.
Prepare meeting agendas, collate pre-reads, record key decisions and circulate concise action trackers.
Support planning and coordination for leadership meetings, client interactions, workshops and team events.
Handle routine administrative requirements with discretion, responsiveness and attention to detail.
Qualifications
Graduate in Commerce, Arts, Management or a related discipline from Delhi University or another reputed institution.
Up to 2 years of relevant work experience; strong fresh graduates may also be considered.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong command of English.
Professional maturity, confidentiality and ability to work effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Additional Information
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM 
AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. 
AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. 
What makes AECOM a great place to work 
You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. 
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The role requires up to 2 years of relevant experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Learning & Development Manager
job_description:
Company Description
Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.
Job Description
The Learning & Development (L&D) Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and driving the hotel's learning, training, talent development, and organizational culture initiatives during the pre-opening phase and beyond. This role plays a critical part in building a highly skilled, service-oriented, and engaged workforce by ensuring all team members are fully trained, certified, and aligned with the hotel's brand standards prior to opening.
The L&D Manager will partner closely with department heads to create a culture of continuous learning, operational excellence, guest-centric service, and leadership development while ensuring compliance with statutory, safety, and brand requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Pre-Opening Training Strategy & Planning
Develop and execute the overall pre-opening learning and development roadmap.
Create a detailed pre-opening training calendar covering all hotel departments.
Identify training needs for each department based on manning plans and operational requirements.
Coordinate with corporate and brand learning teams to implement mandatory brand training programs.
Establish learning systems, policies, procedures, and training documentation before hotel opening.
Prepare pre-opening learning budgets and track training expenses.
2. New Hire Orientation & Onboarding
Design and deliver impactful induction and orientation programs for all new employees.
Ensure all colleagues understand:
Brand values
Vision and mission
Hotel culture
Service standards
Code of conduct
Safety and security procedures
Conduct regular onboarding feedback sessions.
Monitor onboarding effectiveness and employee integration.
3. Departmental Skills Training
Partner with department heads to identify technical and operational skill requirements.
Develop training modules for:
Front Office
Housekeeping
Food & Beverage Service
Culinary
Engineering
Security
Finance
Sales & Marketing
Reservations
Spa and Recreation
Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are embedded within training programs.
Conduct training needs analysis and competency assessments.
4. Brand Standards & Service Excellence
Lead all hotel service culture initiatives.
Facilitate brand immersion and service excellence programs.
Ensure all employees are certified on:
Brand standards
Luxury/service culture expectations
Guest engagement practices
Quality assurance requirements
Conduct service audits and mystery guest readiness assessments before opening.
Drive consistent delivery of guest experience standards.
5. Compliance, Safety & Mandatory Training
Manage mandatory certifications and compliance training programs.
Ensure completion and tracking of:
Fire Life Safety (FLS)
POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment)
Food Safety & Hygiene
First Aid
Health & Safety
Information Security
Security Awareness
Emergency Response Procedures
Local statutory training requirements
Maintain accurate training records and audit documentation.
6. Leadership & Talent Development
Support leadership capability building across all management levels.
Design development programs for:
Supervisors
Assistant Managers
Department Heads
High-Potential Employees
Facilitate coaching and mentoring initiatives.
Support succession planning and career development frameworks.
Drive Individual Development Plans (IDPs).
7. Learning Management Systems (LMS)
Administer and maintain the hotel's Learning Management System.
Track training completion, certifications, and compliance status.
Generate monthly learning reports and dashboards.
Ensure training records remain audit-ready.
Drive digital learning adoption and e-learning engagement.
8. Pre-Opening Operational Readiness
Coordinate training schedules aligned with project timelines.
Ensure all associates are trained before operational activation.
Support:
Mock drills
Dry runs
Trial stays
Soft opening activities
Brand audits
Readiness assessments
Measure training effectiveness and readiness scores.
9. Employee Engagement & Culture Building
Partner with People & Culture to build a strong employer brand and workplace culture.
Conduct engagement workshops and culture sessions.
Support employee recognition programs.
Facilitate communication forums and team-building activities.
Promote diversity, inclusion, and colleague wellbeing initiatives.
10. Training Administration & Reporting
Prepare monthly training reports and KPI dashboards.
Track:
Training hours per employee
Compliance completion rates
Certification status
Training effectiveness scores
Guest service improvements
Present training insights to the Executive Committee.
Develop annual training plans and budgets.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
100% pre-opening training completion.
Brand certification compliance.
Training hours per employee.
New hire onboarding effectiveness.
Employee engagement scores.
Guest satisfaction improvements attributable to training.
Audit and compliance scores.
Leadership development participation and success rates.
Learning management system utilization.
Training budget adherence.

Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Human Resources, Learning & Development, Business Administration, or related field.
Professional certifications in Training, Coaching, Facilitation, or Talent Development preferred.
Experience
5-8 years of Learning & Development or Human Resources experience within hospitality.
Minimum 2-3 years in a managerial training role.
Prior hotel pre-opening experience strongly preferred.
Experience with international hotel brands is an advantage.

title: Bar Executive
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that
guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any
deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary
supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc.
Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete
scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor
dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of
guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.

 

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling,
disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model
and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy
process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures;
report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete
safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are
clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and
protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company
standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with
disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others
using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working
relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and
respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to
quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and
implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality,
safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety
of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines
(e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time
or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects
weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and
manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and
hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move
up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees,
including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job
duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

 

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


Fairfield by Marriott guarantees a beautifully simple stay wherever you travel,
with over 1,000 locations worldwide. Our Marriott family farm heritage inspires
a calming, reliable experience characterized by warm hospitality, all at a great
value. As a member of our team, you’ll deliver on the Fairfield Guarantee — our
commitment that every guest leaves the hotel satisfied. At Fairfield, we invite
you to explore career opportunities that hold our hotels and the service we
provide to the highest standard. In joining Fairfield by Marriott, you join a
portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best
work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global  team, and become the best
version of you. Team leadership Staff training Inventory management Customer service Conflict resolution Safety compliance Operational efficiency Coaching Scheduling Performance evaluation Communication Problem solving Attention to detail Hospitality management Maintenance coordination Candidates must have at least 2 years of related work experience and 1 year of supervisory experience. A high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent is required for this position.

title: Delivery Manager Operations - English & Exams
job_description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
We connect. We inspire.
Pay Band: 6
Country/Location: Noida, India
Department: GSS English & Exams (IELTS Operations)
Contract Type: 1 Year Fixed term contract 
Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week 
Training & Assessment Requirement
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicab
Role Description/Purpose
The Delivery Manager – Operations is responsible for leading and managing end-to-end Finance Operations service delivery to ensure it is efficient, scalable, and consistently meets business and customer expectations. The role focuses on designing and implementing robust service delivery frameworks, including workforce planning, utilisation, and process optimisation, while ensuring adherence to defined service level agreements and quality standards. It plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and operational excellence across shared services, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure business continuity. The role also ensures strong governance, reporting, and compliance practices, enabling reliable and high-quality outcomes for stakeholders and customers in a global operating environment.
Role Accountabilities
The role operates within the English & Examinations business, a key strategic and revenue-generating unit of the organisation, delivering services across a global network of over 100 countries. It functions in a shared services environment that supports multi-country operations, requiring high levels of standardisation, automation, and efficiency in processes. The Delivery Manager must balance ongoing service delivery with transformation and digital initiatives in a cost-conscious and resource-constrained setting, working closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business priorities, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements, while maintaining uninterrupted service delivery.
You will lead end-to-end delivery of Finance Operations services, defining and implementing service delivery frameworks covering staffing, scheduling and utilisation, and ensuring SLA compliance and high-quality customer interactions. You will establish escalation mechanisms and helpdesk structures, monitor risks and ensure mitigation and business continuity planning, and drive process standardisation to reduce operational inefficiencies. You will also ensure adherence to information security policies (ISO 27001/22301), monitor access controls and compliance within your teams, drive a security awareness and incident reporting culture, and ensure immediate action is taken in case of non-compliance or risks.
You will maintain strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders, communicating performance, issues and insights to leadership, managing MIS reporting on a daily, weekly and monthly basis, aligning service delivery with stakeholder expectations, and facilitating stakeholder reviews, governance forums and visits. On people and resource management, you will manage recruitment, onboarding and training of teams, drive performance management and productivity improvements, implement engagement and retention initiatives, and build a high-performing, motivated operations team.
On quality, you will ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards, deliver against KPIs and quality benchmarks, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and manage customer feedback and complaint resolution. On governance and reporting, you will provide insights through dashboards, reports and analytics, ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory and legal requirements, identify, assess and manage operational risks, and strengthen governance frameworks and reporting accuracy.
Qualifications & Experience
Graduation in Commerce
Written and verbal proficiency in English (British Council systems and global processes operate in English)
7+ years of experience in Finance Operations (O2C / R2R) / Shared Services
4+ years of people management experience
Strong understanding of finance governance and controls
Experience in reporting, dashboards, and MIS
Experience in operational delivery in a global/shared services environment
Strong understanding of Finance Operations & Shared Services delivery
Expertise in financial governance and compliance frameworks
Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills
Desirable:
Lean / Six Sigma certification
Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
Experience in transitions / migrations
Exposure to global capability centres
Further Information
Right to Work: Locally recruited 
Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work. 
Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided. 
India (OCI)
Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in
A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement
We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.
Safeguarding Statement
The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. title: DevOps (CI/CX)
job_description:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
DevOps (CI/CD) - Quality Assurance & Testing
We are seeking a DevOps professional with 4 to 6 years of experience in CI/CD quality assurance and testing to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of applications across multiple platforms and environments.
Core Testing Responsibilities:
Validate FSA application functionality across desktop, web, cloud-connected, and integrated system environments.
Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing for new features, bug fixes, and modernization initiatives.
Verify cloud adaptation and migration activities, ensuring application behavior remains stable during platform transitions and framework upgrades.
Perform API testing, integration testing, and data validation across interconnected systems.
Test Automation & CI/CD Integration:
Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites to improve release quality and reduce manual verification efforts.
Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing and quality gates into deployment workflows.
Contribute to quality improvements through risk analysis, test strategy refinement, and continuous process optimization.
Collaboration & Communication:
Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and DevOps teams to ensure early defect detection and faster resolution.
Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, and release readiness activities.
Track, report, and manage defects through their lifecycle while ensuring proper root-cause analysis and validation of fixes.
Production Support & Validation:
Support customer validation, release verification, and production issue investigations when required.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline
4 to 6 years of proven experience in software testing of desktop, web, or enterprise applications
Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman or similar solutions
Good knowledge of SQL and database validation techniques
Experience working with defect management and Agile project management tools
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and quality validation within automated release processes
Experience with Git-based development workflows
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
Ability to interpret logs, identify root causes, and collaborate effectively with development teams
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience validating cloud-hosted applications and cloud migration initiatives
Knowledge of performance, security, and reliability testing concepts
Familiarity with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, and automated quality gates
Experience in API automation testing
Exposure to desktop applications developed using .NET technologies
Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Robot Framework
Experience with hardware-integrated or automotive diagnostic applications
Understanding of software compliance, vulnerability validation, and release certification activities
Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and Copilot-assisted test design
Qualifications
B.E
Additional Information
4 to 6 years experience

Legal Entity: Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited CI/CD Software Testing Test Automation API Testing SQL Git Agile Postman Jenkins Azure DevOps SonarQube Playwright Selenium Cypress Robot Framework Debugging Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline and possess 4 to 6 years of experience in software testing. Strong proficiency in SDLC, STLC, API testing, and CI/CD workflows is required, along with analytical and problem-solving skills.

Company Description
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Job Description
Overview
A Strategic Account Manager owns large regional or national restaurant chains, typically 20+ outlets across multiple cities, often with sophisticated operations teams. These accounts are enterprise-level: they require executive alignment across regions, cross-functional coordination with Swiggy and operations teams, and the ability to think strategically about long-term partnerships. 
Key Responsibilities
Own enterprise accounts: Manage 20-30 multi-city chains, each with 20+ outlets generating annual revenue in crores. These accounts are the profit center of the city
Executive partnership: Your primary contacts are executives (franchisors, regional VPs, founders). You are a trusted advisor shaping their Swiggy strategy
Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate with Swiggy central team, operations, and finance teams to deliver custom solutions, integrations, or special programs for accounts
Strategic planning: Develop 6 to 12-month growth plans with accounts. Identify expansion opportunities across new cuisines, formats, and locations. Position Swiggy as core to their growth
Complex deal structuring: Negotiate high-value contracts, custom pricing, exclusive arrangements, and value-add services. You have significant autonomy on deal terms
Enterprise QBRs: Present quarterly business reviews to boards or executive teams. Your presentations need data, insights, and vision for the partnership
Churn prevention: Monitor account growth obsessively. Identify red flags early, escalate issues, and develop retention strategies for at-risk accounts
Market expansion: Identify new restaurant groups entering your market or new formats expanding. Lead high-touch outreach and land transformational accounts
Data mastery: Build predictive models for account health, identify leading indicators of churn, develop ROI calculators for pitches, and forecast quarterly revenue with accuracy
Strategic travel: Travel to account locations and regional hubs 1-2 times per quarter. Occasionally present at franchisee conferences or advisory boards
Executive presence: Your interactions with restaurant executives and internal Swiggy leadership reflect Swiggy's brand. You are a professional partner, not a transactional salesperson

title: Product Manager (Core Accounting)
job_description:
Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer-facing brands - Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15.1 billion and $4.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion.

Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we can empower everyone to experience the world.
The Role
The Record-to-Report (RTR) track is part of Booking Holdings’ Finance Technology and Enterprise Applications organization. The team builds and operates products that enable accurate, controlled and efficient financial accounting, reporting and period-end close across Booking Holdings.
We are looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve products supporting the accounting lifecycle, including general ledger, revenue accounting, intercompany accounting, asset accounting, treasury accounting, reconciliations, financial controls, reporting and month-end close.
The role sits at the intersection of Finance, Accounting, Product, Engineering, Data and Enterprise Technology. The Product Manager will translate complex accounting and operational needs into scalable product capabilities, while ensuring strong controls, auditability, data lineage and user experience.
Our goal is to create a standardized and intelligent RTR platform that reduces manual effort, improves financial accuracy, accelerates the close and provides Finance users with timely insight into accounting health and control risks.
What You'll Be Doing
Define and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for one or more RTR products or capabilities.
Understand the needs of Accounting, Finance Operations, Controllers, Treasury Accounting, FP&A, Regional Finance and audit stakeholders.
Translate accounting policies, business processes and control requirements into clear product requirements and scalable system solutions.
Partner with Engineering, Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Analysts and implementation teams to design, build and operate products.
Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, risk reduction, regulatory and control requirements, user needs and technical dependencies.
Define success measures and monitor product performance, including automation rates, reconciliation coverage, exception volumes, manual effort, close timelines, posting quality and control adherence.
Drive discovery, process mapping, solution evaluation and end-to-end delivery from problem definition through adoption and operationalization.
Collaborate with Finance and Technology stakeholders to establish clear system ownership, data lineage and integration boundaries across SAP, data platforms and adjacent applications.
Lead initiatives that improve the speed, accuracy and predictability of the month-end close.
Ensure products meet security, compliance, audit, SOX and financial-control expectations.
Partner with global stakeholders to standardize processes and support entity onboarding, organizational change and platform transformation.
Communicate product decisions, priorities, risks, dependencies and outcomes to senior stakeholders.
Work closely with users during testing, rollout and adoption to ensure that solutions are usable, controlled and fit for operational needs.
Engage with other Product Managers across Finance Technology and Booking Holdings to align platform capabilities, development priorities and long-term architecture.
What You'll Bring
A minimum of 5 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Finance Technology, Accounting Systems or a related discipline.
Overall experience of 8+ years in IT Roles is preferred
Experience working with financial systems, ERP platforms or enterprise accounting products; SAP S/4HANA experience is strongly preferred.
Good understanding of Record-to-Report processes, including general ledger, journal entries, accruals, reversals, intercompany accounting, reconciliations, asset accounting or financial close.
Ability to communicate effectively with Finance and Accounting users as well as technical stakeholders, including Engineers, Architects, Data Engineers and Analysts.
Experience converting complex business processes and accounting requirements into clear product requirements and practical technology solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and evaluate alternative solutions.
Ability to define meaningful product and operational metrics and use data to guide prioritization and decision-making.
Experience working in a highly integrated enterprise environment with multiple systems, data sources, teams and dependencies.
Understanding of financial controls, auditability, SOX requirements, data lineage and evidence management.
Experience with reconciliation, financial reporting, workflow, automation or business intelligence products is an advantage.
Experience working with platforms such as BlackLine, SAP Analytics Cloud, Snowflake, payment systems, treasury platforms or other Finance Technology solutions is a plus.
Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to align teams without direct authority.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with attention to product details, operational realities and delivery execution.
Collaborative, outcome-oriented and comfortable working in a global, fast-paced environment.
Solution-oriented and results-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
We’re a truly global e-commerce company, with business operations in nearly every country and city on the planet. And we want to make it easy for everyone, anywhere in the world, to pay for their travel or do business with our platform - whenever and however it’s convenient for them.
Through the Booking Holdings brands, we help our customers reach all corners of the earth. Our ability to provide great service rests on how well we understand our diverse customer base, which is why having a diverse team is so important to us. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

We ensure equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without discrimination or harassment based on race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, marital status, medical condition, disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Booking Holdings also extends this policy to every phase of the employment process including, but not limited to, recruitment, selection, placement, transfer, training and development, position elimination, restructure, promotion, compensation, benefits, layoffs, termination, and all other conditions or privileges of employment. Booking Holdings and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, please email reasonableaccommodation@bookingholdings.com with your request. title: Mgr Software Engineering
job_description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI.  You’ll
innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with
decades of proven success.  ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your
colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the
global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you
are empowered to shape the future of payments.

 

As a Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team,
dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

 

Job Summary:

Manages the activities of one or more software systems development function or
software applications development function. Selects, develops and evaluates
personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.

Job Responsibilities:

 * Manages and directs ACI's development resources in accordance with corporate
   and division goals and objectives. Instructs and guides staff to maximize
   their technical, managerial, and corporate growth and development. Provides
   feedback and completes performance appraisals. Develops annual staff salary,
   training plans, and reports on the status of the staff and projects.
 * Works with senior management to set the technical direction for company
   products and services. Leads and guides the development and maintenance
   products and services ensuring that they align with the company’s strategic
   and business plans.
 * Manages product security including product risk reduction, compliance,
   product security training, product security software development lifecycle,
   and security architecture.
 * Leads interaction with internal and external organizations and individuals to
   ensure appropriate information exchange, with the goal of properly developing
   the staff and successfully completing assigned projects.
 * Perform other duties as assigned
 * Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to
   the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

 

Knowledge, Skills and Experience required for the job:

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent
   experience.
 * 12+ years of software development and/or design experience.
 * 5+ years of direct management or leadership experience, including staff
   performance management and development.
 * Proven ability to set technical direction and align development efforts with
   business and strategic goals.
 * Experience managing multiple concurrent software development projects and
   competing priorities.
 * Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including
   secure development practices.
 * Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their application in software
   development (e.g., AI-assisted coding tools, intelligent automation, or
   AI-driven product features).
 * Ability to evaluate and guide adoption of AI-based tools and technologies to
   improve team productivity and product capabilities.
 * Demonstrated experience with budgeting, resource planning, and staff
   development (training plans, performance appraisals).
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with experience interacting
   with both technical staff and senior leadership.
 * Ability to guide, mentor, and grow technical talent within a team.

 

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for the job:

 * Experience managing software development teams in the payments, fintech, or
   financial services industry.
 * Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices,
   product security architecture, and risk/compliance frameworks.
 * Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and managing distributed or
   cross-functional development teams.
 * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern software
   architecture (microservices, APIs).
 * Strong track record of managing staff performance, career development, and
   succession planning.
 * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience
   liaising between technical teams and senior leadership.
 * Prior experience contributing to or owning technical roadmaps aligned with
   business strategy.

 

AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)

 * Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions:
   1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation,
      documentation, defect reduction), and
   2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or
      operational capability.
 * Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but
   remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and
   maintainability before merging.
 * Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place
   secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.

 

Work Environment:

 * Standard work environment
 * Some limited Travel required, may be domestic or international

 

Core Capabilities:

We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture
and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:

 * Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet
   commitments.

 * Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough
   circumstances.

title: Senior Manager, Rights Management
job_description:
About Crunchyroll
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
About the role
The Senior Manager, Rights Management will lead the critical function of managing content rights administration for Crunchyroll across distribution channels. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Rights and Scheduling, within the Global Operations org, this role will lead the operating model for the function and ensure that commercial terms are translated accurately, consistently and auditably into rights records. 
The Senior Manager establishes the standards, controls and workflows that protect Crunchyroll from incorrect rights exploitation and collaborates with Business Affairs, Content Acquisition, Deal Management and technology teams to set up the rights pipeline for success.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee content rights entry: oversee entry of content details from contracts (titles, territories, languages, windows, media, restrictions) into Rightsline, the system of record that carries rights to distribution channels (SVOD, digital manga, theatrical, home video).Own the content-rights operating model: set clear boundaries and handoffs with upstream teams Business Affairs and Content Acquisition, partner team Deal Management who is responsible for financial data entry, and downstream teams Scheduling and Avails. 
Establish validation rules, exception management and change management: set up clear processes, reports and systematic checks to audit entry of rights, communicate rights changes, and handle exceptional cases for complex deals or system limitations.
Collaborate with technology teams to bolster system support: continuously improve Rightsline to increase efficiency, reduce risk, and set up audit trails.
Manage the Rights Management team: lead a Manager and team that will be globally distributed who will enter contract details into Rightsline; set up time-zone coverage, accountability checks, and workflows.
About You
We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
Required:
8+ years experience leading teams in rights/contract management in media & entertainment 
Experienced leader who can drive forward strategic initiatives and set goals for the team
Strong communication and collaboration skills to influence cross-functionally 
Ability to drive clarity from ambiguity and turn concepts into operational plans
Well versed in understanding contract language and translating terms 
Experience with Rightsline and understanding data flows both upstream and downstream and subsequent business impacts
Preferred:
Experience in streaming industry
Experience and familiarity of anime content and anime industry
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Free premium access to Crunchyroll
Professional Development
Company's Paid Parental Leave
up to 22 weeks for birthing parents
up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
Hybrid Work Schedule
Paid Time Off
Flex Time Off
5 Yasumi Days
Half-Day Fridays during the summer
Winter Break
#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid 
About our Values
We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.
Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

title: Food & Beverage Associate
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down
goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper
locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking
doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work
areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver
prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing
clean-as-you-go procedures.

 

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report
accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety
training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean
and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and
protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company
standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer
telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working
relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and
respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to
quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a
variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended
period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and
place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine
motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery
surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and
below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform
other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

 

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.

experiences in the hotel and city they’re in. Our lively communal spaces and

playfulness.
 
Moxy Crew take work seriously, but they never take themselves too seriously.
