live in the now but know what’s next, and have high energy and a do-it-yourself
attitude.
 
If you’re someone who is thoughtful, spirited and loves serving up huge doses of

joining Moxy Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International.
Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing
global  team, and become the best version of you. title: Quality Analyst
job_description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
We connect. We inspire.
Pay Band: 5
No of positions: 4
Country/Location: Noida, India
Department: GSS English & Exams (IELTS Operations)
Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract, 1 year
Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week.
Training & Assessment Requirement
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable 
Role Purpose
The primary responsibility of the Quality Analyst is to develop and maintain knowledge articles, operational guidelines, and processes that enable effective organisation and accessibility of information. The role ensures accuracy and quality in process delivery through regular monitoring and timely resolution of complaints and feedback.
The Quality Analyst is also responsible for Supporting financial compliance, audit readiness, and control adherence across operational processes
Role Accountabilities
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Analyst to drive operational excellence through robust documentation management, quality monitoring, financial process assurance, and compliance governance. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a strong understanding of process documentation, quality frameworks, knowledge management practices, and operational controls.
As a Quality Analyst, you will act as the documentation expert for the process and take ownership of developing, maintaining, and governing operational documents including SOPs, process maps, user guides, and end-to-end workflow documentation across both front-office and back-office operations. You will leverage tools such as MS Visio, MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint to create and maintain high-quality process documentation aligned with ISO 9001:2015 standards.
The role involves managing and continuously improving knowledge management practices while designing effective knowledge distribution processes to enhance accessibility and adoption across teams. You will analyse the impact of knowledge initiatives on operational efficiency and organisational outcomes, working closely with process owners and stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure documentation remains accurate, current, and readily available within process repositories.
You will be responsible for maintaining master document control records and ensuring adherence to documentation retention, archival, and deletion standards. In partnership with audit teams, you will support internal and external audits by ensuring documentation and process controls remain compliant and audit-ready.
Beyond documentation and governance, the role includes monitoring selected process activities to assess quality and operational effectiveness. You will identify strengths and opportunities for improvement across processes and teams, provide structured coaching and feedback, support retraining initiatives where required, and contribute to training effectiveness assessments.
A key component of this role will include supporting finance quality controls and governance. You will perform quality reviews of financial transactions, validate refunds, chargebacks, and reconciliations, and ensure compliance with established financial controls and operational procedures. The role requires identifying process risks and discrepancies, supporting audits and root cause analysis for financial exceptions, collaborating closely with Finance and SSC teams, and tracking financial quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
The role also carries responsibility for maintaining information security and organisational compliance standards. You will be expected to understand and comply with information security and IELTS-related requirements, raise concerns related to policy non-compliance where necessary, and ensure adherence to organisational standards including the code of conduct and IT policies.
We are looking for candidates with excellent analytical capability, strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement. The ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively with stakeholders, and maintain high standards of quality, compliance, and operational delivery will be key to success in this role.
Role specific skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications
Minimum 4 – 7 years of work experience with minimum 2+ years in quality control.
Meet English language proficiency at a minimum level of IELTS band 7 or equivalent internationally recognized qualification (BCMS/Vendor will arrange for language proficiency and certification test)- communication skills will also be judged in the voice and accent assessment round.
Typing Speed minimum 35 WPM
Basic MS Excel knowledge of using formulas (vlookup, hlookup, conditional formatting and pivot table)
Understanding Operations and Quality management.
Knowledge of customer service principles and practices
Certified green belt
Good understanding of MS VISIO
British Council Core Values and Behaviours to be judged.
Six Sigma Certified
Use of 7 QC tools
Financial controls and audit exposure
ERP tools (SAP Desirable)
Knowledge of refunds, chargebacks, payments, Reconciliations, PR & Vendor Creation, Payroll, debt chasing, purchase to order.
Further Information
Language: Strong English proficiency is crucial for this role, requiring fluency in both written and spoken communication to effectively navigate British Council systems and international operations.
Please note: Interviews will be conducted primarily in English. The successful candidate must be able to speak and write well in English, as this is essential for the role.
Locally recruited: Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work. Relocation support is not provided.
Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need to have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in
A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement
We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.
Safeguarding Statement
The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.
If you experience any difficulties with submitting your application, please email askhr@britishcouncil.org Quality control Process documentation Knowledge management Financial compliance Audit readiness MS Visio MS Excel ISO 9001:2015 Six Sigma 7 QC tools Financial controls Root cause analysis Data analysis Communication skills Attention to detail Candidates must have 4-7 years of work experience with at least 2 years in quality control and possess a Six Sigma Green Belt certification. Proficiency in English (IELTS band 7 or equivalent) and technical skills in MS Office tools and financial operations are mandatory.

title: Chef de Partie (South Indian)
job_description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team,
that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are the Master of
your culinary station, creating delicious dishes guests love. As a Chef de
Partie (South Indian), you’re not just overseeing kitchen operations – you’re
spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable
experiences that make the stay for every guest.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

 * Prepare great tasting dishes:  Season, cook, and test dishes according to
   standard recipes, ensuring consistency in taste and presentation
 * Supervise the kitchen team:  Oversee line cooks to ensure and provide support
   as needed in the absence of senior chefs to ensure smooth and efficient
   operations
 * Maintain kitchen cleanliness:  Keep all work areas clean, tidy, and free of
   cross-contamination
 * Ensure food quality and storage compliance:  Monitor ingredient quality,
   ensuring proper storage and stock rotation
 * Assist with cost management:  Contribute to controlling food costs, improving
   gross profit margins, and meeting departmental financial targets
 * Inspire and develop the team:  Supervise and support team members, monitor
   performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work
   environment
 * Uphold regulatory standards:  Maintain compliance with health, safety,
   sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards
   of guest and team member well-being


QUALIFICATIONS

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the
qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with
Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership.
A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and
accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every
moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

 * High school graduate with at least 3 years of experience in a 5-star hotel or
   high-end restaurant.
 * At least 1 year as a Demi Chef de Partie or equivalent in an international
   brand hotel. Technical culinary education preferred.
 * Proficient in Western or Chinese cuisine, with expertise in various cooking
   techniques
 * Knowledge of seafood/meat processing, cooked food processing, storing, and
   receiving standards.


Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build
an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a
global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests
worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with
the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best
Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of
world-class brands [https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/],

title: Consultant-Client
job_description:
As a Consultant-Client, you will play a crucial role in bridging the gap between
our company's technical expertise and our clients' needs. Your primary focus
will be to understand client requirements, provide expert advice, and deliver
tailored solutions. You will work closely with our data science team to ensure
seamless integration of our services with client operations.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Conduct thorough client consultations to understand their unique needs and
   challenges.
 * Provide expert advice and recommendations based on your extensive data
   science knowledge.
 * Design and implement customized solutions, leveraging your skills in Python,
   SQL, and statistical analysis.
 * Collaborate with the data engineering team to ensure efficient data
   processing and ETL pipelines.
 * Monitor and optimize client projects, ensuring timely delivery and
   high-quality results.
 * Maintain open lines of communication with clients, providing regular updates
   and addressing any concerns.
 * Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to offer
   innovative solutions.
 * Document and present project findings and recommendations to both technical
   and non-technical stakeholders.
 * Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals and client
   pitches.


QUALIFICATIONS

 * A minimum of 10 years of experience in data science, with a strong background
   in organic research and data engineering.
 * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and statistical analysis tools is a must.
 * Experience with ETL processes and data engineering practices is essential.
 * A strong understanding of mathematics and its application in data analysis.
 * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively
   interact with clients and team members.
 * Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 * A problem-solving mindset with a track record of delivering innovative
   solutions.
 * Familiarity with the Dufry-Offshore industry or a related field is an
   advantage.
 * A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field is
   preferred.
 * Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and industry
   trends. Data Science Python SQL Statistical Analysis Data Engineering ETL Consulting Mathematics Data Analysis Project Management Communication Problem-solving Organic Research Candidates must have at least 10 years of experience in data science with a strong background in organic research and data engineering. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and statistical analysis is required, along with a degree in a relevant quantitative field.

title: Manager, Rights Management
job_description:
About Crunchyroll
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
About the role
The Manager, Rights Management oversees the day-to-day administration and quality of content-rights data in Rightsline. This role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Rights & Scheduling, ensures that rights information received from Business Affairs and Content Acquisition is complete, interpretable, accurately configured, and maintained through approved controls.
The Manager is responsible for operational execution and leading a team to review source terms, enter and update content-rights attributes, identify discrepancies, managing exceptions, and coordinating resolution with the appropriate business or technology partner. The role is a key point of accountability for Rightsline data quality and timely rights changes while maintaining clear separation from financial-term entry, scheduling, and avails ownership.
Key Responsibilities
Content rights entry: responsible for entering content details from contracts (titles, territories, languages, windows, media, restrictions) into Rightsline, the system of record that carries rights to distribution channels (SVOD, digital manga, theatrical, home video), following approved workflows and standards.Perform quality checks and reconciliation: regularly audit datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy and clarity, and resolve discrepancies.
Prepare operational reporting: prepare analysis on work volume, completeness, accuracy, and data variances for business targets with cross-functional teams.
Support special projects: provide input and oversight on projects ranging from systems improvement UAT to data reconciliation initiatives.
Manage a team of analysts: lead a team of analysts who will enter contract details in Rightsline and ensure SLAs are met.
About You
3+ years experience leading teams in rights/contract management in media & entertainment 
Proven leadership skills in keeping teams accountable and goal execution with an eye on process improvement
Attention to detail; well versed in understanding contract language and translating terms 
Strong communication and collaboration skills to influence cross-functionally 
Experience with Rightsline and understanding data flows both upstream and downstream and subsequent business impacts
Preferred:
Experience in streaming industry
Experience and familiarity of anime content and anime industry
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Free premium access to Crunchyroll
Professional Development
Company's Paid Parental Leave
up to 22 weeks for birthing parents
up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
Hybrid Work Schedule
Paid Time Off
Flex Time Off
5 Yasumi Days
Half-Day Fridays during the summer
Winter Break

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.
Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

title: Assistant Manager-Loss Prevention
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Assists in the management of the daily functions of the department to ensure
protection of property assets, employees, guests and property. Maintains logs,
certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures.
Assists in the training of staff in established emergency procedures and
implements accident and fire prevention procedures. Position focuses on ensuring
guest and employee satisfaction while achieving the operating budget.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention
or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related
major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional
area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations

• Assists the Director of Engineering in administering fire prevention programs
and emergency preparedness.

• Assists in conducting hazard and risk assessments at the property to include
quarterly OSHA/SAFETY audits, incident tracking, and the hazard abatement
process.

• Assists in the development of detailed "shut down" procedures for the property
to ensure that all areas are secured at the appropriate times.

• Complies with applicable federal, state and local law and safety regulations.

• Follows proper key control guidelines in loss prevention and in the property.

• Develops a monthly checklist for all cctv equipment, alarmed doors, and duress
alarms to ensure that they are fully functional.

• Incorporates into patrols, which encompass all areas of the property's
interior and exterior, an inspection tour of recording system.

• Follows Duty of Care process for the protection of guests and employees.

• Follows up on all unusual activities in and around the property that would
impair the well being of guests and employees.

• Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts,
or otherwise negotiating with others.

• Implements action plans to monitor and control risk.

• Monitors all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair
the well being of guests and employees.

• Oversees all loss prevention operations to include but not limited to patrol
process, emergency response, investigations (initial & follow up) for all guest
and employee related incidents, shipping and receiving process (makes
recommendations for improvement), electronic key system and manager on duties
responsibilities.

• Oversees and guides the efforts of the Accident Prevention Committee.

• Oversees first aid program for guests and employees.

• Oversees the claims process and protects company assets by closely monitoring
the General Liability and Worker's Compensation cases.

 

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Meet quality standards and customer expectations on a daily basis.

• Identifies the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or
training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.

• Inspects and critiques the performance of the loss prevention department to
establish and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service.

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and
retention.

 

Additional Responsibilities

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and
solve problems.

• Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on
relevant information in a timely manner.

• Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written
form, e-mail, or in person.

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity

title: Consultant- Oracle Security & Controls
job_description:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle HCM Cloud Security Specialist with strong
expertise in Oracle Fusion Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), and
audit controls. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing,
implementing, and maintaining robust security frameworks within Oracle HCM Cloud
while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements,
and industry best practices.
 
 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Design, implement, and maintain Oracle HCM Cloud security models to safeguard
   sensitive HR and organizational data.
 * Configure and manage Data Roles, Job Roles, Duty Roles, Privileges, and Role
   Hierarchies in accordance with the principle of least privilege.
 * Administer and maintain Areas of Responsibility (AORs), User Administration,
   and security configurations across Oracle Fusion applications.
 * Perform security assessments, role design, provisioning reviews, and
   segregation of duties (SoD) analysis.
 * Configure, monitor, and support Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC), including
   Advanced Access Controls (AAC) and Advanced Financial Controls (AFC).
 * Partner with functional and technical teams to identify security risks,
   compliance gaps, and access management issues, and implement effective
   remediation plans.
 * Support SOX, internal, and external audits by providing security
   documentation, evidence, and control testing.
 * Implement and maintain IT General Controls (ITGCs) and security controls
   aligned with SOX, ISO 27001, and other regulatory compliance requirements.
 * Conduct user access reviews, security troubleshooting, and remediation
   activities to maintain compliance and operational efficiency.
 * Assist in the development and enforcement of security governance policies,
   standards, and procedures.
 * Monitor and evaluate security risks and recommend enhancements to strengthen
   Oracle Cloud security posture.


QUALIFICATIONS

 * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information
   Security, Accounting Information Systems, or a related field.
 * 3-7 years of experience implementing, administering, or supporting Oracle
   Cloud Security and Controls engagements.
 * Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion applications, including:
   * HCM Cloud
   * Financials (ERP)
   * Supply Chain Management (SCM)
   * Security Administration
   * Business Process Controls
 * Hands-on experience with Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC), including AAC
   and AFC.
 * Experience navigating and configuring Oracle Fusion application security and
   administration modules.
 * Solid understanding of:
   * Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
   * Segregation of Duties (SoD)
   * User Provisioning and Access Governance
   * Enterprise Security Frameworks
 * Experience supporting SOX compliance, ITGC testing, internal audits, risk
   assessments, and compliance initiatives.
 * Knowledge of information security principles, methodologies, technologies,
   and industry best practices.
 * Working knowledge of Oracle Database concepts, Oracle Security Architecture,
   and GRC frameworks.
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
 * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with business
   stakeholders, auditors, and technical teams. Oracle HCM Cloud Oracle Fusion Security Governance, Risk & Compliance Audit Controls Data Roles Job Roles Segregation of Duties Oracle Risk Management Cloud Advanced Access Controls Advanced Financial Controls SOX Compliance IT General Controls Role-Based Access Control User Provisioning Security Governance Access Management Candidates must possess a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 3-7 years of experience in Oracle Cloud Security and Controls. Strong expertise in Oracle Fusion applications, GRC frameworks, and risk management modules is essential for this role.

job_description:
Who We Are 
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. 
We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. 
While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. 
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity 
What’s In It For U 
Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative 
Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. 
Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. 
More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. 
Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. 
Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. 
Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. 
Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. 
Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. 
Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. 
Insurity’s Next Senior Procurement & FinOps Specialist 
This is an opportunity to join an AI-first team that is driving agentic development across FinOps and Procurement practices utilizing tools such as Claude Code, Snowflake, and Glean, for a true business-value multi-agent architecture.
What Our Senior Procurement & FinOps Specialist Will Do 
Perform FinOps analysis across SaaS and assigned cloud or AI-cost categories; identify variances, optimization opportunities, allocation gaps, forecast risks, and required actions.
Produce reliable spend, renewal, license, and budget analysis from approved enterprise data sources; reconcile material discrepancies before presenting findings or recommendations.
Partner with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, IT owners, and vendors to drive timely decisions, approvals, and risk resolution; escalate material commercial, operational, or financial risk.
Define and improve repeatable playbooks, metrics, documentation, and AI-assisted workflows for the procurement and FinOps operating model.
Track the Budget spend and ensure the system of record (SOR) is updated
Validate and reconcile vendor Order Forms against business stakeholders’ requirements
Review and redline vendor contracts, Order Forms, and Quotes to ensure the documents are in compliance with Insurity standards and expected service level objectives and agreements provided by Vendors.
Independently manage an assigned portfolio of SaaS renewals, new-vendor procurements, and associated stakeholder workplans from intake through execution and system-of-record completion.
Lead medium-complexity sourcing and commercial analyses, including requirements gathering, supplier research, quote/RFx comparison, total-cost analysis, and recommendation preparation.
Assist with driving Operational Efficiencies throughout the business by suggesting changes to the existing processes and/or systems
Work closely with business stakeholders to follow the defined renewal strategy 
Ensure all vendor renewals and new purchases are completed on time and have no operational impact 
Obtain all required approvals from Legal, InfoSec, Team management before the vendor contracts, Order Forms, and Quotes are signed
Inform the management of any out of budget spend requests
Assist with the analysis and potential implementation of continuous improvement efforts which could involve people, processes, or technology
Other duties as assigned

Perform the following skills at an advanced level:
Applied FinOps capability for SaaS and technology spend: interpreting spend and usage data, supporting cost allocation and forecasting, identifying optimization opportunities, and escalating material budget or renewal risks.
Sourcing and procurement operations capability, including independently leading medium-complexity sourcing events, developing comparison analyses, coordinating negotiations, and recommending supplier or commercial options.
Ability to independently manage a renewal and procurement portfolio, including timeline development, stakeholder engagement, commercial documentation, approval orchestration, and risk management.
Commercial and contract fluency: ability to review order forms, quotes, renewal documentation, pricing structures, and key business terms; identify discrepancies or non-standard items; and coordinate required Legal and InfoSec review.
AI-tool fluency: applying approved AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, stakeholder communications, and workflow automation, with sound judgment around data access, quality, and governance.

Detail-oriented
Active listener
Ability to collaborate and work autonomously

AI tools, including both Code generation tools and AI-assistance tools, such as Glean, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot

Excel

title: Performance Marketing Executive - Content (Tamil)
job_description:
Description
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centere — access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing professional to manage end-to-end digital marketing—from running ads and creating content ideas to tracking and optimizing performance.
This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for results, not just execution. Training and guidance will be provided.
Key Responsibilities :
For each app you work on, you'll study the audience, the market, and the competition - then write ads that get people to download and make that first purchase.
You decide the angle, the hook, the format, and the script - and you write it yourself.
You'll brief designers and video editors on your concepts and follow through until the output matches your intent.
You'll ship multiple creative variants per campaign (80-100 per week) - fast cycles, not one polished ad a week.
You run your own A/B tests, read the results, and decide what to try next.
You track what's working in each market and make sure the creative feels native to that audience.
Requirements
Must-Have
1–3 years of experience in performance marketing content or growth marketing.
Hands-on exposure to Meta Ads & Google Ads campaigns.
Strong copywriting skills (English + regional language preferred).
Understanding of performance metrics like CAC, ROAS, CPI, CTR.
Experience working with creative and video teams.
Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.
What We Offer :
End-to-end ownership of marketing
Training and mentorship from leadership
High learning curve with direct business impact
Performance-based growth opportunities
Why This Role Is Exciting :
You will directly drive growth through paid marketing and experiments
You will own end-to-end performance—from ads to insights and optimization
You will test, learn, and scale what works with real business impact
High visibility with leadership and a steep learning curve Performance marketing Meta ads Google ads Copywriting Content strategy Data analysis A/B testing Campaign management Creative direction Video editing coordination Growth marketing CAC ROAS CPI CTR Tamil Candidates must have 1–3 years of experience in performance or growth marketing with hands-on expertise in Meta and Google Ads. Strong copywriting skills in English and Tamil, along with a data-driven mindset, are essential for this role.

title: Senior InfoSec GRC Specialist
job_description:
About Velsera
Medicine moves too slow. At Velsera, we are changing that.
Velsera was formed in 2023 through the shared vision of Seven Bridges and Pierian, with a mission to accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of life-changing insights.
Velsera provides software and professional services for:
AI-powered multimodal data harmonization and analytics for drug discovery and development
IVD development, validation, and regulatory approval
Clinical NGS interpretation, reporting, and adoption
With our headquarters in Boston, MA, we are growing and expanding our teams located in different countries!

What will you do?
Compliance & Governance
Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive information security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with the ISO 27001 framework
Lead, manage, and mature the organization's Information Security Management System including risk treatment, internal audits, and readiness for external certification audits.
Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for Security and Privacy Rules, ensuring compliance for all systems, processes, and applications handling PII and Protected Health Information (PHI).
Conduct continuous monitoring and evidence collection to demonstrate compliance with relevant frameworks.
Plan, conduct and manage internal and supplier audits
Plan GRC activities, prioritise and implement them in timebound manner.
Perform detailed security risk assessments and gap analyses on new and existing systems, with a focus on cloud infrastructure
Collaborate with Product, Technology, IT and Security teams to implement security controls into cloud / infra / environments, ensuring compliance. Provide technical guidance to them on implementing controls and best practices, specifically related to cloud security architecture and configurations.
Review risk mitigations periodically and track remediation efforts to closure.
Conduct third-party vendor risk assessments, focusing on their adherence to required compliance standards.
Develop and deliver targeted security awareness and training programs focused on HIPAA and ISO 27001 requirements for all staff, including technical teams.
Evaluate and recommend new security technologies and processes to enhance the compliance and risk posture.
Stay current on emerging cloud security threats, regulatory changes, and updates to the ISO 27001 family of standards and HIPAA.
What do you bring to the table?
· Experience:
Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in Information Security GRC, with a focus on risk management, compliance, and governance.
Proven, hands-on experience driving and maintaining ISO 27001 certification programs.
Deep practical knowledge and experience of implementing security controls ensuring compliance in a technical, cloud-centric environment.
Strong technical competency in Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related cloud-native security services.
Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or related field.
Certifications (One or more highly preferred):
CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)

title: Commis II (Indian Curry)
job_description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team,
that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will assist in
food preparation and cooking under the supervision of senior chefs. As a Commis
II (Indian Curry), you’re not just preparing great tasting food items – you’re
spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable
experiences that make the stay for every guest.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

 * Prepare high-quality dishes:  Prepare menu items according to designated
   recipes and quality standards
 * Delight our guests:  Manage guest orders efficiently while ensuring a
   positive dining experience
 * Execute complex recipes:  Maintain a strong knowledge of menu offerings,
   handle complex recipes, and oversee stations, execution, quality control, and
   inventory checks
 * Inspect and finalize plates:  Inspect all preparations and dishes ahead of
   serving to ensure they meet quality and presentation standards
 * Maintain a clean and organized workspace:  Keep food service stations stocked
   and sanitary while following proper food handling, storage, and safety
   protocols
 * Manage inventory needs:  Prepare requisitions for supplies and food items as
   needed
 * Comply with regulatory standards:  Maintain compliance with health, safety,
   sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards
   of guest and team member well-being


QUALIFICATIONS

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the
qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with
Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership.
A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and
accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every
moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

 * Minimum 1 year of experience as a Cook or Trainee in a 5-star hotel or
   high-standard restaurant.
 * Basic knowledge of Western or Chinese cuisine.
 * Ability to remain calm and problem-solve under pressure.
 * Comfortable working in hot, humid, and noisy kitchen environments.
 * Strong teamwork and communication skills.
 * Willingness to learn and follow kitchen procedures and hygiene standards.


Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build
an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a
global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests
worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with
the light and warmth of hospitality.

title: Sr Analyst, FP&A
job_description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Elastic is looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst to join our India finance team. You will support financial planning, reporting, and analysis for our global finance function — and help make our finance processes faster and smarter using AI tools. This is a great opportunity for someone who is curious, enjoys solving problems, and wants to do more than just run reports.
What You Will Be Doing
Financial Partnership — Act as a trusted finance partner to business and functional leaders, providing timely reporting, dashboards, and visibility into operational spend. Serve as the primary point of contact for financial analytics and ad-hoc requests.
Reporting & Analysis — Deliver management reporting packages, business scorecards, and financial models for senior leadership. Build and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Sigma, or similar tools — with a focus on real-time reporting.
Forecasting & Budgeting — Support rolling forecasts, annual budgeting, and monthly budget vs. actual analysis using Pigment. Monitor KPIs, highlight trends, and deliver clear variance commentary.
Core Finance Operations — Own month-end and quarter-end close activities including expense accruals, journal entries, variance analysis, and supporting schedules.
Technology & Business Transformation — Lead re-engineering of FP&A processes using AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini) and Excel. Propose and implement new tools, drive automation adoption across finance, and upskill teams on new ways of working. Use generative AI to accelerate variance commentary, financial narratives, and reporting outputs. Validate AI-generated insights critically before presenting to leadership. Ensure accurate reconciliation across Adaptive, Pigment, Workday, and NetSuite. Maintain data quality as the foundation for reliable reporting and a single source of truth.
What You Bring
Experience — 5–8 years in a finance function with exposure to business transformation, process re-engineering, or finance automation. CA / MBA / CMA preferred.
AI & Automation Fluency — Hands-on experience using AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar) in a finance workflow — an active user, not just someone aware of the tools. Experience with Pigment, Adaptive, or NetSuite is a strong plus.
Transformation Mindset — Spots manual, repetitive processes and drives smarter alternatives. Comfortable proposing new tools and building the case for change.
Collaboration & Teaching — Works cross-functionally, shares knowledge, and coaches peers on automation and new tools. Makes the team around them better.
Communication — Simplifies financial complexity for non-finance stakeholders at all levels. Comfortable working across global teams and time zones.
Detail Orientation — Delivers accurate, high-quality work consistently in a fast-paced environment.
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.

title: Node JS Technical Lead
job_description:
You will be part of our rapidly growing Adobe Commerce practice helping to shape and deliver the right outcomes for our clients. As a Technical Lead at Tryzens, this individual is responsible for developing and overseeing the Node JS development for eCommerce projects, specifically focused on using the latest technologies and practices to ensure the delivery of themes and packages of the highest quality.
The core responsibilities are: 
Development of client solutions
Participate in the discovery phase and provide an estimation of the business requirements.
Planning and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project execution as per technical and functional specifications.
Design, Develop and modify features for Node JS Application.
Interact with the business and other technology teams.
Participating in and leading unit testing and code review sessions to identify potential project bottlenecks and suggest solutions.
Engagement in technical design discussions, requirement analysis, coding, testing, implementation, and maintenance of Node JS software applications.
Providing hands-on support in Node JS software/application architecture, development, design, independent analysis, and problem resolution.
Communicating with client business to fully understand client expectations.
Ensure that features are being delivered efficiently and on-time
Effectively troubleshoot production issues
Follow the latest advancements in back-end technologies and techniques
Continue to expand knowledge of new technologies, as well as strengthen the current knowledge base
Train and integrate new team members and proactively support the continued
development of existing team members.
Build and promote a positive working environment for the team.
Effectively work with team members in line with company policy and procedures,
including performance, development, disciplinary and conflict resolution with
effective feedback
Excellent communication skills
Commercial
Supporting Presales during the development of new business with new or existing clients
General
Participate in recruitment activities where necessary
Essential Skills & Experience
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent. 
Team player with excellent collaboration skills, with a fantastic can-do attitude. 
Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
A minimum of 5 years of experience developing on the Node JS framework including:
Good experience with the MEAN stack and the application architecture MVC would be a plus
Good knowledge of HTML, Stylesheets (CSS3, SASS), and Cross-browser development (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Safari, Chrome)
Proficiency in NodeJS microservices
Proven ability to work effectively with team members as well as various stakeholders within the company
Proficient in using version control (GIT), JIRA, Web Developer Tools (e.g., Chrome, Firebug
Familiar with Confluence, MS Outlook, Word, Excel
Overall, 7 to 12 plus years of IT experience.
General experience working with e-commerce systems is a plus
Experience with Shopify and Shopify plus
Experience in React JS, Angular
Experience in Node JS integration with Shopify sites.
Very good knowledge and strong skills in developing Node JS application
Good knowledge of SQL and NoSQL systems
Good experience with REST APIs implementation
Proficiency in JavaScript frameworks
Experience in Agile Scrum Node JS JavaScript MEAN Stack Microservices REST APIs HTML CSS3 SASS SQL NoSQL Git Jira Agile Scrum Shopify React JS Angular Candidates must have a bachelor's degree and at least 7 to 12 years of IT experience, with a minimum of 5 years specifically in Node JS development. Proficiency in MEAN stack, microservices, and e-commerce systems is essential, along with strong communication and collaboration skills.

title: Senior Process Manager
job_description:
Responsibilities

 

 * Client Management – establish self as a valued partner and work closely to
   achieve goals defined
 * Independently handle all client escalations and lead mitigation steps to
   prevent future escalations
 * Help knowledge management endeavour by sharing process knowledge and best
   practices within the teams
 * Lead various quality initiatives across processes managed
 * Responsible for Business continuity, transformation and various audits
 * Good understanding of Asset Servicing Life Cycle.
 * Experience in announcement scrubbing, dividend processing, Claims processing,
   managing meeting events, reconciliation of breaks related to Corporate
   Actions.
 * Should be well versed with all event types. Mandatory, Mandatory with Choice
   and Voluntary events.
 * Should be aware of all critical dates in an event such as Ex-date, record
   date, pay date, deadline date.
 * Should be aware of risk in corporate action process i.e. regulatory,
   financial and reputational risks – impact of delayed/incorrect processing.
 * Knowledge of SWIFT messages used in Asset Services
 * Should be aware of regulatory requirements such as Client Money disclosure,
   Shareholders Rights directive (SRD)
 * Strong capabilities in MS Office Tools.
 * Preferred experience with data visualization and data analytics tools
 * Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple priorities 
 * Excellent presentation and communication skills (written and verbal) 
 * Ability to work with teams across time-zones and cultures 
 * Organized, detail oriented, flexible, self-starter & highly motivated
 * Should be able to act fast and decisively when dealing with critical
   situations
 * Good with numbers and ability to derive information from data
 * Excellent multi-tasking and creative problem solving Asset Servicing Corporate Actions Client Management Reconciliation Risk Management SWIFT Messages Regulatory Compliance Data Analytics MS Office Business Continuity Process Improvement Communication Problem Solving Leadership Stakeholder Management Audit Management Candidates must possess deep knowledge of the asset servicing life cycle, including various corporate action event types and regulatory requirements. Strong analytical skills, proficiency in MS Office, and the ability to work effectively across time zones are essential for this leadership role.

title: Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level II
job_description:
Job Summary

The Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level II is responsible for
preparing, building, installing, and supporting test articles, test systems, and
laboratory equipment used in product validation and functional testing
activities. This role supports engine and component testing by performing test
setup, instrumentation installation, troubleshooting, engine handling, and data
collection activities while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and
engineering standards.

The position requires hands-on technical expertise in test cell operations,
engine systems, laboratory equipment, and test methodologies to ensure accurate
and reliable test results that support product development and validation
objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Test Preparation & Execution

 * Prepare test articles, fixtures, rigs, instrumentation, and associated
   equipment for testing activities.
 * Install instrumentation and measurement devices in accordance with
   engineering standards and test requirements.
 * Conduct and support product testing in accordance with approved test
   procedures, methodologies, and project plans.
 * Monitor and document test execution to ensure accurate and reliable test
   results.
 * Support engine, subsystem, and component functional testing activities.

Engine Test Cell Operations

 * Conduct and monitor engine tests based on approved test plans and engineering
   requirements.
 * Perform installation, removal, assembly, and disassembly of engines and
   related systems within test cells.
 * Execute necessary modifications to engines and test setups to support testing
   objectives.
 * Support continuous test cell operations, including shift-based and 24/7
   testing activities when required.
 * Maintain working knowledge of engine systems, test cell equipment, and
   laboratory operations.

Troubleshooting & Maintenance

 * Perform preliminary troubleshooting of engine, instrumentation, test stand,
   and test cell-related issues.
 * Support test stand setup, configuration, installation, and maintenance
   activities.
 * Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure operational readiness.
 * Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance activities to improve
   equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
 * Identify and resolve technical issues impacting test execution and data
   quality.

Data Collection & Reporting

 * Verify equipment calibration and instrumentation readiness before testing.
 * Collect, validate, and document test data in accordance with established
   procedures.
 * Prepare test reports, records, and documentation that clearly communicate
   testing methods, observations, and results.
 * Support engineers and project teams by providing accurate and reliable test
   information.
 * Ensure data integrity and adherence to quality requirements throughout the
   testing process.

Safety, Quality & Continuous Improvement

 * Follow all Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), Quality Management System
   (QMS), and laboratory procedures.
 * Conduct risk assessments and comply with Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) and other
   safety requirements.
 * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
 * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including TBWS (The
   Cummins Way) activities.
 * Collaborate effectively with project teams, engineers, technicians, and other
   stakeholders to improve testing processes and operational efficiency.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Competencies

Technical Competencies

 * Product Functional Testing
 * Engine Test Cell Operations
 * Test Setup and Configuration
 * Test Article Build and Instrumentation Installation
 * Data Acquisition and Measurement Systems
 * Data Reporting and Analysis
 * Product Function Test System Design
 * Preventive and Predictive Maintenance
 * Equipment Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
 * Data Quality Management
 * Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis

Behavioral Competencies

 * Health and Safety Fundamentals
 * Action Oriented
 * Decision Quality
 * Drives Results
 * Manages Complexity
 * Effective Communication
 * Collaboration and Teamwork
 * Continuous Improvement Mindset
 * Accountability and Ownership
 * Values Differences

 

Qualifications

Required

 * High School Diploma, Secondary Education Certificate, or equivalent
   experience in a relevant STEM-related field.
 * Intermediate-level technical knowledge gained through education, training,
   apprenticeship, or relevant work experience.

Preferred

 * Technical Diploma, Associate Degree, or equivalent certification in
   Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a
   related field.
 * Relevant regional certifications associated with testing, mechanical systems,
   or laboratory operations.
 * Experience in engine testing, powertrain testing, automotive testing, or
   product validation environments.


QUALIFICATIONS

Skills & Experience Required

 * Hands-on experience supporting product testing, engine testing, laboratory
   operations, or related technical environments.
 * Strong knowledge of engine systems, components, and test cell operations.
 * Experience with test stand setup, instrumentation installation, and
   troubleshooting activities.
 * Familiarity with data acquisition systems, test equipment, and measurement
   techniques.
 * Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and laboratory quality
   practices.
 * Understanding of safety procedures, risk assessment processes, and LOTO
   requirements.
 * Experience in preventive and predictive maintenance practices.
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic reporting tools.
 * Familiarity with AVL PUMA test cell systems is considered an advantage.
 * Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
 * Ability to work effectively in a team environment and support continuous
   operations when required.

Experience

 * Some relevant work experience in testing, mechanical systems, laboratory
   operations, manufacturing, automotive, or product validation environments.
 * Experience supporting engine testing, troubleshooting, instrumentation, and
   test cell operations preferred.
 * Demonstrated ability to work safely, follow procedures, and contribute to
   high-quality testing outcomes.

title: Product Designer
job_description:
About the Role
Channel Fusion is moving from a services-heavy channel marketing company to a product-led, AI-enabled platform business for Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies. Our enterprise clients use our products to run their partner programs, including partner portals, incentives, rewards, and co-op funds. Their partners and dealers are mostly in the US, and they judge us by how well those tools work day to day.
This is an existing seat on our Chandigarh product team, and the role is changing as we change. Within the agreed product scope, you'll own both what the experience is and how it works. You'll understand the problem, decide what users need to see and do, and define how the experience should behave. Then you'll use AI tools and agents to make those decisions clear and testable in a working prototype, so the team can review something real in days instead of weeks.
You don't need to know how to code. Code changes are made through AI. What we're looking for is your ability to direct AI well, judge what it produces, and catch its mistakes.
What You Own
• What the experience is and how it works, within the agreed product scope. You frame the user problem, decide what users need to see and do, and define flows, interactions, and behavior. These decisions are yours to make and defend.
• Working prototypes built with AI. You use AI tools and agents to turn your design decisions into a working prototype, shared through a review URL. Each prototype shows the main user journey with realistic data, plus the relevant loading, empty, error, and success states.
• Design quality. You own accessibility, fidelity to each client's brand, and consistency with our shared patterns. You check your own work before it goes to review, and you keep approved behavior intact when you make changes.
• Usability for US partner and dealer audiences. You design for how US partners, channel managers, and program admins work. You validate with real users and back your design decisions with evidence, not opinion.
• Handoff and QA. Your handoff explains the intended experience, behavior, and design decisions clearly enough for engineering to build from. You stay involved through QA to confirm that what ships matches the agreed design.
Decision rights: Within the agreed product scope, you decide what users see and do and how the experience behaves, including interaction design, visual execution, and how you prototype. Product leadership owns scope and roadmap priorities. Engineering owns technical implementation and production delivery. Changes to shared platform patterns are agreed with product leadership.
What Great Looks Like
• First 90 days: You've taken over the design work already in flight with no gaps in delivery. You know the current product areas and the open design debt.
• 6 months: You've shipped at least one meaningful feature end to end. Every feature you hand off comes with a review-URL prototype that covers the main journey and its key states, and engineering builds from it without major rework.
• 12 months: You own the design of a product area, and at QA the delivered experience consistently matches the agreed design. You've made measurable usability gains (for example, task completion, partner adoption, or fewer support tickets) and helped make AI-built prototypes standard practice on the team.
What You Do NOT Own
• Product scope and roadmap priorities. You inform them, but product leadership owns them.
• Technical implementation and production delivery. Engineering owns these. Your prototypes clarify and test design decisions. They are not production code.
• Marketing, brand, or campaign creative.
• Custom, one-off design services for individual clients outside the product roadmap.
Qualifications
Required
• 4+ years designing B2B SaaS products used by external customers
• Experience designing products for US users
• AI-native working style: you use AI tools and agents every day to design and to build working prototypes. Coding knowledge is not required. You can direct AI well, judge its output, and catch its mistakes.
• A portfolio of shipped work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
• Strong written and spoken English for working directly with US-based stakeholders
Preferred
• Product-led work on partner, dealer, or channel platforms, such as portals, incentives, rewards, or co-op/MDF
• Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system
• Experience designing for accessibility (WCAG) and for multiple client brands on one platform
• Experience running usability research with enterprise or B2B users B2B SaaS Product Design AI Tools Prototyping User Experience Interaction Design Usability Research Accessibility WCAG Design Systems Stakeholder Management Design Quality User Flows QA Enterprise Software Candidates must have 4+ years of experience designing B2B SaaS products and a strong portfolio of shipped work. Proficiency in using AI tools for design and prototyping is required, along with excellent English communication skills.

job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers
to resolve maintenance issues with little to no supervision. Perform preventive
maintenance on tools and equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually
inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio).
Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and shut-offs
for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies
as needed. Assure each day’s activities and problems that occur are communicated
to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display
proficiency in any one of the following categories, above average skills in two
more of the following categories and basic skills in the remaining categories:
air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing,
pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen
equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building management.
Display solid knowledge and skill in the safe use of hand and power tools and
other materials required to perform repair and maintenance tasks. Display basic
ability to repair or replace PVC copper pipe (including soldering). Troubleshoot
and perform basic repair on all types of equipment (e.g., pump and motor
replacement), plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical
equipment including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners,
internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom
items. Program TV's and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related
duties. Assist with surface preparation and painting, minor drywall and wood
trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough
cleanup of the painting or repair area. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before
performing any maintenance work. Display working knowledge of all engineering
computer programs related to preventative maintenance, energy management, and
other systems, including devices that interact with such programs. Perform
mid-level troubleshooting of hotel Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP)
systems. Display the ability to train and mentor other engineers (e.g., Engineer
I). Display ability to perform Engineer on Duty responsibilities, including
readings and rounds.

title: Mechanical Technical Lead Engineer
job_description:
The group you’ll be a part of
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. 
The impact you’ll make
As a Mechanical Engineer at Lam, you're designing and defining cutting-edge mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. Your role involves feasibility studies, testing, and guiding teams in detailed design and fabrication. You provide the crucial design information needed to shape our technology's packaging.
What you’ll do
Support the full life cycle of mechanical and electro-mechanical systems from concept to productization including conceptualization, designing, CAD modeling, development, and test/validation.
Designs components using variety of metals, ceramics, quartz, plastics, and advanced coatings.
Ensure documentation aligns with SEMI, Lam standards, and industry best practices for geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
Conduct detailed analysis including structural, finite element analysis (FEA), thermal, heat transfer, stress, vibrations, fluid and gas flow dynamics, and manufacturability to properly specify designs.
Develop and conduct feasibility studies and test plans to characterize and validate design performance.
Prepare high-quality reports and technical presentations to clearly communicate design intent, evaluation, and validation to a diverse audience in design reviews.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to ensure solutions can be manufactured with high-quality, cost-optimized, and to requirements.
Provide key deliverables including Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), technical specifications, risk analysis, test specifications, and design review presentations.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers.
Who we’re looking for
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years; or equivalent experience.
Excellent communication, both written and verbal, and technical presentation skills.
Highly proficient in 3D CAD tools such as CREO, Siemens NX, ProE, SolidWorks, and others.
Hands-on experimental and design background coupled with solid engineering skills.
Preferred qualifications
Experience in Semiconductor industry is a plus.
Experience in project management, managing projects, or problem solving while managing time and multiple priorities.
Our commitment
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time. Mechanical Engineering CAD Modeling CREO Siemens NX ProE SolidWorks Finite Element Analysis Structural Analysis Thermal Analysis GD&T Failure Modes and Effects Analysis Technical Documentation Project Management Semiconductor Industry Design Validation Mentoring Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering with at least 5 years of experience, or a Master's degree with 3 years of experience. Proficiency in 3D CAD tools and strong analytical skills in structural, thermal, and fluid dynamics are required.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
job_description:
About the Company
At Delta, we are re-imagining and re-building the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.
🎯 Mission Driven: Re-imagine and re-build the future of finance.
💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of ~$0.5billion, and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.
📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.
💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded TinyOwl and Housing.com.
💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).

About the role 

You'll be the dedicated security engineer at a derivative exchange (~250 people, 50-100 person dev team). All infra is AWS. DevOps builds it; you make sure it's secure and can prove it. You'll be hands-on — reviewing Terraform PRs for security gaps, building automated drift detection, writing SIEM rules, and owning the credential lifecycle. When the CTO asks, "Are we secure?" you pull up a dashboard, not a slide deck. You own the security posture of the infrastructure from shaping how access and controls are modelled, to verifying they hold in practice. 



What you'll do
Verify that infra implementations match the security model — continuously, not quarterly.
Build automated compliance checks and drift detection (AWS Config, Steampipe, custom tooling, whatever works)
Review Terraform PRs for IAM, SCP, and network security gaps before they hit production.
Own credential lifecycle: rotation, PAM, JIT access, session recording.
Write and tune detection rules in OpenSearch SIEM.
Build evidence dashboards that prove security posture to non-security leadership 7. Evaluate security tooling (build vs buy) and own the recommendation with documented tradeoffs. 

Must-haves

5+ years in infrastructure or security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on AWS security
IAM beyond basic roles — you understand policy evaluation logic, permission boundaries, cross-account access patterns
Have built automated security checks that run in production (any tooling)
Can read and critically review Terraform for security posture
Have operated PAM tooling or credential rotation in production (any tool)
Comfortable owning a security domain end-to-end without constant direction

Strong advantages
Worked at an org < 500 people where you were one of the very few (or the only) security engineers
Multi-account AWS Organizations / SCP experience. Wrote SIEM detection rules in production (any platform — OpenSearch, Splunk, Elastic, etc.)
Regulated fintech, exchange, or payments background. 
Built security evidence/reporting that non-security people actually used. AWS Security IAM Terraform Infrastructure Security SIEM OpenSearch Compliance Automation Credential Lifecycle Management PAM JIT Access AWS Config Steampipe Network Security Drift Detection Security Engineering Candidates must have at least 5 years of experience in infrastructure or security engineering, with a minimum of 2 years specifically focused on AWS security. Proficiency in IAM policy evaluation, Terraform security reviews, and automated security tooling is required.
