title: Front Office Executive - JW Marriott Bengaluru Prestige Golfshire Resort & Spa
job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 

Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment,
assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for
each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information.
Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to
issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily
reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply
guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests,
contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have
been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance
and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain
manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss
Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.

 

Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching
employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of
Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working
relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond
appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures;
report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete
safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and
professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect
company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests’
service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine
appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review
written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate
etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information
using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to
10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested
by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

title: Manager of Software Engineering - .Net, C#, Python
job_description:
This is your chance to change the path of your career and guide multiple teams
to success at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Corporate and
Investment Bank - Securities Services Technology team, you lead multiple teams
and manage day-to-day implementation activities by identifying and escalating
issues and ensuring your team’s work adheres to compliance standards, business
requirements, and tactical best practices.

Job responsibilities

 

 * Designs, develops, and maintains enterprise applications using C# and .NET
   ecosystem, build scalable solutions with both .NET Framework and modern .NET
   (6/7/8+), develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems and
   implement clean code principles and industry-standard design patterns
 * Works with various database technologies including SQL and NoSQL solutions,
   design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data access patterns,
   implement data persistence layers using Entity Framework.
 * Leads team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering
   practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and
   operational outcomes, while setting expectations for human validation, secure
   handling of inputs/outputs, and consistent use of reusable patterns across
   teams.
 * Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle
   toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and
   automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and
   support capacity unlock initiatives.
 * Provides guidance to immediate team of software engineers on daily tasks and
   activities
 * Sets the overall guidance and expectations for team output, practices, and
   collaboration
 * Anticipates dependencies with other teams to deliver products and
   applications in line with business requirements

 * Manages stakeholder relationships and the team’s work in accordance with
   compliance standards, service level agreements, and business requirements
   
    

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

 * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+
   years applied experience. In addition, demonstrated coaching and mentoring
   experience
 * Proficient in coding in one or more languages specifically C#, .Net Core/.Net
   6+, Python and SQL.
 * Experience in developing responsive front end UI using
   React/Angular/Typescript along with understanding of object-oriented
   programming principles
 * Experience leading responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted
   development and delivery tools across engineering teams, including defining
   ways of working (review/validation expectations), measuring outcomes, and
   ensuring secure handling of data.
 * Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data
   sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and governance
   expectations; ability to coach engineers on compliant and effective usage.
 * Database Knowledge (Any of the following): SQL Databases (SQL Server,
   PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle). Understanding of database design principles and
   query optimization and experience with ORM frameworks (Entity Framework,
   Dapper).
 * Knowledge of Frontend Integration (Any of the following): React (Hooks,
   components, state management, modern React patterns), Angular (Components,
   services, TypeScript, RxJS). Understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript
   fundamentals and experience with REST API consumption and integration.
 * Experience leading technology projects and managing technologists
 * Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle including
    automation and continuous delivery methods
 * Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application
   Resiliency, and Security

 

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

 * Experience working at code level

  C# .Net Python SQL Software Engineering Team Management RESTful APIs Microservices Distributed Systems Entity Framework React Angular TypeScript AI-assisted Engineering SDLC Agile Methodologies Requires 5+ years of applied software engineering experience with proficiency in C#, .NET, Python, and SQL. Candidates must demonstrate leadership experience, knowledge of modern SDLC practices, and the ability to guide teams in AI-assisted development.

title: Lead Reliability Engineer - Network and Security
job_description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes
Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.
Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
Lead Reliability Engineer - Network and Security
What you'll be doing
You will build and operate the security controls that protect Zenoti's cloud estate, while partnering closely with InfoSec, Platform, and Engineering to enforce these controls.
Own network architecture and connectivity. Design, build, and run the network backbone of a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS estate: vWAN/hub-spoke, ExpressRoute/VPN, cross-cloud (AWS↔Azure) connectivity, private endpoints, DNS, routing, and segmentation, engineered for redundancy and tested failover.
Secure the edge and perimeter. Run the WAF, DDoS protection, Front Door/CDN, firewalls, and egress control, with no single points of failure, and keep network visibility high through flow analytics and cross-cloud path monitoring.
Automate everything that repeats. Treat network and security as code: secure-by-default Terraform modules, IaC scanning gates, drift detection, policy-as-code (OPA, Azure Policy, SCPs), automated evidence collection, and certificate and secrets lifecycle automation.
Operate detection, response, and resilience. Lead detection engineering, SIEM tuning, and incident command with RCA-to-control feedback loops, plus DR and ransomware-recovery architecture with failover runbooks tested on a schedule.
Keep us continuously compliant. Maintain a control registry mapped to SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and regional privacy laws, and govern identity, PKI, and encryption in line with InfoSec policy.
Be the architecture authority and set direction. Run design reviews and readiness assessments for new platforms and tools, manage risk-acceptance workflows, own the roadmap, mentor engineers, and give leadership clear, metric-anchored risk reporting.
What you'll bring
8+ years designing and operating infrastructure in Azure (primary) and AWS, with deep expertise in both network and security.
Deep cloud networking: vWAN/hub-spoke, ExpressRoute/VPN (IPSec), BGP and routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, and firewall and WAF management, including diagnosing complex cross-cloud connectivity issues.
Security fundamentals: TLS/PKI, IAM, SIEM, threat analysis, and EDR and vulnerability/patch management across Windows and Linux.
Strong automation skills: production IaC (Terraform preferred; ARM/Bicep/Ansible a plus), CI/CD pipeline integration, and scripting in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to eliminate manual toil.
Multi-tenant SaaS architecture: tenant isolation, blast-radius thinking, and data residency across regions, including GDPR and regional laws.
Workload and data security: Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) hardening, encryption and key management, and SQL Server and PaaS datastore hardening.
Brownfield pragmatism: migrating legacy estates to secure baselines without outages, through phased adoption.
Solid command of SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA audits, including customer security questionnaires.
Clear written communication: ADRs, and translating risk into business terms for leadership and auditors.
Ability to influence through technical depth in a fast-paced, scaling SaaS environment.
Nice to have: AZ-500/SC-100, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP/CCSP, CKS.
Zenoti provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Azure AWS Cloud Networking Terraform Security Controls Kubernetes IaC SIEM Network Architecture Identity and Access Management Python PowerShell Bash SOC 2 PCI-DSS HIPAA The role requires over 8 years of experience in infrastructure operations with deep expertise in Azure and AWS networking and security. Candidates must possess strong automation skills using Terraform and have a solid understanding of security fundamentals and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

title: Pathology Research Specialist II

At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.
Pathology Research Specialist II 
POSITION PURPOSE: 
The primary focus of this role is to support disease testing and diagnostic activities, and to support disease trait projects and disease assay development and improvement initiatives. Pathology Research Specialist collaborates closely with multidisciplinary teams, including plant pathology, plant breeding, genetics, testing, and operations, to drive progress toward platform objectives.
YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
Performs pathology phenotyping assays in the greenhouse, field, or lab to deliver timely/weekly targets. Actively supports the design and implementation of new bioassays. May support discovery projects focused on new disease traits or on enabling relevant technology for the program.
Assists with plant production, inoculum production and disease diagnosis and improvement of technology and processes
Supports rearing, handling, and utilization of insect vectors for disease transmission assays and insect (e.g., thrips, aphids), ensuring compliance with phytosanitary and biosafety protocols
Has primary or shared responsibility for specialized laboratory technology
Organizes, reports, prepares, and maintains technical documents such as disease protocols, diagnostic methods, or best practices. May co-lead these efforts.
Use of relevant hardware and software for data collection, management, QAQC and reporting.
Solves routine problems requiring original thinking and deductive reasoning, with ability to manage multiple projects and interact with others within specialized area.
Works collaboratively and outreaches within and beyond the team for knowledge and problem solving. Interacts effectively with employees and stakeholders at different levels.
Manages multiple tasks and works effectively with more than one technical supervisor
Champions HSE policies and phytosanitary procedures for the safe operation of the local research facility and program
WHO YOU ARE: 
BS with minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in biology, agronomy, plant pathology or related field or relevant experience. MS degree is desirable.
Ability to collect, understand, analyze, and summarize data effectively. Basic experience or knowledge in research methods, experimental design and statistical knowledge are desirable.
Strong computer skills and basic ability to use enterprise databases. Ability to apply AI to daily activities is desirable.
Demonstrated ability to conduct tasks independently and in a team setting to accomplish goals within specific timelines.

job_description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
Lead Site Reliability Engineer
Zenoti
Platform Engineering / SRE • Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes.
Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
About the Role
We are looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer to own the reliability of Zenoti's non-database tier: web applications, APIs, analytics and reporting systems running on cloud infrastructure (preferably Azure). You will set the reliability bar, lead incident and observability practices, and work closely with engineering teams on resilient design and safe delivery. Database reliability is covered by a separate team; this role focuses on everything above it.
What will I be doing?
Own the reliability, availability, performance and scalability of Zenoti's non-database platform: web applications, APIs/microservices, background processing, analytics and reporting workloads.
Define SLIs/SLOs/SLAs and error budgets for application and API components and drive their adoption across engineering teams.
Lead observability for applications: APM, distributed tracing, log aggregation, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerting that reduces noise and MTTD/MTTR.
Lead incident response for application-tier issues: triage, mitigation, root cause analysis, blameless postmortems and tracking of corrective actions to closure.
Drive capacity planning, load and performance testing, autoscaling and cost-efficiency of Azure-hosted application and analytics infrastructure.
Own reliability of the analytics stack (data pipelines, reporting and BI platforms such as Tableau) from a platform, availability and performance standpoint.
Review architecture and design of new services for resilience, fault tolerance, failover, graceful degradation and operability; provide architectural governance and cloud best practices.
Partner with development teams to improve build, release and deployment pipelines: safe rollouts, canary/blue-green strategies, rollback, release health checks and build structure.
Automate toil and operational workflows using Python or similar scripting languages and Infrastructure as Code.
Fully understand system inter-dependencies and limitations; functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions.
Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing deep knowledge and experience.
Mentor and guide engineers, assisting in their career development and coaching them on advanced technical issues.
Serve as SME for reliability trends, new and existing technologies, and architectural concepts; lead technical discussions with engineering leadership.
Be a self-starter who owns things from start to end with little oversight.
What skills do I need?
12+ years of overall experience in Software Engineering.
At least 4+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering / production operations of web and API-based systems.
Strong hands-on experience with public cloud, preferably Azure (App Service, AKS/VMs, Application Gateway/Front Door, Load Balancers, VNets, Storage, Azure Monitor/Application Insights, Key Vault).
Deep understanding of operating and troubleshooting web applications and REST APIs in production: HTTP, load balancing, caching, CDN, TLS, DNS and networking fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools (New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor or similar), including APM, log aggregation, distributed tracing, metrics and dashboards.
Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and build structure (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, TeamCity, GitLab or similar): able to read, debug and improve pipelines, artifact management and release strategies. Deep DevOps specialization is not required.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep or similar); configuration management experience (Ansible, Chef, Puppet) is a plus.
Solid experience in Python or a similar object-oriented or scripting language for automation.
Experience with microservices, distributed applications, containers (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless on Azure.
Strong debugging skills on Windows and Linux, including IIS and .NET application troubleshooting (memory, CPU, thread and connection analysis).
Experience supporting analytics/reporting platforms or data pipelines (for example Tableau administration, ETL/ELT jobs, queues or streaming) is a plus.
Working knowledge of cloud security principles (identity and access, secrets management, network security, vulnerability remediation).
Experience with incident management, on-call practices, RCA and postmortems; excellent written and verbal communication.
Experience with the full software development lifecycle and delivery using Agile practices.
Good to have: Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400) or equivalent.
Why Zenoti?
Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.
Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.
Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti's platform.
Attractive compensation.
Medical coverage for yourself and your immediate family.
Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions. We also include your family in benefit awareness initiatives.
Regular social activities, and opportunities to give back through social work and community initiatives.
Join Zenoti and be a part of our mission to empower wellness businesses worldwide!

Company Description
About Sopra Steria
Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.
The world is how we shape it.
Job Description
Technical Lead – Java, Spring Boot and React
Experience: 8 to 14 years
Location: Noida
Education: B.E./ B.Tech./ MCA
Job Responsibilities
Define the development plan and acceptance criteria based on requirements.
Design, build, test and maintain the new and existing features with high-performance, reusable, and reliable code.
Focus on achieving the best possible performance, quality, and uptime of the application by:
Identifying and solving bottlenecks or bugs.
Ensuring code with high quality, readability, and structure.
Implementing smart automation (when relevant).
Creating and updating technical documentation to ensure service continuity.
You embed agile and development best practices in your daily work.

Strong experience in below skill

At least 9 years of experience in Java J2EE
Strong experienc in Spring Boot, SOLID Principles
At least 4 years of experience in ReactJS
Strong experience in JavaScript,
Strong skills in SQL and Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL
Kubernetes/Openshift
DevOps Best practices
Tools: GITLAB/GITHUB, Maven
Good to have Skills:
Apache Kafka
Elastic Stack: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Beats
Reactive programming
Event sourcing
Jenkins
SonarQube
Fortify
IntelliJ
Additional Information
At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.
All of our positions are open to people with disabilities. Java J2EE Spring Boot ReactJS JavaScript SQL Oracle PostgreSQL Kubernetes Openshift DevOps Gitlab Github Maven Solid principles Requires 8 to 14 years of experience with strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and ReactJS. Candidates must hold a B.E., B.Tech., or MCA degree and possess experience with database management and DevOps practices.

title: Automotive Aftermarket Diagnostic Specialist, BAN
job_description:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Perform hands-on vehicle service, diagnostics, and troubleshooting in OEM dealerships/workshops
Develop automotive diagnostic content with minimum 2 years of hands-on experience
Map ESI standard texts to OEM texts for Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software
Create requirement specifications for Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software
Develop end-to-end diagnostic content for all automotive systems including engine management, electric & hybrid systems, brake control, infotainment, ADAS, transmission, HVAC, and airbags
Analyze vehicle communication bus logs using various analyzers
Simulate automotive systems using simulator solutions and in conjunction with OE testers
Design and create workflow or test sequences using IDEs like BDX or Grade-X
Evaluate OE diagnostic data, derive useful insights, and implement findings in target tester
Perform on-vehicle validation of implemented diagnostic content and create test reports
Conduct benchmarking and reverse engineering of aftersales & aftermarket diagnostic testers
Evaluate coverage of aftermarket tester by performing tests on various vehicle brands and systems across different markets and create test reports
Review deliverables thoroughly and provide recommendations
Engage in continuous learning and self-development
Collaborate closely with software engineering teams and technical experts from global teams
Travel to workshops and OE dealerships as needed for on-vehicle coverage, tracing, and release testing
Mandatory Qualifications:
Strong vehicle system knowledge, including sub-systems and components
Proven ability to diagnose and troubleshoot vehicles and make them roadworthy
Ability to understand OE system descriptions, service & repair manuals
Ability to independently handle diagnostic testers
Proficiency with diagnostic testers including VIDA, Xentry, GDS, ADT, SDT-II, DiagBox, HDS, Launch, Autel, G-Scan, and Zenith
Good knowledge of wiring diagrams and conventions
Good knowledge of Bosch Aftermarket Diagnostic Tool - ESI [tronic]
Sound knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, DoIP, UDS, and J1939
Good knowledge of BDX-Bosch Data Extension
Experience with analyzer & simulation tools from Vector or Samtec such as HSX and HS+
Ability to handle various OEM testers
Good to Have:
Knowledge or experience in programming languages
Qualifications
B.E/B. Tech, Automotive Engineering
Additional Information
3 to 6 Years

title: Lead Software Engineer - Java Backend
job_description:
We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you
can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment
Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build,
and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and
scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for
conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within
various business functions in support of the firm’s business objectives.

Job responsibilities

 * Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical
   troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional
   approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
 * Develops secure high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code
   written by others
 * Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering
   practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery
   speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring,
   test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while
   establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review,
   automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
 * Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle
   toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and
   automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
 * Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring
   issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and
   systems
 * Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams
   to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical
   credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and
   information architecture
 * Leads communities of practice across Software Engineering to drive awareness
   and use of new and leading-edge technologies

 

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

 * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+
   years applied experience 
 * Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application
   development, testing, and operational stability
 * Proficiency in back-end technologies (e.g., Java, Springboot, Node.js ) with
   experience building microservices-based applications; for full-stack roles,
   proficiency also includes front-end technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS,
   JavaScript, Typescript, React, Angular).
 * Demonstrated ability to independently solve design and functionality
   challenges with minimal supervision.
 * Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), distributed
   systems, and web technologies, including RESTful APIs and web services,
   WebSockets, and JSON.
 * Hands-on experience designing and building scalable applications using SQL
   and NoSQL databases.
 * Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted
   software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration,
   troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI
   outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
 * Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows,
   including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs,
   and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching
   engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
 * Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle including
   advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application
   Resiliency, and Security. 

 

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

 * Strong soft skills, including presentation, negotiation, mentoring, and
   stakeholder management.
 * Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
 * Ability to drive broader impact by sharing and contributing best practices.
 * AWS certification. Java Springboot Node.js Microservices Cloud platforms AWS Azure GCP RESTful APIs Webservices WebSockets JSON SQL NoSQL CI/CD Agile Candidates must have 5+ years of applied software engineering experience with proficiency in Java, Springboot, and microservices architecture. Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, database management, and the software development life cycle is required.

title: HR Data Coordinator
job_description:
HR Data Management Coordinator 
Short Description     
Build your HR career with Stantec in a role where your organizational strengths,
customer service mindset, and attention to detail will contribute to effective
HR service delivery. 
We have an HR Data Coordinator opportunity available within our HR Service
Center team supporting essential HR administrative activities, with primary
focus on the maintenance of our HR/candidate data records and files across
various countries and other HR administrative tasks as assigned.  
You will apply your organizational and time management skills, communicate with
employees and partners, and provide support across all levels of the
organization while managing a variety of data and administrative priorities in a
fast-paced, highly computerized environment. As part of a collaborative HR team,
you will support HR partners and employees across multiple time zones and help
deliver reliable, responsive service across the organization. 
Description     
•    Update and maintain employee records to ensure accurate data is entered,
verified and filed in various HR Management applications for employee life-cycle
changes following established processes and internal documentation. 
•    Process employee transactions, deliver HR services or other time sensitive
administrative activities in accordance with established processes, procedures,
internal compliance guidelines and operational metrics that support effective
service and best practices. 
•    Ensure appropriate documentation associated with the transaction is
complete with appropriate approvals prior to processing the transaction. 
•    Coordinate with HR teams, Payroll, and third-party vendors to resolve
service requests promptly. Troubleshoot when necessary and ensure timely
corrections are performed. 
•    Support data quality related projects, as assigned 
•    May perform other administrative tasks as assigned, such as file
management, professional qualification verifications, letter/notification
coordination, and Talent Acquisition tasks.
Your Capabilities and Credentials
•    Experience completing administrative tasks, including data entry, preparing
letters, correspondence, and related documentation. 
•    Strong professional customer service skills, with the flexibility to attend
meetings during North American time zone hours. 
•    Ability to follow standard methods and procedures to complete primarily
transactional work assignments. 
•    Strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, critical thinking
and problem-solving skills. 
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, paired with a
professional attitude; Fluency in English is required for this role.
•    Ability to stay focused, manage heavy workloads with concurrent deadlines,
and maintain close attention to detail.  You demonstrate flexibility and
dependability.
•    Comfort working with diverse individuals at all levels across a
geographically dispersed organization.
•    Strong professional customer service orientation
•    Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. 
•    Ability to exercise confidentiality, discretion, and sound judgment
•    Understanding of Data management best practices and principles 
•    Accurate typing and data entry skills
•    Ability to learn new processes quickly and adapt to changing priorities. 
•    Knowledge of software applications necessary to process documents, employee
data information and analytics tools (Word, Excel, Oracle / HRIS system (Oracle
is preferred), Mail Systems, and Internet). Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills
with advanced Excel experience is an asset for this role.
•    Ability to work independently and consistently meet role objectives. 
 

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience
•    Bachelor/Master’s degree in commerce, Arts, HR or equivalent experience
with HR course work is preferred.
•    Proven 1-3 years of data entry or HR/Talent Acquisition working experience.
•    Basic/working knowledge of HR/Talent Acquisition practices, employee
information systems, regulations, programs, and philosophies

title: NETWORK CONSULTANT I-INDIA
job_description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Main Responsibilities
Resolving first, second and third level support problems; 75% of which will be resolved without escalation.
Escalating to the relevant Engineering team as required, promptly following procedures and ensuring management is updated accordingly.
Ensuring the customer and ticket is up to date at all times on incident progress.
Maintain, troubleshoot and co-ordinate replacement of faulty hardware.
Involved in the execution of client change requests in a timely manner as planned by Customer Account Manager, Engineering and Command Centre Manager.
Escalation of critical issues/outages to Command Centre Manager and Customer Account Manager as per procedures.
Provide detailed feedback to other groups on all incident resolutions, ensuring full details are entered into ticket case notes.
Daily review and action of open cases; updating Command Centre Manager on current cases and their status as appropriate.
To provide comprehensive handovers to peers at the end of shift.
Attend Daily Operations and Change Review meetings as required.
Logging cases to 3rd party vendors requesting assistance on unresolved issues.
What We Look For in a Candidate
Confident and Professional dealing directly with customers.
Outgoing team player with the ability to liaise with other team members and take the lead on decision making.
Positive and Pro Active attitude.
Working knowledge/understanding of Microsoft products.
Troubleshooting basic Server problems.
Ability to work under pressure.
Supportive and committed team player.
Experience of using Ticket Management tools.
Escalations are performed within the SLA timescales.
Good commutations with customers is required throughout incident lifecycles.
Engineering and Senior Management are kept abreast of appropriate escalations.
Analytical skills.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Be organized and be able to work under pressure.
Detailed working knowledge of a range of networking and security technologies, including:
Cisco switches and routers
Azure networking (vNets, Virtual WAN, HUB, VPN sites etc...) and security (NSG etc…)
Lenovo Switches
F5 Big-IP load balancers, Kemp LB,
Check Point and Endpoint Servers.
Sophos Firewalls.
Cisco WIFI technology.
Good knowledge in Bluecoat Proxy, Meraki Devices
SD-WAN (Multi Vendor) 
RSA Server Management.
Able to demonstrate understanding of key networking concepts, including:
TCP/IP
Layer 2 and layer 3 switching and routing
Routing protocols such as BGP, EIGRP and OSPF
Security solutions such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, and SSL Certificates
Load balancing best practices
Radius/NPS setup and administration.
In-depth troubleshooting and strong analytical skills.

We do not tolerate unlawful discrimination in any employment decisions, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, benefits, discipline, termination, job assignments or training.

If you encounter any job offers that request payment in exchange for employment at Lumen, they are not for employment with us, but may relate to another company with a similar name. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work under pressure in a high-accountability environment are essential.

title: Talent Account Executive [Chennai]
job_description:
Company Description
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
Join us to transform the way the world works.
Job Description
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is remote, meaning it will be performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval. 
We are seeking a driven Account Executive to unlock client opportunities and generate new business. You will manage the full sales cycle — from prospecting and discovery to solutioning and closing — while consistently acting in the best interest of the client. Success in this role requires agility, disciplined prospecting, deep discovery skills, and a relentless drive to exceed quota.
Key Responsibilities
Territory Ownership & Prospecting
Own and actively manage a defined book of business.
Research accounts to uncover triggers, buying centers, and whitespace opportunities.
Prioritize accounts strategically based on potential, readiness, and fit.
Build a healthy, predictable pipeline aligned to the ideal customer profile.
Customer Engagement & Discovery
Conduct deep discovery conversations with decision makers and influencers.
Multi-thread across functions and engage CXO-level stakeholders.
Understand client needs, challenges, budgets, and success metrics.
Travel approximately 40% to meet clients and prospects face-to-face.
Solutioning, Negotiation & Closing
Consult with customers to recommend tailored recruitment solutions.
Build compelling value narratives for each account.
Negotiate effectively and close new business consistently at or above quota.
Maintain disciplined follow-up to ensure predictable deal progression.
Forecasting & Pipeline Management
Deliver accurate, reliable forecasts with full transparency on risks and upside.
Drive consistency in top-of-funnel activities to avoid pipeline gaps.
Communicate pipeline status clearly to management.
Strategic Planning & Market Intelligence
Develop and execute a strategic territory plan.
Document and share competitive intelligence and market insights.
Provide structured feedback to product and marketing teams based on client needs.
Team Contribution & Leadership
Coach, collaborate and support colleagues by sharing feedback and best practices.
Proactively solve problems beyond defined responsibilities.
Lead initiatives that strengthen team capability and support company objectives.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently exceeding quota while building long-term client trust.
Driving CXO-level conversations that lead to strategic partnerships.
Contributing to team growth through collaboration, coaching, and leadership.
Acting as a trusted advisor who aligns LinkedIn’s solutions with client goals.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications: 
3+ years of applicable sales experience 
Preferred Qualifications: 
MBA or Equivalent degree
Solution selling 
Ability to multithread and sell to different business stakeholders 
Experience in selling SaaS solutions ,Field Sales 
Experience in handling CRM 
Demonstrate ability in managing CXO relationships and large enterprise accounts 
Knowledge of software contract terms and conditions with the ability to create fair transactions 
Ability to negotiation and accurate forecasting skills 
Highly agile and self driven.
Experience in research and account planning skills
Consultative selling mindset with strong executive presence
Disciplined in execution with a clear hunger to win and grow
Open to continuous learning and committed to personal and team success.
Demonstrated ability to find, manage and close high-level business in an evangelist sales environment 
Ability to assess business opportunities and use data to inform decision making and persuade others 
Ability to manage a large number of prospect situations simultaneously while positioning company products against direct and indirect competitors 
Suggested Skills: 
Negotiation 
Forecasting 
Communication

LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy_India_EqualOppPWD_9-12-2023.pdf

title: Dir-Catering Sales
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Functions as the business leader of the property’s Catering Sales Department and
manages the property's reactive and proactive catering sales efforts. Shares
responsibility for achieving revenue goals, guest and associate satisfaction and
the financial performance of the department. Implements the brand’s service
strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process.
Provides day to day leadership to a team of on-property catering sales
associates. Partners with key stakeholders within Area Sales to receive warms
leads for more in-depth qualification of the business for the property. Partners
with Event Management and hotel operations to sell products and services that
the hotel has the ability to successfully execute. Verifies a seamless turnover
from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering a high
level of service. Maintains accountability for verifying that the team maximizes
revenue opportunities by up-selling and accurately forecasting (e.g., catering
and group rooms) for all events.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

 

Required:

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration,
Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience
in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and
Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and
marketing or related professional area.

 

Preferred:

• 4 year college degree.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Managing Sales Activities

• Manages the catering sales efforts for the hotel including local and
group/convention business.

• Solicits/books local catering business and develops group business.

• Develops and manages catering sales revenue and operation budgets, and
provides forecasting reports.

• Works with the management team to create and implement a catering
sales/marketing plan addressing revenue, customers and market.

• Develops menus that drive sales.

• Assists with selling, implementation and follow-through of catering
promotions.

• Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand
Standards.

• Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g.,
generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

• Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g.,,
Marriott Hotels & Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance Hotels
and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield
Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning
Meeting).

• Coordinates and deploys catering sales resources on-property to establish
pull-through and sustainment of catering sales strategies and selling solutions.
Develops a close working relationship with operations to execute strategies at
the hotel level.

• Verifies that the property implements a seamless turnover from sales to
operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of
service.

• Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of
the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property
leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.

• Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses
and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.

• Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in
all aspects of the sales process.

• Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

 

Building Successful Relationships

• Interacts effectively with guests/clients, sales and kitchen, vendors,
competitors, local community, catering associations and other hotel departments
in order to monitor guest satisfaction.

• Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty
by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during
their program/event.

• Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the
appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their
expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.

• Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service
expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business
issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during
the program/event.

• Partners with key stakeholders within Area Sales to receive warms leads for
more in-depth qualification of the business for the property.

• Partners with Event Management and hotel operations to sell products and
services that the hotel has the ability to successfully execute.

 

Leadership

• Manages and directs the on-property catering sales managers to achieve hotel
revenue goals by proactively targeting current and new high value accounts in
the market and implementing effective catering sales deployment strategies to
grow market share.

• Partners with Human Resources (HR) to attract, develop and retain the right
people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.

• Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management
systems are in place.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership
Performance Process (LPP), align performance and rewards, addresses performance
issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.

• Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with HR to
minimize lost time due to turnover.

• Keeps an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a
recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.

• Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning
catering solutions.

• Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by
assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that
can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the
future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to
anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.

• Identifies, trains and mentors catering sales associates.

• Transfers functional knowledge and develop catering sales skills of other
discipline managers.

• Shares responsibility for achieving revenue goals, guest and associate
satisfaction and the financial performance of the department.

• Provides day to day leadership to a team of on-property catering sales
associates.

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


At Westin, we are committed to empowering guests to regain control and enhance
their well-being when they need it most while traveling, ensuring they can be
the best version of themselves. To achieve the brand mission of becoming the
preeminent wellness brand in hospitality, we need passionate and engaged
associates to bring the brand’s unique programming to life. We want our
associates to embrace their own well-being practices both on and off property.
You are the ideal Westin candidate if you are passionate; you are active and
take pride in how you maintain your well-being; you are optimistic; you are
adventurous. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to
an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. Catering Sales Revenue Management Team Leadership Strategic Planning Budgeting Forecasting Customer Service Relationship Management Sales Strategy Event Management Marketing Talent Acquisition Performance Management Contract Negotiation Upselling Candidates must possess a 2-year degree with 4 years of experience or a 4-year bachelor's degree with 2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related professional area. Strong leadership, strategic planning, and communication skills are required to manage catering sales teams and drive business growth.

title: Project Manager
job_description:
Overview
Overview
The Client Enablement Manager will own the end-to-end client journey for OneSuite, our AI-powered marketing platform, from onboarding and implementation through adoption and long-term success. The role acts as the bridge between clients and internal Product, Engineering, Marketing and Operations teams, ensuring successful delivery, stakeholder alignment, AI adoption and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Client Onboarding & Enablement
Own end-to-end onboarding from account setup through successful go-live.
Configure client accounts, user roles and permissions.
Develop onboarding plans and ensure timely implementation.
Deliver tailored training sessions for business and technical users.
Create onboarding guides, knowledge base articles, FAQs and documentation.
Client Success & Adoption
Drive platform adoption and long-term client success.
Monitor usage metrics and identify adoption gaps.
Conduct regular client reviews and recommend new platform capabilities.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders.
Product & Delivery Management
Coordinate multiple client implementations and enablement initiatives.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Creative, Finance and Operations teams.
Track timelines, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones.
Support Agile delivery methodologies including Scrum ceremonies and backlog prioritization.
Ensure quality documentation, reporting and governance throughout delivery.
AI Enablement
Enable clients to leverage AI-powered capabilities within the platform.
Promote AI-driven workflow automation and productivity improvements.
Capture client feedback to influence future product enhancements.
Qualifications
Skills & Experience
Required Experience: 5–10 years
Must Have
5–10 years of experience in Client Success, Product Management, Project/Program Management, Customer Enablement or SaaS implementation.
Experience leading enterprise client onboarding and adoption programs.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience working with Agile/Scrum environments.
Knowledge of digital marketing, MarTech or advertising technology.
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or Confluence.
Excellent communication, presentation and documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent client engagements.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve delivery, reporting, documentation or workflow efficiency.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with AI-powered platforms.
Exposure to GitHub/GitLab.
Background in content strategy or knowledge management.
Experience working with global stakeholders and distributed teams.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or related discipline. Client Success Product Management Project Management SaaS Implementation Stakeholder Management Agile Scrum Digital Marketing MarTech JIRA Azure DevOps Confluence AI Tools Workflow Automation Documentation Communication Candidates must have 5-10 years of experience in client success, product management, or SaaS implementation. Strong skills in stakeholder management, Agile methodologies, and knowledge of MarTech or AI-powered platforms are required.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

If slice is a galaxy, the Fraud Investigators are the Guardians, keeping us all
safe while having a lot of fun doing that. To define in fancy words, the fraud
investigation team scrutinizes potential suspicious activities. If you're one
whose nose starts to itch or hair stands up when something isn't right, to whom
talking to people and looking at patterns comes naturally, this team is
tailor-made for you. 




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 * Perform thorough and objective investigation of potential fraud activity on
   slice products. 

 * Close review of Fraud incidents received from different channels & conduct
   the investigation immediately. 

 * Take ownership on gathering all possible information while investigating
   incidents. 

 * Initiate urgent actions as and when required to prevent future financial &
   reputational loss. 

 * Monitor fraud alerts daily and take necessary action. 

 * Identify fraud patterns and modus operandi from the investigation and share
   insights with analytics team. 

 * Coordinate with analytics team, product team and other stakeholders. 

 * Recommend new methods/tools to improve operational efficiency and
   investigation quality. 

 * Plan & execute case investigation and complete investigation reports in an
   accurate manner as per defined timelines.  


WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

 * 0-1 years of working experience in Fraud operations & Investigation.
   (Banking/Fintech organization only). 

 * Comfortable in making decision and judgement. 

 * Graduate degree in any relevant field. 

 * Presentable (as you will need to talk to customers as a part of the
   investigation). 

 * Street smart and ability to detect patterns. 

 * You should be fluent in English & Hindi. 


LIFE AT SLICE: 

Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:  

 * Competitive salaries. Period.  

 * An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their
   dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.  

 * Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep
   schedule.  

 * Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment
   in your life.     

 * A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year.
   Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.   

 * Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.  

 * Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An
   environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your
   friends”. 

We believe in equality. Period. 



At slice, we are committed to building a diverse and talented workforce. We
never discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, colour, national origin,
gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran
status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic
protected by the applicable law. 



We consider all qualified job-seekers with criminal histories in a manner 
consistent with the applicable law. Additionally, we are committed to providing
reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with physical or mental
disabilities in order to participate in the job application or interview
process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits
and privileges of employment. 



Come join our crew!

title: Senior Data Technician
job_description:
Overview
Role Summary The Data Analyst is a key role within the reporting and analytics workstream, responsible for supporting the development, maintenance, and quality assurance of Power BI dashboards. This role focuses on transforming data into clear, accurate, and actionable insights for internal teams and client stakeholders. You will work closely with data, analytics, and business teams to validate datasets, troubleshoot reporting issues, and ensure dashboards are reliable, well structured, and aligned with business requirements.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities Dashboard Development & Maintenance: • Support the development, maintenance, and quality assurance of Power BI dashboards • Translate business requirements into clear dashboard views, metrics, filters, and reporting outputs that support decision-making Data Management & Validation: • Manage and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and readiness for analysis and reporting. • Perform regular data quality checks, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues. • Investigate reporting anomalies, validate calculations, and support root-cause analysis to maintain data integrity. • Document and maintain data definitions, business logic, methodologies, and source changes to ensure transparency and consistency. • Support the ongoing improvement of data processes, reporting outputs, and analytical solutions to enhance data reliability and usability. Collaboration & Stakeholder Support: • Work closely with analytics, data governance, media, and client teams to gather requirements, validate outputs, and ensure dashboards answer key business questions. • Provide clear updates on data issues, dashboard changes, and reporting timelines to support smooth delivery and stakeholder confidence.
Qualifications
Skills & Experience • 5–6 years of experience in data analytics, reporting, dashboard development, or a similar data-focused role • Strong experience working with Power BI dashboards, including dashboard development, maintenance, data validation, and performance troubleshooting. • Experience in data modelling, star schema design, and dashboard performance optimisation • Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to query, join, validate, and analyse large datasets across multiple data sources. • Good working knowledge of Power Query and DAX to support data modelling, measure creation, transformations, and dashboard logic. • Experience working with Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms to access, validate, and prepare data for reporting. • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, complex formulas, pivot tables, and structured reporting outputs. • Experience using Microsoft Copilot or AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, documentation, workflow efficiency, and reporting support. • Python knowledge is a plus, particularly for data analysis, automation, or data quality checks. • Knowledge of media data, including media investment, performance, PCA, taxonomy, ideally within an agency or client-side environment. • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work with stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve data issues. Power BI Data Analysis SQL Data Modeling Star Schema Design Power Query DAX Databricks Excel Microsoft Copilot Python Data Validation Reporting Data Quality Assurance Business Logic Media Data Candidates must have 5–6 years of experience in data analytics and dashboard development with strong proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and data modeling. Experience with cloud-based platforms like Databricks and advanced Excel skills are required to support complex reporting and data integrity.

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
Overview
The Role:
The Data Engineer will play a critical role in seamlessly integrating new clients into our performance marketing platform. This individual will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines that enable efficient client data ingestion, transformation, and integration across various marketing channels. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in cloud-based data engineering, exceptional problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work closely with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding experiences.
Responsibilities
Key Accountability:
Design and implement scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Databricks, alongside AWS services (S3, Athena, Glue, Lambda), to support client onboarding across multiple marketing channels.
Develop and maintain API integrations with marketing platforms including Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Ads API, and third-party systems using OAuth 2.0 authentication.
Build robust web applications and microservices using Python and Flask to support client onboarding workflows and automated data processing tasks.
Manage cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments using AWS services, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and scalable client integrations.
Design database schemas and optimize SQL queries for efficient data storage, retrieval, and transformation across PostgreSQL and MySQL, and model data in DynamoDB for scalable NoSQL workloads.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. Job Description
Role Overview
We are seeking an Automotive Systems Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Engineer to diagnose vehicle systems independently, troubleshoot and repair electrical systems, and create comprehensive guided troubleshooting content for automotive applications.
Core Responsibilities
Diagnose electronic, mechanical, and electrical system problems in vehicles using industry-standard testers and diagnostic tools, including OBD-II scanners, multimeters, and oscilloscopes

Conduct comprehensive vehicle testing, including individual component testing and system validation

Understand automotive electrical system wiring diagrams, wire color codes, connectors, components, and their functionalities, including symbols and DIN standards
Apply proficiency with tools, equipment, and procedures related to component removal and refit to create informative instructional content

Experience with OE testers and OE descriptions

Hybrid and Electric Vehicle Systems certification (Level 2 and Level 3)
Qualifications

3 to 13 Years

title: Buying Specialist - Senior
job_description:
Job Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for executing sourcing and procurement
strategies that deliver optimal cost, quality, delivery, and supplier
performance while supporting business objectives. This role manages regional
commodities aligned to global category strategies, develops supplier
relationships, conducts sourcing and market analysis, mitigates supply risks,
and drives continuous improvement initiatives. The position collaborates closely
with cross-functional teams and suppliers to ensure a resilient supply base,
support global procurement initiatives, and optimize total cost of ownership.

Key Responsibilities
 * Execute sourcing and procurement strategies for direct materials, inventory
   items, capital goods, and services in alignment with global category
   strategies.
 * Manage assigned commodity portfolios, including casting, forging, stamping,
   and other manufacturing categories, ensuring optimal supplier performance and
   cost competitiveness.
 * Conduct supplier sourcing, supplier selection, Request for Quotation (RFQ),
   eBids, RapidSource activities, and tactical sourcing initiatives.
 * Perform supplier evaluation, price benchmarking, cost analysis, market
   intelligence, and industry analysis to identify cost reduction and value
   improvement opportunities.
 * Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships aligned with approved
   Category Partner Lists while ensuring supplier performance meets business
   expectations.
 * Lead supplier negotiations within approved commercial frameworks to achieve
   favorable pricing, quality, delivery, and contractual terms.
 * Monitor supplier performance, quality, delivery, capacity, and responsiveness
   while driving supplier development and continuous improvement initiatives.
 * Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks by implementing supplier
   risk management strategies, dual sourcing, and business continuity plans.
 * Support supplier tooling management, ensuring compliance with Cummins tooling
   ownership procedures, documentation, and lifecycle management.
 * Analyze procurement data, spend trends, supplier performance metrics, and
   market conditions to support data-driven sourcing decisions.
 * Prepare procurement reports, presentations, and business recommendations for
   procurement and supply chain leadership.
 * Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality, finance, logistics, and
   global procurement teams to support new product introductions and sourcing
   initiatives.
 * Ensure compliance with Cummins procurement policies, sourcing procedures,
   ethical standards, and Source-to-Pay processes.
 * Support purchase requisition approvals and ensure timely procurement
   execution to meet operational requirements.
 * Lead or participate in procurement improvement projects while coaching and
   supporting less experienced team members.


RESPONSIBILITIES


QUALIFICATIONS

 * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply
   Chain Management, or a related discipline is required.
 * MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or
   Procurement is preferred.
 * Knowledge of Casting, Forging, and Stamping commodities is preferred.
 * This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or
   sanctions regulations.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


SKILLS


TECHNICAL SKILLS

 * Strategic sourcing and global procurement
 * Commodity management
 * Supplier relationship management
 * Supplier risk management
 * Casting, forging, and stamping commodity knowledge
 * Global sourcing and supplier development
 * RFQ management and supplier evaluation
 * Contract negotiation and commercial management
 * Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis
 * Price benchmarking and cost analysis
 * Spend analysis and procurement analytics
 * Market intelligence and supplier market research
 * Source-to-Pay (S2P) process knowledge
 * Procurement systems and procurement documentation
 * Supplier tooling management
 * Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and procurement reporting tools


PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

 * Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
 * Commercial acumen and negotiation capability
 * Excellent stakeholder and supplier relationship management
 * Cross-functional collaboration
 * Effective communication and presentation skills
 * Project and priority management
 * Risk assessment and mitigation
 * Continuous improvement mindset
 * Leadership and coaching ability
 * High ethical standards and procurement governance awareness
 * Ability to work in a global, multicultural environment


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 * 8–14 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply
   chain, or commodity management within a manufacturing or industrial
   environment. Exceptional candidates with slightly less experience may also be
   considered.
 * Experience managing global procurement activities and international supplier
   networks is preferred.
 * Hands-on experience with casting, forging, stamping, or similar manufacturing
   commodities is highly desirable.
 * Proven experience in supplier negotiations, supplier development, and cost
   optimization initiatives.
 * Experience performing supplier risk assessments, business continuity
   planning, and supply base risk management.
 * Strong background in procurement analytics, market analysis, price
   benchmarking, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) evaluation.
 * Experience collaborating with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and global
   cross-functional teams to deliver sourcing strategies and operational
   excellence.


Cummins is an equal opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal
employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, sex,
color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual
orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity, or other status
protected by law. Procurement Sourcing Supply Chain Management Supplier Relationship Management Market Analysis Risk Mitigation Commodity Management Strategic Sourcing Cost Optimization Manufacturing Casting Forging Stamping Continuous Improvement Cross-functional Collaboration The role requires experience in managing manufacturing commodities such as casting, forging, and stamping. Candidates must be capable of conducting market analysis and driving continuous improvement initiatives within a global procurement framework.
