title: Director of Sales & Marketing
job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with
bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the
property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership
to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall
responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the
brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the
sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer
relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area
Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and
develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the
property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property
specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property
objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and
national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide
strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and
expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and
provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

 

Required:

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration,
Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience
in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and
Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and
marketing or related professional area.

 

Preferred:

• 4 year college degree.

• Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.

• Lodging sales experience.

• Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a
pattern of exceptional performance. 
 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Managing Sales Activities

• Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators
in the market.

• Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.

• Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction
with Regional Marketing Communications.

• Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends
that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer
expectations.

• Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping
reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market
position.

• Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow
occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.

• Attends sales strategy meetings to provide input on weekly and overall sales
strategy.

• Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to
continue to grow market share.

• Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales
and Group Sales within the Sales Office.

• Serves as the sales contact for the General Manager, property leadership team,
Group Sales and Area Sales leaders.

• Serves as the sales contact for customers; serves as the customer advocate.

• Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.

• Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue
Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel
departments as appropriate.

• Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to
acquire new business and/or close on business.

• Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to
augment the overall marketing communication strategy.

• Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.

• Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand
Standards.

• Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g.,
generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

• Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g., ,
Marriott Hotels and Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance
Hotels and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites,
Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace
Suites Morning Meeting).

• Implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales
while consistently delivering high level of service.

• Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of
the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property
leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.

• Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses
and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.

• Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in
all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based
customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.

• Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national
promotions pull through.

• Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

 

Building Successful Relationships

• Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase
brand/product awareness.

• Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.

• Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property
participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.

• Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty
by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during
their program/event.

• Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the
appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their
expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.

• Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service
expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business
issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during
the program/event.

 

Leadership

• Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with
bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.

• Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand
business strategy.

• Executes the sales strategy in order to meet individual booking goals for both
self and staff.

• Coaches leaders of revenue generating departments in developing effective
revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that will drive the property's
financial performance.

• Verifies Sales team understands and is leveraging Marriott International (MI)
demand engines to full potential.

• Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to monitor
compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.

• Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people
in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.

• Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management
systems are in place.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership
Performance Process (LPP), aligns performance and rewards, addresses performance
issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.

• Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with Human
Resources (HR) to minimize lost time due to turnover.

• Maintains an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a
recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.

• Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning
catering solutions.

• Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by
assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that
can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the
future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to
anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.

• Identifies, trains and mentors group sales associates; utilizes all available
on the job training tools for associates.

• Transfers functional knowledge and develops group sales skills of other
discipline managers.

• Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales
objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property
revenues.

• Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g.,
Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.)
and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the
property.

• Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific
campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property
objectives.

 

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity
employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster
an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and
celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and
experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any
protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected
by applicable law.


When you join the Sheraton family, you become a member of its global community.
We’ve been a place to gather and connect since 1937. At Sheraton, associates
create a sense of belonging in more than 400 communities around the world. We
invite, we welcome, and we connect guests through engaging experiences and
thoughtful service. If you’re a team player who is excited to
deliver a meaningful guest experience, we encourage you to explore your next
career opportunity with Sheraton. Join us on our mission to be ‘The World’s
Gathering Place’. In joining Sheraton Hotels & Resorts, you join a portfolio of
brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,
 begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global  team, and become the best
version of you. Sales strategy Marketing management Team leadership Revenue management Customer relationship management Strategic planning Budget management Public relations Market analysis Talent acquisition Performance management Hospitality management Contract negotiation Crisis communication Account management Candidates must have a 2-year or 4-year degree in Business, Marketing, or Hotel Management, combined with 2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated skills in team supervision and a background in the hotel or lodging industry are required.

Candidate should ensure proper coordination and communication with all stakeholders by following project management best practices.This position is responsible for handling medium complex technologies related to conjugate heat transfer,flow estimtion & electronics cooling wherein incumbent is expected to independently handle requirements and deliver quality results within stipulated timelines.

title: Warranty Analyst
job_description:
1. The Warranty Supplier Recovery Engineer is responsible for recovering the
    warranty spend amount from NA suppliers ( for supplier parts failures in
    Ford vehicles built in NA & sold globally) for allocated commodity ( Eg :
    Power train, Electrical, Interior , Underbody, Exterior). 
 2. Responsibilities include sending the monthly debit packs/warranty claims to
    suppliers and needs to manage supplier responses/queries through
    emails/meetings.
 3. In the event of supplier disputes, they need to work with Ford PD/Product
    Development team to resolve it.
 4. Negotiate with suppliers to get better share rate % / recovery for Ford. 
 5. If supplier wants physical parts for analysis, they need to coordinate and
    ship samples to suppliers. They must get failure/root cause analysis report
    from suppliers to prevent failure recurrence. 
 6. Responsible to implement efficiency innovation projects through automation
    of manual reports if any by utilizing data analytical tools. 
 7. Overall, the intent of this team to get recovery for Ford and to improve
    suppliers’ parts quality thereby increasing retention at Ford network. 

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

       Mandatory Skills:

 1. Good communication (both oral & written), presentation and Interpersonal
    skills.
 2. Data Analytics/Software & Technology skills (like Python, Power Automate,
    Power Apps, Power BI etc.,)
 3. Technical/Engineering skills.
 4. Passion to acquire new skills. 

 

Preferred Skills:

 4. Negotiation & supplier handling skills.
 5. Advanced computer skills (e.g. Excel Macros, Pivot table, conditional
    formulas, analytics etc.)
 6. Analytical & Problem solving.
 7. Collaboration.


QUALIFICATIONS

BE (Mechanical/Automobile/Mechatronics/EEE/ECE) & MBA (preferred but not
mandatory)

Min 4~5 years of relevant work experience in automotive industry.  Warranty analysis Supplier recovery Data analytics Python Power automate Power apps Power BI Engineering Negotiation Supplier management Excel macros Pivot tables Problem solving Collaboration Communication Presentation Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automobile, Mechatronics, EEE, or ECE engineering with 4-5 years of relevant automotive industry experience. Proficiency in data analytics tools like Python, Power BI, and advanced Excel is required, along with strong communication and negotiation skills.

title: Lead - Design Engineering
job_description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Engineering Leadership & Design Ownership

 * Lead the detailed engineering and design development of complex
   Infrastructure Solutions projects.
 * Own the technical coordination and engineering execution of assigned customer
   projects from solution handover through engineering release.
 * Translate approved solution architectures, customer requirements and
   conceptual designs into detailed and executable engineering solutions.
 * Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines,
   including mechanical, electrical, structural and controls engineering.
 * Ensure engineering designs are technically sound, complete, manufacturable,
   installable and aligned with project requirements.
 * Lead engineering design reviews and ensure appropriate technical decisions
   are made throughout the design lifecycle.
 * Identify technical risks, design gaps and integration issues early and drive
   appropriate resolution.
 * Ensure consistency and technical alignment across all engineering
   deliverables.

Detailed Engineering & Design Development

 * Lead and coordinate the development of engineering deliverables including:
 * General arrangement and equipment layout drawings.
 * Site and system layouts.
 * Mechanical and thermal infrastructure designs.
 * Electrical system designs and power distribution concepts.
 * Electrical single-line diagrams.
 * Equipment integration and interface drawings.
 * Structural and support requirements.
 * Cable routing and containment concepts.
 * Equipment sizing and system dimensioning.
 * Bills of materials.
 * Technical specifications.
 * Design calculations and engineering documentation.
 * Installation and interface requirements.
 * Customer-specific design documentation.
 * Ensure that engineering outputs accurately reflect:
 * Customer requirements.
 * Approved solution architecture.
 * Applicable engineering standards and codes.
 * Manufacturing capabilities.
 * Installation and site constraints.
 * Serviceability and maintainability requirements.
 * Project schedule and commercial requirements.

Multi-Disciplinary Engineering Coordination

 * Coordinate engineering activities across Mechanical, Electrical, Structural,
   Controls and other relevant engineering teams.
 * Ensure effective integration of company products and third-party equipment
   into the overall solution.
 * Manage technical interfaces between multiple systems, suppliers and
   engineering disciplines.
 * Resolve design conflicts and technical dependencies between systems.
 * Work closely with Solutions Architects to clarify technical intent and
   maintain alignment with the original customer solution.
 * Engage Product Engineering teams when product modifications, customization or
   new engineering development is required.
 * Coordinate with external engineering consultants and suppliers where
   required.

Design Review, Quality & Compliance

 * Lead technical design reviews at appropriate stages of project development.
 * Review and approve engineering documentation and drawings within delegated
   authority.
 * Ensure design outputs meet required quality standards before release.
 * Verify compliance with applicable local regulations, engineering standards
   and customer specifications.
 * Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Installation (DFI) and
   Design for Serviceability principles.
 * Identify opportunities to standardize designs and improve engineering
   efficiency.
 * Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into future designs and
   engineering standards.

Customer & Project Support

 * Provide technical support during customer design reviews and engineering
   discussions.
 * Participate in customer meetings when detailed engineering expertise is
   required.
 * Support clarification of technical requirements and resolution of
   engineering-related customer queries.
 * Work closely with Project Management to ensure engineering deliverables are
   aligned with project schedules and milestones.
 * Support technical issue resolution during manufacturing, installation,
   commissioning and project execution.
 * Provide engineering support for design changes and variations during the
   project lifecycle.

Engineering Process Improvement & Standardization

 * Drive continuous improvement in design engineering processes, tools and
   methodologies.
 * Develop and improve engineering standards, design guidelines and reusable
   solution modules.
 * Identify opportunities for standardization and modularization of
   Infrastructure Solutions.
 * Support the development of engineering templates, design libraries and
   standard engineering documentation.
 * Improve engineering quality, cycle time and first-time-right design
   performance.
 * Promote effective use of engineering tools and digital design platforms.

Technical Leadership & People Development

 * Provide technical leadership and guidance to Design Engineers and other
   engineering team members.
 * Mentor and develop engineering talent within the Infrastructure Solutions
   organization.
 * Support capability development across relevant engineering disciplines.
 * Act as a technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
 * Foster a collaborative engineering culture across functions and geographies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical
   Engineering or a related Engineering discipline.
 * Typically 10–15+ years of progressive engineering experience in data center
   infrastructure, mission-critical infrastructure, industrial systems or
   integrated engineering solutions.
 * Demonstrated experience leading the engineering and detailed design of
   complex multi-disciplinary projects.
 * Strong understanding of integrated Mechanical and Electrical infrastructure
   systems.
 * Experience working with complex engineered-to-order or customized solutions.
 * Experience in design engineering for data centers, modular infrastructure,
   mission-critical facilities or similar environments is strongly preferred.
 * Strong understanding of engineering drawings, specifications, calculations
   and technical documentation.
 * Experience coordinating engineering activities across multiple technical
   disciplines.
 * Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making capabilities.
 * Experience working with Manufacturing, Project Management, Supply Chain and
   Product Engineering teams.
 * Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
 * Ability to communicate complex technical issues to engineering and
   non-engineering stakeholders.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 * Experience in data center infrastructure solutions.
 * Experience with modular or prefabricated infrastructure solutions.
 * Experience with integrated power and thermal infrastructure.
 * Experience in Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) engineering
   coordination.
 * Experience working with data center OEMs, EPC organizations, engineering
   consultancies or mission-critical infrastructure providers.
 * Experience with CAD and engineering design tools.
 * Experience with global engineering teams and international projects.
 * Experience leading engineering teams or technical workstreams.

 


The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to
help execute our Strategic Priorities.

title: Principal Engineer – SoC Physical Verification Engineer
job_description: We are seeking an experienced SoC Physical Verification Engineer to drive physical verification signoff for next-generation logic, memory-centric SoCs, and advanced-node designs. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring tapeout-ready silicon through comprehensive DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC, DFM, reliability verification, and manufacturability signoff, while collaborating closely with Physical Design, CAD, RTL, Product Engineering, EDA vendors, and foundry teams. This role requires a strong hands-on technical leader who can drive methodology, execution, and signoff while collaborating closely with Architecture, BUMP, RDL routing and PD team collaboration. Key Responsibilities · Own and drive full-chip and hierarchical / block physical verification signoff, including DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC, Antenna, DFM, Density, Metal Fill, CMP, and Reliability Checks. Debug, customize, and deploy foundry-qualified rule decks, manage waivers, and ensure clean signoff closure for advanced-node designs. Perform reliability verification including ESD, Latch-up, Electromigration (EM), Floating Nets, Multi-Power Domain, and Connectivity Checks. Support parasitic RC extraction and correlation of verification results with implementation and silicon measurements. Develop and maintain physical verification automation, regression infrastructure, scripting frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows. Work closely with PD, CAD, RTL, Product Engineering, EDA vendors, and foundries (including direct TSMC interaction) from project kick-off through tapeout. Required / Preferred Qualifications · Experience in full-chip or block-level physical verification for advanced-node SoCs, memory, or heterogeneous integration designs. Strong expertise in DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC, DFM, Antenna, Reliability Verification, and Physical Verification Signoff Methodologies. Experience in advanced technology nodes including 22nm, 16nm, 7nm, 5nm, and below. Good understanding of RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows, extraction methodologies, and physical design impacts on verification closure. Strong debugging, analysis, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Familiarity with AI-assisted development and verification workflows. Experience with DRAM, Memory-Centric SoCs, Chiplets, 2.5D/3D IC Integration. Background in CPU, GPU, High-Performance Computing Designs. Knowledge of advanced-node FEOL/BEOL rules, foundry design manuals, and DFM methodologies. Exposure to post-silicon debug, yield analysis, and silicon correlation activities. MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. Experience developing automation using Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar scripting languages Tools Required · Physical Verification: Mentor Calibre (DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC, DFM), Synopsys IC Validator (ICV), Cadence Pegasus. · Implementation & Extraction: Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus, Synopsys StarRC, Cadence Quantus. · Automation & Analysis: Python, Tcl, Perl, AI/ML-enabled verification frameworks, and regression infrastructure development tools. Physical Verification DRC LVS ERC PERC DFM Reliability Verification SoC Design Advanced-node Design Python Tcl Perl Mentor Calibre Synopsys IC Validator Cadence Pegasus RTL-to-GDSII Candidates must have extensive experience in physical verification for advanced-node SoCs and expertise in industry-standard tools like Calibre, ICV, or Pegasus. A Master's or PhD in Electrical or Computer Engineering is required, along with strong scripting skills in Python, Tcl, or Perl.

title: CAD Software Engineer
job_description:
This role is for a CAD/CAM Engineering Developer responsible for designing,
developing, customizing, testing, and maintaining engineering software solutions
on proprietary/OEM CAD, PLM, or CAE platforms (e.g., CATIA V5, 3DEXPERIENCE or
similar in-house/proprietary CAD systems). The developer will work with C, C++,
vendor-specific SDKs/APIs and frameworks (such as CAA, RADE or equivalent), and
other OEM proprietary applications in related engineering domains. Key
responsibilities include building CAD and Engineering automation solutions,
Customization, geometry and topology operations, feature modeler extensions,
custom data structures, and PLM-integrated engineering applications.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Develop and maintain custom applications on a proprietary CAD/CAM/PLM
   platform using C, C++, vendor SDKs/frameworks, Object Modeler-style
   architectures, and related development toolkits.

 * Design, document, and implement interface-based components, custom commands,
   dialogs, state-machine workflows, and reusable modules.

 * Design, implement, and optimize C, C++ data structures (e.g., trees, graphs,
   hash maps, linked lists, custom containers) to efficiently represent and
   manipulate CAD geometry, topology, and engineering data.

 * Work with CAD document structures such as parts, assemblies, drawings,
   containers, and spec-tree/feature-tree objects, regardless of the specific
   proprietary platform used.

 * Build functionality around feature modelers, knowledge-based engineering
   (rules, checks, parameters), catalog management, and user-defined features
   (UDFs).

 * Implement geometric and topological operations using CAD kernel concepts such
   as B-Rep, bodies, faces, edges, wires, transformations, extrude, fillet,
   boolean operations, and surface projections.

 * Support drafting automation where applicable, including drawing generation,
   views, dimensions, and annotations.

 * Configure and manage development of workspaces, frameworks, modules,
   dependencies, and platform-specific build systems (e.g., MS Visual Studio).

 * Debug and troubleshoot CAD software customizations, including native
   debugging, memory leaks, dangling pointers, crashes, and custom DLL issues.

 * Apply strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals, along with
   numerical methods such as linear algebra, trigonometry and transformations
   for CAD/engineering calculations.

 * Work within file-based and PLM/database-driven architectures across COTS and
   proprietary CAD platforms.

 * Support version control, test automation, regression testing, CI/CD build
   automation, and code quality scanning.

Responsibility to adhere to the defined software process models and maintain
JIRA artifacts.


QUALIFICATIONS

Must-haves

 * Around 5+ years of experience in CAD/CAM Engineering development work.

 * Strong C++ proficiency, including object-oriented design, design patterns,
   memory management, pointers, and lifecycle handling.

 * Solid hands-on experience with C++ data structures and their handling —
   arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hash maps/sets, and
   custom containers — along with the ability to choose and implement the right
   data structure for performance-critical CAD operations.

 * Understanding of algorithm complexity (time/space), and ability to write
   efficient, maintainable C++ code for large-scale engineering applications.

 * Prior experience developing on any proprietary/OEM CAD, software platform
   (e.g., CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or an internal/proprietary CAD system) -
   deep expertise in a specific tool is not mandatory, but demonstrated
   experience building customizations, plugins, or extensions on a proprietary
   CAD platform is required.

 * Understanding of object-modeler / interface-based programming concepts,
   including interfaces, implementation classes, and base object/query-interface
   style patterns (e.g., TIE macros, CATBaseUnknown, QueryInterface, or platform
   equivalents).

 * Hands-on knowledge of core CAD framework concepts, especially:
   
   * Object Modeler / Data Model concepts
   
   * Feature Modeler
   
   * Geometric and Topological Modeler (CAD kernel ACIS or Parasolid)

 * Experience with CAD document structures such as parts, assemblies, drawings,
   containers, and spec-tree/feature-tree objects.

 * Familiarity with proprietary CAD SDK/toolkit development environments,
   including workspaces, frameworks, modules, build/dependency management tools
   (MS Visual Studio or platform equivalents).

 * Ability to debug native applications by attaching debuggers to the platform's
   runtime executable (e.g., CNEXT.exe, 3DEXPERIENCE.exe, or equivalent).

 * Experience with VBA, scripting languages (e.g., CATScript or platform
   equivalents) for automation and batch processing.

 * Knowledge of CAD Kernels and Solid Modelers.

 * Ability to diagnose memory leaks, dangling pointers, crashes, and custom DLL
   issues.

 * Understanding of CAD / geometry concepts, including B-Rep, bodies, faces,
   edges, wires, transformations, and geometric operators.

 * Strong foundation in linear algebra, trigonometry, vectors, rotations,
   transformations, and interpolation.

Nice-to-haves

 * Exposure to Java / JavaScript for backend or dashboard-related extensions on
   PLM platforms.

 * Knowledge of knowledge-based engineering concepts: rules, checks, parameters,
   catalog management, and UDFs.

 * Experience with drafting APIs, drawing generation, 2D views, dimensions, and
   annotation automation.

 * Familiarity with PLM Core APIs (e.g., ENOVIA, Teamcenter, Windchill, or
   equivalent), including open/save operations, lifecycle, session management,
   and versioning.

 * Experience with regression testing tools/frameworks for CAD platforms (e.g.,
   ODTT / mkodt or equivalent).

 * Knowledge of CI/CD automation using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.

 * Experience with static code analysis tools (e.g., mkCheckSource or
   equivalent).

 * Familiarity with CMake or additional build automation tools.

 * Domain exposure in automotive or aerospace engineering, such as BIW,
   powertrain, harness, or related CAD standards. C++ CAD/CAM Development Software Engineering Data Structures Algorithms Geometry Modeling Topology Operations PLM Integration SDK Development API Development Debugging Linear Algebra Object-Oriented Design Memory Management CI/CD Version Control Candidates must have at least 5 years of experience in CAD/CAM development with strong proficiency in C++ and data structures. A bachelor's degree in engineering is required, along with experience in proprietary CAD SDKs and geometric modeling concepts.

title: Senior Fund Administrator
job_description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Fund Administrator - 1 year FTC role.
In this role, you will:
100% of time spent in processing / technical aspects of the process.
Checking all transactions and activities (depending on business requirement, this role may undertake input and processing of transactions, where in that scenario, the relevant checks will be undertaken by another checker of the same level)
Key role for the delivery of a cohesive service to our clients and their investors.
Manage high volume and high value transactions and ensure no trades/activities are missed, which would result in claims and adverse client impact.
Day to day processing of activities within the department to ensure that all tasks are processed in accordance with agreed procedures and controls and in accordance with relevant fund parameters.
Suggest and implement improvements to the Transfer Agency processes and procedures in consultation with the Supervisor.
Process productivity and quality targets are set, monitored and achieved to ensure optimum resource utilization and achievement of business objectives and customer SLA’s agreed with clients.
Problem situations are proactively identified and resolved to give maximum customer satisfaction and escalated where necessary. Appropriate measures are taken to improve quality and prevent recurrence
Establish and maintain effective relationship with clients and teams & identify areas of service improvements
All operations are performed as per laid down procedures and ensure all procedural controls are effectively monitored and adhered.
To be successful you will:
A graduate/ post-graduate diploma or degree in Accounting, Finance and Banking is a must have requirement. Higher qualification not a bar provided aspirations commensurate with the position.
Knowledge of securities industry is essential and preferably experience in handling Mutual Fund investors/investments. Strong computer skills in Excel and Microsoft Word
At least 2-3 years of Prior experience in Transfer Agency & Registrar or Fund services operations is must. In the current role for 12 Months.
Working knowledge and prior experience/understanding of regulations such as CASS (Client Money), IMR (Investor Money regulations, GDPR, FATCA and CRS, CSSF.
Demonstration of strong knowledge of TA Operational Transaction Activity for the UK/Europe/Asia industry specifically Luxemburg Transfer Agency is desirable.
Multi-cultural background or experience, ability to work across broad range of cultures in support of HSBC Group values and objectives
CISI – Chartered Institute for Securities and Investment Certifications
Understanding of Market and Mutual Fund operations desirable
Practical experience of process reviews and re-engineering would be beneficial.
Experience in coaching and mentoring new and junior members of the team is desirable.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Tax Specialist
job_description:
Company Description
Egis Engineering is an independent multi-disciplinary consultancy providing engineering services for the built environment. We are based in the Middle East, India and deliver engineering solutions around the globe. Joining Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. Egis group comes with more than 50 years of experience and a team of 20,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world.
Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
Job Description
Role Purpose:
To manage end-to-end tax compliance for Middle East and South Asia entities while supporting General Accounting within a centralized shared services model
Prepare and review VAT Returns, ensuring accurate & timely filings (UAE, KSA, ZATCA,FTA)
Maintain VAT compliance calendar for all entities
Validate output VAT & Input VAT recoverability
Reconcile VAT GL to VAT Returns; Input VAT to AP Ledger and Output VAT to AR Ledger
Handle VAT treatment for intercompany cross charges and reverse charge mechanisms
Support for tax audits and coordinating with tax authorities (ZATCA and FTA) during audits and discussions.
Determine applicability of Withholding Tax
Validate vendor payments for correct WHT deductions
Prepare Withholding Tax returns
Support corporate tax calculations, deferred tax calculations, posting tax journals in ERP
Perform book to tax reconciliations
Provide audit support, prepare schedules, reconciliation and maintain tax process documents
Role extention towards General Ledger:
Execute month-end close activities: - Accruals, provisions, reclassifications
Perform balance sheet reconciliations (with strong focus on tax accounts)
Validate trial balance accuracy across entities (with strong focus on tax accounts)
Support statutory audits and group reporting
Work within ERP environment (e.g., Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP)
Qualifications
Qualifications
Chartered Accountant (CA) / ACCA
4–8 years of experience in:
Tax (MESA region preferred)
General Accounting (R2R)
Additional Information
Equality, Diversity & Inclusion 
We are an Equal Opportunities employer and we strive to build a workforce that truly reflects the communities we represent. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. If you decide to apply for an opportunity with us, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

Business Line: Shared Services
Type of contract: Permanent contract
Service Line: Shared Services FIN
Region: Middle East and South Asia
Job Family: Tax Tax compliance VAT returns Withholding tax General accounting Oracle fusion cloud ERP Financial reconciliation Statutory audits Group reporting Corporate tax Deferred tax Month-end close Balance sheet reconciliation Tax audits ZATCA compliance FTA compliance Requires a Chartered Accountant (CA) or ACCA qualification. Candidates must have 4–8 years of experience in tax within the MESA region and general accounting.

title: Senior Methodology Engineer – Physical Design Automation
job_description: We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Methodology Engineer to drive the development of advanced Physical Design automation, methodologies, and quality systems for complex SoC and ASIC designs. The ideal candidate will combine strong expertise in the RTL-to-Signoff Physical Design flow with software development skills to build scalable automation frameworks, improve design productivity, and enable high-quality silicon delivery across advanced process technologies. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain automation frameworks supporting the complete RTL-to-Signoff Physical Design flow. Build methodology solutions for synthesis, floorplanning, power planning, placement, CTS, routing, timing closure, and signoff. Create quality checking, validation, and reporting systems for implementation and signoff metrics. Develop scalable tools, scripts, and data pipelines for design analysis, productivity enhancement, and methodology optimization. Collaborate with Physical Design, STA, DFT, RTL, Library, and CAD teams to improve implementation methodologies and design quality. Drive continuous improvements in timing, power, area, congestion, IR/EM, and physical verification closure. Define and maintain best practices, design guidelines, and signoff methodologies across multiple projects. Support advanced-node implementation challenges through innovative automation and data-driven solutions. Required / Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 4+ years of experience in Physical Design, CAD Methodology, or Design Automation. Strong understanding of the complete ASIC/SoC implementation flow from RTL to GDSII Signoff. Experience developing automation solutions using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or C++. Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools and flow customization. Experience with advanced technology nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm, or below). Strong knowledge of hierarchical and top-down design methodologies. Experience in Physical Design flow automation, CAD infrastructure, and methodology development. Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based solutions for EDA automation and productivity enhancement. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Tools & Skills Synopsys: Design Compiler (DC), Fusion Compiler (FC), IC Compiler II (ICC2), PrimeTime (PT),ICV, StarRC Cadence: Innovus, Tempus, Voltus, Pegasus Siemens/Mentor: Calibre DRC, LVS, ERC Programming: Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, C++ Automation: Workflow development, data pipelines, quality dashboards, methodology deployment Physical Design RTL-to-Signoff ASIC SoC Python Tcl Perl Shell C++ Synopsys Cadence Siemens Automation Timing Closure EDA Tools Advanced Nodes Requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Computer, or related engineering fields. Candidates must have at least 4 years of experience in physical design, CAD methodology, or design automation.

Company Description
Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
Job Description
The AR Specialist will play a key role in the Accounts Receivable/Cash Accounting team in Bangalore. Specialist role will be responsible for executing end-to-end cash accounting activities and performing bank reconciliations for French & Eura entities. This role requires meticulous execution, strong attention to detail, and daily collaboration in French
Key responsibilities will include:
Monitor bank accounts and accurately allocate/post incoming cash to customer accounts.
Perform regular bank and treasury tool (Diapason) checks to ensure all transactions are completely posted.
Prepare detailed bank reconciliation statements and resolve reconciling items in a timely manner.
Reconcile customer accounts, match unapplied credits, and request remittances from stakeholders.
Generate Adhoc reports on the direction of the business/onshore teams when required.
Investigate and resolve suspense account items, unapplied cash, and open items in the bank clearing accounts.
Maintain updated Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the specified processes of the assigned entities.
Adhere strictly to timelines, SLAs, KPIs, and compliance standards

B2/C1 level proficiency in French (written and spoken) to seamlessly interact with French-speaking business units.
3+ years of core experience in Accounts Receivable, Cash Application, and Bank Reconciliation processes.
Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
Solid Excel and data handling skills.
Familiarity with Oracle ERP systems or similar enterprise accounting software.
Good time management skills and a proven track record of working to strict deadlines.
Collaborative mindset with an interest in learning and working within a dynamic team
Desirable:
Prior experience utilizing treasury platforms like Diapason.
Experience working in a global shared services environment.

Service Line: Shared Services FIN

title: Software Engineering Associate
job_description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and
supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At
DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are
committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have
the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal
community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world
that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions
that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets.
The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include
development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client
needs and implementing data standards and governance.


 

Pay and Benefits:
 

 * Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 * Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on
   location
 * Pension / Retirement benefits
 * Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when
   needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 * DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote
   (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or
   employee).


 

The Impact you will have in this role:


 

The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and
supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research,
new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance,
or any other activities related to software products used internally or
externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development
process requires in-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging
development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers
work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining
requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Engineering role
specializes in planning, documenting technical requirements, designing,
developing, and testing all software systems and applications for the firm.
Works closely with architects, product managers, project management, and
end-users in the development and enhancement of existing software systems and
applications, proposing and recommending solutions that solve complex business
problems.


 

Your Primary Responsibilities:
 

 * Develop applications in compliance with functional and non-functional
   requirements
 * Construct unit test cases that ensure compliance with functional and
   non-functional requirements
 * Follow design and code standards, contributing to continuous improvement
   discussions
 * Create and maintain system documentation
 * Align risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor
   and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately
 * Contribute to the design of components or individual programs
 * Provide production support for applications as needed
 * Work with subject matter experts reviewing technical designs and
   specifications
 * Apply different software development methodologies dependent on project needs
 * Work with peers to mature ways of working, continuous integration, and
   continuous delivery
 * Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor
   and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

Qualifications:

 * Minimum of 4 years of related experience
 * Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed for Success:


 

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across
all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location,
individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal
opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate
on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender
expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or
disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are
provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or
interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other
benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request
accommodation.

With over 50 years of experience, DTCC is the premier post-trade market
infrastructure for the global financial services industry. From 20 locations
around the world, DTCC, through its subsidiaries, automates, centralizes, and
standardizes the processing of financial transactions, mitigating risk,
increasing transparency, enhancing performance and driving efficiency for
thousands of broker/dealers, custodian banks and asset managers. Industry owned
and governed, the firm innovates purposefully, simplifying the complexities of
clearing, settlement, asset servicing, transaction processing, trade reporting
and data services across asset classes, bringing enhanced resilience and
soundness to existing financial markets while advancing the digital asset
ecosystem. In 2024, DTCC’s subsidiaries processed securities transactions valued
at U.S. $3.7 quadrillion and its depository subsidiary provided custody and
asset servicing for securities issues from over 150 countries and territories
valued at U.S. $99 trillion. DTCC’s Global Trade Repository service, through
locally registered, licensed, or approved trade repositories, processes more
than 25 billion messages annually. To learn more, please visit us
at www.dtcc.com [http://www.dtcc.com/] or connect with us on LinkedIn

application delivery for DTC, NSCC and FICC.  The department also develops and
supports Asset Services, Wealth Management & Insurance Services and Master
Reference Data applications. Software development Unit testing System documentation Technical requirements Application design Continuous integration Continuous delivery Production support Risk mitigation Programming languages Software testing Data standards Governance Infrastructure capabilities Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years of related experience in software development. David Kennedy Recruitment is working with a fast-growing AI technology company serving millions of users worldwide that is seeking to onboard a Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer to join their R&D / Engineering team.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role, helping design, build and scale core applications while working alongside the CTO, Tech Lead, Product Managers and SREs. The company's products include adult/NSFW content, so candidates must be fully comfortable working on them.
Position: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
Location: Europe, Remote
Employment type: B2B engagement

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Ruby on Rails
Collaborate with Product Managers to review requirements and translate specifications into technical solutions
Prepare technical integration plans, development breakdowns and effort estimates
Implement new features and improve existing platform functionality
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code
Take part in pull requests, peer code reviews and testing
Troubleshoot application issues and improve reliability, performance and scalability
Contribute to technical decision-making and product roadmap discussions
Experiment with technologies and approaches that improve product functionality and user experience
Work with distributed engineering, infrastructure and product teams
REQUIREMENTS:
5+ years' commercial experience as a Backend or Full-Stack Software Engineer
Strong, recent hands-on Ruby on Rails experience in production
Ability to independently design and implement complex backend features
Experience on applications serving thousands or more monthly active users, with an understanding of building reliable, scalable systems
Experience in technology scale-ups, startups or similarly agile environments, comfortable with changing priorities and tight deadlines
Proven ability to take features from requirements through development, testing and production
Excellent spoken and written English, and comfortable working with international remote teams
Based in Europe, with CET ±3 hours working overlap
Fully comfortable working on AI companionship products involving uncensored and NSFW content
BENEFITS:
100% remote working, with a B2B contract
20 working days of paid time off annually
Annual company gathering
Health and wellbeing support
Learning and professional development budget
Company laptop and equipment support
Access to AI development tools, including Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT
Direct collaboration with experienced engineering leadership and the chance to influence technical decisions
And many more!!! title: Manager - Compliance
job_description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
InMobi Advertising
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
Who are we and What do we do?
InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.
What’s the InMobi family like?
Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results-focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.
What do we promise?
We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission-critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training, and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
What you will be doing?
Role - You will oversee and manage the company’s legal compliance program, ensuring that all activities and operations comply with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies. The role requires proactive and strategic thinking with a deep understanding of regulatory frameworks and experience in managing compliance functions effectively.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and manage compliance strategies, policies, and procedures in alignment with legal requirements and organizational goals.
Monitor and interpret regulatory developments and changes in relevant laws affecting the organization.
Identify and assess compliance risks and implement risk mitigation strategies. Conduct regular compliance audits and assessments to ensure adherence to policies and regulations.
Design and deliver compliance training programs for employees at all levels. Foster a culture of compliance and ethical behaviour within the organization.
Prepare and present detailed compliance reports and findings to senior management and regulatory bodies as required.
Collaborate with internal departments, including legal, finance, information security and operations, to ensure comprehensive compliance management.
10 years experience in drafting and understanding of the concepts of Shareholder's agreement, share purchase agreement, debt financing documents.
Strong knowledge of global compliance frameworks and regulations, particularly, Corporate laws, securities laws, Prevention of Insider trading and whistle blower regulations ISO and SOC2.
Good understanding of business operations and ability to align compliance activities with business objectives
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build and lead effective teams
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships
Company Secretary/Bachelors of Law
Why Join Us?
You will contribute to creating disruptive and innovative consumer experiences using technology. We value autonomy, collaboration, technical innovation, and results-oriented thinking. InMobi’s culture is all about rewarding excellence so there are fantastic opportunities for the right candidates!
The InMobi Culture
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more! Compliance strategy Regulatory compliance Risk mitigation Compliance audits Corporate law Securities law Insider trading regulations Whistleblower regulations ISO SOC2 Leadership Stakeholder management Communication Legal drafting Shareholder agreements Debt financing The role requires 10 years of experience in legal documentation and a deep understanding of corporate and securities laws. Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Law or be a Company Secretary and possess strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

title: Sr. Finance Analyst
job_description:
BFS - Sr Finance Analyst – Commercial Finance Analyst 

 

As a Senior Finance Analyst at GBS BFS, you will be instrumental in managing P&L
at the regional/Strategic Business Unit (SBU) /Line of business (LOB) level.
Your responsibilities will encompass analysis and operational oversight,
providing financial insights to support strategic decision-making and enhance
business performance. Core duties include regular financial performance
monitoring, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Additionally, the role involves operational tasks such as accruals and financial
reporting.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Periodic Financial Analysis and Metrics Management: Drive performance to meet
   targets for pricing, orders, revenue, Variable Contribution Margin (VCM),
   fixed costs, free cash flow (FCF), and conversion. Identify opportunities for
   improvement in these areas.
 * Collaboration with Functional Leaders: Work closely with functional leaders
   to support activities such as Pulse, SRO (Short Range Outlook), AOP (Annual
   Operating Plan), and related forecasting processes, ensuring accurate and
   timely financial projections.
 * Lead and participate in monthly sessions with both operations and finance
   leadership to review R&O (risks and opportunities), financial performance,
   address variances, and align action plans.
 * Insight Generation and Financial Analysis: Provide new and valuable insights
   through comprehensive financial analysis, supporting informed decision-making
   and strategic initiatives.
 * Standardization and Automation Initiatives: Promote and implement the
   standardization and automation of financial processes and report to drive
   productivity and operational efficiency across the team.
 * Oversee the timely and accurate completion of recurring deliverables,
   including accruals, intercompany recharges, and the preparation of financial
   reports. Prepare leadership presentations and support monthly operating
   reviews.


QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Certifications

 * Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant/master’s degree in finance, or Business
   Administration
   Required Experience 6+ years of overall finance experience


Critical

 * A Capable finance professional who has the intellectual curiosity and an
   attitude in going above and beyond to partner with the business in commercial
   excellence.
 * Exposure to Global Customers with ability to interact effectively with all
   levels of employees/customers and align and integrate with other departments
   / sites.
 * Strategic Partner with Corporate Finance and Functional leaders to manage
   financial targets for the function.
 * Prior exposure of driving business finance metrics
 * Exposure to Tools like Power BI, Advance excel etc.
 * Knowledge of ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, Essbase, HANA/BW and Hyperion
 * The ability to quickly identify subtle patterns among issues and to make
   consistent, timely decisions
 * Strong cross functional and peer influencing skills.


Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy
of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges,
enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We
serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of
services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies
Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence
layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees
with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned
to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Financial Analysis P&L Management Budgeting Forecasting Variance Analysis Financial Reporting Power BI Advanced Excel SAP Oracle Essbase HANA/BW Hyperion Strategic Planning Cross-functional Collaboration Commercial Finance Candidates must hold a degree in Finance, Business Administration, or be a Chartered/Cost Accountant with at least 6 years of experience. Proficiency in ERP systems like SAP or Oracle and advanced data tools like Power BI is required.

title: Team Leader
job_description:
The Team Leader will play a crucial role in managing and guiding a team of CREs,
who are responsible for customer interactions and collections. This role
involves strategic planning, team motivation, and ensuring a positive customer
experience. The Team Leader will report to the Department Head and work closely
with other departments to align collection efforts with company goals.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Lead and motivate a team of Customer Relationship Executives, fostering a
   positive and productive work environment.
 * Oversee daily operations, ensuring efficient and timely customer service and
   collection processes.
 * Handle complex customer inquiries and complaints, providing effective
   solutions and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
 * Implement and monitor performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement
   and driving team performance.
 * Collaborate with the Department Head and other teams to align collection
   strategies with company objectives.
 * Conduct regular team meetings, providing feedback, and facilitating open
   communication channels.
 * Train and mentor team members, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary
   skills and knowledge.
 * Stay updated on industry trends and best practices, implementing innovative
   approaches to enhance collection efficiency.
 * Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, maintaining a high
   standard of professionalism.
 * Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including
   clients and internal teams.


QUALIFICATIONS

 * A minimum of 5 years of experience in a leadership role, preferably in a
   customer-facing or collections environment.
 * Proven track record of successfully managing and motivating teams, with a
   focus on customer satisfaction.
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build
   strong relationships.
 * Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a data-driven approach
   to decision-making.
 * Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) systems and
   relevant software.
 * Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced
   environment.
 * Excellent organizational skills, with a focus on attention to detail and
   accuracy.
 * Strong leadership qualities, including the ability to inspire and mentor team
   members.
 * A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a willingness to adapt to
   changing circumstances.
 * A relevant degree in Business Administration, Customer Service, or a related
   field is preferred.

Egis Engineering is an independent multi-disciplinary consultancy providing engineering services for the built environment. We are based in the Middle East, India and deliver engineering solutions around the globe. Joining Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. Egis group comes with more than 50 years of experience and a team of 20,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world.
Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
Job Description
The Finance Controller will manage the General Accountants team in Bangalore and will be responsible for processing clear reconciliations and a group of reports on behalf of multiple entities around the group in multiple regions. This is an integral role and requires accurate execution, and a strong attention to detail and a good understanding of the figures.
Key responsibilities will include:
Manage the team to address all performance issues
Liaise with Regional SSC contacts as a key point of contact
Perform reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
Develop, Produce and review various business reports
Support month end closing · Participate in process improvement activities
Review Inter-company reconciliations and work with GSSC to generate missing postings
Take ownership of various balance sheet reconciliations
Participating in P&L Analytics, Forecasting, Budgeting and providing the walk to Senior finance leadership

Essential:
Qualified Accountant
Management experience
Attention to detail
Strong excel and data handling skills
Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Familiar with Oracle ERP system
Experience of working to deadlines
Ability to challenge the numbers and explain variances

Must Have- CA Qualified [Chartered Accountant] or
MBA-Finance & Accounts from Tier 1 Institutes
Desirable: · French language skills if possible

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

If you decide to apply for an opportunity with us, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

Business Line: Shared Services
Type of contract: Permanent contract
Service Line: Shared Services FIN
Region: Middle East and South Asia
Job Family: Accounting and Consolidation Financial reporting Reconciliations Team management Oracle ERP P&L analytics Forecasting Budgeting Data handling Stakeholder engagement Month end closing Balance sheet reconciliation Inter-company reconciliation Financial analysis Process improvement Communication skills Candidates must be a qualified Chartered Accountant or hold an MBA in Finance from a Tier 1 institute. title: Deputy Modeler to Lead Modeler- BIM - Site Civils & Roads (Multi-D Projects)
job_description:
Company Description
AECOM’s Enterprise Capabilities team is looking for a Deputy Modeler to Lead Modeler- BIM - Site Civils & Roads (Multi-D Projects) to join our team in Bengaluru/Gurugram.
About Enterprise Capabilities
Fundamental to our Think and Act Globally strategy and digital adoption, Enterprise Capabilities (EC) is AECOM’s primary vehicle for workshare. Operating across geographic boundaries and time-zones, EC partners with regional and Global Business Line project teams to provide technical expertise, accelerate delivery and keep AECOM competitive in the industry. 
With a team of over 3000 technical professionals located across nine countries and remote technical anchors, EC teams are trusted to deliver high-quality, specialist services that help to fill capability gaps, resourcing needs and technical constraints on projects of all scopes and sizes. 
Job Description
We are looking for Site Civils/Roads/Data centers/Multi -Disciplinary experience staff at various levels who have worked on global design projects with strong hands-on experience in Autodesk Civil 3D and/or Bentley OpenRoads Designer (ORD) to develop and coordinate high-quality 3D BIM models and engineering deliverables.
Key Responsibilities
Develop detailed 3D models for Site Civils/Roads/Data centers/Multi -Disciplinary experience.
Create and manage alignments, profiles, surfaces, corridors, templates/assemblies, superelevation, site grading and cross-sections.
Model drainage and utilities including stormwater, sewer, ducts, electrical, telecoms and other services.
Develop and maintain accurate BIM models in accordance with project BIM standards, BEP and ISO 19650 requirements.
Perform multidisciplinary model federation and BIM coordination across highways, drainage, utilities, structures and other disciplines.
Carry out 3D clash detection using Navisworks or equivalent platforms, identify conflicts and support resolution and closure.
Perform 3D solid extraction from Civil 3D/ORD models for BIM coordination, clash detection, quantity verification and downstream applications.
Ensure extracted solids and federated models maintain correct geometry, coordinates and model integrity.
Produce plans, profiles, sections, details, schedules and model-based deliverables.
Perform model health checks, self-checking and BIM/CAD QA/QC.
Manage references, model revisions, naming conventions and information exchange through CDE platforms.
Coordinate with engineers, BIM coordinators, designers and other disciplines to resolve modelling and design issues.
Support model-based quantities, constructability reviews and digital engineering workflows.
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, BIM coordinators, designers and project stakeholders.
Ability to clearly communicate technical issues, modelling constraints, clashes and proposed solutions.
Good interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams.
Software & Technical Skills
Essential:
Autodesk Civil 3D
Bentley OpenRoads Designer
AutoCAD / MicroStation
3D BIM Modelling
Clash Detection & Model Coordination
3D Solid Extraction
Navisworks
ProjectWise / Autodesk Construction Cloud
Desirable:
Dynamo
BIM/CDE workflows
ISO 19650
International highway and infrastructure standards
Preferred Candidate
A hands-on Civil Infrastructure BIM Modeler capable of developing coordinated road, highway, drainage and utility models, performing clash detection and 3D solid extraction, and supporting BIM coordination and model-based deliverables.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related Civil/Infrastructure Engineering discipline.
Essential Experience
3+ years of experience.
Strong understanding of civil 3D modelling and multidisciplinary BIM coordination.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and survey information.
Experience producing accurate, coordinated models and drawings to project standards.
Strong QA/QC, problem-solving and coordination skills.
Ability to work independently and deliver to tight project deadlines.
Additional Information
At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity
Our Freedom to Grow hybrid working philosophy is the cornerstone of our success as a business – supporting a culture of flexibility, trust and performance at AECOM.
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM 
AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. 
AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. 
What makes AECOM a great place to work 
You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. 
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
